title: New U.S. threat of sanctions are bad for global economy - Le Maire
description: New tariff threats by the United States on certain French products are bad for the global economy, and France is counting upon the solidarity of its European partners as it looks to challenge the move, the French finance minister said.

title: U.S. vows 100% tariffs on French Champagne, cheese, handbags over digital tax
description: The U.S. government on Monday said it may slap punitive duties of up to 100% on $2.4 billion in imports from France of Champagne, handbags, cheese and other products, after concluding that France's new digital services tax would harm U.S. tech companies.

title: Bamboo Airways to take delivery of first Boeing Dreamliner this month
description: Vietnamese startup Bamboo Airways said on Tuesday it will take delivery of a Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner  this month, its first wide-body aircraft, and aims to start direct flights to the United States by early 2021.

title: U.S. may increase tariffs after WTO rejects EU claims over Airbus
description: The World Trade Organization on Monday rejected European Union claims that it no longer provides subsidies to planemaker Airbus , prompting the United States to say it could increase retaliatory tariffs on a wider range of European goods.

title: Volkswagen headquarters raided again over diesel scandal
description: German public prosecutors raided the Wolfsburg headquarters of Volkswagen  on Tuesday in the latest investigation into the carmaker's diesel emissions scandal.

title: China to release 'unreliable entity list' soon: Global Times tweet
description: China will release an "unreliable entity list" soon, which includes relevant U.S. entities, Global Times Business said http://bit.ly/2ReSCmG in a tweet on Monday, citing an unnamed source.

title: PG&E says its distribution lines caused no deadly fires in 2019
description: California utility PG&E Corp  has determined there were  no lives or structures lost in 2019 wildfires that may have been caused by its distribution lines, according to a Friday court filing.

title: U.S. has not ruled out imposing tariffs on imported autos: Commerce chief
description: U.S. Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross said on Tuesday the Trump administration has not ruled out imposing tariffs on imported autos, after letting a review period end in November with no action.

title: United orders 50 new Airbus long-range jets to replace Boeing 757s
description: United Airlines Holdings Inc  announced on Tuesday an order for 50 Airbus SE  A321XLR jets to fly between the U.S East Coast and Europe, becoming the latest U.S. airline to ink a deal for the European planemaker's new passenger jet.

title: WTO tussles over hard stop vs phase-out of appeals system
description: The World Trade Organization (WTO) battled on Tuesday over whether to bring its Appellate Body to an abrupt halt or allow its adjudicators to settle a handful of pending cases, according to trade officials present at a meeting on the subject.

title: Exclusive: White House considered kicking Huawei out of U.S. banking system - sources
description: The Trump administration considered banning China's Huawei from the U.S. financial system earlier this year as part of a host of policy options to thwart the blacklisted telecoms equipment giant, according to three people familiar with the matter.

title: Former Bumble Bee tuna CEO found guilty of price fixing
description: The former chief executive of Bumble Bee Foods LLC, Chris Lischewski, was found guilty of price-fixing on Tuesday, a court filing showed.

title: Huawei urging suppliers to break the law by moving offshore: Ross
description: China's telecoms giant Huawei has been encouraging its suppliers to violate U.S. law by telling them to move operations offshore in a bid to avoid U.S. sanctions, Commerce Department Secretary Wilbur Ross told Reuters on Tuesday.

title: Proper U.S.-China trade deal more important than timing: U.S. Commerce chief
description: U.S. Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross on Tuesday rejected any deadlines on a trade deal with China and launched a fresh attack on telecoms giant Huawei, further dimming hopes for an end to a 17-month trade war that has slowed global growth.

title: U.S. judge disqualifies Huawei lawyer from fraud, sanctions case
description: A U.S. judge on Tuesday disqualified James Cole, a Washington lawyer for China's Huawei, from defending the telecommunications equipment maker against charges of bank fraud and sanctions violations.

title: France fights back over U.S. tariff threat to champagne, cheese
description: France and the European Union said on Tuesday they were ready to retaliate if U.S. President Donald Trump acted on a threat to impose duties of up to 100% on imports of champagne, handbags and other French products worth $2.4 billion.

title: Factbox: Trump has upended relationships with nine of 10 top U.S. trading partners
description: During his election campaign in 2016, U.S. President Donald Trump promised to shake up global trade and bring down America's growing trade deficits.

title: Trump says China trade deal may have to wait amid sticking points in talks
description: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday a trade deal with China might have to wait until after the U.S. presidential election in November 2020, denting hopes that the two largest economies would soon reach an initial deal to ease their damaging trade war.

title: U.S. solar group says Trump tariffs killing jobs; White House says 'fake news'
description: The U.S. solar industry warned on Tuesday that the Trump administration's tariffs on imported panels will cost the United States 62,000 jobs and $19 billion (£14.81 billion) in investment, an estimate the White House dismissed as "fake news".

title: Alphabet's new CEO Pichai now sole target on Google regulatory battles
description: Alphabet Inc's new chief executive, Sundar Pichai, will have the hot seat all to himself as regulators around the world investigate the company, U.S. politicians demand that it be broken up, and President Donald Trump accuses it of aiding his rivals.

title: Elon Musk's tweets bring controversy, nearly 30 million followers
description: Trial began in U.S. District Court in Los Angeles on Tuesday in a defamation lawsuit brought against Elon Musk by British cave diver Vernon Unsworth over three July 15, 2018 tweets by the Tesla chief executive, one calling him "pedo guy."

title: U.S. shoppers, mostly online, spend 16% more over holiday weekend
description: A record number of U.S. consumers spent more online and in stores over the holiday weekend for everything from clothing to toys, the National Retail Federation said on Tuesday.

title: Elon Musk's jury to be queried on opinions of billionaires, visitors to Thailand
description: Potential jurors in the defamation trial of high-tech entrepreneur Elon Musk may be excused from the case if they voice strong feelings about billionaires or people who visit Thailand.

title: Johnson & Johnson says new tests show no asbestos in Johnson's Baby Powder
description: Johnson & Johnson said on Tuesday that recent tests showed that Johnson's Baby Powder was free of asbestos, after U.S. Food and Drug Administration investigations reported trace amounts of the material in the product earlier this year.

title: Brazilian investor group Abradin files complaint against Embraer-Boeing deal
description: A Brazilian group representing minority investors filed a complaint on Tuesday with Brazil's antitrust watchdog CADE against the Embraer-Boeing deal.

title: Safran CEO cautious on supply chain once Boeing grounding lifted
description: The head of French jet engine maker Safran  has voiced caution over the ability of aerospace supply chains to ramp up quickly after the return to service of the Boeing 737 MAX, which has been grounded for months following two fatal accidents.

title: Stocks fall, bonds climb amid concern over longer trade war
description: A comment by President Donald Trump that a deal to end the U.S.-China trade war might not come until after the November 2020 election weighed on global stock markets on Tuesday, sending investors to the safety of bonds.

title: Goldman Sachs to launch new products and services on Amazon's cloud
description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc will be launching new technology-based products and services for its institutional clients on Amazon's cloud next year, bank Chief Executive David Solomon said at a conference on Tuesday.

title: Fidelity Investments names new head of $3 trillion asset management division
description: Fidelity Investments on Tuesday named Bart Grenier, who was at the center of a tickets scandal at the mutual fund company more than a decade ago, to lead its nearly $3 trillion asset management division.

title: Glencore's Glasenberg says successor could be in place next year
description: Glencore could announce a new chief executive next year once a new management team is in place, its current boss told an investor meeting on Tuesday as the commodities giant laid out its priorities for 2020.

title: McLaren looks to Asia and hybrid cars to stay on track
description: British exotic sports car maker McLaren Automotive will bank on expanded sales in Asia and a new generation of hybrid cars as it steers toward a potential public offering, the company's chief executive said on Tuesday.

title: France's Safran and Germany's MTU to work on new fighter engine
description: France's Safran  and MTU Aero Engines  of Germany have agreed to develop together a jet engine for a Franco-German fighter, removing a key obstacle to one of Europe's flagship defence projects.

title: French Champagne makers fear impact of potential new U.S. duties
description: French champagne producers and exporters decried a U.S. government threat to slap tariffs of up to 100% on a range of French products including sparkling wines, saying they have nothing to do with the dispute and calling for government help.

title: Amazon partners with Verizon on 5G in cloud computing expansion
description: Amazon.com Inc on Tuesday said it was extending its cloud to 5G networks in partnership with Verizon Communications Inc, so developers can run latency-sensitive programs on mobile and connected devices.

title: Xiaomi, Oppo to use Qualcomm's newest mobile phone chips
description: Two fast-growing Chinese phone brands said on Tuesday that they will adopt Qualcomm Inc's  newest 5G chip in their flagship devices early next year.

title: Workday third-quarter profit, revenue beat; shares rise
description: Workday Inc beat Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit and revenue on Tuesday, and raised its full-year forecast for sales in its biggest business, as more companies signed up for its cloud-based financial and human resources management software.

title: Safran suspends electric jet taxiing project after Airbus ends talks
description: France's Safran SA  has shelved plans to install an electric taxiing system on Airbus  A320 jets after the planemaker halted discussions on the project, it chief executive said.

title: Thyssenkrupp presents 'complex' turnaround plan for steel - workers
description: Ailing conglomerate Thyssenkrupp  has worked out a new strategy for the group's steel business, a leading labor representative said on Tuesday, adding the roadmap included significant investments but also restructuring steps.

title: Oil steadies after slide on Trump's U.S-China trade comments
description: Oil steadied on Tuesday, settling narrowly mixed as expectations of output cuts from OPEC and allied producers helped prices bounce after a slide following comments from U.S. President Donald Trump that a trade deal with China may be delayed.

title: Wall Street falls as trade hopes wane
description: U.S. stocks sold off for a third consecutive session on Tuesday after comments from President Donald Trump and Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross threw cold water on hopes of a possible near-term respite from the market-bruising U.S.-China trade war.

title: British VW drivers launch 'dieselgate' case in High Court
description: Tens of thousands of British drivers on Monday accused Volkswagen  of fitting devices to cheat clean air laws at the start of the country's biggest class action lawsuit brought to tackle "dieselgate".

title: New Nissan CEO rules out closer capital ties with Renault
description: Nissan Motor Co  is committed to its automaking  alliance with Renault SA  but will not look to deepen its capital ties with the French automaker any time soon, its new CEO said on Monday.

title: Saudi Arabia wants OPEC+ to deepen oil cuts due to Aramco IPO
description: OPEC and its allies plan to deepen oil cuts and have the deal in place so it runs at least until June 2020 as Saudi Arabia wants to deliver a positive surprise to the market before the listing of Saudi Aramco, two sources familiar with the talks said.

title: Italy's FIOM union says new models needed for full employment at FCA's Turin plant
description: Italian metalworker union FIOM on Monday called on Fiat Chrysler  to come up with new car models to be produced in its home town of Turin to ensure the Mirafiori plant there reaches full employment.

title: Black Friday sales in Britain jump 16.5% by value: Barclaycard
description: The value of Black Friday sales in Britain jumped 16.5% compared with last year, according to data from payments firm Barclaycard, in a much needed boost for the country's retailers.

title: WTO rules that EU continues to provide unfair Airbus subsidies
description: The World Trade Organization (WTO) ruled on Monday that the European Union continues to provide unfair subsidies to European planemaker Airbus , supporting the U.S. case for retaliatory tariffs.

title: U.S. factory sector contracts again in November: ISM
description: The U.S. economy's manufacturing sector contracted for a fourth straight month in November as new order volumes slid back to around their lowest level since 2012, according to an industry report released on Monday.

title: Exclusive: U.S. digs deeper into Deutsche role in Danske money laundering scandal - sources
description: The U.S. Department of Justice has in recent weeks stepped up its investigation into Deutsche Bank's role in the 200 billion euro ($220 billion) Danske Bank money laundering scandal, four people familiar with the inquiry told Reuters.

title: Hong Kong Airlines told to improve finances or risk losing license
description: Hong Kong Airlines, controlled by cash-strapped Chinese conglomerate HNA Group, must shore up its financial position by Dec. 7 or risk the suspension or loss of its license, a Hong Kong air transport regulator said on Monday.

title: Renault close to finalizing shortlist for new CEO: Senard
description: French carmaker Renault  is close to finalizing the shortlist of names for the post of chief executive and could complete the shortlist before the end of the year, said Renault chairman Jean-Dominique Senard on Monday.

title: Saudi exchange to limit Aramco index weighting with cap
description: Saudi Arabia's Tadawul has introduced an equity index  cap of 15% which is set to address concerns over the weighting oil giant Saudi Aramco will have when it lists on the exchange.

title: U.S.-China trade deal 'stalled because of Hong Kong legislation': Axios
description: A trade deal between United States and China was now "stalled because of Hong Kong legislation", news website Axios reported on Sunday, citing a source close to U.S. President Donald Trump's negotiating team.

title: Euro zone factory activity shrank in November but worst may be over: PMI
description: Euro zone manufacturing activity contracted for a 10th straight month in November although the bloc's battered factories may have turned a corner as forward-looking indicators in Monday's survey appear to have passed a nadir.

title: China's facial recognition rollout reaches into mobile phones, shops and homes
description: China on Sunday put into effect new regulations that require Chinese telecom carriers to scan the faces of users registering new mobile phone services, a move the government says is aimed at cracking down on fraud.

title: China picks new leaders for Macau, replaces economy chief
description: China has appointed a slate of new officials to head the world's top gambling hub of Macau, changing key roles including the city's economy and justice secretaries.

title: Burst of social unrest tests emerging market risk models
description: A wave of social unrest across developing countries this year has caught many investors off-guard and is challenging models designed to gauge political risk for investors, prompting some to pull money out.

title: UBS Asset Management bullish on emerging market equities, debt
description: The United States' economic outperformance will wane, the dollar will probably weaken and growth next year can be expected from emerging markets, UBS Asset Management said on Monday, the latest money manager to turn bullish on the sector.

title: Britain's competition watchdog reviewing Google's Looker buyout deal
description: Britain's competition watchdog on Monday said it was probing Google's $2.6 billion buyout of privately held big-data analytics firm Looker Data Sciences.

title: China's factory activity surprises with fastest expansion in three years: Caixin PMI
description: China's factory activity showed surprising signs of improvement in November, with growth picking up to a near three-year high, a private sector survey showed on Monday, reinforcing upbeat government data released over the weekend.

title: U.S. Attorney says government can still seek to take auto workers union control: Detroit News
description: The U.S. government may still seek to take control of the United Auto Workers Union (UAW) once its investigators determine the depths of corruption in the union, U.S. Attorney Matthew Schneider said in an interview with Detroit News on Sunday.

title: Off the radar: U.S. CEOs' jet perks add millions to corporate tax bills
description: As U.S. corporate jet use approaches pre-financial crisis levels and chief executives take an increasing number of personal trips on the company tab, many investors are being kept in the dark about the true cost of the perk.

title: UAW announces financial reforms as U.S. corruption probe widens
description: The United Auto Workers (UAW) union said on Monday it would implement stringent changes to its financial procedures and processes in response to a widening corruption probe from U.S. prosecutors.

title: U.S. oil output growth slows: just how much is anyone's guess
description: U.S. oil producers could expand daily output by 1 million barrels next year, or by as little as 100,000 barrels, with the wide gap creating huge uncertainty as OPEC officials gather this week to weigh production curbs.

title: FAA chief to testify at Dec. 11 U.S. House hearing on grounded Boeing 737 MAX
description: The head of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will testify on Dec. 11 before a U.S. House panel on the agency's review of the grounded Boeing 737 MAX, which was involved in two fatal crashes in five months.

title: U.S. stocks retreat on economy and trade jitters
description: Wall Street stepped back from last week's record highs on Monday, with weak U.S. manufacturing data and fresh trade worries keeping buyers on the sidelines.

title: U.S. Cyber Monday sales to hit record $9.2 billion
description: Cyber Monday sales were on course to bring in a record $9.2 billion, according to evening estimates, building on a bumper Black Friday weekend for U.S. retailers driven by earlier-than-usual promotions and free shipping.

title: U.S. says sees no reason to reduce tariffs in EU aircraft subsidy case
description: The U.S. Trade Representative's office on Monday said it saw no basis in Monday's World Trade Organization report that would justify reducing U.S. retaliatory tariffs by $2 billion as Europe's Airbus  has suggested.

title: Huawei plans to shift research center to Canada from U.S.: Globe and Mail
description: Huawei Technologies Co Ltd plans to shift its research center to Canada from the United States, Ren Zhengfei, the founder of the Chinese telecoms equipment maker, said in an interview with Canada's Globe and Mail.

title: States fight bonus pay for CEO of OxyContin maker Purdue
description: The chief executive officer of OxyContin-maker Purdue Pharma LP should not collect a potential $1.3 million bonus when he has been accused of contributing to the opioid epidemic, a group of state attorneys general said in a court filing on Monday.

title: Britain's Reckitt Benckiser gives new parents more paid leave
description: British household goods maker Reckitt Benckiser Group Plc  said on Tuesday it was extending its paid leave globally for new mothers from 16 weeks to 26 weeks, but the change will take time to implement in the United States due to regulatory issues.

title: Exclusive: Brazil's Odebrecht in talks to stave off Braskem sale, keep payout - sources
description: Creditors of Brazil's Odebrecht SA are in advanced talks to let the corruption-ensnared conglomerate keep its crown jewel asset, listed petrochemical company Braskem SA , for another two years, retreating from their prior demand for a quick sale, two sources with knowledge of the matter said.

title: Wells Fargo adds more external bankers to top ranks
description: Wells Fargo & Co said on Monday Scott Powell will become chief operating officer, the second external recruit to join the top ranks since Chief Executive Charles Scharf took over six weeks ago.

title: UnitedHealth forecasts 2020 earnings, midpoint below estimates
description: Health insurer UnitedHealth Group  on Monday issued its adjusted earnings forecast for 2020, the midpoint of which was below analysts' estimates.

title: Trump's tariff ambush risks pushing Brazil closer to China
description: U.S. President Donald Trump's surprise decision to slap metals tariffs on Brazil is a blow to President Jair Bolsonaro's aim of forging closer ties with Washington and could push Latin America's No. 1 economy closer to Trump's top trade foe - China.

title: Dollar, stocks slide on Trump tweets, dour PMI data
description: The dollar and global stock markets fell on Monday after U.S. President Donald Trump said he would restore tariffs on some imports from Brazil and Argentina, with losses exacerbated by a slide in new U.S. factory orders in November to their lowest since 2012.

title: Zuckerberg denies that Trump tried to lobby against ban on political ads: CBS
description: Facebook Inc  Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg said in an interview to CBS on Monday that U.S. President Donald Trump did not discourage him from banning political ads on the social media platform during a secret meeting in October.

title: Large investor lays out $31 million options hedge against U.S. stock market drop
description: Monday's slide in U.S. stocks prompted at least one large investors to load up big on stock options that would guard against a sharper hit to stocks into the start of next year.

title: Cosmetics maker Natura urges Brazil to protect Amazon after fires hit suppliers
description: Brazilian cosmetics maker Natura & Co  is pressing government officials, the private sector and local communities to bolster environmental protections in the Amazon after fires this year disrupted its supply chain, its chief executive told Reuters.

title: Apple fails to end MacBook 'butterfly' keyboard class action
description: A federal judge on Monday rejected Apple Inc's  bid to dismiss a proposed class action lawsuit by customers who said it knew and concealed how the "butterfly" keyboards on its MacBook laptop computers were prone to failure.

title: Oil futures edge up on talk of further OPEC+ supply curbs
description: Oil futures gained about 1% on Monday on hints the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) and its allies may agree to deepen output cuts at a meeting this week and as rising manufacturing activity in China suggested stronger demand.

title: Exclusive: Former Honeywell CEO in bid talks for Vertiv - sources
description: A company led by former Honeywell International Inc  chief executive David Cote and backed by Goldman Sachs Group Inc  is in talks to acquire U.S. backup power equipment firm Vertiv for more than $5 billion, including debt, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: FCC chair, Democrats call on Congress to reverse planned spectrum sale
description: The chair of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on Monday joined several Democratic senators in urging the cancellation of an auction of wireless spectrum used by U.S. law enforcement agencies because of the costs and difficulty of moving them to alternatives.

title: Italy set to grant funds to keep Alitalia afloat: source
description: Italy is set to free up funds for loss-making airline Alitalia on Monday as Rome struggles to find investors to keep it afloat, a political source told Reuters.

title: U.S. manufacturing contracts further, tempers economic growth hopes
description: U.S. factory activity contracted for a fourth straight month in November as new orders slumped back to around their lowest level since 2012, while construction spending fell in October, tempering optimism over the economy that had been fanned by a recent run of upbeat reports.

title: Roku tumbles 15% as Morgan Stanley warns of streaming 'exuberance'
description: Roku Inc's high-flying stock tumbled 15% on Monday after Morgan Stanley downgraded the video streaming company, warning that revenue and profit growth could slow next year.

title: China wants U.S. tariffs rolled back in phase one trade deal: Global Times
description: Beijing's top priority in any phase one trade deal with the United States is the removal of existing tariffs on Chinese goods, China's Global Times newspaper reported on Sunday, amid uncertainty on whether the two sides can end a 17-month trade war that has depressed global growth.

title: Nissan, Renault, Mitsubishi Motors agree to form new venture for advanced R&D: Kyodo
description: The Nissan Motor Co , Renault SA  and Mitsubishi Motors Corp  alliance has agreed to form a new company focused on research and development of advanced automotive technologies, Kyodo News said.

title: Fiat Chrysler reaches tentative labor deal with United Auto Workers
description: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV and the United Auto Workers (UAW) union on Saturday announced a tentative agreement for a four-year labor contract, a boost for the automaker as it works to merge with France's Groupe PSA.

title: Airbus dismisses 16 employees in German compliance investigation
description: Airbus  has dismissed 16 employees without notice in relation to an investigation into the potential misuse of client documents, a spokesman for the group said on Sunday, confirming a newspaper report.

title: China's Nov factory activity unexpectedly expands at quickest pace in almost three years - Caixin PMI
description: China's factory activity unexpectedly expanded at the quickest pace in almost three years in November, with solid increases in output and new orders, a private business survey showed on Monday.

title: United States requests extradition of ex-Autonomy boss Lynch from UK
description: The United States has formally requested the extradition of Michael Lynch, the British tech billionaire who sold his data company Autonomy to Hewlett Packard  (HP) in an ill-fated $11.1 billion deal, to face charges including securities fraud, wire fraud and conspiracy.

title: Many firms have no contingency plans should U.S.-China trade war worsen: DHL survey
description: As the U.S.-China trade war drags into its 16th month and continues to disrupt supply chains, more than one-quarter of multinational firms have not made contingency plans, showed a survey from a subsidiary of courier giant DHL.

title: Tesla move will draw further companies into Germany: state premier
description: Tesla's  announcement earlier this month that it will build its first European factory near Berlin will draw further companies from the electric mobility and energy storage sectors into Germany, a state premier told newspaper Die Welt.

title: Exclusive: EU antitrust regulators say they are investigating Google's data collection
description: EU antitrust regulators are investigating Google's collection of data, the European Commission told Reuters on Saturday, suggesting the world's most popular internet search engine remains in its sights despite record fines in recent years.

title: Black Friday shoppers stay away from stores, make $7 billion-plus splurge online
description: U.S. shoppers made more purchases online on Black Friday than in the mall - hurting traffic and sales at brick-and-mortar stores, according to data that offered a glimpse into what is still one of the busiest shopping days of the year.

title: International stocks to outperform U.S. in 2020: investors
description: Even though the U.S. stock market continues a record-breaking rally that has sent the benchmark S&P 500 index up nearly 25% for the year, investors appear to be looking elsewhere for better values in the year ahead.

title: Facebook issues corrective label on user's post under new Singapore fake news law
description: Facebook  said on Saturday it had issued a correction notice on a user's post at the request of the Singapore government, but called for a measured approach to the implementation of a new "fake news" law in the city-state.

title: Judge will decide on Vivendi request to suspend Mediaset's European plan: source
description: An Italian judge will decide on Vivendi's  request to suspend Mediaset's  pan-European project, as she took note that the two groups failed to settle their long-running dispute, a legal source said on Friday.

title: Beer suds to soap suds: waste alcohol finds use in green detergent
description: The next time you wash your dishes, you could find yourself up to your elbows in soap suds spiked with leftover alcohol, if the world's largest brewer and a environmentally friendly detergent firm have their way.

title: Daimler could face further recalls in Germany due to diesel cheating: magazine
description: German luxury carmaker Daimler  could face further recalls related to manipulated diesel engines in some of its compact car models, weekly magazine Der Spiegel said on Friday, without citing sources.

title: Global funds raise stock allocations at the expense of cash: Reuters poll
description: Global funds recommended switching cash back into equities in November as stocks worldwide rose to near record highs despite a lack of clarity over how, when, or if a truce will be called on the damaging U.S.-China trade war, a Reuters poll showed.

title: Block Friday: French activists try to disrupt discount shopping day
description: Activists staged protests against online retailer Amazon around France on Friday and tried to blockade a shopping mall in Paris, denouncing as rampant consumerism the U.S. Black Friday shopping frenzy that has spread to European shores.

title: Take Five: NATO -- dead or alive?
description: Beneath the birthday bonhomie, tensions will be simmering as the transatlantic military alliance turns 70 and leaders of the 29 member states celebrate near London on Dec. 3-4.

title: Timeline: Twists and turns in Mediaset vs Vivendi TV drama
description: Italian broadcaster Mediaset  and shareholder Vivendi  were negotiating on Friday to find a way to end a three-year legal battle after all-night talks failed to produce a breakthrough, sources said.

title: Euro zone inflation rises quicker than expected in November
description: Euro zone inflation accelerated faster than expected in November on a rise in food and services prices, likely comforting European Central Bank policymakers even if some factors pushing up prices may be only temporary.

title: Oil to be stuck in a rut in 2020 as slowing demand fuels glut: Reuters poll
description: Oil prices will remain subdued in 2020 as growth concerns weigh on demand and fuel a glut of crude, a Reuters poll showed on Friday ahead of production-policy talks among OPEC and its allies next week.

title: Exclusive: Big four auditors face investor calls for tougher climate scrutiny
description: European investors managing assets worth more than 1 trillion pounds ($1.28 trillion) are pressing top auditors to take urgent action on climate-related risks, warning that failure to do so could do more damage than the financial crisis.

title: Renault-Nissan to reboot alliance with new overseer
description: Renault, Nissan and Mitsubishi plan to appoint a general secretary at the helm of their partnership to boost cooperation and reboot joint operations after the departure of former alliance supremo Carlos Ghosn.

title: Farm machinery makers, Brazil banks working on private financing - Deere
description: Agricultural machine manufacturers are working with banks in Brazil to avoid a repeat of slumping sales when public financing is expected to run out next year, the head of the local unit of  U.S. tractor maker Deere & Co told Reuters on Thursday.

title: Exclusive: Brazil, China, UAE firms in second round of bids for Petrobras refineries - sources
description: Brazil's state-controlled oil company Petroleo Brasileiro SA  has selected four groups for the second round of bidding for four refineries up for sale, including China's Sinopec, Abu Dhabi's state investor and two Brazilian firms, according to four people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Britain's Ocado signs technology partnership with Japan's Aeon
description: British online grocer Ocado  has signed a technology partnership with Japan's Aeon  to help the retailer establish an online business, its first deal in Asia.

title: Exclusive: Mexico's Pemex fights in court to suspend clean diesel rule - documents
description: Mexico's state-run oil company Pemex has been fighting for almost a year in court to suspend a rule issued by the previous government, requiring the nationwide sale of clean diesel to start this year, court documents seen by Reuters show.

title: BMW, Great Wall to build new China plant for electric cars
description: BMW  and its partner Great Wall Motor  said they plan to build a plant in China with a capacity of 160,000 cars per year, and which will produce BMW's electric MINI brand and Great Wall Motor models.

title: Indian retailer Future's shares surge as regulator approves Amazon investment
description: Shares in Future Retail Ltd  surged 13% on Friday, after India's antitrust body approved a deal that would give Amazon.com Inc  a minority stake in one of the country's top retail groups.

title: France's PSA to sell stake in smaller Chinese tie-up as sales slide
description: Peugeot maker PSA Group  said it is preparing to sell its 50% stake in an eight-year-old joint venture with Chinese partner Chongqing Changan Automotive  which has struggled with falling sales.

title: Airbus considering production of hybrid airplane by 2035
description: Airbus   is considering producing a hybrid plane by 2035 as it strives for a low emission aircraft, its chief executive said.

title: Top U.S. retailers absorb tariff pressure ahead of holiday shopping season
description: Prices for electronics sold online at top U.S. retailers were up slightly heading into the critical U.S. shopping season, but sites including Walmart Inc  and Amazon.com Inc  have held prices steady for many other popular holiday products despite the pressure from tariffs on Chinese imports.

title: As Juncker bids farewell, new EU executive begins with scrutiny over Luxembourg tax
description: Officials from the new European Commission will discuss an International Monetary Fund study that lists Luxembourg as a world-leading tax haven just days after the former leader of the Grand Duchy departs the EU executive's helm.

title: Singapore tells Facebook to correct user's post in test of 'fake news' laws
description: Singapore instructed Facebook  on Friday to publish a correction on a user's social media post under a new "fake news" law, raising fresh questions about how the company will adhere to government requests to regulate content.

title: Saudi Aramco IPO oversubscribed so far, but not by big margin
description: Saudi Aramco's initial public offering (IPO) was on course to be oversubscribed but not by a huge margin, according to figures released so far by the lead manager before a Dec. 4 close for institutional investors to submit offers.

title: China's factory activity unexpectedly returns to growth in November
description: Factory activity in China unexpectedly returned to growth in November for the first time in seven months, as domestic demand picked up on Beijing's accelerated stimulus measures to steady growth.

title: OPEC November oil output slips before Aramco IPO, policy meeting
description: OPEC oil output has fallen in November as Angolan production has slipped due to maintenance and Saudi Arabia has kept a lid on supply to support the market before the initial public offering (IPO) of state-owned Saudi Aramco, a Reuters survey found.

title: Stocks dip as trade worries halt record rally, dollar falls
description: Oil prices slumped and a gauge of global equity markets on Friday edged away from an all-time high it nearly breached earlier in the week as doubts simmered over the outlook for signing an initial deal to ease U.S.-China trade tensions.

title: Apple 'taking a deeper look' at map policies after calling Crimea part of Russia
description: Apple Inc  is "taking a deeper look at how we handle disputed borders" after it referred to the Russian-annexed Crimean Peninsula as part of Russia in its Maps and Weather apps for Russian users, a company spokeswoman told Reuters on Friday.

title: Factbox: Quotes from shoppers as they scour for the best deals on Black Friday
description: Shoppers headed out to stores across the United States in a quest to score the best Black Friday discounts on everything from handbags to 4K TVs, with early promotions marking the start of a condensed holiday shopping season.

title: Wall Street slips as U.S.-China tensions weigh, investors watch retail
description: Wall Street's major indexes ended Friday's shorter session lower as U.S.-China discord over Hong Kong fueled investor anxiety about trade talks and retail stocks dipped as in-store Black Friday sales appeared to draw smaller crowds.

title: Buffett's Berkshire outbid for Tech Data: CNBC
description: Billionaire investor Warren Buffett was thwarted in trying to spend some of the $128.2 billion of cash at his Berkshire Hathaway Inc, after a private equity firm outbid him to buy technology equipment distributor Tech Data Corp for $5.14 billion, CNBC said on Friday.

title: That frenzied Black Friday crush? Not this year
description: The frenzy associated with Black Friday shopping was missing this year as U.S. retailers offered earlier discounts and more consumers shopped online, though spot checks around the country showed traffic picked up after a sluggish morning.

title: Exclusive: U.S. weighs new regulations to further restrict Huawei suppliers - sources
description: The U.S. government may expand its power to stop more foreign shipments of products with U.S. technology to China's Huawei, amid frustration the company's blacklisting has failed to cut off supplies to the world's largest telecoms equipment maker, two sources said.

title: Nokia says working to end patent licensing row with Daimler, others
description: Nokia  said on Friday it was working to end a row with Germany's Daimler  and other firms which have complained to the EU antitrust regulators about the level of fees charged for technology patents from the Finnish company.

title: Oil slumps but sets monthly gain ahead of OPEC meeting
description: Oil prices fell on Friday, with U.S. crude dropping more than 4%, on fresh trade tensions and record high U.S. crude production, but they still ended the month higher as OPEC watchers expect an extension next week to a pact to throttle oil output beyond March.

title: Musk's defamation trial over 'pedo guy' tweet is narrowed
description: The British cave explorer who sued Tesla Inc's  Elon Musk for branding him "pedo guy" in a tweet has narrowed his defamation case against the electric car maker's chief executive, and is no longer seeking damages for an emailed suggestion he might be a child rapist.

title: Chinese envoy to Canada visits detained Huawei CFO, urges Ottawa to correct 'mistake'
description: China's new ambassador to Canada visited a senior Huawei Technologies Co Ltd official who is fighting extradition to the United States and urged Ottawa to release her, the embassy said on Friday.

title: Judge to rule on Vivendi request to halt Mediaset European TV plan
description: An Italian judge will decide on Vivendi's  request to block Mediaset's  pan-European television project after the two groups failed to settle their long-running dispute, a legal source said on Friday.

title: Daimler to ax at least 10,000 jobs in latest car industry cuts
description: Daimler said on Friday it will cut at least 10,000 jobs worldwide over the next three years, following others in the industry as they cut costs to invest in electric vehicles while grappling with weakening sales.

title: Connected car prices may rise if Qualcomm wins antitrust case: auto makers
description: The cost of cars equipped with ultra-fast 5G wireless technology is likely to go up if microchip supplier Qualcomm Inc's  patent licensing practices fail to change, a trade group representing major automakers and two leading automotive  suppliers said in court filings on Friday.

title: Nissan to roll out high-tech production system amid pressure to cut costs
description: Nissan Motor Co. is introducing a new, higher-tech production system globally to try to boost efficiency as it looks to reverse a slide in profitability.

title: Barclays joins rivals with cuts to CEO pension perks
description: Barclays  is planning to cut the 396,000 pounds  ($508,068) pension allowance it pays Chief Executive Jes Staley by around half, echoing moves by rivals who have pledged to rein in executive pension perks following a campaign by investors.

title: EU lawmakers clear U.S. beef imports but fault U.S. tariffs
description: European Union lawmakers approved an increase in U.S. beef imports to the EU on Thursday, a move likely to ease transatlantic tensions.

title: China reiterates its pledge to lower trade barriers, widen market access: Xinhua
description: China on Thursday reiterated its pledge to further widen market access for foreign capital and lower non-tariff trade barriers, as it aims to boost flagging trade amid a slowing economy and a trade war with the United States.

title: Denmark's Maersk to lay off staff as part of cost cuts
description: Danish shipping group Maersk  said on Thursday it would lay off staff at its main offices in Denmark and in other countries.

title: Panasonic to sell its chip unit to Taiwan's Nuvoton for $250 million
description: Panasonic Corp  said it would sell its loss-making semiconductor unit to Taiwan's Nuvoton Technology Corp  for $250 million as the Japanese electronics giant struggles to lift its profit amid a lack of growth drivers.

title: Labour talks with Lufthansa end without results: cabin crew union
description: Cabin crew union UFO on Thursday said that wage talks it held with Lufthansa  ended without results, adding that it would now prepare for industrial action at the German carrier.

title: China's major shareholders sell A-shares, pressuring markets
description: Business owners and major shareholders are selling down their stakes in listed companies, producing a glut of shares in a market already under pressure from a slowing economy and the impact of the Sino-U.S. trade dispute.

title: After $13 billion levy ruling, future of India's tattered telecom sector hinges on government aid
description: The Indian government's win of a long-contested dispute over telecom fees could end up a Pyrrhic victory, as the billions of dollars in levies now owed are seen as burdens too big to bear for two of the country's three main carriers.

title: Factbox: India's telecom sector on the ropes after $13 billion levy ruling
description: India's telecoms sector has been rocked by a Supreme Court ruling last month that sided with the government in a dispute over how levies are calculated, saddling the industry with a combined $13 billion in fresh debt.

title: China's factory activity seen contracting for seventh month on trade pressure: Reuters poll

description: Venezuela's government and its oil company PDVSA have offered to pay suppliers and contractors into accounts in China using the yuan currency, five people familiar with the matter said.

title: India considers commissions cap for Uber, Ola, unsettling industry

title: Morgan Stanley dismisses traders linked to concealment of multimillion-dollar loss: Bloomberg

description: HP Inc  on Tuesday posted quarterly earnings above analysts' estimates as higher sales of personal computers and workstations helped counter weakness in its printer business.

title: U.S., Canadian and Mexican representatives to meet on Wednesday: Politico
description: U.S., Canadian and Mexican representatives are set to meet in Washington on Wednesday to discuss the trade deal to replace the North American Free Trade Agreement, Politico reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the plans.

title: Exclusive: Hedge fund Citadel's commodities business up about $1 billion for the year - sources
description: Citadel's commodities investments are up at least $1 billion for the year, according to three sources familiar with the matter, helping to drive strong overall performance at one of the world's largest hedge funds.

title: Wall Street crawls to record levels on trade hopes
description: U.S. stocks crawled higher on Tuesday, and all three major Wall Street indexes notched record levels, as upbeat comments by President Donald Trump on trade talks eclipsed some softer-than-anticipated economic data.

title: Uber drives up prices for shared rides, Chicago data reveals
description: How much ride-hailing companies Uber and Lyft charge customers throughout a day is one of the most closely held secrets in Silicon Valley.

title: Factbox: The world's biggest electric vehicle battery makers
description: Asian companies dominate the market for electric vehicle (EV) batteries and they are expanding their production capacity in Europe, China and the United States in a fight to win lucrative contracts from global automakers.

title: Dell cuts full-year revenue forecast on PC chip shortage
description: Dell Technologies Inc  cut its full-year revenue forecast on Tuesday as its PC business grapples with a shortage of chips from Intel Corp , sending its shares down nearly 5% in extended trading.

title: Oil gains, bolstered again by U.S.-China trade talks
description: Oil prices rose on Tuesday after news that U.S. and Chinese officials discussed trade, while predictions for a weekly draw on U.S. crude stockpiles lent some support as well.

title: Fed's Brainard calls for 'flexible' average inflation target
description: The Federal Reserve should move from a strict 2% inflation target to a broad, "flexible" promise that inflation would average that level over time, a key member of the U.S. central bank's board of governors said on Tuesday in one of the most explicit endorsements yet of changes in its monetary policy framework.

title: S&P 500 earnings swoon seen extending to fourth quarter
description: Earnings of companies in the benchmark S&P 500 index are expected to decline in the fourth quarter from the year-earlier period, which would mark a second straight quarterly profit drop, according to IBES data from Refinitiv.

title: U.S. unveils procedure to shield telecom networks from national security threats
description: The United States on Tuesday set out a procedure to protect its telecommunications networks and their supply chains from national security threats, saying it would consider whether to bar transactions on a case-by-case basis.

title: Musk to testify in own defense in defamation trial, his lawyer says
description: Tesla Inc's chief executive, Elon Musk, will testify in his own defense against a defamation lawsuit brought by a British cave explorer, Musk's lawyer said on Monday in U.S. District Court in Los Angeles.

title: Black Friday darker for some retail stocks than others
description: The U.S. holiday shopping period kicking off on Friday may heighten Wall Street's perception of a growing divide between retailers adapting to online sales and those unable to shake their reliance on dwindling shopping mall traffic.

title: Lincoln electric SUV to use Ford-backed startup's 'skateboard' chassis: sources
description: A battery-powered Lincoln SUV, due in mid-2022, will be the first Ford Motor Co  vehicle built on a custom electrified chassis that resembles a skateboard, which was developed by Ford-backed startup Rivian, according to several people familiar with the program.

title: NYSE seeks to let direct listings raise capital in IPO alternative
description: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) said on Tuesday it had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to allow companies going public to raise capital through a direct listing, instead of an initial public offering.

title: U.S.-China trade deal close, Trump says; negotiations continue
description: The United States and China are close to agreement on the first phase of a trade deal, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday, after top negotiators from the two countries spoke by telephone and agreed to keep working on remaining issues.

title: Stocks, oil prices edge up on trade talk optimism
description: Oil prices and a gauge of global stock markets edged higher on Tuesday, lifted by fresh record highs on Wall Street after U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States and China were  close to agreeing on the first phase of a trade deal.

title: Aramco IPO retail subscription at $5.8 billion, says lead manager
description: Retail subscription for Saudi Aramco's initial public offering (IPO) reached 21.77 billion Saudi riyals ($5.8 billion) on Monday, lead manager Samba Capital said.

title: General Electric grabs finance chief from shipping group Maersk
description: A.P. Moller-Maersk's  finance chief Carolina Dybeck Happe will leave the shipping group to take up a similar position at General Electric  early next year, the companies said on Monday.

title: GE brings in shipper Maersk's CFO as finance chief
description: General Electric Co  on Monday named finance head at shipper AP Moller-Maersk  as its new chief financial officer in the latest top-level change aimed at turning around the U.S. industrial conglomerate.

title: Factbox: M&As in vogue for luxury retailers seeking growth
description: Louis Vuitton owner LVMH snapped up U.S. jeweler Tiffany & Co on Monday for $16.2 billion in its largest buyout ever, adding America's biggest luxury name to its stable of brands.

title: Fiat Chrysler has started 90% of planned investments in Italy: executive
description: Fiat Chrysler  has already started 90% of the investments earmarked for Italy, the auto maker's Chief Operating Officer for the EMEA region Pietro Gorlier said on Monday.

title: Brazil minister says it's 'impossible' to put value on Eletrobras privatization
description: Brazil's mines and energy minister said on Monday it is "impossible" to say how much the privatization of state-run power company Eletrobras SA  will raise, despite an earlier government estimate of 16.2 billion reais ($3.84 billion).

title: Saudi Aramco meets ADIA, Abu Dhabi funds in IPO pitch: sources
description: Saudi Aramco's executives met officials of Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) on Monday to discuss a potential investment in the oil giant's share sale that could raise as much as $25.6 billion, three sources familiar with the talks said.

title: Eight electric pickup truck manufacturers to load up U.S. market by 2021
description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk and his spacy Cybertruck have ignited a frenzy over electric pickups, and at least seven other U.S. automakers expect to build new battery-powered trucks by 2021.

title: McDonald's to pay $26 million to settle California wage lawsuit
description: McDonald's Corp agreed to pay $26 million to settle a nearly seven-year-old lawsuit accusing the fast food chain of underpaying U.S. staff at its corporate-owned restaurants in California.

title: China and U.S. moving closer to trade deal, but no agreement on tariff rollbacks: report
description: China and the United States are "moving closer to agreeing" on a "phase one" trade deal, the Global Times, a tabloid run by the ruling Communist Party's official People's Daily, reported on Sunday.

title: MSCI arms all investors with ESG ratings of 2,800 top firms
description: MSCI  published the environmental, social and governance (ESG) ratings of more than 2,800 companies on Monday, giving all asset managers more detail to make their investment decisions.

title: CBS and Viacom to close merger on Dec. 4
description: The all-stock merger of CBS Corp  and Viacom Inc  is expected to close on Dec. 4, the companies said on Monday.

title: Novartis takes on Sanofi, Amgen with $9.7 billion takeover of heart drug maker
description: Swiss drugmaker Novartis  is betting on heart drug prospect inclisiran in a $9.7 billion takeover of The Medicines Co  as it challenges cardiovascular medicines from Amgen Inc , Sanofi  and Regeneron Pharmaceuticals .

title: Just Eat urges shareholders to shun Prosus and stick with Takeaway deal
description: Britain's Just Eat  urged shareholders on Monday to shun a $6.3 billion cash offer from Prosus , saying a currently lower valued deal with Takeaway.com  was a better bet as it would create the largest food delivery firm outside China.

title: No 'phase two' U.S.-China deal on the horizon, officials say
description: An ambitious "phase two" trade deal between the United States and China is looking less likely as the two countries struggle to strike a preliminary "phase one" agreement, according to U.S. and Beijing officials, lawmakers and trade experts.

title: Musk suggests Tesla has 200,000 orders for Cybertruck
description: Tesla Inc  Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk indicated in a tweet on Sunday that the electric carmaker received  200,000 orders for its electric pickup truck within three days of its launch.

title: Blackstone to invest $400 million in gene therapy venture with Ferring
description: Blackstone Group Inc  said on Monday it will invest $400 million in a joint venture with Swiss drug company Ferring that is working on an experimental gene therapy for bladder cancer, the private equity giant's largest ever bet on drug development.

title: Chinese importers scoop up Brazilian soybeans amid U.S. trade uncertainty
description: Chinese buyers scooped up at least 20 cargoes of Brazilian soybeans last week due to uncertainty over a trade deal with the United States that sent them rushing to lock in supplies, traders said on Monday.

description: Uber will appeal Monday's decision by London's transport regulator to strip the firm of its license in the city, saying it has taken steps to change its business model and sets the standard on safety.

title: LVMH swoop on Tiffany will boost operating profits: Chairman
description: Acquiring Tiffany will lift LVMH's operating profits by 500 million to 600 million euros ($661.32 million) in the first 12 months, the luxury goods group's Chairman and Chief Executive Bernard Arnault said on Monday.

title: China's electric vehicle market to see sales rebound next year, executives say
description: China's new energy vehicle (NEV) market is likely to see a sales rebound next year as automakers roll out more new products to lure buyers, but more supportive government policies are needed, auto executives said.

title: SoftBank-backed Paytm raises $1 billion in fresh funding
description: Indian digital payments company Paytm said on Monday it has raised fresh funds from a group of investors including existing backers SoftBank's  Vision Fund and China's Ant Financial Services in a deal valuing the firm at $16 billion.

title: Tesla shares rise as Musk says Cybertruck orders hit 200,000
description: Tesla Inc shares rose 4% on Monday after Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk tweeted over the weekend that the company had already received 200,000 orders for its futuristic Cybertruck pickup.

title: China says it hopes U.S. will work on basis of equality in trade talks
description: China's foreign ministry said on Monday it hopes the United States will work with Beijing on a basis of equality and mutual respect on the ongoing bilateral trade negotiations.

title: Factbox: Uber's legal challenges around the world
description: Uber  was stripped of its London operating license on Monday for the second time in just over two years as the city's regulator said the taxi app had put passenger safety at risk.

title: Americans, not Chinese, pay Trump tariffs: NY Fed study
description: When the Trump administration imposed tariffs on Chinese imports last year, officials insisted China would pay the cost - implying Chinese firms would have to cut their prices to absorb import "taxes" of up to 25% when the goods hit U.S. shores.

title: EBay to sell ticketing unit StubHub for $4.05 billion
description: EBay Inc  will sell ticketing unit StubHub to ticket reseller Viagogo Ltd for $4.05 billion in cash, the companies said on Monday, nearly a year after the ecommerce major came under pressure from activist investors to hive off some of its businesses.

title: AIG to sell 76.6% stake in Fortitude Re for $1.8 billion
description: U.S. insurer American International Group Inc  said on Monday it would sell a major portion of its stake in reinsurer Fortitude Re to buyout fund Carlyle Group  and Japanese insurer T&D Holdings  for about $1.8 billion.

title: Pelosi says U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade deal is 'within range'
description: U.S. House of Representatives Speaker Nancy Pelosi said on Monday that a version of the U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade agreement that House Democrats could back was "within range" but that they needed to conduct a final review.

title: U.S. securities regulator proposes new rules on use of derivatives in exchange traded funds
description: The U.S. securities regulator on Monday proposed new regulations for the use of derivatives by investment funds to introduce some safeguards for more risky products and increase competition.

title: CBS ordered to disclose internal records on Viacom deal
description: A Delaware judge on Monday ordered broadcaster CBS Corp to turn over records regarding its plan to reunite with Viacom Inc to a shareholder who wants to investigate if the deal unfairly benefits Shari Redstone, who controls both companies.

title: Fed's Powell: Monetary policy well positioned to support strong labor market
description: Monetary policy is "well positioned" to support the strong labor market, which is just now starting to benefit workers on the margins, Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell said Monday.

title: Going whole hog: U.S. tells exporters to report pig carcass sales as China buying soars
description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture said on Monday that commodity exporters must disclose sales of hog carcasses, giving officials and traders more insight into a surge of Chinese pork buying that has roiled global meat markets.

title: LVMH aims to restore Tiffany's sparkle with $16.2 billion takeover
description: Louis Vuitton owner LVMH has agreed to buy Tiffany for $16.2 billion in its biggest acquisition yet, as the French luxury goods maker bets it can restore the U.S. jeweller's lustre by investing in stores and new collections.

title: House Democrats see progress on U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade deal, passage possible this year
description: U.S. House Democrats said on Thursday they ironed out some differences with the White House over a trade agreement with Canada and Mexico, and Congress could still vote on the deal - one of President Donald Trump's top priorities - this year.

title: Pelosi says progress was made on USMCA in meeting with Lighthizer
description: U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi said on Thursday that progress was made on the U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade pact in a meeting she held with U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer and Richard Neal, the chairman of the House Ways and Means Committee.

description: (This November 22 story in fifth paragraph, corrects name to Alger from Alger Capital)

description: Uber  was stripped of its license to carry paying passengers in London on Monday for the second time in just over two years, pending an appeal, over a "pattern of failures" on safety and security.

description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co missed Wall Street estimates for quarterly revenue on Monday, hit by lower demand for its servers and storage products, sending its shares down about 4% in trading after the bell.

description: A U.S.-based foundation overseeing promising semiconductor technology developed with Pentagon support will soon move to Switzerland after several of the group's foreign members raised concerns about potential U.S. trade curbs.

title: Wall Street sets records on trade progress optimism
description: Each of Wall Street's three major averages kicked off the trading week with record closes on Monday as signs pointed to progress between the United States and China on a trade truce, while a round of merger deals also helped buoy sentiment.

title: Mexico steps up pressure on U.S. Congress to approve trade deal
description: Mexico's government on Monday ramped up pressure on Democratic lawmakers to approve a new North American trade deal, urging U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to push it through Congress and rejecting demands for greater labor market oversight.

title: Calvin Klein-owner PVH Corp raises FY profit outlook on strong demand in Europe
description: PVH Corp  raised full-year adjusted profit forecast on Monday after its third-quarter results beat Wall Street expectations, powered by higher demand for its Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger apparel in Europe.

title: World share markets rally on revived trade hopes; dollar gains
description: The dollar rose and global equity markets rallied on Monday, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 hitting new highs as investors grew more hopeful the United States and China could soon sign an interim deal to end their trade war.

title: DHL to debut zero-emission electric delivery vans in U.S. cities
description: Deutsche Post DHL Group's StreetScooter electric vehicle unit will enter the U.S. market next year as delivery firms and municipalities work to cut greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Exclusive: Impossible Foods eyes doubling valuation with new funding
description: Impossible Foods Inc, maker of the plant-based Impossible Burger, is in talks with investors about a new round of fundraising that could more than double the $2 billion valuation it attained in May, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: U.S. charges former Outcome Health executives in $1 billion fraud
description: U.S. prosecutors announced criminal charges accusing the founders of Outcome Health of overseeing a scheme to overbill clients and fraudulently obtain nearly $1 billion of funds, including from major investors.

title: Oil climbs on U.S.-China trade talks optimism
description: Oil prices edged higher on Monday as positive comments from the United States and China rekindled hopes in global markets that the world's two largest economies could soon sign an interim deal to end their trade war.

title: Charles Schwab to buy TD Ameritrade in $26-billion blockbuster brokerage deal
description: Charles Schwab Corp  agreed on Monday to buy TD Ameritrade Holding Corp  in an all-stock deal valued at $26 billion, creating a brokerage giant in a market that has been ravaged by price wars.

description: European Union plans to allow more U.S. beef imports cleared a key hurdle on Monday when EU lawmakers specializing in trade backed the move, which is likely to ease transatlantic tensions.

title: Texas, Nevada drop out of state AG group suing to block Sprint, T-Mobile merger
description: Texas' attorney general settled with T-Mobile Inc  and Sprint Corp  and will drop his opposition to the $26.5 billion merger, leaving just Democratic attorneys general fighting the proposed combination.

title: France's LVMH close to buying Tiffany after sweetening offer: sources
description: LVMH  is close to buying U.S. jewelry chain Tiffany & Co  for about $16.3 billion after sweetening its offer, sources said on Sunday, as the owner of Louis Vuitton and Bulgari aims to tap the fast-growing luxury jewelry market.

title: Saudi central bank says Aramco IPO not causing liquidity issues for banks
description: Saudi Arabia's central bank is monitoring banking indicators on a daily basis and is not seeing any impact on liquidity from oil giant Aramco's initial public offering (IPO), its governor said on Sunday.

title: Saudi Aramco won't breach maximum weight for firms in Saudi index: Argaam
description: Saudi Aramco's weighting in Saudi Arabia's main stock index once the oil giant has listed shares is not expected to breach the maximum limit set by the Gulf kingdom's Tadawul exchange, a senior executive said on Sunday.

title: Saudi Aramco markets IPO in Dubai after approaching Kuwait fund
description: Saudi Aramco met investors in Dubai on Sunday to market its initial public offering (IPO), after trying to secure demand from Kuwait's sovereign wealth fund for the deal, worth up to $25.6 billion, which relies heavily on local and regional buyers.

title: Japanese hotel group Unizo gets six new buyout offers
description: Japanese hotel operator Unizo Holdings  said on Sunday it had received six more buyout offers at a price competitive with an existing $1.6 billion bid proposed by Blackstone Group .

title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Conditions may be set for Santa Claus rally
description: (This November 22 story has been refiled to add dropped word in paragraph 12.)

title: Finnair cancels 276 flights as unions join solidarity strike
description: Finland's national airline Finnair  said on Sunday it was forced to cancel 276 flights scheduled for Sunday and Monday after attempts to settle a labor dispute at the Finnish postal service failed, leading several Finnish labor unions to join a solidarity strike on Monday.

title: France's 5G spectrum to be sold at floor price of 2.17 billion euros: minister
description: Frances's 5G spectrum will be sold at a floor price of 2.17 billion euros ($2.4 billion), a minister said on Sunday, significantly more than the amount previously recommended by the country's telecoms regulator Arcep.

title: SoftBank to go ahead with WeWork stock tender offer this week
description: SoftBank Group Corp  will this week launch a previously agreed tender offer for as much as $3 billion of WeWork shares, including up to $970 million owned by the office sharing company's cofounder Adam Neumann, two people familiar with the matter said.

title: HP reiterates its rejection of Xerox's offer to buy the company
description: HP Inc  reiterated on Sunday its rejection of Xerox  Corp's  $33.5 billion cash-and-stock offer for the company, adding that the proposal "significantly undervalues HP."

title: Amazon opens pop-up store on China's Pinduoduo until year-end
description: Amazon.com Inc on Monday said it will open a pop-up store on Chinese e-commerce platform Pinduoduo Inc that will run until the end of December and carry a selection of about 1,000 products from overseas.

title: Exclusive: UniCredit clinches deal to cut exposure to Turkish lender Yapi Kredi - sources
description: UniCredit  has struck a deal to reduce its exposure to Turkey's Yapi Kredi , three sources told Reuters, a move seen as a first step toward the Italian bank's full exit from the recession-hit country.

title: German 5G bidders must guarantee no foreign state meddling: CDU
description: Bidders for German 5G rollout contracts must guarantee the network will be free of foreign state influence, Chancellor Angela Merkel's Christian Democrats agreed on Saturday, stopping short of singling out China's Huawei.

title: China attacks U.S. at G20 as the world's biggest source of instability
description: The United States is the world's biggest source of instability and its politicians are going around the world baselessly smearing China, the Chinese government's top diplomat said on Saturday in a stinging attack at a G20 meeting in Japan.

description: Britain's opposition Labour Party held a rally outside an Amazon  depot on Saturday as it highlights its promise to target multinational firms it accuses of dodging taxes and cheating workers should it win next month's general election.

description: Italy should use ongoing talks over the reform of the euro zone bailout fund, the ESM, to secure something for itself such as the appointment of an Italian to head the fund, Bank of Italy Deputy governor Fabio Panetta said on Saturday.

title: Canada's use of Huawei 5G would hamper its access to U.S. intelligence: U.S. official
description: The U.S. national security adviser urged Canada on Saturday not to use Huawei 5G technology, saying that doing so would put in jeopardy intelligence sharing with the United States and expose Canadians to being profiled by the Chinese government.

title: Still hope for U.S.-China deal this year: U.S. official
description: United States national security adviser Robert O'Brien said on Saturday that an initial trade agreement with China is still possible by the end of the year, but warned Washington would not turn a blind eye to what happens in Hong Kong.

title: Elon Musk: About 150,000 orders thus far for Tesla Cybertruck
description: Tesla Inc  Chief Executive Elon Musk said on Saturday that there have been about 150,000 orders thus far for the electric carmaker's Cybertruck, which was unveiled late on Thursday.

title: Novartis nears deal to buy U.S. biotech firm Medicines Co for about $7 billion: WSJ
description: Swiss drugmaker Novartis AG  is nearing an agreement to acquire U.S. biotechnology firm The Medicines Co  for about $7 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday.

title: Emirates' Clark says Rolls-Royce needs to sort itself out after engine delays
description: The board of Rolls-Royce  must urgently address its engine performance problems, the head of Dubai's Emirates said, as the world's largest buyer of wide-body jets weighs up who will power its order of Boeing  787 jets.

title: Airbnb's Belinda Johnson to step down as COO, join board
description: Airbnb said on Friday Belinda Johnson will step down as chief operating officer in March and join the home rental company's board.

description: British retailer Marks & Spencer  has appointed the chief executive of rival Tesco's  F&F Clothing division to be the boss of its struggling clothing and home business, it said on Friday.

title: South African Airways inks deal to end eight-day strike
description: South African Airways (SAA) signed a wage deal with trade unions on Friday to end an eight-day strike that brought the cash-strapped state airline to the brink of collapse.

description: Tesla Inc  on Thursday unveiled its electric pickup, a truck with a futuristic angular body in gunmetal gray that resembled an armored vehicle and takes aim at the heart of Detroit automakers' profits.

title: Bitcoin plummets to a six-month low on China crackdown
description: Bitcoin slumped to a six-month low on Friday after China's central bank launched a fresh crackdown on cryptocurrencies, warning of the risks entailed in issuing or trading them.

title: Uber still in the dark on London taxi license renewal, three days before expiry
description: Uber is waiting to find out whether its taxi license in London, one of its most important markets, will be renewed, just three days before it is due to expire in the latest stage of a long-running battle with the city's transport regulator.

title: Trump says yet to decide whether to close trade deal with China
description: President Donald Trump said on Friday a potential U.S.-China trade deal was coming along well, but he had yet to decide whether he wanted to finalize it.

title: U.S. factory and services activity quicken in November: Markit
description: U.S. manufacturing output accelerated in November to its fastest pace in seven months and services activity also picked up more than expected, a survey of purchasing managers showed on Friday in a sign of the continued resilience of the U.S. economy in the face of the U.S.-China trade war and other headwinds.

title: Trump, Xi send positive signals on initial deal to defuse U.S.-China trade war
description: The leaders of the United States and China on Friday both underscored their desire to sign an initial trade deal and defuse a 16-month tariff war that has lowered global growth, providing a welcome boost to financial markets.

title: U.S. takes aim at judges pay in new attack on WTO system
description: Judges at the World Trade Organization can earn more than 300,000 Swiss francs tax-free for what is a part-time job, the United States said on Friday, in a fresh onslaught on its beleaguered arbitration system.

title: Peugeot still aims to sign merger deal with Fiat this year: source
description: French carmaker PSA  plans to sign a $50 billion merger deal with Fiat Chrysler Automobiles (FCA)  this year, a source with direct knowledge of PSA's thinking said on Friday, brushing off concerns over a shock lawsuit filed this week.

title: AstraZeneca shares rise on early U.S. approval for leukemia drug
description: AstraZeneca  shares rose 2.7% on Friday after the British drugmaker won earlier-than-expected U.S. regulatory approval for a leukemia drug, in a challenge to rival AbbVie .

description: Makers of aircraft parts are making contingency plans for a prolonged grounding of Boeing's 737 MAX, with several expecting the jet's return to service to take longer than the planemaker hopes.

description: A potential U.S. ban on e-cigarette flavors could result in a loss of more than 150,000 jobs and a direct sales hit of $8.4 billion, according to a report released on Friday by a vaping industry trade group.

description: Technology company Prosus  remains confident about its bid for British meal delivery business Just Eat , Chief Executive Bob van Dijk said on Friday, despite an increase in the value of rival Takeaway.com's all-share bid.

title: Factbox: Tesla, Detroit, Amazon-backed Rivian race to electrify pickup trucks
description: Tesla Inc  debuted its electric pickup truck Cybertruck on Thursday, joining a list of automakers and start-ups that have been working on electrifying pickup trucks - the heart of the Detroit automakers' profits.

title: Battling slowing sales, insurer AIA hires new CEO from rival Ping An
description: Asia-focussed insurer AIA Group Ltd  on Friday named a senior executive at Chinese rival Ping An Insurance Group Co  as its chief executive officer to replace company veteran Ng Keng Hooi.

title: KKR reaches halfway in $3 billion Asia infrastructure fundraising: source
description: Global private equity group KKR & Co  has raised $1.5 billion for its first Asia-focused infrastructure fund, roughly half the total targeted, one person with direct knowledge said.    KKR began to target Asia's infrastructure sector with a series of hires beginning about a year ago and launched its fundraising in 2019.

title: China's Xi: Should strengthen communication with U.S. to avoid misjudgment - Xinhua

description: Auto sales at Ford Motor Co's  China venture with Chongqing-based carmaker Changan  are likely to turn positive next year, Changan’s president said on Friday.

description: The board of Australia's second largest bank on Friday apologized unreservedly for 23 million breaches of money laundering laws, but stood by management despite pressure from politicians to review its leadership.

title: Facebook agrees to provide additional documents in California AG data privacy probe
description: Facebook Inc has agreed to turn over additional documents after the California state attorney general's office went to court this month to compel the social media firm to comply with requests for information in its privacy investigation.

title: Deutsche Bank sues Madoff feeder funds for reneging on $1.6 billion claims sale
description: Deutsche Bank  has sued two offshore funds that funneled money to Bernard Madoff for 14 years, accusing them of reneging on their agreement to sell more than $1.6 billion of claims in the bankruptcy of the swindler's firm.
