title: Lyft sees 'path to profitability' as riders, revenues increase
description: Ride-hailing company Lyft Inc  on Wednesday said higher-than-expected third-quarter revenues and an improved outlook showed it was well on its way to profitability by the end of 2021.

title: The Federal Reserve is waiting for a U.S.-China 'Phase One' trade deal too
description: U.S. trade policy and its impact on business investment, manufacturing and exports were a key factor in the Federal Reserve's decision to cut rates, chair Jerome Powell said Wednesday.

title: U.S. SEC considers relaxing post-crisis structured mortgage product rules
description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Wednesday said it was seeking feedback on whether disclosure rules were discouraging firms from issuing SEC-registered residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS) as the Trump administration seeks to overhaul the U.S. housing finance market.

title: U.S. lawmakers question Boeing's $1 mln rebate clause for Southwest 737 MAX orders
description: To convince Southwest Airlines Co  to buy the Boeing 737 MAX, the plane maker reassured the airline that pilots would not need expensive simulator training and backed up the promise with a $1 million per plane rebate if training was needed, U.S. lawmakers said on Wednesday.

title: Western Digital announces CEO succession plan, signals lean second-quarter
description: Hard-drive maker Western Digital Corp  said on Wednesday its second-quarter profit would come in sharply below analysts' expectations and that its chief executive officer would retire soon, sending its shares down 10%.

title: Facebook sales grow as users tick up; Zuckerberg defends political ads
description: Facebook Inc  reported an uptick in users in lucrative markets and its third straight rise in quarterly sales growth on Wednesday, but the company's controversial political ads stole the limelight when CEO Mark Zuckerberg spoke to analysts.

title: Ford reaches tentative labor deal with United Auto Workers union
description: Ford Motor  and the United Auto Workers union on Wednesday announced a tentative agreement for a new labor deal, allowing the No. 2 U.S. automaker to avoid a strike like the one that cost its larger rival General Motors  about $3 billion.

title: Exclusive: Alibaba to resume Hong Kong listing plans as soon as November - sources
description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd  is eyeing a listing in Hong Kong as early as November to raise up to $15 billion, after political unrest put the move on ice earlier this year, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.

title: Costa Rica defers to Chile, U.N. on rescheduling climate change summit
description: Costa Rica's government said on Wednesday it defers to Chile, the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and member states on how to proceed with the United Nations global climate change summit, COP25.

title: U.N. seeks new host for climate talks after Chile withdraws
description: The United Nations is seeking a new host for this year's round of climate talks in December after Chile withdrew as raging street protests grip the South American country.

title: Chile cancels APEC trade summit and major climate gathering after riots
description: Chile withdrew on Wednesday as the host of an APEC summit next month at which the United States and China had been expected to sign a deal to ease a trade war that has hurt the global economy, as raging street protests gripped the South American country.

title: Malaysian financier Jho Low ready to address other issues after U.S. settlement
description: Fugitive financier Jho Low is ready to address issues related to the 1MDB scandal in Malaysia or elsewhere, a spokesman from the Wells Haslem Mayhew Strategic Public Affairs agency who handles press matters on behalf of Low said on Thursday.

title: GM, Toyota, Fiat Chrysler back Trump on California emissions challenge
description: Major automakers are siding with the Trump administration in its bid to bar California from setting its own fuel efficiency rules or zero-emission requirements for vehicles, the companies said in a filing with a U.S. appeals court late on Monday.

title: Boeing CEO pummeled on compensation, 737 MAX flaws at U.S. hearing
description: Boeing Co  Chief Executive Dennis Muilenburg was repeatedly hammered by U.S. lawmakers at a hearing on Wednesday over his compensation and key mistakes in development of the 737 MAX that he newly acknowledged.

title: Toshiba sues former employee of U.S. unit, citing fraud
description: Toshiba Corp said on Thursday it filed a lawsuit against a former employee of a U.S. unit for conspiring with a contractor and defrauding the Japanese industrial conglomerate.

title: Stock investors see silver lining in Fed's rate-cut pause
description: The U.S. Federal Reserve may be done cutting interest rates but stock investors are not done buying.

title: Wall St. gains, U.S. Treasury yields fall after remarks by Fed's Powell
description: Wall Street gained ground and U.S. Treasury yields fell on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve signaled a pause in the current easing cycle following the expected announcement of a rate cut.

title: Factbox: What happens at the Fed's rate-setting meetings?
description: The U.S. Federal Reserve concluded its latest two-day policy meeting on Wednesday to set a key U.S. interest rate that impacts investors, consumers, and companies around the world.

title: For Fed Chair Powell, blunt is the 'appropriate' approach
description: Understanding central banks is often compared to reading tea leaves: picking up on subtle clues that point in one direction or another.

title: Kuwait, Gulf central banks cut key rates following Fed
description: Kuwait’s central bank cut its benchmark interest rate on Wednesday, joining the Federal Reserve-led monetary easing cycle with its Gulf peers for the first time since July.

title: Instant View: Markets take Fed cut, pause signal in stride
description: U.S. stocks firmed slightly and yields on Treasuries gyrated in narrow ranges on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve lowered interest rates for the third time this year, while signaling it might pause its easing cycle.

title: Bayer says U.S. farmers unfazed by glyphosate litigation
description: Bayer, the world's largest maker of seeds and pesticides, said U.S. farmers were unperturbed by lawsuits seeking damages from Bayer for an alleged cancer-causing effect of glyphosate-based herbicides.

title: Bayer says U.S. glyphosate plaintiffs more than double since July
description: Germany's Bayer is now facing 42,700 U.S. plaintiffs blaming its glyphosate-based weedkillers for their cancer, more than twice the tally in July and potentially raising any future settlement.

title: Fiat Chrysler board approves moving forward with Peugeot merger: sources
description: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV's   board of directors has approved moving forward with talks to merge with French automaker Peugeot SA , a person familiar with the situation said on Wednesday.

title: Facebook agrees to pay UK fine over Cambridge Analytica scandal
description: Facebook has agreed to pay a 500,000 pound ($644,000) fine for breaches of data protection law related to the harvesting of data by consultancy Cambridge Analytica, Britain's information rights regulator said on Wednesday.

title: Exclusive: J&J's own expert, working for FDA, found asbestos in Baby Powder
description: Ever since Johnson & Johnson disclosed this month that a government test had turned up asbestos in its Baby Powder, the company has attacked the validity of the result.

title: S&P closes at record on Fed bump
description: U.S. stocks advanced on Wednesday, with the S&P 500 closing at a record for the second time in three sessions, after a policy statement by the U.S. Federal Reserve that cut interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point.

title: Former Exxon CEO Tillerson denies misleading investors in climate case
description: Former Exxon Mobil Corp Chief Executive Officer Rex Tillerson on Wednesday denied misleading investors about how the oil major measured potential costs of climate change, as he testified in a closely watched civil lawsuit brought by New York's attorney general.

title: Boeing CEO Muilenburg resists multiple calls for resignation
description: Boeing  Chief Executive Dennis Muilenburg on Wednesday spurned repeated calls to step down by U.S. lawmakers and from the mother of a young woman who was a victim of one of two 737 MAX crashes that killed 346 people.

title: Oil falls on hike in U.S. crude stockpiles, trade deal concerns
description: Oil prices fell on Wednesday after a steep U.S. crude inventory build added to worries about a possible delay in resolving the U.S.-China trade war, which has hurt global oil demand.

title: PSA could help Fiat Chrysler modernize its vehicle platforms
description: A proposed merger between France's Groupe PSA  and Fiat Chrysler Automobiles  would give FCA access to Peugeot’s more modern and flexible vehicle architectures, potentially enabling the combined companies to achieve lower costs through higher production volumes, a global auto analyst said on Wednesday.

title: Ford shutters oldest Brazil plant as revival bid faces doubts
description: Ford Motor Co  on Wednesday said it was shutting down its oldest plant in Brazil later in the day as planned, with prospects for saving any of the jobs in doubt as talks with a potential buyer have fallen behind schedule.

title: Boeing 737 MAX grounding a drag on Canadian investment in machinery, equipment
description: The global grounding of Boeing's  737 MAX jet is weighing on Canadian economic investment in machinery and equipment, with carriers unable to take deliveries of the planes, the Bank of Canada said on Wednesday in a report.

title: Two plead guilty in conspiracy involving Uber, LinkedIn, others: U.S. Justice Dept
description: Two hackers pleaded guilty in federal court on Wednesday for a conspiracy to extract bounties from Uber Technologies Inc , LinkedIn  and other corporations in exchange for promises to delete information stolen from Amazon Web Services , according to the Justice Department.

title: Peugeot, FCA accelerate merger talks: sources
description: The boards of French automaker Peugeot SA and Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV   on Wednesday agreed to pursue a $50 billion merger, sources familiar with the matter said, a deal that could transform the global auto industry.

title: Uber takes aim at 'patchwork' of ride share taxes in Illinois
description: Uber Technologies Inc on Wednesday sued a Chicago suburb over a new ride share tax, while calling on Illinois lawmakers to address the state's "emerging patchwork" of taxation.

title: GM expects to spend more on EVs than gas-powered cars in next five years: CEO
description: General Motors Co  expects to spend more on developing and selling electric vehicles (EVs) than gasoline-powered cars over the next five years, Chief Executive Mary Barra said on Tuesday.

title: Merck sees ongoing Keytruda strength as its sales top $3 billion in quarter

title: Russia's Sberbank to buy stake in Mail.ru to expand in digital economy

title: U.S. consumer confidence slips in October
description: U.S. consumer confidence unexpectedly fell in October amid household concerns about the short-term outlook for business conditions and job prospects.

title: Factbox: When will the Boeing 737 MAX fly again?
description: Boeing Co's  best-selling jet, the 737 MAX, was grounded globally in March, days after the crash of an Ethiopian Airlines flight that followed a similar Lion Air disaster in Indonesia in on Oct. 29, 2018. A total of 346 people died in the two crashes.

title: India's IndiGo places historic order for 300 Airbus planes

description: Merck & Co Inc  said on Tuesday it intends to ramp up  production of its top-selling vaccine Gardasil in 2023 and warned of a slowdown in revenue growth next year as demand for the therapy outpaces supply.

description: U.S. fund manager BlackRock Inc  chief executive said on Tuesday the world will see higher equity markets in 2020.

description: Shares of Beyond Meat Inc  plunged more than 20% on Tuesday as investors rushed to cash in after a restriction on selling stock lifted and worries mounted about rising costs and increased competition at the hugely popular plant-based meat producer.

description: Mastercard Inc  on Tuesday beat Wall Street estimates for quarterly profit as customers shrugged off fears of an economic slowdown and spent more with their credit and debit cards, boosting fees for the world's second-largest payment processor.

description: Johnson & Johnson said on Tuesday that 15 new tests found no asbestos in a bottle of baby powder that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration says tested positive for trace amounts of asbestos, a finding the agency stands by.

description: China will eliminate all restrictions on foreign investments not included in its self-styled "negative lists," a vice commerce minister said on Tuesday, and also will "neither explicitly nor implicitly" force foreign investors and companies to transfer technologies.

title: Wall St. dips after S&P notches record, Fed on deck

description: Uber Technologies Inc said it would not share real-time location data of its electric bike riders with the city of Los Angeles, saying it would violate their privacy.

description: As a private investor, former U.S. Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Scott Gottlieb is focused on an area where few have found success in recent years: developing new antibiotics.

title: Global stocks falter, dollar slips on potential U.S.-China trade delay

title: Airbus-owned Stelia Aerospace to build Portugal assembly plant
description: Stelia Aerospace, owned by European planemaker Airbus , will open a 40 million euro ($44 million) assembly plant near Porto in Portugal, creating 240 jobs, company and government officials said on Tuesday.

title: Hudbay vows appeal after court affirms Arizona project ruling
description: Hudbay Minerals on Tuesday vowed to appeal a court ruling that barred the Canadian miner from building a major copper mine in the United States after losing its bid to have a judge revisit the decision.

title: KKR earnings slide 23% as weaker deal activity hits revenue
description: Private equity firm KKR & Co  reported a 23% year-on-year drop in its quarterly after-tax distributable profit on Tuesday, as fee revenue slid amid a broader slowdown in asset sales by buyout firms.

title: IAC must face Tinder co-founder's $2 billion lawsuit: NY appeals court
description: A New York state appeals court on Tuesday rejected IAC/InterActiveCorp's  bid to dismiss a $2 billion lawsuit by a group of Tinder founders, executives and early employees who said it undervalued the dating app to avoid paying them billions of dollars.

title: Oil mixed on forecast of falling U.S. fuel stockpiles
description: Oil prices were mixed on Tuesday, paring earlier steep losses as investors focused on signs that U.S.-China trade tensions could ease next month and expectations that U.S. refined product stockpiles declined last week.

title: U.S. shipping sanctions to dent demand for dirty shipping fuel: Refinitiv

description: Wells Fargo & Co  has laid off more than 200 bankers in its U.S. lending divisions in recent months, as the bank reacted to business trends and restructured some units, sources familiar with the matter said this week.

title: KKR adds Deutsche Bank to defense supplier Hensoldt's IPO lineup: sources

description: Lebanon needs a political solution to the country's crisis in days to regain confidence and avert a future economic collapse, Central Bank Governor Riad Salameh told Reuters on Monday.

title: Key dates leading up to the U.S. Pentagon's cloud-computing award to Microsoft
description: Microsoft Corp  has won the U.S. Pentagon's $10 billion cloud-computing contract, the Defense Department said on Friday, beating out favorite Amazon.com Inc .

title: Brazil rates to hit record low 5.00%, seen falling further: Reuters poll
description: Brazil's benchmark interest rate will be cut to a record low of 5.00% on Wednesday, according to the unanimous view in a Reuters poll of economists, as the central bank battles to spur economic growth and prevent inflation from falling further below target.

title: In a Nike factory in Argentina's hinterland, the ghost of Macri's fall
description: Rumors of layoffs started spreading among workers at a factory here in northeastern Argentina making Nike Inc  shoes the night before Cristian Fredy Aquino's scheduled shift.

title: Investors brace for poor U.S. shale earnings amid weak oil and gas prices
description: Investors are bracing for weaker results from U.S. shale players in coming days as lower oil and natural gas prices and cost-cutting measures have weighed on third-quarter operations.

title: Exclusive: Thai Siam Cement's packaging unit set for $1 billion IPO - sources
description: Thailand's Siam Cement Pcl's (SCG)  packaging subsidiary is planning a local listing, in a float that is set to raise about $1 billion, two sources with knowledge of the matter said.

title: Lazard appoints Girodolle CEO of Lazard France
description: Lazard  said on Sunday it had appointed Jean-Louis Girodolle as CEO of Lazard Investment Banking in France, just a week after its chairman and CEO Matthieu Pigasse resigned.

title: AT&T to add directors, sell up to $10 billion in assets next year
description: AT&T Inc on Monday unveiled a three-year strategic plan that included selling up to $10 billion worth of businesses next year, paying off all its debt from the purchase of Time Warner and adding two new board members, bowing to pressure from activist investor Elliott Management.

title: Trade optimism, Fed rate-cut expectation sends S&P 500 to record
description: The S&P 500 hit a record high on Monday, while the Nasdaq fell just short of its lifetime high touched in late July as a more civil tone between the United States and China lifted hopes for a possible trade deal and investors looked toward a Federal Reserve rate cut later this week.

title: Pentagon deal to boost Microsoft's position in cloud computing: analysts
description: Amazon.com Inc's  firm grip on the cloud computing market could be threatened by Microsoft Corp's  multi-billion dollar contract with the Pentagon, Wall Street analysts said on Monday.

title: T-Mobile beats quarterly phone subscriber estimates
description: T-Mobile US Inc  on Monday beat analysts' third-quarter estimates for net new phone subscribers who pay a monthly bill, boosted by competitive wireless plans aimed at fending off its bigger rivals.

title: LVMH woos Tiffany to tap fast-growing jewellery market
description: LVMH has offered to buy Tiffany & Co, known for its engagement rings and ties to Hollywood glamour, as the owner of Louis Vuitton and Bulgari seeks to expand in jewellery, one of the fastest-growing parts of the luxury goods market.

title: California regulator to probe utilities' mass power outages aimed at preventing fires
description: California regulators said on Monday they will open a formal probe of whether utilities violated any rules by cutting power to millions of residents for days as a precaution during recent periods of high winds and heightened wildfire risks.

title: 'We know we made mistakes' on 737 MAX: Boeing CEO
description: Boeing Co Chief Executive Dennis Muilenburg will acknowledge on Tuesday that the aircraft manufacturer made mistakes, as he appears at a congressional hearing on two 737 MAX crashes that killed 346 people, according to written testimony made public on Monday.

title: Japan tax agency finds Ghosn used Nissan money for private use: report
description: Japan's tax authorities have determined former Nissan Motor Co Ltd  boss Carlos Ghosn used company money for private use, bolstering the automaker's case that he diverted corporate funds for personal gain, the Yomiuri reported on Tuesday.

title: United, Avianca and Copa's South American deal delayed as they mull fourth partner
description: A proposed joint venture between United Airlines, Colombia's Avianca Holdings and Panama's Copa Holdings has been delayed due to the potential inclusion of a fourth partner, as well as problems at Avianca, the CEOs of two of the companies said.

title: Justice Department issues grand jury subpoenas in J&J opioid probe: filing
description: Johnson & Johnson  received grand jury subpoenas in August from the U.S. attorney's office for the Eastern District of New York related to its opioid medication policies, the company said in a regulatory filing on Monday.

title: Microsoft says Russia-linked hackers target sports organizations
description: Microsoft Corp said it has tracked "significant" cyberattacks coming from a group it calls "Strontium" or "Fancy Bear", targeting anti-doping authorities and global sporting organizations.

title: Trump administration eases risks for banks on false lending claims
description: The Trump administration said on Monday it would try to entice banks to offer more mortgages to low-income borrowers by reducing reliance on a Civil War-era law the Obama administration used in the wake of the subprime mortgage crisis to build bad-lending cases against big banks.

title: Google's search for sales in cloud, hardware clip Alphabet profit
description: Google parent Alphabet Inc  reported quarterly results on Monday that show costs continue to rise faster than revenue as the web search leader seeks to broaden its business, dampening Wall Street's enthusiasm despite Google's continued dominance in advertising sales.

title: TSMC, GlobalFoundries settle patent disputes
description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (TSMC)  and smaller contract chipmaking rival GlobalFoundries Inc on Monday agreed to dismiss all patent litigations between themselves and those that involve their customers.

title: Beyond Meat to offer more store discounts as competition heats up; shares fall
description: Beyond Meat Inc reported its first ever net profit and raised its full-year sales forecast, but shares tumbled 6.5% in extended trading as the vegan burger maker said it would need to offer more store discounts or promotions as competition heats up.

title: Google results to share stage with U.S. antitrust probe
description: Beyond fresh insights into Alphabet Inc's quarterly earnings on Monday, financial analysts could press executives for details on the U.S. antitrust probe by 48 states.

title: U.S. lawmakers will press Boeing CEO for answers on 737 MAX crashes
description: The head of a U.S. Senate panel reviewing two catastrophic Boeing 737 MAX crashes told Reuters ahead of hearings this week that the plane would not return to U.S. skies until "99.9% of the American public" and policymakers are convinced it is safe.

title: Lebanon's central bank urges quick solution to avoid future collapse
description: Lebanon's central bank governor said on Monday a solution must be found in days to a crisis unleashed by huge protests against the ruling elite, saying this would restore confidence and avoid any future economic collapse.

title: New tuberculosis treatment for developing countries to cost $1,040
description: A newly approved three-drug treatment for tuberculosis will be available in 150 countries including India and South Africa, priced at $1,040 for a complete regimen, more than twice the cost proposed in the past by advocacy groups for other treatments.

title: Lockheed Martin awarded $7 billion U.S. defense contract: Pentagon
description: Lockheed Martin Corp  has been awarded a $7 billion modification to a contract providing for 114 F-35 aircraft for the U.S. Air Force, the U.S. Marine Corps, the U.S. Navy, and the governments of Norway, Australia and Italy, the Pentagon said on Monday.

title: Ford to cut 450 jobs at Canada plant on Flex, Lincoln MKT production halt
description: Ford Motor Co will cut about 450 jobs at its Oakville assembly plant in Ontario, as the No. 2 U.S. carmaker discontinues production of the Ford Flex and Lincoln MKT, Canada's largest private-sector union Unifor said https://reut.rs/2pmAPhJ on Monday.

title: Oil falls on weak Chinese data, forecasts for U.S. crude stocks build
description: Oil prices fell on Monday after four days of gains as expectations U.S. crude stockpiles will rise and worries about weak Chinese industrial data offset hopes oil demand will increase if talks progress on a Sino-American trade deal.

title: U.S.-China trade hopes boost stocks; dollar weak
description: An index of global stock markets rallied to a 21-month high on Monday, boosted by growing hopes for a U.S.-China trade deal and the view that the U.S. Federal Reserve this week will deliver its third interest rate cut for 2019.

title: De Beers banks on 'diamonds are for me'
description: Anglo American  unit De Beers said its 2019 marketing budget will exceed last year's figure of $170 million and will focus on the biggest market the United States, where women lavishing diamonds on themselves has boosted sales.

title: Richard Branson's Virgin Galactic soars before crashing to earth in NYSE debut
description: Richard Branson-backed Virgin Galactic Holdings Inc  fetched a valuation of around $2.3 billion on its market debut on Monday, after shares in the first publicly traded space tourism company popped before fizzling out.

title: Micron launches new storage drives to challenge Intel in data centers
description: (The October 24 story corrects to reflect that Micron's new devices are solid-state drives rather than hard drives with spinning disks.)

title: U.S. may extend tariff suspensions on $34 billion in Chinese goods
description: The United States Trade Representative is studying whether to extend tariff suspensions on $34 billion of Chinese goods set to expire on Dec. 28 this year, the agency said on Monday.

title: Trump: 'ahead of schedule' on China trade deal
description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday he expected to sign a significant part of the trade deal with China ahead of schedule but did not elaborate on the timing.

title: Prologis to buy warehouse rival Liberty in $12.6 billion deal
description: Warehouse giant Prologis Inc  said on Sunday it had agreed to acquire rival industrial real-estate business Liberty Property Trust  in a $12.6 billion deal to improve its U.S. presence amid the ecommerce boom.

title: French luxury group LVMH offers to buy U.S. jeweler Tiffany: sources
description: Louis Vuitton owner LVMH  has approached Tiffany & Co  with a $14.5 billion acquisition offer, people familiar with the matter said, at a time when the U.S. luxury jeweler grapples with the impact of tariffs on its exports to China.

title: Exclusive: Brazil to lure airlines to fly domestic, taking meetings with three carriers
description: Brazil is determined to lure airlines to operate domestic flights in Latin America's largest aviation market, and is taking meetings with at least three carriers, a senior government official told Reuters.

title: Brazil working to bring Boeing 737 MAX plane back into service this year
description: Brazil is working to bring the Boeing 737 MAX airplane back to service "by the end of the year," Civil Aviation Secretary Ronei Glanzmann said on Sunday.

title: UBS wants new recruit Khan to drop criminal complaint over spying: paper
description: UBS  wants Iqbal Khan, co-head of its wealth management business, to drop his criminal complaint over a spying scandal that emerged after he left cross-town rival Credit Suisse , the SonntagsZeitung newspaper reported on Sunday.

title: China should ease regulations for foreign financial institutions: HSBC executive
description: China should ease regulations so that foreign financial institutions can obtain licenses and raise deposits more easily in the country, a senior executive from HSBC   said on Sunday.

title: China studying blockchain application for forex - regulator
description: China is studying the application of blockchain and artificial intelligence in cross-border financing with a focus on risk management, and will further liberalize its capital markets, a senior foreign exchange regulator said on Sunday.

title: Leading union demands concessions in Thyssenkrupp elevator sale
description: Top representatives at IG Metall, Germany's biggest union, will not approve a sale of Thyssenkrupp's  prized elevator division unless potential buyers give far-reaching concessions to employees, they said.

title: Tech consultations on parts of U.S. trade deal completed: China's Commerce Ministry
description: Chinese Vice Premier Liu He had a phone call with U.S. trade officials as both countries confirmed technical consultations on some parts of a trade agreement were basically completed, China's Ministry of Commerce said in a statement on Saturday.

title: U.S., China say they are 'close to finalizing' part of a Phase One trade deal
description: U.S. and Chinese officials are "close to finalizing" some parts of a trade agreement after high-level telephone discussions on Friday, the U.S. Trade Representative's office and China's Commerce Ministry said, with talks to continue.

title: Lagarde will take ECB out of ivory tower: De Guindos in El Pais
description: Christine Lagarde will ensure European Central Bank policymakers climb down from their "ivory tower" and face the political realities of the euro zone, the ECB's vice president, Luis de Guindos, said in an interview published on Saturday.

title: JS Global pulls Hong Kong listing amid trade gloom: sources
description: Household appliances maker JS Global Lifestyle Company Ltd  pulled its initial public offering of up to HK$3.62 billion ($464 million) on Saturday, the third float delayed in Hong Kong so far this year, two sources told Reuters.

title: Microsoft: 'appreciate' winning JEDI contract - statement
description: Microsoft Corp.  said in a statement on Saturday that the company appreciates being chosen by the U.S. Defense department (DoD) for the Pentagon's $10 billion Joint Enterprise Defense Infrastructure Cloud (JEDI) contract.

title: China's industrial profits fall 5.3% in Sept as trade war toll mounts
description: Profits at China's industrial firms contracted for the second straight month in September as producer prices continued their slide, highlighting the toll a slowing economy and protracted U.S. trade war are having taken on corporate balance sheets.

title: Factbox: 'Fly up' co-pilot urges in final moments of fatal Lion Air crash
description: A final Indonesian report on the fatal crash of Lion Air flight 610 published on Friday details stress and confusion in the cockpit as the Boeing 737 MAX's MCAS software, misled by faulty sensor readings, repeatedly lowered the plane's nose.

title: 'Rhetoric' masks lack of progress on gender diversity in finance: UK watchdog
description: The number of women in senior roles at financial services firms in Britain has flatlined since 2005 despite diversity "rhetoric" from industry, according to research from the Financial Conduct Authority.

title: Amazon's AWS unit gets OK to build $800 million data facility in Argentina
description: Argentina has given the go-ahead to Amazon.com Inc's Web Services division AWS to build an $800-million data facility in Buenos Aires, which would mark a massive investment for the company in South America, according to a provincial bulletin dated Oct. 24.

title: AB InBev loses $13 billion in value as beer drinking slows in Brazil and South Korea
description: Anheuser-Busch InBev  saw more than $13 billion wiped off its market value on Friday, after a profit warning and weaker-than-expected third-quarter earnings growth sparked by reduced demand for its beer in Brazil and South Korea.

title: How SoftBank made WeWork an offer it had to accept
description: By Mike Spector, Joshua Franklin, Greg Roumeliotis and Anirban Sen

title: Take Five: Brextension, Brelection, Bremain
description: Oct 31 was when Britain was to exit the European Union, with Prime Minister Boris Johnson saying he would rather be "dead in a ditch" than delay Brexit again. But with the UK parliament failing to play along, he's been forced to ask for an extension and the EU will decide on Monday or Tuesday long it will be.

title: Behind AT&T's plan to take on Netflix, Apple and Disney with HBO Max
description: In the bestselling novel "Circe" -- optioned by WarnerMedia for its forthcoming HBO Max streaming service -- the daughter of the Greek god Helios tames wild beasts and menaces the gods.

title: USTR says close to finalizing parts of trade deal with China
description: The United States and China are close to finalizing some sections of a trade agreement after a phone call between top negotiators, the U.S. Trade Representative's office said on Friday.

title: Exclusive: India probe finds AB InBev, Carlsberg, United Breweries colluded on prices - sources
description: The investigations unit of India's Competition Commission has concluded that Anheuser-Busch InBev , Carlsberg  and United Breweries  colluded to fix beer prices, two people with direct knowledge told Reuters.

title: Estonian minister blamed for slow reform after Danske scandal
description: Estonia's far-right finance minister has been criticized by lawmakers for holding up financial reforms promised after the Baltic state became the focus of Europe's biggest money laundering scandal.

title: Britain's ARM to continue supplying chip technology to Huawei
description: Chip designer ARM will continue to supply Huawei Technologies after the British company's legal team ruled that its chip technology is of UK origin and would not breach U.S. restrictions on supplying the Chinese tech giant.

title: Amazon sales forecast, slower cloud growth disappoint investors
description: Shares of Amazon.com Inc were down 3% on Friday, as investors were let down by a lower-than-expected sales outlook and surprised by slower revenue growth at its lucrative AWS cloud business.

title: U.S. FAA revokes certification of Xtra Aerospace after Lion Air crash
description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Friday revoked the repair certification of Florida-based Xtra Aerospace LLC, which fixed a sensor suspected of contributing to the catastrophic crash of a Lion Air 737 MAX a year ago.

title: Boeing considered system redesign before accidents: NTSB report
description: Boeing  engineers and test pilots considered before two fatal 737 MAX crashes whether an anti-stall system should be redesigned after discussing how flawed data from a single sensor could trigger it repeatedly, U.S. investigators have found.

title: Verizon earnings beat estimates as cheaper plans attract customers
description: Verizon Communications Inc  beat Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit and revenue on Friday, as the largest U.S. wireless carrier cut prices of its unlimited plans to pull in more subscribers who pay monthly bills.

title: Brazil's Vale CEO says not yet time to resume dividends
description: Vale SA's  chief executive officer said on Friday that a resumption in paying dividends or share buybacks would depend on progress in repairing the damage from its Brumadinho tailings dam collapse, which killed more than 250 people.

title: EU readies stricter rules against money laundering: document
description: The European Union is getting ready to tighten rules against money laundering, an EU draft document shows, a year after previous reforms now deemed inadequate to tackle a series of banking scandals.

title: Heineken to invest $244 million in Brazil by 2020 to double capacity: paper
description: Heineken , the world's second-largest brewer, will invest 985 million reais ($244 million) in Brazil to double its production capacity, CEO Mauricio Giamellaro told the Valor Econômico newspaper in an interview published on Friday.

title: Wall Street firms record best first-half profit in a decade: report
description: Wall Street firms recorded their best first half in a decade as profits rose 11%, but a slowdown in the global economy and ongoing trade tensions could hit earnings in the second half of 2019, according to a report from the New York State Comptroller.

title: Airless tire makers hope for breakout moment with autonomous driving
description: Makers of airless tires such as Japan's Bridgestone Corp. hope driverless cars will herald a breakthrough for their niche technology, which is more than a decade old but underperforms standard tires in every way except resistance to puncture.

title: Future delivery: Japanese trucks designed with no cabin and interchangeable cargo holds
description: In Japan, trucks are being designed for a driverless future with no cabin and interchangeable container areas that would allow vehicles to be highly customized for parcel delivery or even serve as mini-hotels or beauty salons.

title: JLR parent posts smaller loss as China demand picks up
description: Jaguar Land Rover owner Tata Motors  posted a smaller-than-expected loss in the second quarter on Friday as a pick up in sales of its luxury car in China helped it ride out weak vehicles sales in India, its home market.

title: Renault looks for new partners, third-quarter revenue falls
description: French carmaker Renault  is on the hunt for new partners to buy its cars and components as it reported a fall in quarterly revenue and pushed ahead on a strategic review with "nothing off the table".

title: SoftBank to write down minimum $5 billion for WeWork, other losses: Bloomberg
description: SoftBank has ample funds to endure the pain from its massive bailout of WeWork, analysts said, even as it is reportedly set to write down at least $5 billion due to a slump in the value of the U.S. office sharing startup and some other top holdings.

title: BMW CEO says trade war could cost U.S. jobs
description: BMW  has told United States trade representatives, including Robert Lighthizer, that intensifying a global trade war could threaten jobs in South Carolina, Chief Executive Oliver Zipse said on Friday.

title: Factbox: Which HBO subscribers will get HBO Max at no extra charge?
description: Next week, when WarnerMedia reveals details about its upcoming subscription streaming video service HBO Max, some current HBO subscribers in the United States will learn that they will have access to the new service at no additional charge.

title: Judge asks Samsung heir to be humble at bribery trial
description: A South Korean judge overseeing Samsung Group heir Jay Y. Lee's bribery trial told him on Friday to "humbly accept" whatever the outcome of the trial, which could result in a tougher sentence for the conglomerate's de-facto leader.

title: Debenhams appoints chairman, investors lend support through Christmas
description: British department store group Debenhams said Mark Gifford, a former chief financial officer at rival House of Fraser, had been appointed as the chairman of its parent group Celine Jersey Topco.

title: Kering shares surge as Gucci shines despite Hong Kong protests
description: Kering  led a luxury goods share rally on Friday after its star fashion label Gucci posted stronger-than-expected sales, demonstrating how some brands have so far managed to counter the hit from protests in Hong Kong.

title: Deeper global slowdown still more likely despite round of rate cuts: Reuters poll
description: A steeper decline in global economic growth still more likely than a synchronized recovery, even as multiple central banks dole out rounds of monetary easing, according to economists polled by Reuters in recent weeks.

title: Exclusive: China's WeWork equivalent Ucommune files for U.S. IPO - sources
description: China's biggest shared workspace provider Ucommune has filed a confidential prospectus with the U.S. securities regulator as it seeks an initial public offering (IPO) before the end of the year, two people with direct knowledge of the matter said.

title: EasyJet adds Orly baggage connections with long-haul partners
description: Low-cost airline easyJet  has added baggage services to its flight-connections partnership with two budget long-haul carriers flying from Paris, in a move that challenges Air France on transatlantic and Caribbean leisure routes.

title: H&M opens new-look small boutique in Berlin, plans more
description: H&M  opened a boutique-like store in a trendy neighbourhood in Berlin on Friday that offers yoga classes, a cafe with a garden and space for other brands as the Swedish budget chain seeks a new look to revive flagging sales.

title: Big U.S. retailers pull 22-ounce J&J baby powder off shelves after recall
description: Four major U.S. retailers, including Walmart and Target Corp, are removing all 22-ounce bottles of Johnson & Johnson's baby powder from their stores, following the healthcare conglomerate's recall last week of some bottles due to possible asbestos contamination.

title: Toyota's not alone in the slow lane to self-driving cars
description: When Toyota Motor Corp  launches its all-battery Lexus next year, the luxury model will be able to drive autonomously on highways, a big step for the Japanese automaker, which has so far trailed rivals in bringing self-driving cars to market.

title: Richemont teams up with designer Alber Elbaz for fashion venture
description: Richemont  said on Friday that it was teaming up with former Lanvin designer Alber Elbaz for a new venture at a time when luxury goods groups are vying to make star hires.

title: S&P 500 nears record high on trade progress, upbeat Intel earnings
description: U.S. stocks rose on Friday after Washington said it was close to finalizing parts of a trade pact with Beijing and strong quarterly results from Intel Corp  boosted investor sentiment, sending the S&P 500 briefly over the record high close it set three months ago.

title: General Motors to restart Mexican plants after labor deal ratified
description: General Motors Co  will gradually restart operations at several idled plants in Mexico beginning this weekend, after unionized workers for the U.S. automaker ratified a new labor contract, the company's Mexican unit said on Friday.

title: Johnson & Johnson CEO testified Baby Powder was safe 13 days before FDA bombshell
description: Facing off against a plaintiff’s lawyer for the first time about Johnson & Johnson’s Baby Powder, the company’s Chief Executive Alex Gorsky earlier this month insisted that the company’s iconic brand was safe.

title: Timeline: UAW members ratify new labor deal with GM to end strike
description: The United Auto Workers union said on Friday its members ratified a new four-year labor contract with General Motors Co  , ending the strike with the No. 1 U.S. automaker after 40 days.

title: Indonesia report on 737 MAX crash faults Boeing design, says Lion Air made mistakes
description: Boeing, acting without adequate oversight from U.S. regulators, failed to grasp risks in the design of cockpit software on its 737 MAX airliner, sowing the seeds for a Lion Air crash that also involved errors by airline workers and crew, Indonesian investigators found.

title: Boeing completes year of turmoil with promise to Indonesia on 737 MAX crash
description: Boeing Co on Friday promised to act on safety recommendations for its 737 MAX aircraft made in a new report by Indonesian investigators on the deadly Lion Air crash a year ago.

title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Bond fund managers see risk Fed cuts rates to zero
description: Speculation the Federal Reserve will continue cutting interest rates well past its policy meeting next week is pushing some bond fund managers into assets ranging from short-term Treasury bills to half-paid off 15-year home mortgages.

title: Global stocks, dollar, yields climb on trade progress news
description: Global stock indexes, the dollar and bond yields rose on Friday, with the S&P 500 nearing a record high as the United States said it was close to finalizing parts of a trade deal with China.

title: Two charities to pay $6 million to resolve U.S. pharma kickback probe
description: Two charities will pay $6 million to resolve claims they operated as pass-throughs for seven pharmaceutical companies to pay kickbacks to Medicare patients using their high-priced medications, the U.S. Justice Department said on Friday.

title: UAW to bargain next with Ford on new contract deal: sources
description: The United Auto Workers union is set to announce later on Friday it has chosen Ford Motor Co  as the next U.S. automaker the union will negotiate with, sources briefed on the matter told Reuters.

title: What slowdown? China's riding to the rescue of luxury brands
description: When Tiffany & Co said this month it was sending its priciest jewelry to mainland China to reach wealthy shoppers no longer jet-setting abroad, it reflected a trend helping global luxury brands weather a Chinese economic slowdown.

title: Exxon Mobil seeks buyer for Montana refinery: sources
description: Exxon Mobil Corp  is seeking a potential buyer for its roughly 60,000 barrel per day Billings, Montana refinery, according to three sources familiar with Exxon’s plans.

title: General Motors strike to dent U.S. October job growth
description: A strike by General Motors  workers should weigh on U.S. job growth in October, government data showed on Friday.

title: UAW turns to Ford after GM workers approve new contract
description: The United Auto Workers union said on Friday it has chosen Ford Motor Co  as the next U.S. automaker the union will negotiate with after workers at General Motors Co  approved a new contract deal.

title: U.S. denies China's claim of 'weaponizing' visa decisions for Washington space meeting
description: The United States on Friday rejected Chinese accusations that political motives were behind a top Beijing space official not receiving a visa in time to attend the start of an international conference in Washington this week.

title: United wants Azul in Latin American venture with Copa, Avianca
description: United Airlines  wants to include Brazil's Azul  in its planned tie-up with Copa Holdings  and Colombia's Avianca Holdings  to create a four-way partnership in Latin America, a senior executive said on Friday.

title: U.S. government's annual budget deficit largest since 2012
description: The U.S. government ended fiscal year 2019 with the largest budget deficit in seven years as gains in tax receipts were offset by higher spending and growing debt service payments, the Treasury department said on Friday.

title: Exclusive: Qatar pushes for Deutsche Bank chairman to go - sources
description: Qatari investors in Deutsche Bank  want the lender's chairman to leave after he botched an attempt to appoint their envoy to the board, people familiar with the matter said.

title: MSCI CEO says limiting capital flows to China would be 'devastating'
description: Restricting the flow of U.S. capital to China would have a "devastating" impact on global markets, the head of index provider MSCI Inc  told CNBC on Friday.

title: Mexico expects U.S. Congress to start formal trade deal approval soon
description: Mexico expects U.S. lawmakers to soon begin the process of approving a new trade deal between the two countries and Canada now that President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador has promised wage increases and funding for labor reforms, a senior Mexican official said on Friday.

title: Russia affirms close oil cooperation with Saudi Arabia, OPEC+
description: Russia's energy ministry said on Friday it continues close cooperation with Saudi Arabia and OPEC and non-OPEC oil producers to enhance market stability and predictability.

title: Fisher loses another $584 million from high-profile clients
description: A Texas retirement system and Goldman Sachs Group Inc pulled a combined $584 million from Fisher Investments on Friday, after allegations that firm founder Ken Fisher made sexist comments at a conference.

title: United Airlines' plans to sunset 757s depends on 737 MAX timing: COO
description: United Airlines  wants to sunset older Boeing Co  757s "as soon as possible" but the timing will depend on when the Boeing 737 MAX starts flying again, Chief Operating Officer Andrew Nocella told journalists on Friday.

title: Fiat Chrysler recalls 108,000 diesel Ram 1500 pickup trucks for coolant leaks
description: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV  said on Friday it is recalling 108,000 Ram 1500 diesel-powered pickup trucks in the United States for coolant leaks tied to reports of some fires and four minor injuries.

title: Tesla starts selling China-made Model 3 with autopilot function
description: U.S. electric vehicle maker Tesla  on Friday started selling its China-made Model 3 with an autopilot function priced from 355,800 yuan ($50,310), making it the company's cheapest model on sale in the country, the official website showed.

title: White House adviser Navarro fighting 'Phase One’ of U.S.-China trade dealL CNBC
description: White House trade adviser Peter Navarro is fighting "Phase One" of the China trade deal announced by U.S. President Donald Trump on Oct. 11, CNBC reported on Friday, citing sources.

title: Oil prices clock strong weekly gains on trade hopes, crude supply
description: Oil prices rose on Friday, registering the strongest weekly gains in more than a month as support from optimism over a U.S.-China trade deal, falling U.S. crude stocks and possible action from OPEC to extend output cuts outweighed broader economic concerns.

title: United Airlines says in talks with Apple on San Francisco airport upgrade
description: United Airlines is in early discussions with Apple Inc about upgrading the U.S. carrier's terminal at San Francisco International airport, United's Chief Digital Officer Linda Jojo told journalists on Friday without providing more details.

title: Brazilian beverage distributors file antitrust complaint against Ambev
description: Beverage distributors working for Brazilian brewer Ambev SA  have filed a complaint against the company at the local antitrust regulator Cade, accusing it of anticompetitive practices.

title: 3M cuts profit forecast after sales miss on slowing Asia demand
description: 3M Co  on Thursday became the latest U.S manufacturer to signal American corporations are suffering from the trade war with China, after it reported quarterly revenue well short of Wall Street estimates and cut its full-year profit forecast.

title: Chemicals maker Dow cuts costs as global slowdown bites
description: Dow Inc  beat Wall Street's tempered profit estimates in the third quarter as it cut costs to offset a sharp drop in demand for chemicals used in plastics and other manufacturing, sending its shares up more than 5%.

title: Raytheon profit beats estimates, raises 2019 forecast on higher weapons demand
description: U.S. weapons maker Raytheon Company  reported better-than-expected third-quarter profit on Thursday and raised its full-year earnings and sales outlook, helped by higher demand for space programs, weapons and missile warning systems.

title: FCA pays up to keep its Jeep brand on CR7 Juve jersey
description: Italian-American carmaker Fiat Chrysler  more than doubled the value of a jersey sponsorship deal with Juventus  in a sign of increasing support from the Agnelli family for Italy's football champions.

title: U.S. business investment still weak; jobless claims fall
description: New orders for key U.S.-made capital goods fell more than expected in September and shipments also declined, a sign that business investment remains soft amid the fallout from the U.S.-China trade war but other data on Thursday showed the spat has yet to have much effect on the overall jobs market.

title: Under pressure, Barclays restores UK post office cash withdrawals
description: Barclays  on Thursday said it will maintain customers' ability to withdraw cash from Britain's Post Office branches, reversing a change announced earlier this month that angered the public and lawmakers amid cuts to the lender's branch network.

title: Car parts maker Valeo says sales up but warns of GM strike impact
description: French car parts supplier Valeo  cautioned on Thursday that the General Motors strike was currently costing it around 160 million euros ($178 million) in sales and around 50 million euros in operating margin terms.

title: U.S. senators ask FTC to probe Amazon over Capital One hack
description: Two U.S. senators on Thursday asked the U.S. Federal Trade Commission to probe Amazon.com Inc  to determine if the company failed to secure its servers prior to the Capital One hack.

title: Fortum CEO says Uniper obstructed proposed purchase: Kommersant

description: Daimler  reported a slight rise in third-quarter operating profit on Thursday, boosted by sales of Mercedes-Benz cars, sending its shares higher, but announced cost cuts and warned legal provisions tied to diesel litigation could rise.
