title: Uber makes JFK airport helicopter taxis available to all users
description: Ride-hailing company Uber Technologies Inc  is taking to the air in New York City where users with a little cash to spare will soon be able to book helicopter flights to John F. Kennedy International airport through their apps.

title: H&M shares surge after first quarterly profit rise in two years
description: Sweden's H&M  posted its first rise in quarterly pretax profit in more than two years on Thursday as the world's second-biggest fashion retailer said its drive to meet rapid changes in the market were on track.

title: In turbulent times, Tesco's new boss has something to build on
description: When the little known Ken Murphy takes over next year as CEO of Tesco , Britain's biggest retailer, he will inherit something current boss Dave Lewis did not have the luxury of when he joined in 2014 - a strategy and a stable business.

title: UAW cites 'significant progress' in Ford talks as GM strike continues
description: The United Auto Workers union said on Thursday it has made "significant progress" in contract talks with Ford Motor Co , even as a strike at General Motors Co  is in its third week.

title: Advertising blitz, sugar-free Gatorade drive PepsiCo profit beat
description: PepsiCo Inc  benefited from an ad blitz in the third quarter, beating profit and sales estimates, as more health-conscious consumers bought its low-calorie beverages and snacks in North America.

title: China is dumping wooden cabinet imports in U.S.: Commerce Department
description: The U.S. Commerce Department said in preliminary determination on Thursday that China was dumping wooden cabinets in the United States at margins ranging from 4.5% to 262.2%.

title: Some LSE investors call on Hong Kong exchange to up bid by 20%, add cash
description: Some London Stock Exchange investors have told Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) that any bid must contain more cash and be up to 20% higher to persuade them to engage, three shareholders and a banking source close to the deal said.

title: Facebook's Instagram launches Snapchat-like 'Threads' app
description: Facebook Inc said on Thursday it was launching a separate camera-first messaging app, "Threads", for its photo-sharing platform Instagram, stepping up the company's social media war with smaller rival Snapchat.

title: Apple chief says against ceiling on hiring of qualified migrants
description: Apple's chief executive Tim Cook said on Thursday he was a "supporter" of immigration and was against any ceiling on the hiring of qualified migrants.

title: Corona maker Constellation hit by pot investment loss; shares drop
description: Constellation Brands Inc  racked up millions of dollars in losses from its investment in Canadian pot company Canopy Growth, pushing the maker of Corona and Modelo beers into a quarterly loss and sending its shares down as much as 8%.

title: Explainer: The jet subsidy row that threatens transatlantic trade war
description: The United States will learn on Wednesday the annual value of European Union goods it is allowed to target with tariffs as part of a 15-year-old dispute at the World Trade Organization over illegal subsidies to the world's largest planemakers.

title: Renault chairman auditions narrowed field of Nissan CEO candidates
description: The Nissan Motor Co  CEO race has narrowed to a contest between three Renault-Nissan veterans, with Renault's chairman conducting interviews ahead of a Renault-Nissan alliance meeting scheduled for Wednesday, people familiar with the matter said.

title: EU says U.S. tariffs linked to Airbus would be counterproductive
description: The European Commission said on Wednesday that a U.S. move to impose trade sanctions on EU imports would be short-sighted and counterproductive and risked causing damage on both sides of the Atlantic.

title: WTO awards U.S. right to hit 7.5 billion of EU goods over Airbus subsidies
description: The World Trade Organization ruled on Wednesday that the United States could target $7.5 billion of imports from the European Union over illegal subsidies for planemaker Airbus.

title: Timeline: Highlights of the 15-year Airbus, Boeing trade war
description: The World Trade Organization is poised on Wednesday to open the door to hefty U.S. tariffs on European goods over illegal subsidies for Airbus, pushing a 15-year-old row over support for plane giants to the center of fraught global trade relations.

title: WTO decision will weigh on Airbus, Germany's Merkel says
description: A decision by the World Trade Organisation (WTO) allowing the United States to target goods imported from the European Union over illegal subsidies to Airbus  will weigh on the planemaker, German Chancellor Angela Merkel said on Wednesday.

title: Airbus urges talks to settle long-running trade dispute
description: Airbus  on Wednesday urged talks to reduce trade tensions after the World Trade Organization gave the United States approval to impose tariffs on $7.5 billion worth of European goods over illegal EU subsidies handed to Airbus.

title: France ready to hit back if U.S. sanctions EU imports: minister
description: France is ready to retaliate if the United States goes ahead with trade sanctions on EU imports, its finance minister said on Wednesday after Washington won WTO backing for the measures.

title: Website that allowed Huawei phones to install Google apps taken down
description: A China-based website that allowed for manual installation of Google's Android apps on Huawei's newly launched Mate 30 devices went offline on Wednesday after a security researcher highlighted the "backdoor" to sidestep a U.S. ban.

title: U.S. SEC proposes exchanges seek public consultation on data fee changes
description: The U.S. securities regulator on Tuesday proposed a change to the way exchange operators alter their fees, in a move aimed at improving transparency but which could make it harder for operators to compete on price to propel revenue growth.

title: Britain says tariffs are no answer to Airbus dispute after WTO ruling
description: Britain said tariffs were in no-one's interest and should not be applied to the UK after a ruling by the World Trade Organization on Wednesday that the United States could target $7.5 billion of imports from the European Union over illegal subsidies for planemaker Airbus.

title: Citi says prospects for a Brexit deal look weak so brace for delay
description: U.S. investment bank Citi said the Brexit proposals of British Prime Minister Boris Johnson appeared to fall foul of European Union red lines so an extension and election were likely.

title: Tesla's China production to start, eyes on mass production timing: sources
description: Tesla Inc's  China factory aims to start production this month but it is unclear when it will meet year-end production targets due to uncertainties around orders, labor and suppliers, sources with knowledge of the matter said.

title: London court allows mass claim against Google over iPhone data
description: London's Court of Appeal gave the go-ahead for action against Google  over claims it collected data from more than 4 million iPhone users, overturning a ruling in 2018 that in effect blocked any route to legal redress.

title: CIS-based firm Freedom Holding plans NASDAQ listing
description: Freedom Holding Corp, a U.S. holding companies with subsidiaries that provide services to financial markets in Eastern Europe and Central Asia, has gained approval to list on New York's NASDAQ Capital Markets exchange, it said on Wednesday.

title: Samsung ends mobile phone production in China
description: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd  has ended mobile telephone production in China, it said on Wednesday, hurt by intensifying competition from domestic rivals in the world's biggest smartphone market.

title: WeWork Japan gets new CEO, days after We Company founder quits
description: WeWork Japan on Wednesday named a new head of local operations, just days after the co-founder of the We Company stepped down following a botched attempt to gain a stock market listing.

title: Paddy Power and Poker Stars owners to create online gambling leader
description: The owner of Paddy Power Betfair has agreed to buy the company behind Poker Stars in a $6 billion share deal to create the world's largest online betting and gambling company by revenue,  seeking to take advantage of the opening up of U.S. markets.

title: Softbank names Ralf Wenzel to oversee joint ventures in Latin America
description: Japan's Softbank Group Corp  named entrepreneur Ralf Wenzel as chief executive at its Latin American Tech Hub, with the goal of creating joint ventures among Softbank-backed companies in an effort to expand in the region.

title: Volkswagen registers unit in Turkey ahead of production decision
description: Volkswagen  has established a subsidiary in Turkey's western Manisa province, the country's Trade Registry Gazette showed on Wednesday, as the company nears a final decision on the location for its new production plant.

title: Veteran investor Gilbert to leave Standard Life Aberdeen
description: Veteran investor Martin Gilbert will leave Standard Life Aberdeen  next year, ending a career spanning more than three decades at the helm of one of Britain's most successful asset managers.

title: Credit Suisse says risk calculation, hedging change to reap $250 million
description: Credit Suisse  on Wednesday said it expects an estimated $250 million boost in annual profit from higher net interest income it expects to reap by calculating risk-weighted assets in dollars rather than Swiss francs.

title: UK to fly back another 7,100 people on Wed after Thomas Cook collapse
description: UK's Civil Aviation Authority said 44 flights are scheduled to fly on Wednesday to bring back 7,100 people back to the country, following the collapse of travel firm Thomas Cook.

title: Job done - Tesco boss to quit next year
description: Tesco  boss Dave Lewis, credited with saving Britain's biggest retailer from collapse in 2014, will step down next summer after declaring its turnaround complete, handing over to a relative unknown catapulted into one of the sector's top jobs.

title: German businesses urge EU to protect them after latest WTO decision
description: Germany's DIHK chambers of commerce on Wednesday urged the European Union to act strongly in order to protect their interests in a tariff row between the EU and the United States, reacting to the World Trade Organization's (WTO) latest decision.

title: ASOS shakes up board to revive fortunes
description: Online fashion retailer ASOS Plc on Wednesday revamped its board by naming several new directors, including Ocado Solutions Chief Executive Officer Luke Jensen, as it looks to bounce back from a string of profit warnings.

title: Johnson & Johnson settles Ohio lawsuits to avoid federal trial
description: Johnson & Johnson said on Tuesday it will pay $20.4 million to settle claims by two Ohio counties, allowing the U.S. healthcare giant to avoid an upcoming federal trial seeking to hold the industry responsible for the nation's opioid epidemic.

title: U.S. orders speedy checks for cracks on 165 Boeing 737 NG planes
description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration said on Wednesday that aircraft operators must inspect 165 Boeing 737 NG airliners for structural cracks within seven days after the issue was found on a small number of planes.

title: Exclusive: Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs poised to lead Airbnb's listing - sources
description: Short-term home rental company Airbnb Inc is set to hire Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs Group Inc as joint lead advisers on its planned stock market flotation next year, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.

title: Amazon.com brings Alexa to Brazil, kicks off pre-orders for devices
description: Amazon.com Inc will launch its virtual assistant Alexa in Brazil starting this month, with plans for three different devices with the software installed, as it rapidly expands operations in Latin America's largest economy.

title: London forex trader sues Citigroup over 'malicious' forex prosecution
description: A London-based former Citigroup  trader is suing the U.S. bank for more than $112 million, alleging it made materially false and malicious statements to U.S. prosecutors that led to his trial in New York on foreign exchange-rigging charges.

title: Troubles with Tesla's automated parking feature summon safety regulators
description: U.S. regulators are looking into parking lot crashes involving Tesla Inc  cars driving themselves to their owners using the company's Smart Summon feature, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on Wednesday.

title: Tesla deliveries miss Wall Street estimates; shares fall 6%
description: Electric car company Tesla Inc said on Wednesday its deliveries rose less than 2% in the third quarter, missing Wall Street estimates and sending its shares down nearly 6% in trading after the bell.

title: Investors keep their faith in Hong Kong markets despite protests
description: As anti-government protesters fought pitched battles with police in Hong Kong streets last week, a group of bankers in another part of the city were busy taking in billions for the public float of the Asia unit of the world's largest brewer.

title: GoPro cuts second-half outlook citing Hero8 shipment issues
description: GoPro Inc  on Wednesday cut its revenue and profit forecasts for the rest of the year, hit by a delay in production of its latest Hero8 Black cameras, triggering a 19% drop in its shares.

title: Brazil telecom carrier Oi may consider selling mobile operation: executive
description: Brazilian telecom carrier Oi SA  may consider selling its mobile operation if it gets attractive offers, Chief Operating Officer Rodrigo Abreu told Reuters on Wednesday, following reports of interest from its largest rivals.

title: Kroger to layoff several store employees
description: Kroger Co  is looking to lay off several store employees holding middle management roles, amidst the supermarket chain's push to improve delivery and in-store technology to attract shoppers.

title: U.S. to hit EU with tariffs of 10% on aircraft, 25% on other goods: official
description: The United States will impose 10% tariffs on aircraft and 25% on other industrial and agricultural products from the European Union as part of a World Trade Organization penalty award in a long-running aircraft subsidy case, an official with the U.S. Trade Representative's office said on Wednesday.

title: Wall Street tumbles as trade war threatens U.S. economy
description: Wall Street's main indexes suffered their sharpest one-day declines in nearly six weeks on Wednesday after employment and manufacturing data suggested that the U.S.-China trade war is taking an increasing toll on the U.S. economy.

title: Any errors in arrest of Huawei CFO were technical, Canadian government tells court
description: Any errors in the arrest of Huawei Technologies Co Ltd's Chief Financial Officer Meng Wanzhou in Canada last December were technical in nature and do not meet the requirements to suspend her extradition proceedings to the United States, government lawyers said in court on Wednesday.

title: Global stocks fall to lowest in month on U.S. growth worries
description: World equity benchmarks hit their lowest levels in a month on Wednesday as signs of a slowdown in U.S. economic growth and weak earnings in Europe fanned fears that the U.S.-China trade war could push the global economy into a recession.

title: Delta says new U.S. tariffs on Airbus will hurt profits, inflict 'serious harm'
description: Delta Air Lines Inc  warned on Wednesday that new U.S. tariffs on Airbus  planes "will inflict serious harm on U.S. airlines" and shrink the company's profits.

title: Oil slides 2% as U.S. inventories build, weak economic data weighs
description: Oil prices fell more than 2% on Wednesday after official data showed a rise in U.S. crude inventories, adding to worries about an oversupplied market as weak economic readings in the United States depressed global financial markets.

title: Pompeo says U.S. tariffs after WTO ruling could include cheese, wine
description: U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo said on Wednesday that retaliatory U.S. tariffs following the World Trade Organization ruling over European illegal subsidies for planemaker Airbus  could include cheese and wine.

title: Florida joins Justice Department settlement with Sprint, T-Mobile
description: Florida has signed on to a consent agreement that the Justice Department reached with Sprint Corp and T-Mobile US Inc to allow the companies to merge, according to a court filing on Wednesday.

title: U.S. set to quickly widen trade war with EU tariffs after WTO ruling: sources
description: The United States' top trade body is likely to release a list of European goods subject to new tariffs Wednesday afternoon, after the World Trade Organization's landmark ruling on illegal aircraft subsidies, industry sources said.

title: Analysts cut estimates for Exxon's third-quarter profit on weaker oil prices
description: Analysts on Wednesday trimmed their profit estimates for Exxon Mobil Corp  after the largest publicly traded oil producer pointed to weaker third-quarter results in a regulatory filing due to weaker oil prices and chemicals margins.

title: Pick-up trucks remain mainstay for Detroit Three in third quarter
description: The Big Three U.S. automakers on Wednesday reported a rise in sales of pick-up trucks for the third quarter as lower interest rates boosted demand in an otherwise sluggish auto market.

title: Slowing U.S. private hiring adds to gloom over economy
description: Hiring by U.S. private employers slowed further in September, suggesting that trade tensions, which have pressured manufacturing, could be spilling over to the labor market.

title: Airbus hits four-month low after WTO ruling; Pernod falls
description: Airbus  shares fell to four-month lows and Pernod Ricard SA  extended losses on Wednesday after Washington won approval to impose tariffs on $7.5 billion worth of European goods, opening a new front in the global trade war.

title: Short sellers circle cannabis stocks as profits dwindle
description: Wall Street's love of cannabis appears to be going up in smoke as vaping-related ailments and missed revenue projections are prompting short sellers to raise their bets against the industry, fund managers and analysts said on Wednesday.

title: Despite third quarter decline, Tesla's Model 3 stays on top in Norway
description: Tesla Inc's electric Model 3 remained Norway's top-selling car in the third quarter, although its sales declined from earlier in the year, registration data showed on Tuesday.

title: Facebook, Google, Amazon face another House inquiry: Bloomberg
description: Facebook Inc, Amazon.com Inc and Alphabet Inc's Google will face a congressional inquiry on how the big technology companies may be damaging the competitive landscape for small businesses, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday.

title: WPP poaches Sainsbury's Rogers to be finance chief
description: Advertising group WPP  has poached John Rogers, the boss of Sainsbury's  Argos business and previously seen as a frontrunner to be the British supermarket group's next CEO, as its new finance chief.

title: Ryanair boss slams UK aviation regulator after Thomas Cook collapse
description: Ryanair  boss Michael O'Leary slammed Britain's aviation regulator on Tuesday, saying its soft licensing rules contributed to the chaos around Thomas Cook's  bankruptcy.

title: Charles Schwab to end commissions for stock trading, shares fall
description: Discount brokerage Charles Schwab Corp  said on Tuesday it is eliminating commissions for online trading of stocks, ETFs and options listed on U.S. or Canadian exchanges.

title: Strike hits Fiat Chrysler plant in Italy after death of worker
description: A Fiat Chrysler  worker died overnight in an accident at the group's factory in Cassino, central Italy, prompting unions to launch a strike at the plant to demand tighter safety measures, officials said on Tuesday.

title: Hyundai, Kia sue four big U.S. railroads over fuel surcharges
description: Hyundai Motor Co  and its Kia affiliate have sued the four largest U.S. railroads, accusing them of violating U.S. antitrust law by conspiring to drive up shipping costs though coordinated fuel surcharges.

title: Ford ties up with Mahindra in India to cut risks and costs
description: Ford Motor Co and Mahindra & Mahindra said on Tuesday they would form a joint venture in India, in a move aimed at reducing risks for the U.S. automaker's local business and cutting the cost of developing and producing vehicles for emerging markets.

title: Major U.S. investors have billions at risk in Chinese stocks
description: Major U.S. fund managers have tens of billion of dollars at stake in some of the most popular Chinese stocks on Wall Street, exposing them to potential losses should the White House move to delist Chinese firms from U.S. exchanges.

title: GE to provide world's most powerful turbines for British wind project
description: GE Renewable Energy has been chosen as preferred supplier to provide turbines for Britain's Dogger Bank offshore wind project being developed by SSE  and Equinor , the companies said on Tuesday.

title: Factbox: European airline collapses since 2017
description: Adria Airways is the latest in a string of airlines to have folded in the past few years, leaving thousands of passengers stranded in airports, with a knock-on effect on related industries such as hospitality.

title: Thomas Cook owes Turkey's tourism sector $381 million - council
description: Turkey's Tourism Advisory Council said on Tuesday it estimates that Thomas Cook owes the local sector more than 350 million euros ($381.08 million), adding that it was impossible for the amount to be re-paid in the short- and medium-term.

title: Fiscal crises biggest risk to global business, WEF says
description: The possibility of a fiscal crisis is the biggest risk to doing business globally, according to a survey of World Economic Forum business leaders published on Tuesday, though there were strong regional differences in views of the biggest risk.

title: Stocks inch higher as investors downplay escalating trade war
description: (This September 30 story has been refiled to correct company name in paragraph 11 to "Amundi" from "Amundi Pioneer")

title: As Draghi leaves ECB, his opponents get chance to turn the tables
description: Mario Draghi leaves the European Central Bank at the end of the month, and that may give opponents of his ultra-easy monetary policy a chance to shift the tone of the debate at the top of the institution.

title: TSMC counter-sues U.S. chip rival GlobalFoundries for patent infringement
description: Apple Inc supplier TSMC  has counter-sued smaller contract chipmaking rival GlobalFoundries Inc in the United States, Germany and Singapore, saying the U.S. firm has infringed 25 of its patents.

title: Danske Bank closes down its banking activities in Estonia
description: Danske Bank  said its Estonian business had entered into liquidation on Tuesday after the country's financial regulator in February ordered it to close its branch at the center of one of the largest ever money laundering scandals.

title: Credit Suisse chairman apologizes to Khan for surveillance
description: Credit Suisse  Chairman Urs Rohner apologized to the bank's former wealth management head Iqbal Khan for an "inappropriate surveillance operation" ordered by the bank's chief operating officer, who had to step down.

title: UK to fly back 7,000 people as Thomas Cook repatriation efforts enter second week
description: Britain's Civil Aviation Authority on Tuesday said 39 flights are scheduled to bring back a further 7,000 people to the country after the Thomas Cook collapse, as the operation enters its second week.

title: UK accounting watchdog examining EY audit of Thomas Cook
description: Britain's Financial Reporting Council has started an investigation into accountant EY's audit of Thomas Cook, the travel company that collapsed last month leaving tens of thousands of holiday-makers stranded abroad.

title: King dollar reigns supreme as U.S. outshines the euro area
description: The dollar surged to a 29-month high against a basket of rival currencies on Tuesday, while pummeling the euro to its weakest since May 2017.

title: Ryanair can bide its time for better plane deals, says O'Leary
description: Ryanair  can wait out price rises sought by planemakers since the global grounding of the Boeing 737 MAX, the Irish airline's boss said on Tuesday.

title: Credit Suisse clears its CEO in spying scandal that rocked Swiss banking
description: Credit Suisse  cleared its CEO on Tuesday of snooping on a star wealth manager in an episode that saw suicide, scandal and espionage invade the secretive world of Swiss private banking.

title: Italy's Illycaffe sets five year target for U.S. expansion
description: Italy's Illycaffe could reach its goal of opening 200 cafes in the United States within five years as part of a broader drive to expand its business outside its home market, Andrea Illy, the chairman of the premium coffee maker said.

title: Deere to lay off 163 U.S. workers as trade war dents equipment demand
description: Deere & Co  on Tuesday announced indefinite layoffs for 163 U.S. manufacturing workers at plants in Illinois and Iowa that make agricultural, forestry and construction equipment, citing decreased customer demand.

title: Goldman Sachs reshuffles Asia M&A leadership as John Kim joins Carlyle - memo
description: Tech specialists Raghav Maliah and Jung Min have been appointed co-heads of Goldman Sachs'  mergers and acquisitions in Asia Pacific excluding Japan as former head John Kim moves to global private equity giant Carlyle Group.

title: Juul hires Altria executive to handle regulation amid vaping crisis
description: Juul Labs Inc on Tuesday hired the head of regulatory affairs at its part-owner Altria Group Inc to take on a similar role at the e-cigarette maker, amid a regulatory backlash against the growth of teen vaping in the United States.

title: Weak oil prices hit Exxon's third-quarter earnings: filing
description: Exxon Mobil Corp's  operating profits fell last quarter for the fourth consecutive period, according to a regulatory filing on Tuesday that showed all three of its major businesses slumping from a year ago.

title: Visa, Mastercard reconsider backing Facebook's Libra: WSJ
description: Visa , Mastercard Inc  and other key financial partners may reconsider their involvement in Facebook Inc's  cryptocurrency, Libra, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: UAW rejects new GM offer as strike forces 6,000 Mexico layoffs
description: The United Auto Workers union said on Tuesday it rejected a new comprehensive offer from General Motors Co to end a two-week-old strike, saying the automaker came up short on several fronts including wages, healthcare and temporary workers.

title: WeWork weighs pullback in China as part of cost cuts: WSJ
description: WeWork's parent The We Company's new management team is considering curbing its expansion plans in China as part of the company's new emphasis on controlling costs, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Fitch downgrades WeWork after aborted IPO leaves financing hole
description: Global credit rating agency Fitch Ratings on Tuesday downgraded WeWork's credit rating by two notches to "CCC+", putting the Softbank-backed office-sharing firm deep into junk territory a day after it abandoned an initial public offering.

title: U.S. manufacturing dives to 10-year low as trade tensions weigh
description: U.S. manufacturing activity tumbled to a more than 10-year low in September as lingering trade tensions weighed on exports, further heightening financial market fears of a sharp slowdown in economic growth in the third quarter.

title: Wall Street tumbles as factory activity hits 10-year low
description: The S&P 500 and Dow suffered their worst tumbles in over a month on Tuesday after data showed U.S. factory activity shrank in September to its weakest in over a decade, ratcheting up fears that the U.S.-China trade war is hobbling the world's largest economy.

title: Too big to lend? JPMorgan cash hit Fed limits, roiling U.S. repos
description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  has become so big that some rival banks and analysts say changes to its $2.7 trillion balance sheet were a factor in a spike last month in the U.S. "repo" market, which is crucial to many borrowers.

title: Oil prices slip as U.S. economic data weakens demand outlook
description: Oil futures sank on Tuesday as weak U.S. economic data dimmed crude's demand outlook and pressured prices, while reports of a third-quarter decline in output from the world's largest oil producers kept oil from falling further.

title: Exclusive: Italian prosecutors widen probe over safety of Atlantia-operated bridges - sources
description: Italian prosecutors have widened an inquiry into suspected safety breaches at subsidiaries of Atlantia ATL.MI to include more employees and viaducts than they identified last month, two sources close to the investigation told Reuters.

title: Exclusive: Comcast emerges as new Google antitrust foe - sources
description: Comcast Corp, one of America’s largest media and communications companies, is wading into the epic regulatory pile-on against big tech companies such as Google, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Tesla registers Shanghai construction unit in acceleration of China plans
description: U.S. electric vehicle maker Tesla Inc has registered a construction company in China, a business registration filing shows, the latest sign Tesla is pushing ahead with its plans in the world's biggest auto market.

title: Big drone on campus: UPS gets U.S. government okay for drone airline
description: United Parcel Service Inc on Tuesday said it won the U.S. government's first full approval to operate a drone airline, which gave it a lead in the nascent U.S. drone delivery business over rivals Amazon.com Inc and Alphabet Inc.

title: U.S. September auto sales fall as shift in Labor Day holiday hurts
description: Automakers, including Toyota Motor Corp  and Hyundai Motor , on Tuesday reported a sharp drop in September U.S. sales, hurt by the early timing of Labor Day as sales from the holiday weekend were booked in August.

title: UAW rejects new GM offer, makes new counterproposal
description: The United Auto Workers union said a new comprehensive offer made by General Motors Co late Monday to end a two-week-old strike was not acceptable and said it had made a new counterproposal.

title: American Airlines pilots demand compensation over Boeing 737 MAX grounding
description: American Airlines Group's  pilots want compensation for  lost pay stemming from flights canceled as a result of the Boeing 737 MAX grounding, the head of the airline's pilot union said on Tuesday.

title: Fears of U.S. slowdown weigh on stocks; bonds rally
description: Weak economic data in the United States and Europe weighed on global stock benchmarks on Tuesday, sending investors into safe-haven assets.

title: PayPal to enter China market through local acquisition
description: U.S. digital money transfer platform PayPal Holdings Inc  has obtained Beijing's approval to buy a controlling stake in a domestic payments firm, which would make PayPal the first foreign firm to enter China's payment services market.

title: China urges 'calm and rational' resolution to U.S.-Sino trade war
description: China hopes Beijing and Washington will resolve their trade dispute "with a calm and rational attitude", Vice Commerce Minister Wang Shouwen said on Sunday, ahead of talks in two weeks between the two sides.

title: Big name IPOs in third quarter brighten gloom for equity market fundraising
description: A couple of hefty share listings in Europe and the return of AB InBev's  Asian unit float in the third quarter of 2019 brought some hope to a global IPO market battered by political volatility and downbeat global growth expectations.

title: Sempra Energy to sell Peruvian businesses to China Yangtze for $3.59 billion
description: Sempra Energy said on Monday it would sell its Peruvian businesses to a unit of China Yangtze Power Co for $3.59 billion, as part of a planned exit from South America to focus on its core U.S. and Mexican markets.

title: Saudi Aramco plans to pay base dividend of $75 billion in 2020
description: Saudi Arabia's state oil giant Saudi Aramco plans to pay a base dividend of $75 billion in 2020, it said in a corporate overview posted to its website on Monday as it prepares for an initial public offering (IPO).

title: Blackstone to buy U.S. warehouses from Colony Capital in $5.9 billion deal
description: Blackstone Group Inc  said on Monday it would buy U.S. industrial warehouses from real estate and investment management firm Colony Capital Inc  in a $5.9 billion deal, to capitalize on the e-commerce boom.

title: Exclusive: Fintech firm Revolut to hire 3500 staff in global push with Visa
description: British-based digital banking app Revolut is set to hire around 3500 staff as it expands into 24 new markets thanks to a new global deal with payments giant Visa Inc, the two companies said on Monday.

title: UK Markets watchdog fines Prudential 24 million pounds over annuity sales
description: Britain's markets watchdog has fined the country's largest insurer Prudential  24 million pounds ($29.39 million) for failures related to non-advised sales of annuities, it said on Monday.

title: Bank of America, Morgan Stanley eye growth in employee-benefits management
description: Morgan Stanley  and Bank of America Corp  are expanding the employee-benefits services they offer, hoping to gain market share in the dull-but-reliable business of managing wealth for companies and employees.

title: Exclusive: Dubai Aerospace drops plans for big aircraft order, targets M&A deal
description: Dubai Aerospace Enterprise favors expanding its fleet via a takeover of a rival after the group was unable to agree on a major order from Airbus  and Boeing , its chief executive said.

title: AB InBev Asia unit's strong Hong Kong debut to boost IPO outlook amid political unrest
description: AB InBev's Asia-Pacific unit , which raised about $5 billion after relaunching its IPO this month, rose more than 6% on its market debut in Hong Kong, easing concerns of the impact of ongoing anti-government protests on new share offerings.

title: Snapback to higher bond yields? At least five years, strategists say
description: A return to significantly higher yields will take longer than previously thought, according to a Reuters poll of fixed-income strategists who slashed their year-ahead major government bond yield forecasts to the lowest since polling began 17 years ago.

title: Global third-quarter M&A sinks to three-year low amid U.S.-China trade war fears
description: Global mergers and acquisitions (M&A) plunged 16% year-on-year to $729 billion in the third quarter, according to Refinitiv data, the lowest quarterly volume since 2016, as growing economic uncertainty curbed the risk appetite of companies considering deals.

title: Exclusive: Nasdaq cracks down on IPOs of small Chinese companies
description: Nasdaq Inc  is cracking down on initial public offerings (IPOs) of small Chinese companies by tightening restrictions and slowing down their approval, according to regulatory filings, corporate executives and investment bankers.

title: Hong Kong Aug home prices drop for third month, steeper declines forecast
description: Hong Kong private home prices fell for the third straight month in August, according to government data released on Monday, as increasingly violent street protests take a toll on the economy.

title: Hong Kong's sky-high property prices prove resilient in face of protests
description: While months of Hong Kong protests have scared away tourists, sent jitters across the financial centre and cast a dark cloud over the local economy, there's one thing residents of the city are confident they can bank on - sky-high property prices.

title: Global stocks stalled in third-quarter as bonds boom and dollar zooms
description: It has been a pivotal few months for financial markets. China and Europe have halted the global stocks rally, oil has cooled dramatically and rising recession worries have sent gold and government bonds charging again.

title: Volkswagen rejects judge's call to settle German class action on emissions
