title: Capri cuts sales forecast as Michael Kors demand slows
description: Capri Holdings Ltd  missed quarterly revenue estimates and cut its full-year sales forecast on Wednesday, as the high-end fashion house struggled with slowing demand for its Michael Kors brand at department stores and at its own retail outlets.

title: FedEx ends ground delivery partnership with Amazon
description: FedEx Corp confirmed on Wednesday it would terminate its contract with Amazon.com Inc for small-package ground deliveries, as the online retailer focuses on building out its own delivery network.

title: IAC explores option to spin off Match, ANGI; beats quarterly revenue
description: IAC/InterActiveCorp said it was exploring the possibility of spinning off its stake in Tinder-parent Match Group and online homeservices provider ANGI Homeservices as it reported a better-than-expected quarterly revenue on Wednesday.

title: GM wins victory in ignition switch defect lawsuits
description: General Motors Co  persuaded the U.S. federal judge who oversees nationwide litigation over defective ignition switches to narrow claims by owners who said their vehicles lost value because of the defect, which has been linked to 124 deaths.

title: Broadcom in advanced talks to buy Symantec's enterprise business: sources
description: Chipmaker Broadcom Inc is in advanced talks to buy  Symantec Corp's enterprise business, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Silver lining to U.S. market sell-off: Fundamentals still seem to matter
description: U.S. companies posting strong earnings are still winning laurels from investors, even amid the broad stock sell-off over the last week, suggesting that the kind of indiscriminate selling seen the last time an apparent devaluation of China's yuan spooked global markets is far from imminent.

title: Medina Mora, powerful Citigroup exec who battled scandals, dies at 69
description: Manuel Medina Mora, one of the most influential Mexican bankers to work on Wall Street during a long career at Citigroup Inc , has died, the bank's Mexican unit Citibanamex said on Wednesday. He was 69.

title: Dollar will be cut down to size if Fed gives in to market whims - Reuters poll
description: The U.S. dollar's dominance will come to an end if the Federal Reserve gives in to pressure from financial markets and President Donald Trump and chops interest rates another 50 basis points this year, a Reuters poll of market strategists showed.

title: Rush into U.S. bonds curbs global stock markets; gold touches 6-year high
description: Investors rushed into the safety of U.S. government bonds on Wednesday, muting a broad stocks rally as fears of a global recession grew.

title: S&P 500 erases big losses to end up; investors buy bargains, yields off lows
description: The S&P 500 recovered from steep early losses to end slightly higher on Wednesday as investors snapped up oversold shares and bond yields rebounded from significant lows that raised fears about a recession.

title: AMD lands Google, Twitter as customers with newest server chip
description: Advanced Micro Devices Inc  on Wednesday released the second generation of its processor chip for data centers and said that it had landed Alphabet Inc'  Google and Twitter Inc  as customers.

title: Hedge fund Hoplite Capital plans to shut down - letter
description: Hedge fund Hoplite Capital is returning money to outside clients after a period of sluggish returns, the firm's founder, John Lykouretzos, told investors in a letter on Wednesday.

title: Chemicals maker Albemarle profit beats, raises 2019 earnings forecast
description: Albemarle Corp  beat quarterly profit estimates on higher demand for bromine and raised its 2019 adjusted profit forecast on Wednesday, sending shares of the world's largest lithium producer up over 10% in extended trading.

title: Medicare to cover expensive cancer cell therapies
description: The U.S. Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) on Wednesday said it has finalized a decision to cover expensive cancer cell therapies sold by Gilead Sciences Inc  and Novartis AG .

title: Tesla stands by safety claims despite U.S. probes, subpoenas over crashes
description: Electric carmaker Tesla Inc stood by its Model 3 safety claims on Wednesday in the face of regulatory scrutiny, while documents showed the top U.S. automotive safety watchdog issued at least five subpoenas since last year seeking information about crashes involving the company's vehicles.

title: Lyft sees ride-hailing price war easing, sending Uber and Lyft shares up
description: Lyft Inc on Wednesday said a price war with rival Uber was easing, boosting shares of both companies and allowing Lyft to raise its outlook for the year and forecast a faster path to profitability.

title: U.S. government contractors get first look at Huawei ban
description: The U.S. agency responsible for government contracts on Wednesday released an interim rule for a ban on federal purchases of telecommunications equipment from five Chinese companies, including Huawei.

title: Trump says China is 'killing us with unfair trade deals'
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday said his tough stance on China's economic and trade policies would ultimately benefit the American economy, even as Beijing signaled it could strike back by curbing sales of chemicals known as rare earths that are used in everything from iPhones to military equipment.

title: Ryanair's UK pilots vote to strike later this month
description: Members of Ryanair's British pilot union voted on Wednesday in favor of strike action later this month in a dispute over working conditions, the British Airline Pilots Association (BALPA) said.

title: MMT may be Democrats' economic cure, but only Trump got the memo
description: From her home overlooking Setauket Harbor on Long Island's North Shore, a motorboat bobbing at the dock, Stephanie Kelton hopes to revolutionize how the U.S. government manages the economy.

title: CVS Health raises 2019 profit forecast after beating profit estimates
description: CVS Health Corp  raised its full-year profit forecast and reported higher-than-expected second-quarter results on Wednesday, as increased U.S. prescription drug prices fueled rebates to its pharmacy benefits business.

title: New York Times forecasts weakness in digital ads, shares down 12%
description: The New York Times Co  fell short of Wall Street estimates for revenue on Wednesday and warned of declines in digital advertising for the rest of the year, sending its shares down 12%.

description: Oil prices tumbled more than 4.5% on Wednesday to a seven-month low, extending recent heavy losses following a surprise build in U.S. crude stockpiles and fears that demand will shrink due to Washington's escalating trade war with Beijing.

title: Former Defense Secretary Mattis rejoins General Dynamics board
description: Former U.S. Defense Secretary Jim Mattis rejoined the board of General Dynamics Corp  on Wednesday, seven months after quitting his job in the Trump administration over disagreements about foreign policy, the defense contractor said.

title: AIG profit beats on strong underwriting, investment income
description: Insurer American International Group Inc  beat Wall Street estimates for quarterly profit on Wednesday, boosted by improved underwriting in general insurance business and higher investment income, sending its shares up 3% in extended trading.

description: Media company Fox Corp  reported quarterly results that beat Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, boosted by higher fees collected from cable and satellite operators and online distributors.

description: Apple Inc and Goldman Sachs Group Inc rolled out a virtual credit card on Tuesday, which will help the iPhone maker diversify from device sales and also build out the Wall Street bank's new consumer business.

title: Mercedes-Benz offers subsidies to retrofit older diesel cars in Germany
description: Daimler  said on Tuesday Mercedes-Benz customers in Germany could apply for a 3,000 euro ($3,350) subsidy to upgrade the exhaust filters of older, polluting diesel vehicles, the latest effort among German carmakers to avoid inner-city bans.

title: CBS, Nexstar to renew affiliation agreement in multi-year deal
description: CBS Corp  said on Tuesday it reached a multi-year agreement with Nexstar Media Group Inc  to renew CBS network affiliations for Nexstar stations.

title: Sprint to launch Chinese-made OnePlus 5G smartphone in U.S.
description: Sprint Corp said on Tuesday it would launch a 5G smartphone made by OnePlus, becoming the second U.S. wireless carrier after T-Mobile to offer a cellphone made by the Chinese company.

title: Trump still wants trade deal with China: adviser
description: U.S. President Donald Trump wants to continue trade talks with China and the Trump administration is still planning to host a Chinese delegation for further talks in September, a top White House adviser said on Tuesday.

title: German finance minister: U.S.-China trade conflict escalation would hurt economy more
description: An escalation in a trade conflict between the United States and China will further damage the global economy, German Finance Minister Olaf Scholz warned on Tuesday, urging all sides to negotiate.

title: Amazon Music cuts monthly price to 99 cents for students with Prime subscription
description: Amazon.com Inc  on Tuesday lowered the price of its paid music service to 99 cents per month from $4.99 for students with a Prime subscription.

title: Jolted markets mark new 2019 milestones
description: Global financial markets have been jolted in recent days by yet another escalation in a trade war between the United States and China, with the resulting selloff and bid for safety pushing assets and markers into new territory for the year.

title: Exclusive: China's Huawei seeks compensation from Flex over withheld goods
description: Huawei Technologies said it was seeking compensation from its contract manufacturer Flex Ltd  for illegally withholding some 400 million yuan ($57 million) worth of its goods in the wake of a U.S. trade ban on the Chinese firm.

title: More flexible yuan could be positive for China's credit rating: Fitch
description: A freer-floating yuan could be a positive for China’s sovereign credit rating, agency Fitch said on Tuesday, by helping preserve its foreign exchange reserves and cushioning some of the negative effects of U.S. trade tariffs.

title: Factbox: J.C. Penney's revolving door of CEOs
description: J.C. Penney Co Inc  late last year tapped Jill Soltau as chief executive officer to stem the decline in sales, the fifth leadership change at the department store operator in 15 years.

description: J.C. Penney Co Inc  has been struggling to reassure investors it can lure shoppers back into its stores amid fierce competition from online giants like Amazon.com Inc  and discount retailers like TJX Cos Inc's  Marshalls and T.J. Maxx chains.

title: Jeff Bezos sells Amazon stock worth $2.8 billion last week
description: Amazon.com Inc  Chief Executive Officer Jeff Bezos offloaded $990 million worth of shares in the company last Thursday and Friday, taking the total value of shares sold last week to $2.8 billion.

title: China firmly opposes currency manipulator label: PBOC
description: China firmly opposes a U.S. decision to label it a currency manipulator, its central bank said on Tuesday, adding that Beijing has not used and will not use the yuan to cope with trade frictions with the world's biggest economy.

title: Exclusive: India raises cost of refinery project with Aramco by 36% - sources
description: India has increased the cost estimate of a giant refinery and petrochemical project to be jointly built with Saudi Aramco and Abu Dhabi National Oil Co by more than 36%, after protests by farmers forced the relocation of the plant, four sources said.

title: Goldman Sachs sees no trade deal before 2020 U.S. election, now expects three rate cuts
description: Goldman Sachs said it no longer expects the United States and China to agree on a deal to end their prolonged trade dispute before the November 2020 presidential election as policymakers from the world's largest economies are "taking a harder line".

title: Air China to suspend Beijing-Hawaii flights amid weak travel demand

title: Some Wall Street workers face pay slump in 2019: report
description: Many Wall Street workers will see their pay stay flat or decline this year, as big banks and money managers continue to cut costs, according to a report on Tuesday by compensation consultancy Johnson Associates.

title: U.S. labor market slowing as job openings, hiring fall
description: U.S. job openings and hiring fell in June, suggesting that demand for labor was cooling in tandem with a slowing economy, which could provide another reason for the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates again next month.

title: U.S. Drug distributors propose $10 billion to end state lawsuits over opioids: Bloomberg
description: Drug wholesalers AmerisourceBergen Corp , McKesson Corp  and Cardinal Health Inc  have proposed a $10 billion settlement for claims that they played a part in the U.S. opioid epidemic, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with negotiations.

title: Snap to raise $1 billion to invest in AR, possible acquisitions
description: Snap Inc  on Tuesday said it will raise $1 billion in short-term debt and plans to invest in more media content, augmented reality features and may also buy other companies.

title: Exclusive: Airbus plans A321 Toulouse expansion in traces of axed superjumbo
description: Airbus is poised to open a new assembly line for the A321neo in Toulouse, France, easing a grip on production of the hot-selling jetliner enjoyed by workers in Germany and accelerating an industrial rethink caused by the demise of the much larger A380.

title: Disney to bundle Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+ at popular Netflix price

description: Members of the United Nations on Wednesday signed the Singapore Convention on Mediation, an agreement it hopes will make it easier to settle cross-border commercial disputes and stabilise trade relationships.

description: Walt Disney Co  reported a steeper earnings decline than Wall Street expected on Tuesday as the company poured money into its ambitious plunge into streaming media and began folding in assets purchased from Twenty-First Century Fox.

description: Twitter Inc said on Tuesday that it may have used data for personalized ads without a user's permission due to issues with the microblogging website's settings.

description: Barneys New York Inc filed for bankruptcy protection on Tuesday and put itself up for sale, pushed to the brink by falling revenue and soaring rent at its stores that caused many vendors to effectively stop shipping merchandise to the luxury department store chain.

title: U.S. FDA says some data testing Novartis' $2 million gene therapy was manipulated
description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration said on Tuesday that some data from early testing of Novartis' more than $2 million gene therapy Zolgensma was manipulated, but the agency  believes the treatment should remain on the market.

title: Walgreens to close about 200 stores in United States
description: Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc  said on Tuesday it plans to close about 200 U.S. stores and expects to record related pre-tax charges of between $1.9 billion and $2.4 billion.

title: Factbox: Marvel, monsters and 'Mandalorian' coming to Disney+ app

title: U.S. appeals court voids Google 'cookie' privacy settlement that paid users nothing

title: IAG says it hopes to bring forward first MAX delivery to 2022
description: British Airways owner IAG  is in talks with Boeing  to bring forward the first delivery of 200 737 MAX jets by a year to 2022, and said it was confident that the issues that led to its grounding would be addressed.

title: Timeline: Key dates in the U.S.-China trade war
description: The U.S.-China trade war intensified on Aug. 1 with U.S. President Donald Trump vowing to levy 10% tariffs on a remaining $300 billion (£247 billion) list of consumer goods imports from China starting on Sept. 1.

title: China says to take countermeasures if U.S. bent on putting tariffs on Chinese goods
description: China will have to take countermeasures if the United States is bent on putting more tariffs on Chinese goods, the Chinese foreign ministry said on Friday.

title: Honda first-quarter operating profit drops 16% on lower U.S. car sales
description: Japan's Honda Motor Co  reported a 16% drop in first-quarter operating profit on Friday, as a stronger yen weighed on overseas earnings and U.S. vehicle sales dropped.

title: Campbell confirms sale of Australian snacks unit Arnott's to KKR for $2.2 billion
description: Campbell Soup Co  on Friday confirmed that it signed a deal to sell its Australian snacks unit Arnott's and some of its international operations to KKR & Co Inc  for $2.2 billion as the U.S. company works on reducing debt.

title: Exclusive: Foxconn eyes sale of $8.8 billion China plant amid trade war woes - sources
description: Taiwan's Foxconn is exploring the sale of its new $8.8 billion display panel factory in China, people familiar with the matter told Reuters, as demand for the product wanes amid an intensifying U.S.-China trade war.

title: Exchange operator Cboe plans new data platform as profits rise
description: Cboe Global Markets Inc  plans to build a research and data platform that will provide its customers with trading insights and spur new financial products, the exchange operator said after posting better-than-expected earnings on Friday.

title: Exclusive - India's biggest carmaker Maruti Suzuki cuts temporary jobs as sales plunge
description: India's biggest automaker, Maruti Suzuki India Ltd , said it had cut the number of its temporary workers to cope with a slowdown in auto sales, adding to the jobless problem in Asia's third largest economy.

title: JPMorgan set for historic majority stake in China funds JV: sources
description: JPMorgan was on Friday poised to become the first foreign company to hold a majority stake in a Chinese mutual fund business, two sources said, setting a precedent that one analyst said would trigger a wave of similar transactions.

title: Trump instructed top aide to call China to warn more tariffs were coming: sources
description: As a tense meeting with top advisers on China trade talks ended, President Donald Trump turned to trade adviser Robert Lighthizer and told him to call China to warn that new tariffs were coming, two people familiar with the matter said on Friday.

title: Group of 12 U.S. states challenge Trump fuel economy penalty freeze
description: A group of 12 states led by California and New York on Friday challenged the Trump administration's decision to suspend a 2016 Obama administration regulation that more than doubled penalties for automakers that fail to meet fuel efficiency requirements.

title: Nissan wants Renault to reduce stake to revive Renault-FCA deal talks: WSJ
description: Carmakers Nissan Motor Co  and Renault SA  are trying to reach a deal to reshape their global alliance, in hopes of reviving Renault's merger talks with Italy's Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV , the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing emails and people briefed on the talks.

title: Disney report to shine spotlight on streaming war
description: Quarterly reports next week from Walt Disney Co, CBS and Viacom will likely highlight increasing competition in video streaming and could spark volatility in the so-called communication services sector, which has outperformed since it was overhauled last year.

title: Democratic senator warns of Trump involvement in Pentagon contract
description: U.S. Senator Mark Warner on Friday raised concerns over the Pentagon's decision to put on hold a $10 billion cloud computing contract after President Donald Trump said his administration was examining Amazon.com Inc's  bid following complaints from other tech companies.

title: First U.S. FAA-approved 'beyond-line-of-sight' drone flight completed
description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday it had approved the first drone flight beyond the operator's sight line, a major advance for retailers like Amazon.com Inc seeking to speed up deliveries by drone.

title: China vows fight against Trump's latest tariffs as stocks sink
description: China on Friday vowed to fight back against U.S. President Donald Trump's abrupt decision to slap 10% tariffs on the remaining $300 billion in Chinese imports, a move that ended a month-long trade truce.

title: Apple Card will not allow purchase of cryptocurrencies
description: The Apple Inc  credit card being launched with Goldman Sachs Group Inc  will not allow the purchase of cryptocurrencies with the card, according to a customer agreement posted to Goldman's website on Friday.

title: Google to allow rival search engines to compete on Android - at a price
description: Alphabet Inc's  Google will allow rivals to compete to be the default search engines on new Android devices in Europe, but they will have to pay for the privilege.

title: U.S. tariff threat may compound Apple's iPhone woes: BofA
description: Apple Inc could see a hit to its annual earnings from U.S. President Donald Trump's newly proposed 10% tariff on Chinese imports from Sept. 1, analysts from Bank of America Merrill Lynch said on Friday.

title: Exxon Mobil profit sinks, Chevron rises as both boost output
description: Weaker second-quarter refining and chemicals profits offset surging U.S. shale production at U.S. oil majors Exxon Mobil Corp  and Chevron Corp , the two reported on Friday.

title: U.S. shale shippers will pay surcharge for Trump steel tariffs
description: Plains All American Pipeline LP  said on Friday it will tack on a fee for users of a new oil pipeline to pay for the cost of the Trump administration's tariffs on imported steel, with analysts and traders calling it the first U.S. energy pipeline operator to do so.

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq close out worst week since December on trade worries
description: Wall Street extended its sell-off on Friday on renewed trade fears as the benchmark S&P 500 index and Nasdaq saw their worst weekly percentage plunges since December, when investors were spooked by the prospect of a looming recession.

title: Trump says China has to do a lot to turn things around in trade talks
description: President Donald Trump said on Friday China has to do a lot in order to turn things around in trade negotiations with the United States and that he can increase tariffs on Chinese goods.

title: China's new U.N. envoy says Beijing ready to fight U.S. on trade
description: China's new U.N. ambassador warned on Friday that if the United States wanted to fight China on trade "then we will fight," and signaled that trade tensions could hurt cooperation between the countries on dealing with North Korea.

title: Exxon Mobil profit sinks on weakness in chemicals, refining
description: Exxon Mobil Corp  on Friday reported a 21% drop in quarterly profit, its third period in a row of weaker year-over-year results, as sharply higher oil production was offset by weaker refining and chemicals business.

title: U.S. gives tentative approval for expanded Delta, Air France, Virgin joint venture
description: U.S. Transportation Secretary Elaine Chao granted tentative approval on Friday for an expanded transatlantic joint venture made up of Delta Air Lines Inc , Air France KLM SA  and Virgin Atlantic.

title: Wells Fargo boosts estimate for possible legal reserve shortfall to $3.9 billion
description: Wells Fargo & Co  said on Friday that it boosted its estimate for a possible legal reserve shortfall to $3.9 billion for the quarter ending June 30, from $3.1 billion earlier this year, according to a regulatory filing.

title: Apple, Google pause reviewing audio recordings from voice assistants
description: Apple Inc  and Alphabet Inc's  Google have globally suspended reviewing recordings from users interacting with their voice assistants, as concerns over data privacy mount.

title: 'Moving fast:' Musk's SpaceX eyes Florida for launch site for Mars rocket
description: Elon Musk's SpaceX is expanding its facilities in Florida to make room for the space company's forthcoming super heavy-lift launch vehicle dubbed Starship, according to a draft of the plans seen by Reuters on Friday.

title: Stocks, yields tumble as trade frictions unnerve traders
description: A measure of stocks across the globe posted on Friday its largest weekly loss of the year while yields in U.S. and German debt were near or at multi-year lows, after China vowed to retaliate against a possible new round of U.S. tariffs.

title: CBS, Viacom reach working agreement on leadership team: sources
description: Viacom Inc  and CBS Corp  have worked out a management structure in which Viacom Chief Executive Officer Robert Bakish would lead the combined company if the two entities reach a deal to merge, sources familiar with the matter said.

title: Exxon's U.S. refineries suffer greater outages in second quarter over year ago, data shows
description: Exxon Mobil Corp 's U.S. second-quarter refining profits bounced back from a loss earlier this year but remain below past levels in part because of a wave of production outages, according to an examination of data from Reuters and energy industry intelligence service Genscape.

title: Bombardier posts quarterly loss, lowers 2019 forecast; shares plunge
description: Bombardier Inc lowered its full-year earnings and cash flow forecasts and reported a quarterly loss on Thursday, as it faces challenges in its important rail division, sending shares of the Canadian train and plane maker down 18%.

title: Thomson Reuters raises outlook, grows fastest since financial crisis
description: Thomson Reuters Corp raised its sales and earnings outlook for 2019 and 2020 on Thursday after reporting 4% organic revenue growth in the second quarter, which it said was its best since 2008.

title: Factbox: LSE bolsters data, enters forex with Refinitiv deal
description: London Stock Exchange Group has agreed to buy Refinitiv for $27 billion, broadening its global footprint in financial data and market infrastructure to compete better with rivals like ICE and CME.

title: Britain's LSE delivers 'defining' $27 billion Refinitiv deal in data drive
description: London Stock Exchange has agreed to buy financial information provider Refinitiv in a $27 billion deal aimed at offering trading across regions and currencies and establishing the British company as a rival to Bloomberg.

title: Coffee baron's death fuels India Inc anger over government crackdown on wrongdoing
description: The apparent suicide of India's coffee baron V.G. Siddhartha, under investigation by tax authorities, has inflamed anger toward the government among business leaders who feel it is going too far in its crackdown on fraud and tax evasion.

title: South Korean chip giants face 'strangling' from Japanese export curbs
description: South Korean chipmakers are hitting a dead end in their quest to find alternatives for key Japanese materials that have been slapped with export restrictions, raising the prospect of major disruption to their operations in the coming months.

title: GM open to working with other automakers on development of EVs: CEO
description: General Motors Co  is open to working with other automakers on the development of electric vehicles, Chief Executive Mary Barra said on Thursday.

title: Atlanta Fed model raises U.S. third-quarter GDP view to 2.2%
description: The U.S. economy grew at a 2.2% annualized rate in the third quarter based on the latest data on national manufacturing activity and construction spending, the Atlanta Federal Reserve's GDPNow forecast model showed on Thursday.

title: Verizon beats profit estimates as monthly phone subscribers jump
description: Verizon Communications Inc on Thursday beat second-quarter profit estimates as the U.S. mobile carrier added more monthly phone subscribers than expected and stepped up efforts to deploy the next-generation 5G network nationwide.

title: U.S. confirms small soybean sale to private Chinese buyer
description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture on Thursday confirmed a private Chinese company bought 68,000 tonnes of soybeans in the week ended July 25, the first soybean purchase since Beijing offered to exempt five crushers from import tariffs imposed more than a year ago as part of a U.S.-China trade dispute.

title: Kellogg results beat forecasts on North America demand, shares surge
description: Kellogg Co  beat Wall Street expectations for quarterly sales and profit on Thursday, and the food maker's shares rose sharply as investments in marketing and product development drove higher demand for snacks, frozen waffles and meatless burgers in North America.

title: Higher medical costs take shine off Cigna second-quarter profit beat
description: Health insurer Cigna Corp  raised its 2019 profit forecast on Thursday, helped by last year's acquisition of pharmacy benefit manager Express Scripts, but medical costs in the second quarter were higher than expected and its shares fell slightly.

title: UniCredit says no evidence of any customer data breach after Capital One case-memo to staff
description: UniCredit  has found no evidence so far of any customer data having been accessed or compromised in relation to a major data breach at Capital One Financial Corp , the bank said in a memo to staff on Thursday.

title: 'Truck, truck and away': Pickups drive GM's profit beat
description: General Motors Co  posted a better-than-expected net profit on Thursday as high-margin pickup trucks, SUVs and crossovers helped overcome slowing sales in the United States and China, and reiterated its full-year earnings forecast.

title: ADM profit plunges as floods, U.S.-China trade war batter grain handler
description: Global grain trader and food processor Archer Daniels Midland Co  on Thursday reported a 41.3% drop in second-quarter adjusted profit and missed Wall Street expectations, after being battered by the U.S.-China trade war and severe U.S. weather this spring that disrupted production and transportation.

description: BNP Paribas analysts said late Wednesday they expect the Federal Reserve to lower key U.S. borrowing costs only one more time in 2019, with a 25 basis-point cut in September as an insurance against mounting risks.

description: U.S. refiner Marathon Petroleum Corp  beat estimates for quarterly profit on Thursday, benefiting from better-than-expected earnings from its refining segment as well as higher sales in its gas stations business.

description: Intercontinental Exchange Inc , which owns the New York Stock Exchange, on Thursday beat analysts' estimates for quarterly profit, helped by growth across its transaction and clearing business and data services unit.

description: Plant-based burger maker Impossible Foods on Wednesday announced a partnership with major meat supplier OSI Group [OSIGP.UL], a longtime producer of patties for fast-food chains, as it ramps up to meet demand from consumers and restaurants including Burger King.

title: WeWork hosts analysts before IPO; debt, lease obligations in focus
description: Wall Street banks are set to grill WeWork on its finances on Wednesday as it prepares to publicly sell stock for the first time, possibly in September, a sale that will create a benchmark for the rapidly expanding flexible office industry.

description: Some trading and investment firms are calling for competition regulators to scrutinize London Stock Exchange's  proposed $27 billion takeover of financial information provider Refinitiv to prevent further market data price hikes.

title: Apple woos investors with China gain, market value nears $1 trillion
description: Apple Inc shares  rose 4.4% on Wednesday, after the company calmed Wall Street nerves with an improvement in sales in China and as several brokerages predicted a boost from its services business and the launch of new iPhones in the second half of 2019.

title: U.S. Midwest manufacturing in contraction amid trade tension
description: Manufacturing industries in the U.S. Midwest tumbled into contraction territory in July as a deal on trade between China and the United States remained elusive, two private surveys showed on Wednesday.

title: Fiat Chrysler CEO says it has strong momentum into second half
description: Fiat Chrysler   enters the second half of the year with strong momentum, especially in North America and Latin America, Chief Executive Mike Manley said on Wednesday.

description: Credit Suisse  posted its highest quarterly earnings in four years on Wednesday, hailing frugal cost management as paying off in a tough environment.

description: Casino operator Crown Resorts  on Wednesday dismissed media reports that it flouted visa rules to bring Chinese gamblers to Australia after the government ordered an inquiry into immigration officials' dealings with the company.

title: Germany's Bayer dealt new legal blow as more Brazil farmers challenge soy patent

title: Bank of America ends joint venture with Fiserv's First Data
description: Bank of America Corp  said on Monday it would end its electronic payment services joint venture with First Data Corp next June, hours after Fiserv Inc  completed its acquisition of the payment processor.

title: Anadarko Petroleum sheds new light on Occidental finances ahead of vote
description: Anadarko Petroleum Corp  on Monday released new financial details of its proposed combination with Occidental Petroleum  that revealed its acquirer did not expect to generate enough cash to cover its shareholder payments until 2022.

title: Mylan deal puts future of its beleaguered EpiPen in spotlight
description: Mylan NV's  planned merger with Pfizer Inc's  off-patent branded drugs business may have boosted its share price on Monday, but one of its most pressing problems remains: shortages of its flagship EpiPen emergency allergy treatment.

title: Wall St. takes a pause in wait for Fed news, trade progress
description: U.S. stocks stepped back from peak levels on Monday as investors took a breather as they anticipated a U.S. Federal Reserve interest rate cut this week and looked for signs of progress from U.S.-China trade negotiations, currently under way in Shanghai.

title: Sterling slumps on 'no-deal Brexit' worries; stocks dip
description: The British pound touched its lowest level in over two years against the dollar after Prime Minister Boris Johnson said a hard divorce from the EU was in the cards, while stocks dipped globally with Wall Street backing off record highs.

title: Citi combines its stock trading and prime brokerage business
description: Citigroup Inc  is combining its stock trading business with its prime brokerage unit, which caters to hedge funds, private equity firms and other investors.

title: Uber lays off 400 employees in marketing team
description: Ride-hailing company Uber Technologies Inc  said on Monday it laid off 400 people globally from its marketing team.

title: Pfizer to spinoff, merge off-patent drugs unit with Mylan
description: Pfizer Inc  has agreed to spin off its off-patent branded drugs business and combine it with generic drugmaker Mylan NV , a move that leaves Pfizer with its more profitable innovative drugs, including cancer treatment Ibrance and pneumonia vaccine Prevnar.

title: Oil edges up on prospect of U.S. interest rate cut
description: Oil prices rose on Monday as the prospect of an expected interest rate cut by the U.S. Federal Reserve overshadowed  pessimism over U.S.-China trade talks and worries about slower global economic growth.

title: LSE-Refinitiv deal faces long antitrust review: sources
description: U.S. buyout fund Blackstone Group Inc  is expected to announce the merger of its majority-owned financial data firm Refinitiv with the London Stock Exchange Group Plc  within a week, but the deal is expected to face a long antitrust review before it can close, four sources told Reuters.

title: LSE's bid for Refinitiv spotlights quest for data, globality
description: London Stock Exchange Group Plc's  planned purchase of Refinitiv in a $27 billion deal is the latest sign that exchange operators are focusing more on data products to increase revenue, while also trying to expand their global reach.

title: SABIC CEO says no interest in taking over Clariant
description: Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC)  has no interest in taking over Swiss chemicals firm Clariant  and considers its 25% stake in the company as "a long term strategic investment," said its chief executive Yousef al-Benyan on Sunday.

title: Bosch sees car production falling 5% in 2019: report
description: Auto supplier Robert Bosch has revised its forecast for automotive production on Saturday, expecting a 5% fall this year, bigger than an earlier estimate for a 3% decline, the company's chief financial officer told Boersen-Zeitung.

title: Novartis CEO pledges not to sell Sandoz generics unit
description: Novartis  Chief Executive Vas Narasimhan pledged in an interview published on Saturday not to sell the Swiss drugmaker's generics unit Sandoz amid a revamp that has prompted speculation he is preparing to offload the business.

title: Pfizer in talks to merge off-patent drugs business with Mylan: source
description: Pfizer Inc  is in talks to merge its off-patent drugs business with Mylan NV  in a stock deal, according to a source familiar with the matter.

title: Exact Sciences in advanced talks to buy Genomic Health for $2.8 billion: Bloomberg
description: Cancer diagnostics company Exact Sciences Corp  is in advanced negotiations to buy healthcare company Genomic Health Inc  for about $2.8 billion to strengthen its cancer testing, Bloomberg reported on Saturday.

title: London Stock Exchange in talks to buy Refinitiv for $27 billion
description: The London Stock Exchange Group Plc  said on Friday it was in discussions to acquire financial data analytics provider Refinitiv Holdings Ltd for $27 billion, including debt.

title: Instant View: U.S. second quarter GDP growth slows to 2.1% but tops estimates
description: U.S. economic growth slowed less than expected in the second quarter as a surge in consumer spending blunted some of the drag from declining exports and a smaller inventory build, which could further allay concerns about the economy's health.

title: Alphabet shares jump 9% on ad rebound, cloud promise
description: Shares of Alphabet Inc  rose nearly 9% in premarket trading on Friday, after the company handily beat Wall Street targets on higher ad sales and touted growth at its cloud unit, a high-margin business it is leaning more on to drive growth.

title: New auto safety technology leaves insurers in the dark
description: Automakers are accelerating the rollout of technology designed to avoid crashes, but insurance companies are waving a caution flag at consumers eyeing discounts for buying collision-avoiding brakes or automated cruise control.

title: N.Y. Fed model raises U.S. third quarter GDP view above 2%
description: U.S. economy is growing faster in the third quarter than previously thought based on this week's June data on durable goods orders and new home sales, the New York Federal Reserve's Nowcast model showed on Friday.

title: SoftBank Group's $108 billion Vision Fund 2 draws in Microsoft, Apple
description: SoftBank Group Corp  has secured pledges from Microsoft Corp  and other investors of around $108 billion for a second Vision Fund aimed at investing in technology firms.

title: Twitter shares jump 10% on solid user growth, revenue beat
description: Twitter Inc  on Friday reported better-than-expected second-quarter revenue as design changes to its microblogging website attracted more users and advertisers, sending its shares up 10%.

title: Italy picks Deloitte to set up 500 million-euro real estate fund
description: Italy has picked the consulting firm Deloitte as its financial adviser in setting up a 500 million-euro real estate fund in an effort to squeeze money out of the property it owns, an official told Reuters on Friday.

title: Trump says second-quarter economic growth was 'not bad'
description: U.S. President Donald Trump wrote in a tweet on Friday that second-quarter economic growth, which slowed by less than expected, was "Not bad considering we have the very heavy weight of the Federal Reserve anchor wrapped around our neck."

title: U.S.-China tensions weigh on Huawei's ties with partners FedEx, Flex
description: U.S. FedEx Corp  on Friday again apologized and blamed Washington's ban on Huawei for being "unclear" as Beijing deepened an investigation into why the delivery firm was holding up packages meant for the telecoms equipment maker.

title: Alphabet says to continue talks with DoJ in antitrust review
description: Alphabet Inc on Thursday acknowledged a broader U.S. Department of Justice antitrust review of large technology firms and said it will continue to engage with the regulator.

title: Renault cuts revenue goal as car industry misery spreads
description: Renault  warned revenue may decline this year, scrapping a previous goal, after first-half profit was hit by weakening car demand and an earnings collapse at alliance partner Nissan  in the wake of the Carlos Ghosn scandal.

title: In Roundup case, U.S. judge cuts $2 billion verdict against Bayer to $86 million
description: A California judge on Thursday reduced a $2 billion jury verdict, slashing the award for a couple who blamed Bayer AG's glyphosate-based weed killer, Roundup, for their cancer to $86.7 million.

title: Alphabet's revenue rebounds; easing doubts on growth and boosting shares
description: Alphabet Inc shares rose about 8% after the company reported quarterly results that eased investors' concerns about growth challenges facing its Google advertising business.

title: Huawei rolls out 5G phone and flags first Hongmeng device
description: Huawei Technologies [HWT.UL] on Friday released its first 5G phone in China and said it would soon launch smart TVs equipped with its own Hongmeng operating system.

title: Apple pays $1 billion for Intel unit in push for chip independence
description: Apple Inc took a major step toward supplying its own smartphone chips by purchasing the majority of Intel Corp's modem business in a deal valued at $1 billion, the companies said on Thursday.

title: Australia to 'lift veil' on Facebook, Google algorithms to protect privacy
description: Australia said it would establish the world's first dedicated office to police Facebook Inc  and Google  as part of reforms designed to rein in the U.S. technology giants, potentially setting a precedent for global lawmakers.

title: Factbox: How Australia plans to curb Facebook and Google's market power
description: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has found, after an 18-month investigation, that Google and Facebook hold enormous power in the country's online advertising and news distribution markets, and that antitrust and privacy laws have not caught up to the real world.

title: Canada's new cannabis licensing favors richer companies, experts say
description: A new licensing process for legal cannabis producers in Canada limits the ability of smaller companies to attract investment, which could leave the fledgling industry dominated by companies with deep pockets or those who got a foot in the door prior to regulation changes in May, industry executives said.

title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Even if Fed cut is a given, Powell seen as wild card for stock market
description: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell will have to walk a fine line to avoid roiling the stock market next week, even if the central bank delivers on expectations and lowers interest rates for the first time in more than a decade.

title: U.S. economy misses Trump's 3% target in 2018
description: U.S. economic growth in 2018 missed the Trump administration's 3% target by any measure, which could renew criticism of the White House's $1.5 trillion in tax cuts.

title: Trump warns Google after Treasury chief says no concerns on China
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday kept up his pressure on global tech giant Google days after his Treasury secretary ruled out any national security concerns over the company's work in China.

title: U.S. economy slows in second quarter; weak business investment a red flag
description: U.S. economic growth slowed less than expected in the second quarter as a surge in consumer spending blunted some of the drag from declining exports and a smaller inventory build, which could further allay concerns about the economy's health.

title: Trump's ambitious Fannie, Freddie overhaul faces hurdles
description: President Donald Trump's administration faces a growing list of hurdles that could scuttle its ambitions to remove U.S. mortgage giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac from their government lifeline.

title: Factbox: Fannie, Freddie and the government: it's complicated
description: The Trump administration wants to take Fannie and Freddie out of government conservatorship, but doing so will be complicated due to the central role they play in the housing market and the Treasury's holdings in the two firms. [L2N24J0YC]

title: U.S. Department of Justice approves T-Mobile, Sprint tie-up
description: The U.S. Justice Department said it was greenlighting T-Mobile US Inc's request to acquire rival Sprint Corp after the companies agreed to divest Sprint's prepaid businesses including Boost Mobile to Dish Network Corp in an effort to create a new wireless competitor.

title: U.S. to deny tariff relief for Apple Mac Pro parts from China: Trump
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday said his administration would not grant Apple Inc any relief for tariffs on parts made in China for its Mac Pro computer and later added he thought the firm would build a plant in Texas.

title: Democrat calls for 'good faith' talks with USTR on USMCA trade deal
description: The Democratic head of the U.S. House Ways and Means Committee on Friday called for "good faith" negotiations with the Trump administration to address concerns about the new U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade agreement and pave the way for its passage.

title: Chevron 'hopeful' of U.S. approval to continue operating in Venezuela
description: Chevron Corp , the last U.S. oil company operating in Venezuela, said on Thursday it hopes to be able to remain in the Latin American nation as the Trump administration mulls whether to renew its license, expiring on Saturday, to do business there.

title: Sprint, T-Mobile win U.S. antitrust approval for $26 billion merger
description: T-Mobile US Inc won U.S. antitrust approval for its $26 billion takeover of rival Sprint Corp, the Justice Department said Friday, clearing a major hurdle to a deal that merges the nation's third and fourth largest wireless carriers.

title: Trump says he expects Apple to announce it will build plant in Texas
description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday he wanted Apple Inc  to build its plants in the United States and expects the technology firm to announce it will build one in Texas.

title: Anadarko Petroleum beats profit estimates on higher output
description: Anadarko Petroleum Corp , in its last earnings report before shareholders vote on its sale to Occidental Petroleum , on Friday reported a quarterly profit that topped analysts' estimates, as higher production offset lower prices for its oil.

title: LSE says it is in talks to buy Refinitiv for enterprise value of $27 billion
description: The London Stock Exchange Group Plc  said on Saturday it was in talks to buy data analytics platform Refinitiv for a total enterprise value of about $27 billion by issuing new LSE Group shares.

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq hit record highs; dollar gains ground
description: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq closed at record levels and the dollar reached a two-month high on Friday as strong economic data and a string of upbeat earnings reports brought buyers back to the market.

title: Elon Musk's Boring Co raises about $117 million in latest funding round
description: Elon Musk's Boring Co raised about $117 million in its latest round of funding from 20 unnamed investors after offering to sell about $120 million in equity, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing on Friday.

title: Oil gains on U.S. economic data, Gulf crude tanker dispute
description: Oil prices inched up on Friday, ending the week higher after stronger-than-expected U.S. economic data brightened the crude demand outlook and concerns over the safety of oil transport around the Strait of Hormuz threatened supply.

title: T-Mobile says cost to close merger with Sprint should come down by 10%
description: T-Mobile US said on Friday that the cost required to acquire smaller rival Sprint will come down by 10 percent from the initial $26.5 billion following the divesture of assets to Dish Network.

title: China's Wanda Sports raises $190.4 million in downsized IPO
description: Wanda Sports Group , a sport events owner whose interests include the distribution of media rights in Asia for the FIFA World Cup, said on Friday it priced a smaller-than-expected U.S. initial public offering (IPO) below its targeted range to raise $190.4 million.    The Beijing-based company, a unit of Chinese conglomerate Dalian Wanda Group, sold about 23.8 million American depositary shares (ADS) at $8 each, compared with a previously stated target

title: McDonald's beats sales forecast on new deals, store revamp
description: McDonald's Corp  beat quarterly sales expectations at established U.S. restaurants on Friday, as the world's largest burger chain attracted more diners with upgraded stores and new promotions, such as the 2 for $5 Mix and Match deal.

title: Dish Network has tough road to become competitive mobile carrier
description: Dish Network's  bid to become a fourth U.S. mobile carrier may cost billions more than it expected and pits it against corporate giants, but the satellite TV provider has an advantage in starting fresh with no legacy technology to maintain and deep-pocketed potential partners.

title: Gazprom gets bids worth $3.15 billion for sale of own shares
description: Gazprom , the world's biggest conventional gas producer, said on Thursday it had received bids worth 198.89 billion roubles ($3.15 billion) for 3% of its own shares that it is selling into the market.

title: Comcast second-quarter profit beats Wall St., misses on revenue
description: Comcast Corp's  second-quarter profit on Thursday beat Wall Street estimates as it added more high-speed internet customers, but it lost more video and phone customers than expected.

title: Raytheon profit beats, raises full-year outlook
description: U.S. weapons maker Raytheon Co  on Thursday reported a better-than-expected second-quarter profit and raised its full-year profit and sales outlook, helped by higher sales of missiles and guns for naval ships, sending its stock up 3% premarket.

title: PG&E expects $4.8 billion of initial contribution to California wildfire fund
description: Power producer PG&E Corp said on Thursday its initial contribution to California's wildfire fund would be about $4.8 billion, and annual contribution about $193 million.

title: J.P. Morgan pares U.S. second quarter GDP view to 1.0%
description: J.P. Morgan on Thursday trimmed its prior estimate on U.S. economic growth in the second quarter to 1.00% even in the wake of a larger-than-forecast increase in domestic durable goods orders and a shrinkage in trade goods deficit in June.

title: Nissan to cut 12,500 jobs as crisis deepens after profit wipe out
description: Nissan Motor Co  unveiled its biggest restructuring plan in a decade, axing nearly a tenth of its workforce and flagging possible plant closures to rein in costs that ballooned when Carlos Ghosn was CEO.

title: Exclusive: Kenya Airways goes full circle with two-year nationalization plan
description: Kenya will take at least 21 months to take back full control of its national carrier Kenya Airways , buying out minority shareholders and converting shares held by banks into Treasury bonds, a lawmaker briefed on the transaction said.

title: Autogrill enters exclusive deal with Panera Bread for U.S. market
description: Italian caterer Autogrill  said on Thursday it had signed an exclusive multi-year agreement with bakery chain Panera Bread to develop outlets in U.S. airports and motorways.

title: Atlanta Fed model lowers U.S. second quarter GDP estimate to 1.3%
description: The U.S. economy grew at a 1.3% annualized rate in the second quarter based on June data on domestic durable goods orders and advance goods trade, the Atlanta Federal Reserve's GDPNow forecast model showed on Thursday.

title: Tesla needs more time to turn profit; founding engineer steps down
description: Tesla Inc  on Wednesday pushed back its profit timeline once again after missing financial targets in the second quarter, while announcing that the pioneer of the company's electric batteries, J.B. Straubel, was stepping down from his role as chief technology officer.

title: Samsung Electronics' delayed Galaxy Fold now ready for September launch
description: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd's  first foldable smartphone, the Galaxy Fold, will go on sale from September in selected markets after the launch was delayed by screen problems earlier this year, the company said on Thursday.

title: Equities fall, bond yields rise on Draghi remarks, mixed earnings
description: U.S. stocks backed off record highs and government bond yields ticked up on Thursday following mixed earnings reports and rosier-than-expected economic sentiment from the European Central Bank.

title: Ford results dented by restructuring, gives weaker-than-expected forecast
description: Ford Motor Co  on Wednesday reported a lower-than-expected profit, weighed down by charges to restructure its units in Europe and South America, and the automaker gave a full-year earnings forecast that fell short of analysts' expectations.

title: Southwest ekes out profit as bookings offset MAX groundings;  Newark operations ceased
description: Southwest Airlines Co  eked out a small profit in the second quarter on Thursday as strong bookings offset the financial blow of the grounding of Boeing 737 MAX jets, which forced the carrier to cease operations at Newark Liberty International airport.

title: Volkswagen second-quarter operating profit up 30% as SUV push pays off
description: Volkswagen Group  shares rose 2% after the carmaker posted a 30% rise in second-quarter operating profit despite a drop in vehicle sales as rising demand for sports utility vehicles and premium brands boosted margins.

title: J.C. Penney tie-up favorable for Sephora business - LVMH
description: (Corrects reference to J.C. Penney headquarters in second paragraph in this July 24th story)

title: Old habits die hard: Saudi Arabia struggles to end oil addiction
description: When Saudi Aramco was on the verge of a deal last year to buy a stake in an Indian oil refinery, its boss quickly boarded a company jet in Paris and flew to New Delhi.

title: Salesforce expands footprint into China with Alibaba partnership
description: Salesforce.com Inc  said on Wednesday it will partner with Chinese e-commerce company Alibaba Group Holdings Ltd , as the U.S. cloud-based service provider looks to make inroads into the Chinese software market with its products.

title: AB InBev profits as beer sales growth hits five-year high
description: Anheuser-Busch InBev , the world's largest brewer, beat earnings expectations after beer sales grew at their fastest pace in over five years, helped by increases in Latin America, Europe and Africa and a later Easter.

title: Warren Buffett charity lunch in limbo after crypto promoter issues apology
description: Chinese cryptocurrency entrepreneur Justin Sun issued a lengthy public apology on Thursday for the manner in which he promoted his $4.57 million charity lunch with Warren Buffett, raising questions over whether the event will go ahead.

title: Exclusive: Nike explores sale of surfwear brand Hurley - sources
description: Nike Inc , the world's largest sportswear maker, is exploring options for its surfwear brand Hurley International, including its possible divestment, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Unilever second-quarter sales slip as wet weather hits Europe
description: Consumer goods giant Unilever Plc   reported slightly weaker-than-expected quarterly underlying sales growth on Thursday, hit by wet weather in Europe and moderating growth in India, but kept its full-year sales target intact.

title: China auto group cuts 2019 sales forecast to a 5% drop
description: China's biggest auto industry association has cut its sales forecast for this year due to slowing economic growth, and now expects sales to fall for the second year running.

title: Total plans $5 billion of asset sales to future-proof business
description: French energy giant Total  will sell about $5 billion of assets, mostly from its exploration and production business as it sharpens its focus on low-breakeven projects that can weather weak oil prices, it said on Thursday.

title: Starbucks traffic surges, posts best sales growth in three years
description: Starbucks Corp  attracted more customers in the latest quarter on an expanded line up of beverages and food offerings in the United States and China, leading the coffee chain to raise its fiscal 2019 profit forecast.

title: Hershey's tepid annual forecast overshadows quarterly profit beat
description: Hershey Co  reported a better-than-expected quarterly profit on Thursday, but forecast 2019 earnings below Wall Street expectations as the chocolate maker expects the benefits from recent price increases to be pushed out to next year.

title: Philip Morris launches first Africa store to spark alternative cigarettes demand
description: The South African unit of cigarette maker Philip Morris International Inc  opened its first flagship store in Johannesburg on Thursday, as it tries to grow demand in Africa for its alternative heated tobacco product IQOS.

title: Australian regulator to get unit specializing in tech companies
description: Australia's antitrust watchdog will be strengthened with a special branch to oversee the market power of U.S. technology giants Facebook  and Google  under sweeping regulatory reforms proposed by the government on Friday.

title: California, four automakers defy Trump, agree to tighten emissions rules
description: Four major automakers said on Thursday they have reached an agreement with California on fuel efficiency rules, bypassing a Trump administration effort to strip the state of the right to fight climate change by setting its own standards.

title: U.S. to pay farmers up to $16 billion for trade war losses, South to benefit
description: The U.S. government will pay American farmers hurt by the trade war with China between $15 and $150 per acre in an aid package totaling $16 billion, officials said on Thursday, with farmers in the South poised to see higher rates than in the Midwest.

title: U.S. attorney general, state officials discuss big tech firms' effect on competition
description: Eight state attorneys general met with U.S. Attorney General William Barr on Thursday to discuss the effect of big tech companies on competition, and various antitrust actions are being reviewed, the Texas attorney general's office said in a statement.

title: Amazon's push for one-day delivery dents profits, costs up 21%
description: Amazon.com Inc  on Thursday reported its first profit miss in two years and said income would slump in the current quarter, as the online retailer ramps up spending on one-day delivery to spark sales growth.

title: Dow cuts 2019 spending forecast on U.S-China trade tensions
description: Dow Inc  forecast current-quarter revenue below analysts' expectations on Thursday and cut 2019 spending as chemical companies grapple with U.S.-China trade dispute and an oversupply of chemicals used to make plastics.

title: Intel says customers stockpiling chips on U.S.-China tension, hikes forecast
description: Intel Corp forecast current-quarter profit and revenue above estimates and raised its full-year revenue forecast on Thursday, allaying concerns about a global semiconductor sales slowdown and curbs on U.S. sales to China's Huawei Technologies Co Ltd.

title: Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway raises stake in Bank of America
description: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway  has raised its stake in Bank of America Corp , the company said in a regulatory filing on Thursday.

title: U.S. business investment stabilizing, economy slowing
description: New orders for key U.S.-made capital goods surged in June, suggesting some improvement in business investment, but economic growth is still expected to have slowed sharply in the second quarter amid weaker exports and a smaller inventory build.

title: 'Toy Story 4', Barbie star in Mattel's surprise revenue rise
description: Mattel Inc  saw a big boost in demand for its action figures after the worldwide success of the latest "Toy Story" movie while a Barbie makeover lifted sales of the iconic doll, helping it report a surprise rise in quarterly revenue.

title: Wall Street gives up record high following weak results, Draghi
description: Wall Street fell from record highs on Thursday following a flurry of downbeat quarterly results from Ford Motor and other companies and after European Central Bank chief Mario Draghi's comments disappointed investors hoping for a more dovish stance on monetary policy.

title: U.S. DOJ in talks with states to win support for T-Mobile, Sprint  merger: WSJ
description: The U.S. Justice Department is negotiating with state officials to get them to support a planned settlement that would allow T-Mobile US Inc  and Sprint Corp  to merge by selling assets to Dish Network Corp , the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: As Boeing targets October, FAA official says no timeline for 737 MAX
description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration distanced itself on Thursday from suggestions by Boeing  that its grounded 737 MAX could resume flying passengers in October, saying regulators do not have a timeline for vetting safety upgrades.

title: T-Mobile beats estimates for phone subscribers
description: T-Mobile US Inc  on Thursday beat analysts' estimates for second-quarter net new phone subscribers who pay a monthly bill, boosted by the U.S. mobile carrier's competitive wireless plans aimed at fending off its bigger rivals.

title: T-Mobile reschedules analyst call without giving reason
description: T-Mobile US Inc  has rescheduled a call with analysts that was to be held on Thursday following its earnings release, the company said on its website.

title: Oil climbs on Iran tensions, U.S. inventory decline
description: Oil prices edged higher on Thursday supported by rising tensions between the West and Iran and a big decline in U.S. crude stockpiles, but gains were capped due to lingering worries about slowing economic growth that could reduce fuel demand.

title: Boeing 737 MAX groundings plague U.S. airlines, 'frustrated' Southwest exits Newark
description: Boeing Co's  top two U.S. customers warned on Thursday of an increasing financial toll from the prolonged grounding of the 737 MAX jet, which prompted a "frustated" Southwest Airlines Co  to announce it was ending operations at Newark Liberty International airport.

title: Boeing posts biggest loss on 737 MAX, may have to halt production of jet
description: Boeing Co  posted its largest-ever quarterly loss on Wednesday due to the spiraling cost of resolving issues with its 737 MAX, warning it may have to shut production of the grounded jet completely if it runs into new hurdles with global regulators getting its best-selling aircraft back in the air.

title: Eliquis, Orencia sales propel Bristol-Myers to strong second quarter
description: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co , which is set to buy biotechnology company Celgene Corp  for $74 billion, posted better-than-expected second-quarter profit on Thursday on strong sales of blood thinner Eliquis and rheumatoid arthritis treatment Orencia.

title: Five things to look for in Twitter's results
description: Twitter Inc  will have a chance to detail its plans to grow users and ad dollars on Friday when it releases its second-quarter earnings before the market opens.

title: Tesla shares, bonds under pressure as Musk changes tune on profit
description: Shares of Tesla Inc  sank 14% on Thursday and its bonds traded lower, a day after the electric carmaker said it needed more time to turn a profit, reported lower margins and announced the departure of a key executive.

title: Nissan warns of profit plunge, set to unveil 10,000 job cuts
description: Nissan Motor Co Ltd  warned on Wednesday that first-quarter profit tumbled around 90% percent, a day before it is expected to announce more than 10,000 job cuts as the crisis deepens at Japan's second-largest automaker.

title: Dunkin' to add Beyond Meat sausages in breakfast sandwiches
description: Dunkin' Brands Group Inc said on Wednesday it would add vegan burger maker Beyond Meat Inc's plant-based sausages to its breakfast menu at stores in Manhattan.

title: Facebook to pay $100 million to settle with SEC over misuse of user data
description: Facebook Inc  agreed to pay a $100 million fine to settle charges by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that it misled investors for more than two years about the misuse of its users' data, the regulator said on Wednesday.

title: Daimler vows to cut costs after one-offs bring loss
description: Luxury carmaker Daimler  said it would intensify cost cuts after legal risks for diesel-related issues and the cost of replacing Takata airbags triggered a 1.56 billion euros ($1.74 billion) loss before interest and taxes in the second quarter.

title: Nasdaq beats quarterly profit on strength in non-trading units
description: U.S. exchange operator Nasdaq Inc  beat analysts' estimates for second-quarter profit on Wednesday, as a boost in its non-trading businesses, including information services, overshadowed a softer trading environment.

title: PSA-Opel savings drive new profit record, defying slump
description: French carmaker PSA Group  delivered a sharp increase in first-half profit, defying a global industry downturn as new models and cost savings from the integration of Opel-Vauxhall more than made up for weaker emerging market sales.

title: Trump has no position on Boeing's 737 Max, but says it must be fixed to fly: Mnuchin
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has no position on Boeing Co's  grounded 737 Max aircraft except that the plane's flaws must be fixed if the company wants to win U.S. approval to fly it again, U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said on Wednesday.

title: AT&T wireless business grows but premium TV subscribers decline
description: AT&T Inc  exceeded analyst expectations on Wednesday for net wireless subscribers who pay a monthly bill, as it eked out some growth in a saturated market and continued to bundle media content from Time Warner into new wireless plans.

title: GM Cruise to delay commercial launch of self-driving cars to beyond 2019
description: General Motors Co's self-driving unit, Cruise, said on Wednesday it was delaying the commercial deployment of cars past its target of 2019 as more testing of the vehicles was required.

title: KKR devours Tim Tam biscuits maker in $2.2 billion deal with Campbell
description: KKR & Co  said it is buying Campbell Soup Co's  Australian snacks unit Arnott's that will give it ownership of top-selling biscuit brands such as Tim Tam, in a deal local media reported was worth $2.2 billion.

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq hit record highs; euro drops on soft data
description: Tech companies led the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq to record closing highs on Wednesday but the Dow lost ground on downbeat earnings, while the euro dropped to a two-month low, pressured by soft economic data.

title: Global oil market in glut, but not a big enough one for OPEC
description: OPEC has shifted the goalposts for assessing an overhang in oil inventories, giving the group more room to prolong production cuts, while analysts warn the move will offer a distorted view of market conditions.

title: Philippines' Jollibee buying Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf in overseas expansion
description: Jollibee Foods Corp , Philippines' largest food service network operator, is buying U.S. brand Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf (CBTL) for $100 million as part of an expansion outside its home market.

title: Uber Freight launches in Germany, taking on local competition
description: U.S. ride-hailing company Uber  is launching a freight platform in Germany, taking on local technology startups in a race to grab a share of Europe's $500 billion trucking market.

title: Daimler CEO says there are no plans to pursue a merger or spin-off
description: Daimler  has no plans to spin off its trucks division or to pursue a merger with BMW  as a way to raise the company's share price, Chief Executive Ola Kaellenius said on Wednesday.

title: Exclusive: Bearing brunt of trade war, Singapore chipmakers cut jobs
