description: DouYu International Holdings Ltd , China's largest live-streaming platform, on Tuesday said it sold $775 million in stock at a $3.73 billion valuation after pricing its U.S. initial public offering (IPO) at the bottom of an indicative range.

title: U.S. lawmakers take jabs at Amazon, Big Tech in antitrust hearing
description: Lawmakers on the House Judiciary Committee's antitrust panel pressed an executive from Amazon.com Inc on Tuesday about allegations that it competed against its own sellers and pushed them to buy advertising and fulfillment services.

title: U.S. Justice Department asks appeals court to pause antitrust ruling against Qualcomm
description: The U.S. Justice Department asked a federal appeals court to pause the enforcement of a sweeping antitrust ruling against mobile chip supplier Qualcomm Inc on Tuesday, citing support from the Energy Department and Defense Department.

title: SEC reaches $60 million settlements involving ex-American Realty executives
description: Two former executives at American Realty Capital Properties Inc, including the onetime billionaire who built it, have reached more than $60 million in settlements with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission of charges they wrongfully extracted millions of dollars from the real estate investment trust.

title: Bitcoin tumbles as U.S. senators grill Facebook on crypto plans
description: The cryptocurrency market took a beating on Tuesday with bitcoin losing over 10% in value after U.S. lawmakers grilled Facebook on its cryptocurrency plans, as political and regulatory scrutiny of digital coins intensifies.

title: Facebook should not be trusted with 'crazy' cryptocurrency plan: senators
description: Democratic and Republican lawmakers said on Tuesday that Facebook Inc's track record of what they described as untrustworthiness should stand in the way of it launching a digital currency, labeling the plan "delusional" and "crazy" at a Senate hearing.

title: Wall Street slips as bank earnings, Trump trade comments weigh
description: U.S. stocks edged lower on Tuesday as quarterly results from banks added to concerns about lower interest rates dampening their profits, while comments from U.S. President Donald Trump on trade also dragged down Wall Street's major indexes.

title: As steep patent cliff looms, Shionogi moves to develop its own U.S. sales staff
description: For much of its 141-year history, Japan's Shionogi & Co Ltd  has played safe when selling its drugs in the United States and other overseas markets - relying on bigger partners to promote its products and avoiding the cost of maintaining a large sales force.

title: United to resume India flights from September as Pakistan reopens airspace
description: United Airlines Holdings Inc  said on Wednesday it would restart daily nonstop service between New York/Newark, New Delhi and Mumbai from Sept. 6, after Pakistan lifted airspace restrictions.

title: United tops profit estimates as MAX woes prompt higher fares in robust travel market
description: United Airlines Holdings Inc  on Tuesday reported a bigger-than-expected increase in second-quarter profit, driven by strong air travel demand and the ability to charge more for seats after the grounding of Boeing Co's  737 MAX reduced capacity.

title: Five things to look for in Netflix's second-quarter report
description: When Netflix Inc  reports second-quarter earnings on Wednesday, a big question is how the streaming giant will handle a slew of new competitors barging in to its territory.

title: U.S. SEC chief says he has not met with Facebook since Libra announcement
description: A top U.S. financial market regulator said on Tuesday he has not discussed with Facebook its Libra currency proposal, nearly a month after the social media giant announced the project.

title: Oil falls as Iran tensions seen easing
description: Oil prices turned lower on Tuesday, falling more than 3% after U.S. President Donald Trump said progress has been made with Iran, signaling tensions could ease in the Mideast.

title: U.S. retail sales data dents stocks, lifts Treasury yields
description: A gauge of global equities lost ground on Tuesday and U.S. Treasury yields moved higher as a stronger-than-anticipated report on retail sales raised the possibility the Federal Reserve could adopt a less dovish stance.

title: JPMorgan beats profit estimates but shows signs of pressure
description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  reported a quarterly profit that beat estimates on Tuesday as higher interest income and consumer lending offset lower activity at its trading desks.

title: Wells Fargo tempers cost-cutting outlook
description: Wells Fargo & Co reported higher quarterly earnings on Tuesday, due in part to lower expenses, but the bank reined in its outlook for cost cuts to invest in improving its risk management.

title: Tesla drops cheapest Model X, S variants, cuts prices to simplify lineup
description: Tesla Inc  has dropped the standard-range variants of its Model X and Model S from its product lineup and adjusted prices across its range, in a sales push that comes days after the U.S. electric vehicle maker reported record deliveries.

title: UAW president to GM: We invested in you, now invest in us
description: The UAW and General Motors Co  on Tuesday formally kicked off contract talks, with the union's president calling on the automaker to keep open plants it has slated for closure and to invest in its workforce after the union helped it through a government-led bankruptcy a decade ago.

title: Amazon U.S. rivals get sales boost on Prime Day: Adobe
description: Several large U.S. retailers recorded higher sales on the first day of Amazon.com Inc's Prime Day shopping event as online shoppers also flocked to their websites, Adobe Analytics said on Tuesday.

title: New York City can ban ads inside Uber, Lyft vehicles: U.S. appeals court
description: A federal appeals court on Tuesday said New York City can ban advertising inside vehicles driven for companies such as Uber and Lyft, handing a victory to the millions of passengers who it said find such ads "extremely annoying."

title: Walmart Chile to resume talks with union amid strike
description: Walmart Chile said on Monday it would resume talks with a union of 17,000 workers who walked off the job last week amid a major push by the global retail giant to automate jobs and slash costs.

title: Deutsche Telekom loses lawsuit over all-you-can-watch video product
description: Deutsche Telekom has lost a legal battle to continue offering an all-you-can-watch mobile video product after a court sided with the German regulator, saying it violated European rules on roaming and network neutrality.

title: Factbox: The Galapagos drugs pipeline that has drawn in Gilead
description: U.S. antiviral drugmaker Gilead Sciences  will invest $5.1 billion in a major expansion of its partnership with Belgo-Dutch biotech Galapagos NV .

title: Exclusive: U.S. firms may get nod to restart Huawei sales in two-four weeks - official
description: The U.S. may approve licenses for companies to re-start new sales to Huawei in as little as two weeks, according to a senior U.S. official, in a sign President Donald Trump's recent effort to ease restrictions on the Chinese company could move forward quickly.

title: Hold the beers: Budweiser APAC IPO hit by investor push-back
description: Scepticism over AB InBev's high valuations doomed Budweiser APAC's IPO of up to $9.8 billion - poised to be the world's biggest this year - investors and bankers said, putting would-be floats on notice that careful pricing remains key to success.

title: Huawei to invest $3.1 billion in Italy but calls for fair policy on 5G: country CEO
description: China's Huawei Technologies said it would invest $3.1 billion in Italy over the next three years, as the Chinese telecoms giant called on Rome to ensure the "transparent, efficient and fair" use of its 'golden power' on 5G network development.

title: In makeover mode, Burberry bets on new branding to boost sales
description: It has a hotshot new designer known for dressing Beyonce and is experimenting with monthly product launches on social media.

title: Goldman banker highlights Morgan Stanley's Hong Kong IPO woes
description: A senior Goldman Sachs  banker has highlighted to colleagues the role played by rival Morgan Stanley  in failed Hong Kong IPOs following the collapse on Friday of Budweiser APAC's $9.8 billion initial public offering, according to an internal email seen by Reuters.

title: Back to beers for AB InBev after failed Asian float
description: AB InBev's  canceled Asian stock market listing will slow but not derail the world's largest brewer's efforts to cut its debt mountain, delaying future acquisitions and prioritizing its main challenge - selling more beers.

title: Amazon workers in Germany strike over pay, Verdi union says
description: More than 2,000 workers at seven Amazon  sites across Germany have gone on strike over pay for at least two days, labor union Verdi said on Monday.

title: China second-quarter GDP growth slows to 27-year low as trade war bites, more stimulus seen
description: China's economic growth slowed to 6.2% in the second quarter, its weakest pace in at least 27 years, as demand at home and abroad faltered in the face of mounting U.S. trade pressure.

title: China home price growth cools in June, but investment quickens
description: Growth in China's new home prices cooled in June as sales shrank for a second month, but building starts and investment quickened, providing a cushion for the slowing economy while Beijing claims some wins in reducing market froth.

title: China's first-half pork output falls amid disease outbreak
description: China's pork output fell by less than expected in the first half as the country tackles a devastating disease outbreak, although official data showed conflicting figures on the size of the decline in the hog herd.

title: PSA sales slide on emerging-market setbacks
description: French carmaker PSA Group's  vehicle sales fell 12.8% in the first half as emerging markets weighed on its overseas business, challenging the trajectory of the Peugeot manufacturer's recovery.

title: China June industrial output up 6.3% year-on-year, beats forecasts, retail sales up 9.8%
description: China's industrial output grew 6.3% in June from a year earlier, official data showed on Monday, picking up from May's 17-year low and handily beating market expectations.

title: Russia's Aeroflot plans to add nine Airbus A320 Neo to fleet-documents
description: Russia's national flag carrier Aeroflot  is planning to add nine medium-haul A320 Neo Airbus planes for about $870 million to its fleet next year, procurement documents show.

title: Instant View: China second quarter GDP rises 6.2% year-on-year, slowest in at least 27 years
description: China's second-quarter economic growth slowed to its weakest pace in at least 27 years, in line with expectations, as demand at home and abroad cooled in the face of a bruising trade war with the United States.

title: China June crude oil throughput rises to record on new plants
description: China's crude oil throughput rose to a record in June, up 7.7% from a year earlier, following the start-up of two new, large refineries, official data showed on Monday.

title: China churns out record daily steel output in June - Reuters calculation
description: China's daily crude steel output rose to record levels in June, according to Reuters calculations, even as anti-pollution production curbs pushed whole-month production slightly lower, official data showed on Monday.

title: China says first-half growth sets good foundation for hitting 2019 GDP target
description: China's first-half economic growth of 6.3% was "hard-won" and laid a good foundation for achieving a full-year growth target of between 6% and 6.5%, a spokesman for the country's statistics bureau said on Monday.

title: China June coal output hits record high as miners ramp up ahead of summer
description: China's coal output rose in June from the previous month to a record high, official data showed on Monday, as miners ramped up production to ensure supply ahead of peak summer demand for electricity.

title: China June aluminum output climbs to daily record - Reuters calculations
description: China's daily aluminum output hit record levels in June, according to Reuters calculations, even as total production for the whole of the month fell slightly according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Monday.

title: United Airlines extends suspension of Delhi, Mumbai flights to Oct. 26
description: United Airlines Holdings Inc  said on Monday it was extending the suspension of its flights from the United States to Delhi and Mumbai in India until Oct. 26, citing continued restriction of Pakistani airspace.

title: Most big companies fail to report role in deforestation, charity says
description: Most big companies are failing to report the damage their operations are doing to forests despite committing to lighten their footprint under wider efforts to tackle climate change, according to a report published on Tuesday.

title: Charles Schwab in talks to buy USAA wealth-management, brokerage units: WSJ
description: Charles Schwab Corp  is in talks to buy brokerage and wealth-management operations from USAA for about $2 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Citigroup profit beats estimates on gains in consumer lending
description: Citigroup Inc topped expectations for quarterly profit on Monday as a tight lid on costs and strength in consumer lending helped the third-largest U.S. bank counter weakness in its trading business.

title: UAW head wants union to share in profits of U.S. automakers
description: The head of the labor union representing most hourly workers at the U.S. automakers struck an adversarial tone on Monday, vowing in likely contentious talks for new four-year deals that they want to share in the companies' profits.

title: Facebook vows Libra currency will wait for approval as U.S. airs worries
description: Facebook Inc said on Monday it would not proceed with the launch of its Libra cryptocurrency until regulatory concerns are addressed, as the U.S. Treasury secretary took the unusual step on of saying he had serious concerns it could be used for illicit activity.

title: Exclusive: Canada set to postpone Huawei 5G decision to after vote, given sour ties with China - sources
description: Canada is likely to postpone a decision on whether to allow China's Huawei Technologies Co Ltd to supply 5G network equipment until after the October federal election, given increasingly strained relations with Beijing, say three well-placed sources.

title: State AGs fighting T-Mobile, Sprint merger say October trial may not be possible
description: An attorney for the state attorneys general who filed a lawsuit in hopes of stopping T-Mobile's $26 billion merger with Sprint told the judge on Monday that an Oct. 7 trial may not be possible.

title: U.S. judge slashes Roundup jury award to $25.3 million; Bayer still plans to appeal
description: A federal judge on Monday slashed a damages award Bayer AG owed a California man who blamed Roundup weed killer for his cancer, to $25.27 million from $80.27 million, while rejecting the company's bid for a new trial.

title: Amazon rivals ride on Prime Day marketing as protests unfold
description: Amazon.com Inc's Prime Day is now a major marketing opportunity and shopping event in the annual calendar for other U.S. retail companies, rivaling the Thanksgiving holiday's Black Friday as a driver of sales.

title: Trump presses for USMCA passage as Lighthizer, lawmakers prepare to meet
description: President Donald Trump and his top advisers on Monday stepped up their drive to win congressional passage of a trade deal with Canada and Mexico, as the administration's top trade official prepared to meet with Democratic lawmakers again this week.

title: PayPal launches international money transfer service Xoom across Europe
description: U.S. payments company PayPal  is expanding further in Europe by launching its international money transfers service Xoom in Britain and 31 other countries across the continent.

title: Pearson goes 'digital first' in U.S. college market
description: Pearson, the world's biggest education company, will release all its titles for the United States college market in digital form first, in a break from the traditional and more expensive textbook publishing model.

title: Vale to pay $106.5 million to workers affected by Brazil dam disaster
description: Brazilian mining company Vale SA said on Monday it would pay 400 million reais ($106.52 million) to compensate workers affected by the deadly rupture of a tailings dam in January that killed at least 240 people.

title: S&P ends near flat as Citigroup results sink banks; Nasdaq hits new high
description: The benchmark S&P 500 index ended little changed on Monday after oscillating between positive and negative territory throughout the session after Citigroup Inc  kicked off the earnings season with a mixed quarterly report.

title: Gilead invests $5 billion to deepen ties with biotech Galapagos
description: U.S. antiviral drugmaker Gilead Sciences  will invest $5.1 billion in a major expansion of its partnership with Belgo-Dutch biotech Galapagos NV , news that lifted Galapagos's shares more than 18% to an all-time high on Monday.

title: China data steadies stocks as U.S. earnings get underway
description: A gauge of global stocks rose modestly on Monday after economic data from China came in as expected, but equities on Wall Street slipped on weakness in financials in the wake of Citigroup's earnings report.

title: Trump sees slowing Chinese growth pressuring Beijing on trade
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday seized on slowing economic growth in China as evidence that U.S. tariffs were having "a major effect" and warned that Washington could pile on more pressure as bilateral trade talks sputtered along.

title: Oil prices down on dwindling storm impact, Chinese economic data
description: Oil prices sank about 1% on Monday on signs that the impact of a tropical storm on U.S. Gulf Coast production and refining would be short-lived, while Chinese economic data dimmed the crude demand outlook.

title: Opioid 'kingpin' J&J fueled epidemic, Oklahoma argues at trial's end
description: Lawyers for the state of Oklahoma on Monday compared Johnson & Johnson  to a drug cartel leader as they sought to hold the drugmaker responsible for fueling the U.S. opioid epidemic in the first trial to result from lawsuits over the crisis.

title: U.S., Chinese officials to discuss trade in phone call this week: Mnuchin
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin on Monday told reporters he expects to have another telephone call with Chinese officials this week as part of resumed discussions about a trade agreement.

title: Symantec ends talks to sell to Broadcom over price: sources
description: Cybersecurity company Symantec Corp  has walked away from negotiations to sell itself to chipmaker Broadcom Inc  over price disagreements, people familiar with the matter said on Monday.

title: Bitcoin drops more than 10% as scrutiny of cryptocurrencies grows
description: Bitcoin slumped more than 10% over the weekend to a two-week low as fears of a crackdown of cryptocurrencies grew on mounting scrutiny of Facebook's planned Libra digital coin.

title: U.S. Treasury's Mnuchin to give briefing on cryptocurrency on Monday
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin will give a briefing on cryptocurrency at 2:00 pm ET (1800 GMT) on Monday from the White House briefing room, a White House official said.

title: LVMH pairs with Stella McCartney, igniting fashion rivalries
description: French luxury goods group LVMH  on Monday announced a tie-up with Stella McCartney, just months after the British designer known for her animal-friendly ethics ended a long-term partnership the conglomerate's arch-rival Kering .

title: American Airlines extends Boeing 737 MAX cancellations for fourth time
description: American Airlines Group Inc  said on Sunday it is extending for a fourth time cancellations of about 115 daily flights into early November due to the ongoing grounding of the Boeing Co  737 MAX jets.

title: Lufthansa CEO sees no 'Greta Effect' on passenger numbers
description: German airline Lufthansa  expects passenger numbers to rise about 4% this year, its chief executive told a newspaper, playing down talk that public support for teenage climate activist Greta Thunberg might be curbing air travel.

title: Amazon plans to open new warehouse, create 2,800 jobs in Germany
description: U.S. online retail giant Amazon  plans to open a new warehouse in Germany this year and create more than 2,800 jobs with permanent contracts in what is its second-biggest market after the United States.

title: India says Deloitte misreading law in challenging government's call for ban
description: India has told a tribunal the local auditing affiliate of international accounting group Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu is misreading a key federal law as the firm seeks to avoid a five-year ban on new business, according to legal documents reviewed by Reuters on Sunday.

title: U.S. proposes barring big tech companies from offering financial services, digital currencies
description: A proposal to prevent big technology companies from functioning as financial institutions or issuing digital currencies has been circulated for discussion by the Democratic majority that leads the House Financial Services Committee, according to a copy of the draft legislation seen by Reuters.

title: GSK in talks to name HSBC's Symonds as its next chairman: Bloomberg
description: GlaxoSmithKline Plc  is in talks to name HSBC's deputy chairman Jonathan Symonds as the next chairman of the British drugmaker, Bloomberg reported on Sunday, citing a person familiar with the matter.

title: U.S. Fed seen launching repo facility in early 2020: Deutsche Bank
description: The Federal Reserve may launch a policy tool to lend to banks using Treasuries and other securities as collateral in early 2020, with possible testing to begin later this year, a Deutsche Bank strategist said.

title: Huawei plans extensive layoffs at its U.S. operations: WSJ
description: Huawei Technologies Co Ltd is planning extensive layoffs in the United States as the Chinese telecoms equipment company grapples with its U.S. blacklisting, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Exclusive: Barneys New York explores options that include bankruptcy - sources
description: U.S. luxury department store operator Barneys New York Inc is exploring options that include a bankruptcy filing, as it struggles with high rents and changing consumer tastes, people familiar with the matter said on Saturday.

title: Trump administration freezing fuel efficiency penalties
description: The Trump administration said late on Friday it was issuing final rules to suspend a 2016 Obama administration regulation that more than doubled penalties for automakers failing to meet fuel efficiency requirements.

title: China June trade surplus with U.S. rises 11% to $29.92 billion
description: China's trade surplus with the United States, a major source of friction with its biggest trading partner, rose 11% in June to $29.92 billion from $26.9 billion in May, customs data showed on Friday.

title: Deutsche Bank to pay Vestia 175 million euros settlement in derivatives suit
description: Dutch housing cooperation Vestia said on Friday Deutsche Bank would pay it 175 million euros ($197 million) to settle claims  the German bank had improperly sold it interest rate derivatives.

title: China's June exports, imports fall as trade war takes heavier toll
description: China's exports fell in June as the United States ramped up trade pressure, while imports shrank more than expected, pointing to further weakness in the world's second-largest economy and slackening global growth.

title: China June rare earth exports rise, snapping two months of declines
description: China's rare earth exports rose by 9% in June from May, customs data showed on Friday, snapping two months of declines that had stoked worries over supply from the world's top producer of the materials amid the Sino-U.S. trade dispute.

title: China June soybean imports fall on trade war, deadly pig disease
description: China's soybean imports fell 11.5% in June from May, customs data showed on Friday, as the Sino-U.S. trade war and an outbreak of deadly African swine fever curb demand.

title: China's June coal imports fall as local miners boost output
description: China's June coal imports fell 1.4% from May to 27.1 million tonnes, official data showed on Friday, as local miners boosted output to ensure adequate supply ahead of summer.

title: China's June crude oil imports climb as new refineries spur demand
description: China's crude oil imports on a daily basis in June rose 15.2% from a year earlier, customs data showed on Friday, as the start up of new large-scale refiners spurred demand for feedstocks.

title: China iron ore imports in June fall to lowest since Feb 2016
description: China's iron ore imports in June fell from a year ago, touching their lowest since February 2016, customs data showed on Friday, as supply declined from top miners in Brazil and Australia.

title: Daimler warns on profit again, blames diesel and recall costs
description: Luxury carmaker Daimler  cut its profit forecast for the fourth time in 13 months on Friday, as it set aside more money to cover a regulatory crackdown on diesel emissions and vehicle recalls related to Takata airbags.

title: China copper imports in June fall 27% from a year earlier
description: China's unwrought copper imports in June fell 27.2% from a year earlier, official data showed on Friday, as a slowdown in the world's second-biggest economy continues to weigh on demand for the metal.

title: China June new loans rise to three-month, still below forecasts
description: New bank loans in China rose to a three-month high in June as policymakers sought to keep ample funds in the financial system to support the slowing economy amid rising U.S. trade pressure.

title: Airbus pulls anniversary book over fraud probe concerns: sources
description: Airbus has halted sales of a new book that the planemaker had commissioned for its 50th anniversary to avoid hampering the manufacturer's attempts to win a settlement in a bribery probe, two people familiar with the matter said.

title: Exclusive: India aims to raise $47 billion from stake sales in state firms over 5 years - sources
description: The Indian government has plans to raise as much as 3.25 trillion rupees ($47.4 billion) in the next five years by reducing its stakes in some large state-owned firms to 40%, two senior government officials told Reuters, in the nation's biggest privatization push in more than two decades.

title: Volkswagen to contribute $2.6 billion to Ford's autonomous venture: source
description: Carmaker Volkswagen  will inject $1 billion in capital and $1.6 billion worth of assets into Ford's  self-driving unit, a source close to the matter said on Friday, as the two carmakers deepen a global alliance to share costs.

title: Expectations are low for bank earnings but investors say 'buy'
description: Low interest rates and weak trading volume have pushed down Wall Street's second-quarter estimates for the biggest U.S. banks, yet investors still say they want in on the sector.

title: Property speculators hope for investment paradise in southwest China
description: A bus came to a halt amid a tropical rainforest not far from China's border with Myanmar, dropping off about 30 investors on a property tour, some with children in tow.

title: China considers limited support for petrol-electric hybrids in boon for Toyota, Honda
description: China is considering re-classifying petrol-electric hybrid vehicles so they get more favorable treatment than all-petrol or diesel counterparts under clean car rules, making it easier for automakers to meet environment quotas and offer more choice.

title: Airbus aims to sell more than 1,000 planes over 15 years in Latin America, Caribbean
description: European planemaker Airbus SE  plans to sell more than 1,000 new passenger planes in the next 15 years in Latin America and the Caribbean, meeting about half the demand expected in the region, an executive of the company told Reuters.

title: Renault-Nissan audit findings submitted to French prosecutors
description: Renault  has handed French prosecutors the conclusions of an audit into its joint finances with alliance partner Nissan , the carmaker said on Friday.

title: Thomas Cook enlists China's Fosun to salvage oldest travel firm
description: Thomas Cook  is negotiating a 750 million pound ($941 million) rescue that will give Fosun Tourism , its biggest investor, control of the indebted British group's package-tour business, in a blow to other shareholders.

title: U.S. to hold hearing on French tax investigation Aug. 19
description: The U.S. Trade Representative's (USTR) Office will hold a hearing on Aug 19 in its probe of France's new planned tax on big technology companies, calling the proposal "unreasonable."

title: AB InBev pulls Budweiser listing, canceling year's largest IPO
description: Anheuser-Busch InBev said on Friday it will not proceed with the planned listing in Hong Kong of its Asia Pacific unit, Budweiser Brewing Company APAC Ltd, in what would have been the world's biggest initial public offering (IPO) of 2019.

title: Partial ECM exit to leave Deutsche Bank focused on Europe
description: Deutsche Bank  is focusing its equity capital markets (ECM) business such as initial public offerings (IPOs) on Germany and Europe, scaling back in the United States and retreating from most of Asia, banking sources said.

title: U.S. regulators approve $5 billion Facebook settlement over privacy issues: source
description: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission approved a roughly $5 billion settlement with Facebook Inc this week over its investigation into the social media company's handling of user data, a source familiar with the situation said on Friday.

title: Lockheed Martin plans to expand Milwaukee plant workforce by 15%
description: Defense contractor Lockheed Martin Corp  said on Friday it plans to increase the workforce at its approximately 300-person Milwaukee facility by more than 15% this year.

title: Volkswagen zooms ahead in extension of alliance with Ford to electric, automated cars
description: Ford Motor Co  and Volkswagen AG  said they will spend billions of dollars to jointly develop electric and self-driving vehicles, deepening a global alliance to slash development and manufacturing costs while positioning VW as the initial winner.

title: Wall St. notches all-time highs on lingering rate-cut optimism
description: All three major indexes posted record closing highs on Friday as firm expectations for an interest-rate cut from the Federal Reserve continued to propel shares while investors awaited next week's kickoff of the corporate earnings season.

title: Wall Street stocks climb, dollar drops on rate-cut optimism
description: Wall Street stocks closed higher and the dollar fell on Friday as investors prepared for a U.S. interest-rate cut, while oil futures were little changed as a forecast for a global crude surplus offset worries about U.S. output declines due to a tropical storm.

title: Oil flat as tropical storm limits output, glut forecasts weigh
description: Oil prices were little changed on Friday as U.S. Gulf of Mexico crude output dropped by more than half from disruptions caused by a tropical storm, but concerns over a global crude surplus in the months ahead limited gains.

title: J&J faces U.S. criminal probe related to baby powder - Bloomberg
description: The U.S. Justice Department is pursuing a criminal probe into whether Johnson & Johnson lied about potential cancer risks of its talcum powder and has convened a grand jury in Washington, Bloomberg reported on Friday, citing people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Exclusive: Pentagon races to track U.S. rare earths output amid China trade dispute
description: The Pentagon is rapidly assessing the United States' rare earths capability in a race to secure stable supply of the specialized material amid the country's trade conflict with China, which controls the rare earths industry, according to a government document seen by Reuters.

title: EU legal advice favors Vivendi in feud with Mediaset
description: An Italian law that forced French media group Vivendi  to forfeit most of its voting rights in Italian broadcaster Mediaset  may not comply with European rules, according to European Commission legal advice seen by Reuters.

title: Slimmed-down WPP to net $3.1 billion selling Kantar stake to Bain
description: WPP  is selling a 60% stake in Kantar to private equity firm Bain Capital, valuing the data analytics business at about $4 billion and giving the British owner of agencies including Ogilvy and Wunderman Thompson funds to cut debt and rebuild.

title: Boeing 737 MAX to remain off United Airlines' schedule until November 3
description: United Airlines Holdings said on Friday the Boeing 737 MAX would stay off its flight schedule until Nov. 3, a fresh extension leading to about 2,100 cancellations in September and 2,900 in October as the jets remain grounded worldwide.

title: Canada's struggling energy industry takes stock at annual Stampede party
description: Frustration is palpable among Canadian energy executives who have flocked to the annual Calgary Stampede celebrations in Canada's oil capital this week, even though a recent pipeline approval gives them something to celebrate amid the rodeo competitions, corporate parties and pancake breakfasts.

title: U.S. producer prices rise marginally, suggest tame inflation
description: U.S. producer prices rose slightly for the second straight month in June as an acceleration in the cost of services was offset by  cheaper energy goods, resulting in the smallest annual increase in producer inflation in nearly 2-1/2 years.

title: Volkswagen investment vaults Argo into top ranks of self-driving firms
description: Volkswagen AG's $2.6-billion investment in Ford Motor Co's  Argo AI self-driving unit, announced on Friday, immediately vaults the two-year-old Pittsburgh-based startup into the top ranks in the sector.

title: Delta CEO sees 'marginal benefit' as competitors grapple with Boeing MAX grounding
description: Delta Air Lines Inc  sees the momentum behind 6.5% quarterly revenue growth continuing throughout the year, Chief Executive Ed Bastian said, citing strong domestic demand that drove an increase in its full-year profit forecast.

title: Apple's India-made top-end iPhones to hit stores next month: source
description: Apple Inc's top-end iPhones, assembled in India by Foxconn's local unit, are likely to hit Indian stores next month, a source said, potentially helping the tech giant drop prices in the world's second-biggest smartphone market.

title: Exclusive: Verizon sought buyers for Yahoo Finance - sources
description: Verizon Communications Inc earlier this year looked for buyers for Yahoo Finance, one of the most popular internet destinations for financial news and portfolio management tools, three people familiar with the matter told Reuters this week.

title: U.S. underlying inflation stirring; labor market tightening
description: U.S. underlying consumer prices increased by the most in nearly 1-1/2 years in June amid solid gains in a range of goods and services, but that did not change expectations the Federal Reserve would cut interest rates this month.

title: FCA plans electric Fiat 500 for 2020 as moves on from Renault
description: Fiat Chrysler (FCA) plans to spend 700 million euros ($788 million) to take the Fiat 500 electric as the carmaker moves on from its failed $35 billion bid to merge with France's Renault , a pioneer in electric vehicles.

title: Wall Street watchdog to boost transparency about using 'cooperation' for penalty reductions
description: Wall Street's industry-funded watchdog on Thursday said it plans to be more transparent about its process for determining when a securities brokerage qualifies for a reduced penalty in exchange for so-called "extraordinary cooperation."

title: Brazil cotton farmers sue Bayer over patent on GMO seed
description: Brazilian cotton producers in the state of Mato Grosso on Thursday sued Bayer AG , seeking to cancel the chemical company's patent protection for its Bollgard II RR Flex genetically modified cotton seed, according to a statement sent to Reuters.

title: Last Volkswagen Beetle drives into the sunset

title: Japan watchdog to recommend $24 million fine for Nissan over Ghosn pay: source
