description: Construction to expand the Trans Mountain oil pipeline could begin in September, assuming the next regulatory steps go smoothly, the project's chief executive said on Wednesday.

title: Traders bet heavy on Fed rate cuts ahead
description: Traders of U.S. short-term interest rate futures added to bets that the Federal Reserve will cut interest rates starting next month, after the central bank ended a two-day policy meeting with a pledge to "act as appropriate" to sustain economic health.

title: U.S. trade representative says he can resolve Democrats' concerns on North America pact quickly
description: The top U.S. trade negotiator said on Wednesday he is ready to work with lawmakers "sooner rather than later" to address concerns over a new North American pact, even as a leading Democrat outlined roadblocks to the deal's approval.

title: Airbus grabs China Airlines narrow-body jet order
description: Airbus unveiled an aircraft deal with Taiwan's China Airlines on Wednesday, snatching the carrier's medium-haul fleet renewal from Boeing a day after its U.S. rival made a shock entry into the single-aisle fleet of British Airways owner IAG.

title: Oil prices little changed despite U.S. crude stock draw
description: Oil futures were mostly steady on Wednesday as price support from a larger-than-expected decline in U.S. crude inventories was countered by a lull in equities.

title: Canada opens probe into 250,000 GM pickups, SUVs over brake performance
description: Transport Canada, the auto safety regulator, has opened a probe into braking issues in nearly 250,000 General Motors full-size pickups and SUVs after U.S. officials launched a similar probe last year, the agency said on its website.

title: News Corp exploring potential sale of News America Marketing business
description: Wall Street Journal-owner News Corp said on Tuesday it was evaluating options for its News America Marketing (NAM) business, including a potential sale.

title: Kellogg to cut jobs, take $35 million pretax hit on North America unit revamp
description: Kellogg Co said on Tuesday it would cut about 150 jobs and take a $35 million hit to trim its North American operations following the sale of Keebler biscuits and a handful of other brands for $1.3 billion in April.

title: Loonie little changed, pares earlier drop as oil price rallies
description: The Canadian dollar was little changed on Tuesday, paring earlier losses after slipping to a two-week low against the greenback, as a rally in oil prices offset domestic data showing an unexpected drop in April manufacturing sales.

title: IAG orders 14 A321XLRs for Aer Lingus and Iberia
description: IAG on Monday ordered 14 of Airbus' new long-range version of the A321 passenger jet for its Irish Aer Lingus and Spanish Iberia airlines in order to boost their transatlantic routes, the company said on Tuesday.

title: Boeing seen winning renewed backing from 737 buyer at air show: source
description: Boeing may win a significant reconfirmation of support from a buyer of the 737 MAX passenger jet at the Paris Airshow on Tuesday, an industry source said.

title: Sotheby's snapped up by French tycoon Drahi for $3.7 billion
description: Franco-Israeli cable magnate Patrick Drahi made a surprise move into the art world by snapping up Sotheby's in a deal worth $3.7 billion, marking the art auction house's return to private ownership after 31 years.

title: Deutsche Bank considers replacing CFO: report
description: Deutsche Bank Chief Executive Christian Sewing is planning a major overhaul of top management, including replacing the finance chief, Bloomberg news agency reported on Tuesday.

title: Airbus Helicopters sees 18-month wait for oil & gas demand pick-up
description: Airbus expects it will be another 18 months before it sees the first signs of a recovery in demand for large helicopters from the oil and gas industry, the head of its helicopter division said on Tuesday.

title: World electronic gaming revenues to grow 9.6% to $152.1 billion in 2019: report
description: The global video and electronic games market will generate $152.1 billion in 2019, up 9.6% over last year as gaming morphs into content and communication, according to a report by gaming analytics firm Newzoo on Tuesday.

title: Draghi questions market-based inflation indicators
description: Some market-based measures of inflation expectations have lost significance “due to technical conditions”, the European Central Bank’s President Mario Draghi said on Tuesday.

title: AirAsia to convert 253 orders for Airbus A320neo planes to larger A321neo
description: AirAsia Group has decided to convert 253 orders for Airbus' A320neo planes to the larger A321neo model, making AirAsia the world's largest customer for the A321neo, but is not yet ready to order the new longer-range version.

title: Exclusive: Banks face new challenges in Italian diamond scandal
description: A long-running criminal probe into diamond sales by Italian banks has uncovered what prosecutors say is further evidence of  corruption by officials at UniCredit, Italy’s largest lender, and smaller rival Banco BPM.

title: Trump blasts comments by ECB's Draghi, cites unfair competition
description: U.S. President Donald Trump criticized European Central Bank President Mario Draghi's comments earlier on Tuesday that further monetary policy changes may be needed by the ECB, saying that would spark unfair European competition against the United States.

title: Volkswagen aims to boost in-house software development to 60% by 2025
description: Volkswagen said on Tuesday it would put 5,000 digital experts into a new unit called "Car.Software" by 2025 as the German carmaker aims to develop at least 60% of its software in-house by then, up from less than 10% currently.

title: Factbox: Facebook's new cryptocurrency Libra and digital wallet Calibra
description: Facebook Inc revealed plans to establish a cryptocurrency called Libra on Tuesday. It will be run by an association comprised of other corporate investors and non-profit members, with an expected launch in the first half of 2020.

title: Swiss regulator says in contact with initiators of Facebook's Libra
description: Switzerland's financial regulator FINMA said on Tuesday that it is in contact with the "initiators" of Libra, Facebook's planned cyrptocurrency.

title: AirAsia to convert 253 orders for Airbus A320neo planes to larger A321neo type
description: AirAsia Group has decided to convert 253 orders for Airbus' A320neo planes to the larger A321neo model, Airbus said on Tuesday.

title: London's Heathrow airport publishes third runway masterplan
description: London Heathrow, the busiest airport in Europe, published its masterplan plan for expansion on Tuesday, including building a controversial third runway and new terminal facilities, at the start of a 12-week statutory consultation.

title: New blow to Boeing from engine delay, Airbus long-range rival takes off
description: Boeing suffered a fresh setback at the opening of the Paris Airshow on Monday as the U.S. planemaker's engine supplier revealed a delay affecting its all-new 777X jet, while Airbus targeted the middle of the market with a rival plane.

title: Northrop engine teams with Raytheon hypersonic program
description: Raytheon Co said on Tuesday it has teamed up with Northrop Grumman Corp to develop and produce engines for hypersonic weapons that can travel 4,000 miles per hour.

title: Renault-Nissan alliance remains priority for French finance minister
description: Renault's alliance with Japanese partner Nissan remains French Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire's priority ahead of any further consolidation with the likes of Fiat-Chrysler, he said on Tuesday.

title: Alibaba puts CFO in charge of investment in major management reshuffle
description: China's Alibaba Group Holding Ltd on Tuesday unveiled its most significant business reshuffle since co-founder Jack Ma announced his pending retirement, as the e-commerce firm looks to bolster its investment focus in the face of slowing growth.

title: Air Lease signs long-term lease placements for four Airbus jets
description: Air Lease Corporation said on Tuesday it had signed long-term lease placements for two new Airbus A320neo and two Airbus A321neo LR aircraft with Japan's Peach Aviation Ltd.

title: Huawei says U.S. ban hurting more than expected, to wipe $30 billion off revenue
description: China's Huawei Technologies Co Ltd has taken a harder-than-expected hit from a U.S. ban, the company's founder and CEO Ren Zhengfei said, and slashed revenue expectations for the year.

title: Senator Rubio targets Huawei over patents
description: U.S. Senator Marco Rubio filed legislation on Monday that would prevent Huawei Technologies Co Ltd from seeking damages  in U.S. patent courts, after the Chinese firm demanded that Verizon Communications Inc pay $1 billion to license the rights to patented technology.

title: BoE's Carney says keeping open mind on Facebook's Libra
description: Bank of England governor Mark Carney has said he is keeping an 'open mind' on the potential utility of Facebook's planned cryptocurrency, but warned it may face strict regulation if it takes off.

title: Factbox: Airbus and Boeing aircraft deals at Paris Airshow
description: Following is a summary of commercial aircraft deals announced by Airbus and Boeing at the Paris Airshow.

title: American in talks for up to 50 Airbus A321XLR jets: sources
description: American Airlines Group Inc  is edging toward a deal with Airbus to buy up to 50 newly launched A321XLR extended-range narrow-body aircraft, including some converted from existing orders of other models, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Rolls-Royce boss laments Brexit distraction at Paris Airshow
description: Rolls-Royce chief executive Warren East said on Tuesday that uncertainties over Brexit remain an unwelcome distraction for the aerospace industry three years after Britain voted to leave the European Union.

title: Wall Street nears record as mood on trade again turns optimistic
description: Wall Street surged on Tuesday and the S&P 500 approached a record high after Washington rekindled trade talks with Beijing, boosting sentiment along with growing investor confidence that the Fed will cut interest rates this year.

title: Bayer asks trial judge to reverse $2 billion Roundup jury verdict
description: Bayer AG has asked a California judge to overrule a $2 billion verdict by jurors who found the company's glyphosate-based Roundup weed killer responsible for a couple's cancer, arguing the jury decision was not supported by evidence.

title: Trade tensions kick Asian business confidence to 10-year low: Thomson Reuters/INSEAD
description: Confidence among Asian companies in the June quarter fell to its lowest since the 2008-09 financial crisis, as a U.S.-China trade war disrupts global supply chains and shows little sign of easing soon, a Thomson Reuters/INSEAD survey found.

title: Nissan considers seats for Renault chairman, CEO in new committees: Nikkei
description: Nissan Motor Co Ltd plans to give seats in its four proposed committees to alliance partner Renault SA's chief executive and chairman, Japan's Nikkei newspaper reported on Wednesday, citing sources.

title: PG&E settles California fire claims with local governments for $1 billion
description: PG&E Corp will pay $1 billion as part of its bankruptcy reorganization to more than a dozen local governments in California struck by wildfires in recent years, the company and lawyers for the governments said on Tuesday.

title: Facebook's cryptocurrency ambitions face privacy concerns, political backlash
description: Facebook Inc announced ambitious plans on Tuesday to launch a new global cryptocurrency called Libra, part of an effort to expand into digital payments that immediately raised privacy concerns.

title: Canada approves contentious oil pipeline expansion, expects legal challenges
description: Canada on Tuesday approved as expected a hotly contested proposal to expand the western Canadian crude oil pipeline it bought last year, providing hope for a depressed energy industry but angering environmental groups.

title: Oil climbs over $1/bbl on U.S.-China trade deal hopes, Mideast tension
description: Oil prices rose more than $1 a barrel on Tuesday after news that China and the United States were resuming trade talks ahead of a meeting at the G20 summit later this month, spurring hopes that the two countries would resolve an ongoing trade war.

title: Adobe beats quarterly estimates on cloud strength; shares rise
description: Adobe Inc beat analysts' estimates for quarterly profit and revenue on Tuesday, driven by growth in its digital media business that houses its flagship product Creative Cloud, sending its shares up 4.6% after market.

title: Google invests $1 billion to ease housing shortage near California headquarters
description: Alphabet Inc's Google announced on Tuesday it would set aside $750 million in land and $250 million in financing to spur developers in the San Francisco Bay Area to build at least 20,000 homes and rehabilitate other housing over the next decade.

title: Exclusive: U.S. seen open to mechanism to end aircraft subsidy fight - sources
description: The United States is expected to be open to negotiations on an "enforceable mechanism" that could allow European planemaker Airbus to receive government funding on commercial terms and ease the risk of tit-for-tat sanctions, two U.S. sources said.

title: Anadarko approves $20 billion LNG export project in Mozambique
description: U.S. energy firm Anadarko Petroleum Corp on Tuesday  gave the go-ahead for the construction of a $20 billion gas liquefaction and export terminal in Mozambique, the largest single LNG project approved in Africa.

title: Senior U.S. lawmaker says Facebook should halt cryptocurrency project pending review
description: U.S. House Financial Services Committee Chairwoman Maxine Waters said Tuesday that Facebook Inc should halt development of its announced cryptocurrency until Congress and regulators conduct a review.

title: U.S. lawmaker calls for Facebook to pause cryptocurrency project
description: A leading U.S. House lawmaker on Tuesday called on Facebook Inc to halt development on its new cryptocurrency and for company executives to testify before Congress, adding to global concerns about what the digital currency could mean for data privacy and security.

title: Comcast partners with Charter, Cox to advance targeted advertising
description: U.S. cable provider Comcast Corp on Tuesday launched a program to further develop an advertising strategy that better targets audiences, as the TV industry looks to lure more advertisers away from digital players like Facebook Inc and Alphabet Inc's Google.

title: Dish Network nearing $6 billion deal for T-Mobile-Sprint assets: Bloomberg
description: Satellite TV provider Dish Network Corp is in talks to buy the wireless assets of T-Mobile US Inc and Sprint Corp for at least $6 billion, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Global stocks lifted by hopes for monetary policy, U.S.-China trade
description: Global stocks rallied on Tuesday and benchmark government bond yields tumbled after European Central Bank President Mario Draghi hinted at economic stimulus, with equities getting an extra boost from confirmation that U.S. President Donald Trump would meet China's president to talk about trade.

title: Draghi's stimulus hints put ECB in Trump's crosshairs
description: The European Central Bank will ease policy again if inflation fails to accelerate, ECB President Mario Draghi said on Tuesday, signaling one of the biggest policy reversals of his eight-year tenure and provoking the ire of U.S. President Donald Trump.

title: White House's Kudlow: U.S. looking for 'enforceable' trade deal with China - Fox
description: The United States wants to continue trade discussions with China that focus on structural changes and enforcement mechanisms when talks continue late this month during the G20 summit in Japan, White House economic adviser Larry Kudlow said on Tuesday.

title: Explainer: 'Stablecoins' in the spotlight as Facebook unveils Libra cryptocurrency
description: The original cryptocurrency accounts for over half of the $285 billion global coin trading market. But that dominance is under threat, with a host of alternative digital coins emerging as developers race to build cryptocurrencies able to enter  mainstream commerce and finance.

title: Nvidia boosts self-driving AI business with Volvo trucks deal
description: Sweden's AB Volvo is joining forces with Nvidia Corp to develop artificial intelligence used in self-driving trucks, in a boost for the U.S. chipmaker that was dropped by Tesla Inc last year.

title: Boeing 737 MAX boosted by IAG plan to order 200 jets
description: Boeing's grounded 737 MAX jet received a boost on Tuesday after British Airways-owner IAG signed a letter of intent to order 200 of the planes and said it was confident that it would return to service in the coming months.

title: Boost for Boeing as BA owner backs grounded jet with 200-plane order
description: Boeing won a major vote of confidence at the Paris Airshow on Tuesday as British Airways owner IAG signed a letter of intent to buy 200 of its 737 MAX jets that have been grounded since March after two deadly crashes.

title: Airbus seeks new partners to expand in U.S. space market
description: Airbus' defense division is looking for new partners to expand its presence in the growing U.S. space market, and could potentially build components for a lunar program there, Airbus Defense and Space Chief Executive Dirk Hoke told Reuters.

title: Germany to buy three new Bombardier jets
description: Germany's government will buy three new Bombardier jets this year, RND newspapers reported on Tuesday, adding that the deal would have a volume of 240 million euros ($268.51 million).

title: Barrick CEO believes Acacia offer is fair after extending bid deadline
description: Barrick Gold Corp, the world's No. 2 gold miner, believes its proposed offer to take full control of its African unit is "more than fair" and will engage with Acacia Mining Plc's board and minority shareholders to win them over, Chief Executive Mark Bristow told Reuters on Tuesday.

title: Drahi says to keep focus on TMT businesses after Sotheby's deal
description: Billionaire Patrick Drahi said on Monday he would remain focused on his main telecoms and media businesses and would not sell any shares in his Altice Europe NV business to fund his acquisition of Sotheby's auction house.

title: Boeing to supply parts for Airbus A320 jets for British Airways
description: Boeing Co said on Monday it would supply parts for A320 jetliners made by its competitor Airbus to supply British Airways, the first such agreement by the U.S. planemaker to support an Airbus aircraft.

title: Factbox: Airbus and Boeing aircraft deals at Paris Airshow
description: Following is a summary of commercial aircraft deals announced by Airbus and Boeing at the Paris Airshow.

title: Boeing crisis, trade tensions cast pall over air show
description: Safety concerns, trade wars and growing security tensions in the Gulf are dampening spirits at the world's largest planemakers as they arrive at this week's Paris Airshow with little to celebrate despite bulging order books.

title: Boeing says will take time to win back confidence
description: The head of Boeing said on Sunday the U.S. planemaker had made a mistake in implementing a faulty cockpit warning system on the 737 MAX and predicted it would take time to rebuild the confidence of customers in the wake of two fatal crashes.

title: Spain joins France and Germany in race to build Europe's next combat jet
description: Spain on Monday joined a Franco-German project to build a next-generation fighter jet, an initiative touted as key to ensuring Europe can defend itself without depending on allies in an increasingly uncertain world.

title: Citi combines rates and currencies businesses
description: Citigroup Inc said on Monday it is combining its Foreign Exchange & Local Markets and G10 currencies businesses into one unit.

title: Boeing lifts 20-year industry demand forecast to $6.8 trillion
description: Boeing Co raised its rolling 20-year industry forecast for passenger aircraft by 3% on Monday, fueled by strong air traffic predictions, though global geopolitical and economic risks could upset the rosy outlook.

title: Lockheed: No concern that Raytheon-UTC merger will affect F-35 program
description: Lockheed Martin F-35 program manager Greg Ulmer said on Monday he had "no concern" that the proposed merger of Raytheon Co and United Technologies Corp would affect the F-35 program or pressure its margins.

title: Tesla's Elon Musk becomes 'Daddy DotCom' on Twitter
description: Silicon Valley billionaire Elon Musk tweeted https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1140481957341495296 late on Sunday that he had "just deleted" his Twitter account, while also changing his Twitter display name to "Daddy DotCom".

title: Wife of former Nissan boss Ghosn urges Trump to help her husband
description: The wife of former Nissan Motor chairman Carlos Ghosn urged U.S. President Donald Trump to raise her husband's case with Japan's prime minister at a summit of world leaders later this month.

title: Airbus launches new A321XLR jet and wins Air Lease Corp orders
description: Airbus launched its A321XLR jet and announced orders for the new model, as the European planemaker aims to carve out new routes for airlines with smaller planes and steal a march on rival Boeing's plans for a possible new mid-market jet.

title: Boeing says sorry for MAX 737 crashes, promises to learn lessons
description: Boeing executives took turns to apologize for the loss of life in two 737 MAX crashes and pledged to apply lessons of the crisis to future planes as the world's largest aerospace company struck a chastened tone at the opening of the Paris Airshow.

title: UBS loses role in bond deal for Chinese firm on outcry over pig comment
description: UBS has lost a lead role on a U.S. dollar bond deal for state-backed China Railway Construction Corp, just days after a Chinese outcry over a senior UBS economist's use of "pig" in connection with Chinese food price inflation.

title: Alibaba proposes one-to-eight stock split ahead of up to $20 billion HK listing
description: China's Alibaba Group Holding has proposed a one-to-eight stock split ahead of a listing in Hong Kong later this year that is expected to raise up to $20 billion.

title: Exclusive: Hong Kong tycoons start moving assets offshore as fears rise over new extradition law
description: Some Hong Kong tycoons have started moving personal wealth offshore as concern deepens over a local government plan to allow extraditions of suspects to face trial in China for the first time, according to financial advisers, bankers and lawyers familiar with such transactions.

title: Virgin Atlantic orders 14 Airbus A330neos, with further six options
description: Europe's Airbus has agreed to sell 14 A330neo wide-body passenger jets to Virgin Atlantic in a deal valued at $4.1 billion, the companies announced at the Paris Airshow on Monday, with an option for the airline to order six more.

title: UK hopes Trump and Xi can ease trade tensions at G20 summit: Hammond
description: Britain hopes that U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping can make progress on easing trade tensions when they meet later this month at a summit of world leaders in Japan, British finance minister Philip Hammond said.

title: Canada backs startup to boost data on space debris
description: The Canadian government's contracting arm is backing a proposed new satellite system that will use big data analytics to provide commercially available data about the Earth and its orbit amid growing concerns about the risks posed by space debris.

title: Airbus faces cabin comfort dilemma as it launches A321XLR jet
description: Airbus has broken records by launching the longest-range narrow-body jetliner at the Paris Airshow, but planemakers are having to rethink their mantra on comfort as they squeeze ever more miles out of jets designed for shorter trips.

title: Faith in the Fed nudges Wall Street higher
description: Wall Street edged higher on Monday, supported by Facebook, Amazon and Apple, as investors awaited a key Federal Reserve meeting that is expected to lay the groundwork for an interest rate cut later this year.

title: Deutsche Bank to set up 50 billion euro bad bank in revamp
description: Deutsche Bank is planning to overhaul its trading operations by creating a so-called bad bank to hold tens of billions of euros of non-core assets, a source close to the matter said on Monday.

title: Australia's central bank says 'likely' will have to cut rates again
description: - Australia's central bank believes it will likely have to cut interest rates further from the current record low of 1.25% in order to push down unemployment and revive growth in wages and inflation.

title: U.S. settles antitrust charges with Fox, CBS, Scripps, Cox, Tegna
description: The U.S. Justice Department said on Monday it had settled antitrust charges with CBS Corp, Cox Enterprises Inc, E.W. Scripps Co, Fox Corp and Tegna Inc, which were accused of sharing competitively sensitive information.

title: Oil prices fall 1% as economic worries outweigh tanker tensions
description: Oil prices fell more than 1% on Monday after more poor Chinese economic figures fanned fears of lower worldwide oil demand.

title: Bah humbug! Trump's plan for more China tariffs to hit festive shoppers
description: This year's holiday season could be tighter for many Americans if the U.S. government imposes tariffs on another $300 billion worth of Chinese imports - because that will include tech products, game consoles, toys, cribs, ornaments and Santa hats.

title: U.S. chipmakers quietly lobby to ease Huawei ban
description: Huawei's American chip suppliers, including Qualcomm and Intel, are quietly pressing the U.S. government to ease its ban on sales to the Chinese tech giant, even as Huawei itself avoids typical government lobbying, people familiar with the situation said.

title: U.S. firms say China tariffs will raise costs, see few sourcing alternatives
description: A wide range of U.S. companies told a hearing in Washington on Monday that they have few alternatives other than China for producing clothing, electronics and other consumer goods as the Trump administration prepares new tariffs on remaining U.S.-China trade.

title: Boeing says has no plans to change name of 737 MAX
description: Boeing Co said on Monday it had no plans to change the name of the 737 MAX after news reports that it would be prepared to do so to improve its future marketing.

title: Pfizer makes $10.6 billion cancer bet in cash deal for Array Biopharma
description: Pfizer Inc said on Monday it would buy Array Biopharma Inc for $10.64 billion in cash, a deal it hopes will help make it a leader in colon cancer and build up its pipeline of oncology drugs.

title: Blockchain startup Ripple buys $30 million stake in MoneyGram
description: Blockchain firm Ripple has bought $30 million worth of shares and warrants in MoneyGram International Inc, the two companies said on Monday, as they partner to use Ripple's product for cross-border payment and foreign exchange settlement.

title: Fed likely to resist pressure to cut U.S. rates this week
description: The U.S. Federal Reserve, facing fresh demands by President Donald Trump to cut interest rates, is expected to leave borrowing costs unchanged at a policy meeting this week but possibly lay the groundwork for a rate cut later this year.

title: Global stocks, yields dip with Fed meeting on tap
description: A gauge of global stock markets dipped slightly on Monday after a mostly strong month and benchmark U.S. bond yields edged lower as investors awaited developments this week from central banks in the United States and elsewhere.

title: FAA moves to support growth of civil supersonic air industry
description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said on Monday it is moving to rewrite testing rules to allow for the eventual return of civil supersonic air travel.

title: Fashion house Chanel parades its independence as profits rise
description: Luxury fashion group Chanel, whose star designer Karl Lagerfeld passed away in February, on Monday reaffirmed commitment to its independence after reporting higher annual sales and profits.

title: Fed may cut rates near zero if U.S.-China trade worsens: Morgan Stanley
description: The Federal Reserve may lower U.S. interest rates to near zero by the spring of 2020 if U.S.-China trade relations deteriorate further and tip the U.S. economy into a recession, according to Morgan Stanley analysts.

title: KPMG fined $50 million for using stolen data, exam fraud: U.S. SEC
description: KPMG LLP has agreed to pay a $50 million fine over allegations former staffers used stolen information to alter some of the accounting firm's previous audit work and cheated on training exams, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said on Monday.

title: Insurance costs rocket for U.S. IPOs as twitchy investors take to courts
description: Companies going public in the United States face insurance costs that have increased as much as 200% in the last three years to cover their executives against lawsuits alleging they misled investors.

title: Canada set to approve hotly-debated pipeline expansion, Trudeau unlikely to benefit
description: Canada looks set to approve a hotly-debated plan to expand an oil pipeline this week, people familiar with the process told Reuters, but the move is unlikely to help Prime Minister Justin Trudeau rebuild flagging support ahead of an October election.

title: U.S. Navy official sees more orders for Boeing P-8A in coming months
description: The U.S. Navy expects additional U.S. and international orders for the Boeing P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft in coming months, which should extend production by two years to late 2025, a senior U.S. Navy official told Reuters.

title: China's FedEx probe should not be seen as retaliation: Xinhua
description: China's investigation into FedEx Corp over misdirected mail should not be regarded as retaliation against the U.S. company, state news agency Xinhua said on Sunday, amid worsening relations between China and the United States.

title: Exclusive: Boeing seeking to reduce scope, duration of some physical tests for new aircraft - sources
description: Boeing Co engineers are reducing the scope and duration of certain costly physical tests used to certify the planemaker's new aircraft, according to industry sources and regulatory officials.

title: Long-awaited London-Shanghai share listing project goes live
description: Companies listed in Britain will be able to sell shares in China on Monday with the launch of a long-awaited London-Shanghai Stock Connect project that finance minister Philip Hammond called a chance to deepen "global connectivity".

title: Goldman skeptical of 'insurance' U.S. rate cuts from Fed
description: Goldman Sachs economists said on Sunday they are skeptical of "insurance" U.S. interest rate decreases from the Federal Reserve to forestall possible slowing in U.S. economic growth due to global trade tensions.

title: Goldman Sachs combining its private-investing units: WSJ
description: Wall Street bank Goldman Sachs Group Inc is combining its private-investing arms, with the resulting new division to have about $140 billion in assets, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Huawei prepares for 40%-60% fall in international smartphone shipments: Bloomberg
description: Huawei Technologies Co Ltd is preparing for a 40% to 60% decline in international smartphone shipments, Bloomberg reported on Sunday.

title: Target says payments vendor faces glitch; registers back online
description: Target Corp on Sunday said it was unable to process select card payments at some stores for nearly 90 minutes due to a vendor-related issue – the second consecutive outage faced by the retailer in a week.

title: CFM erases jet engine output delay, cautious on rate increases
description: CFM International has caught up with delays in deliveries of its LEAP jet engine after keeping its assembly lines running at high speed while the Boeing 737 MAX remains grounded, the French-American engine maker said on Saturday.

title: Court grants American Airlines' request to end 'devastating' slowdown by unions
description: A U.S. federal court on Friday granted American Airlines Group Inc's request to halt an alleged illegal slowdown by its mechanics' unions that the airline said had become "devastating" to its operations.

title: Nissan considers giving Renault some seats on oversight committees - source
description: Nissan Motor Co is considering giving its alliance partner Renault SA some seats on planned oversight committees after the French automaker expressed discontent with the envisioned governance reform, a source said.

title: Why proposed changes to Hong Kong's extradition law fueled protests
description: Hong Kong leader Carrie Lam has delayed indefinitely a proposed law that would allow extraditions to mainland China, in a dramatic retreat after widespread anger over the bill sparked the biggest street protests in three decades.

title: India to impose retaliatory tariffs on 28 U.S. goods from Sunday
description: India will impose higher retaliatory tariffs on 28 U.S. products including almonds, apples and walnuts from Sunday, following Washington's withdrawal of key trade privileges for New Delhi.

title: NATO faces big bill if it does not pick AWACS successor soon: officials
description: NATO faces significant costs if it does not act soon to choose a successor for its ageing fleet of 14 Boeing E-3A Airborne Warning & Control System (AWACS) surveillance aircraft, often called the alliance's "eyes in the sky", senior officials said.

title: Target says registers back online, blames outage on technology issue
description: Target Corp on Saturday said its payment registers were back online after a systems outage stopped customers in the United States from paying for in-store purchases.

title: Take Five: The Fed and the rest
description: With President Donald Trump's trade policies heightening fears of a U.S. recession, expectations of a Fed rate cut have dramatically increased in the past month. Money market pricing became even more aggressive after Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell threw open the door to a cut, promising on June 4 the Fed would act "as appropriate" to address risks from the trade dispute. It was the second sudden shift in the Fed's tone, after January when it abandoned its bias toward steady tightening.

title: China launches inquiry into FedEx parcel delivery errors: Xinhua
description: Chinese authorities have launched an investigation into FedEx Corp over parcels delivered to the wrong addresses, China's official Xinhua news agency reported on Friday.

title: Norwegian Air expects Boeing 737 MAX fleet to remain grounded until end of August
description: Norwegian Air expects Boeing's 737 MAX aircraft to remain grounded until at least the end of August, missing the European summer season, CEO Bjoern Kjos said on Friday.

title: Exclusive - Business and pleasure: how Russian oil giant Rosneft uses its corporate jets
description: Jets used for corporate travel by Russian state-owned oil major Rosneft flew at least 13 times to Mallorca, Ibiza, Sardinia and the Maldives when CEO Igor Sechin or people from his social circle were in the same vacation spots.

title: Carrefour sees more retail sector consolidation, including in France
description: The boss of Carrefour said on Friday the retail sector was bound to consolidate in the coming years, notably in France, as competition intensifies, and that his mission was to make sure the French retailer came out a winner.

title: Rising oil prices add to global economic strife
description: Escalating tension in the Middle East is driving up oil prices, a huge import cost for many economies, putting more strain on global growth already hurt by the trade war being waged by U.S. President Donald Trump and weakening consumer confidence.

title: How an Obama Fed appointee is scuttling Wall Street's bid to ease rules
description: As a U.S. Federal Reserve governor, Lael Brainard gets only one vote on proposals that come before the central bank's board. Over the past year, she has used it to combat the Trump administration's efforts to ease rules for Wall Street.

title: United States suspends WTO intellectual property litigation against China
description: The United States has halted a World Trade Organization dispute over China's treatment of intellectual property rights until Dec. 31, the WTO dispute panel hearing the case said in a statement published on Friday.

title: Bayer to invest $5.6 billion in weedkiller research to help reputation
description: Germany's Bayer sought to repair its reputation on Friday after damage caused by U.S. litigation over claims its glyphosate pesticide causes cancer, saying it would invest 5 billion euros ($5.6 billion) in weedkiller research.

title: Huawei delays global launch of foldable phone by three months
description: Huawei will delay the launch of its much-touted foldable 5G Mate X smartphone by three months, the latest setback for the company that was slapped with U.S. sanctions last month.

title: Oman Air plans Airbus talks unless Boeing provides 737 Max support plan
description: Oman Air CEO Abdulaziz Al Raisi plans to hold talks with Airbus if Boeing does not provide a support and recovery plan for its grounded 737 MAX planes before June 17, a statement by the Omani company said on Friday.

title: India minister says confident airline capacity problems will be solved
description: India's new civil aviation minister said on Friday he is  confident that airline capacity shortage problems following the grounding of Jet Airways Ltd will be solved, in the government's first comments about the issue since it was re-elected last month.

title: WeWork considers $1.9 billion offer for 70% stake in Indian affiliate: Bloomberg
description: Shared office space manager WeWork Cos is exploring a deal to take majority control of its affiliate WeWork India ahead of the New York-based company's plans to go public, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: EU's Malmstrom hopes Trump, Xi can meet and reduce trade tensions
description: European Union Trade Commissioner Cecilia Malmstrom is hoping  U.S. President Donald Trump meets his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, at the G20 summit in Japan later this month to try to reduce trade tensions between the two countries.

title: Awake at the wheel: Automakers tap VR to banish boredom in autonomous cars
description: Audi, Nissan and other car makers are banking on talking cartoon characters and other virtual reality experiences to keep drivers and other occupants of future autonomous vehicles entertained, auto industry executives said.

title: Airbus agrees new contract for delayed A400M military transporter
description: Airbus has reached an agreement with European state buyers to revise a contract for its delayed A400M military transporter plane, resetting Europe's largest defense project after a lengthy wrangle over costs and military capability.

title: Airbus signs amended A400M deal with buyer countries
description: Airbus said on Friday it had signed an agreement with European buyer countries for a revised contract for its delayed A400M military transporter plane.

title: Fiat Chrysler signs EV charge point deals with Enel, Engie
description: Carmaker Fiat Chrysler (FCA) has signed an agreement with European utilities Enel and Engie to help offer its customers charging points for electric vehicles (EV) it is planning to roll out.

title: Hedge fund Third Point calls on Sony to spin off semiconductor unit
description: Daniel Loeb's activist hedge fund Third Point LLC called on Sony Corp on Thursday to spin off its semiconductor business and sell off stakes in Sony Financial and other units, in order to position itself as a leading global entertainment company.

title: Huawei says it is readying possible Hongmeng software roll-out
description: (This June 13th story corrects to remove incorrect reference to Hongmeng OS rollout on 1 million devices in paragraph 2 and 4 after official clarification from company)

title: PetSmart's Chewy gets Wall Street tails wagging with $1 billion IPO
description: Chewy Inc said on Thursday it priced its initial public offering at $22 per share, above its target, and sold more stock than originally planned, valuing the online pet products retailer at $8.77 billion.

title: U.S. Justice Department set to decide on T-Mobile, Sprint merger as soon as next week: source
description: The U.S. Justice Department is set to decide as early as next week whether to approve the $26.5-billion merger of wireless carriers T-Mobile USA and Sprint Corp, a person briefed on the matter said on Friday.

title: GE poised for significant power orders in Iraq after U.S. push -sources
description: General Electric Co potentially stands to win a large share of  multibillion-dollar contracts to rebuild Iraq's electricity system, reflecting a change in how Iraq intends to award the work after the United States lobbied for GE, according to sources familiar with the matter.

title: Broadcom's $2 billion warning rattles global chip sector
description: Broadcom Inc sent a shockwave through the global chipmaking industry on Friday with its forecast that U.S.-China trade tensions and the ban on doing business with Huawei Technologies would knock $2 billion off the company's sales this year.

title: VW to float 10% of truck unit, seeks to raise 1.9 billion euros
description: Volkswagen aims to raise up to 1.9 billion euros ($2.1 billion) by listing truck unit Traton, it said on Friday, scaling back earlier ambitions to list up to a quarter of the unit by opting to float a 10% stake.

title: VW's Tennessee workers vote against union representation
description: Workers at Volkswagen AG's assembly plant in the state of Tennessee narrowly voted against union representation, dealing a fresh blow to the United Auto Workers' (UAW) efforts to unionize a foreign automaker's plant in the U.S. South.

title: Trump presses Lockheed to keep open a Pennsylvania plant slated for closure
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday urged Lockheed Martin Corp to keep open its Sikorsky helicopter plant in Coatesville, Pennsylvania, a week after the weapons maker announced the planned closure of the facility.

title: All eyes on Fed as stock market pines for rate cut
description: The Federal Open Market Committee meeting next week is shaping up as a pivotal one for Wall Street, with stocks primed for a selloff should the Fed fail to take an even more dovish tilt after policymakers raised expectations for a rate cut in recent weeks.

title: Papa John's dismisses KPMG as its auditor, hires EY
description: Papa John's International Inc said on Friday it dismissed KPMG LLP as its financial auditor and appointed Ernst & Young LLP, which served as its bookkeeper from 1990 to 2017, to handle its accounts for the fiscal year ending December 2019, according to a regulatory filing http://bit.ly/2wWOIUg.

title: U.S. to launch public hearings on additional China tariffs next week
description: The U.S. Trade Representative's Office on Monday will kick off seven days of testimony from U.S. retailers, manufacturers and other businesses about President Donald Trump's plan to hit another $300 billion worth of Chinese goods with tariffs.

title: Apollo in talks to finance Dish Network bid for T-Mobile, Sprint assets - sources
description: Private equity group Apollo Global Management is in talks with satellite TV provider Dish Network to finance a bid for wireless assets that will be divested in the proposed merger between T-Mobile and Sprint Corp, according to two people familiar with the matter.

title: Chicken producer Perdue enters crowded plant-based meat market
description: Perdue Foods, one of America's largest chicken producers, said it will sell frozen chicken nuggets mixed with cauliflower, chickpeas and plant protein to address a growing demand for products combining meat and vegetables.

title: Exclusive: Mexico blamed Walmart's size, access to rivals' data in blocking app deal
description: Mexican officials blocked Walmart Inc's deal to buy delivery app Cornershop because Walmart could not guarantee a level playing field for rival retailers, whose customers use the app to order groceries and other goods, according to an official document and an interview with the top competition regulator this week.

title: Wall Street ends down; Broadcom warning hits chip stocks
description: U.S. stocks ended lower on Friday as investors were cautious going into next week's Federal Reserve meeting, while a warning from Broadcom of a broad weakening in global demand weighed on chipmakers and added to U.S.-China trade worries.

title: Mexico ready to retaliate if U.S. imposes tariffs: minister
description: Mexico will be ready to retaliate in kind if the U.S. government imposes tariffs on Mexican exports to the United States, Mexican Economy Minister Graciela Marquez said on Friday.

title: Bumble owner to spend $100 million on dating apps
description: The owner of dating app Bumble said on Friday it would revamp its holding structure and spend $100 million, as it looks to better compete with Match Group's Tinder.

title: Italy's industry ministry open to any discussions on Alitalia, including with Atlantia
description: Italy's industry ministry is open to discussions with any investor interested in the rescue of troubled carrier Alitalia, including infrastructure group Atlantia, two sources with knowledge of the matter said on Friday.

title: Bombardier opening new California rail-car assembly site
description: Canada's Bombardier is opening a new facility in California that will assemble rail cars for San Francisco's rapid transit system by year's end, and potentially serve other West Coast rail projects.

title: Airbus urges UTC not to be distracted by Raytheon deal
description: Airbus said on Friday it had urged United Technologies to "keep its eye on the ball" in its role as a commercial aerospace supplier as it moves toward a planned merger with U.S. defense contractor Raytheon.

title: Strong U.S. retail sales improve economy's fortunes
description: U.S. retail sales increased in May and sales for the prior month were revised higher, suggesting a pick-up in consumer spending that eased fears the economy was slowing down sharply in the second quarter.

title: Local labor laws apply to Ryanair employees: Belgian court
description: Belgium's labor laws can apply to Ryanair employees based in the country, a local court ruled on Friday, in a case that could set a precedent elsewhere in Europe and upholds a 2018 agreement reached between the airline and Belgian unions.

title: Global stocks dip as Fed meeting looms, oil climbs on geopolitical fears
description: U.S. stocks ended nominally lower on Friday as investors awaited next week's Federal Reserve meeting for signs of imminent easing, while the U.S.-Iran confrontation in the Gulf of Oman added to geopolitical uncertainty, sending oil prices higher.

title: Pilot shortages, unsold planes weigh on ATR deliveries: sources
description: Franco-Italian turboprop maker ATR is tackling a slump in deliveries resulting from a combination of industrial delays, unsold aircraft and pilot shortages, industry sources said.

title: Airbus delivers first A350 to Japan after landmark deal
description: Airbus delivered its first A350 aircraft to Japan Air Lines on Thursday, saying the specially tailored version would start operating on Japan's busy domestic routes.

title: China, Hong Kong homebuyers play cross-border musical chairs in Bay Area
description: An ambitious plan to transform the industrial towns of China's Pearl River Delta into a modern economic zone powered by new technology ventures has triggered a rush of cross-border property investments between Hong Kong and the mainland.

title: Chinese vice premier urges more support for economy amid trade war
description: Chinese regulators should step up support for the economy and keep ample liquidity in the financial system, Vice Premier Liu He said on Thursday, suggesting Beijing would soon unveil more policies to bolster growth amid rising U.S. trade pressure.

title: China's 'Gen Z' shoppers fuelling luxury market momentum: Bain
description: Chinese "Gen Z" shoppers in their early 20s are emerging as an increasingly powerful force in the luxury industry as brands try and tap into buoyant demand for high-end goods in the world's second-biggest economy, consultancy Bain said on Thursday.

title: China chip industry insiders voice caution on catch-up efforts
description: Since the U.S. government put Huawei Technologies Co Ltd on a trade blacklist, effectively banning American firms from doing business with it, China's leaders have spoken boldly about achieving self-sufficiency in the critical semiconductor business.

title: Danone CFO says China's baby formula plan 'not a surprise'
description: China's plan to increase local production of baby formula products has not come as a surprise to global dairy maker Danone, which has plans to launch a new ultra-premium product in that market, said Danone's chief financial officer.

title: Alibaba files for HK listing that may raise $20 billion as soon as third quarter: source
description: China's biggest e-commerce company Alibaba Group Holding Ltd has filed confidentially for a Hong Kong listing that could raise up to $20 billion as early as the third quarter of this year, a person with direct knowledge of the matter said.

title: Trump leaves China tariff deadline open, calls relationship 'testy'
description: U.S. President Donald Trump declined to set a deadline on Wednesday for levying tariffs on another $325 billion of Chinese goods and called the relationship with Beijing good but "testy" after China walked back commitments for a trade deal.

title: Lockheed Martin says F-35 cost cuts a year ahead of plan
description: Lockheed Martin is a year ahead of schedule with its plan to cut the cost of its F-35 A fighter jet variant to $80 million by 2020, the U.S. company said on Thursday.

title: India's Reliance Capital rejects PwC's observations after auditor quits
description: Reliance Capital said on Thursday the observations of global audit firm PwC about its fiscal accounts were "completely baseless and unjustified", after PwC in a surprise move resigned earlier this week as the auditor of the non-banking financial company (NBFC).

title: Pompeo to push in India for more U.S. access to local markets
description: The United States is open to dialogue to resolve trade differences with India by allowing American companies more access to Indian markets, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo said on Wednesday ahead of a visit to New Delhi later this month.

title: France's Le Maire to meet Renault chairman, says Nissan alliance priority
description: French Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire said on Thursday a Fiat Chrysler-Renault merger remained an "interesting opportunity" but added he would tell the French carmaker's chairman that strengthening the Renault-Nissan alliance was the priority.

title: India's Jet Airways plunges as bourse moves to limit speculative trading
description: Shares of Jet Airways sunk over 23% to a record low on Thursday after India's largest stock exchange said the carrier would soon no longer be traded in the derivatives market, while day-trading in the stock would also be barred, in a bid to curb speculative trading in the troubled company.

title: Sweden's Saab backs out of Swiss fighter jet test flights
description: Saab will not test its Gripen fighter jet this month in Switzerland, the Swedish company said on Thursday, after the Swiss defense procurement agency recommended against it on grounds the plane would not be operationally ready in 2019.

title: White House says it will meet two-year deadline for Huawei ban for contractors
description: The White House Office of Management and Budget has told the U.S. Congress it will now meet a two-year deadline to ban federal contracts with companies that do business with Chinese telecom giant Huawei, part of a defense law passed last year, according to a letter seen by Reuters.

title: BMW affirms target to hike sales as China drives May deliveries
description: German luxury carmaker BMW affirmed its target to increase sales this year after group sales rose by 3.2% in May year-on-year, driven by strong demand from mainland China.

title: Packager DS Smith says stocking up on spare parts ahead of Brexit
description: Packaging products maker DS Smith Plc said on Thursday that it had made plans for contingency stocking of spare parts as it readies for Britain's planned exit from the European Union, but expected disruption to its operations to be "relatively contained".

title: Britain's PwC fined $5.8 million over audit of Redcentric
description: Britain's accounting watchdog said on Thursday it had fined PwC 4.55 million pounds ($5.8 million) for failing to challenge management at IT services company Redcentric where a 20 million pound hole was later found in the books.

title: Is bitcoin growing up? Regulated futures boom as investors seek a safer ride
description: When bitcoin was born it was a symbol of counterculture, a rebel currency with near-anonymity and a lack of regulation. A decade later, there are growing signs it's entering the establishment its creators sought to subvert.

title: Credit Suisse, UBS have boosted capital positions: SNB
description: Switzerland's biggest banks, UBS and Credit Suisse, have improved their capital positions but must strengthen their crisis planning, the Swiss National Bank said on Thursday, citing conclusions of financial watchdog FINMA.

title: Tesco CEO not ready to check out in tough UK retail climate
description: The boss of Tesco said he had unfinished business at Britain's biggest retailer after its quarterly sales growth slowed in a subdued grocery market under a cloud from poor early summer weather.

title: Tesco has no plans to exit central Europe: chairman
description: British retailer Tesco has no plans to exit its central European operations, Chairman John Allan said on Thursday.

title: Exclusive: Petrobras ignored warnings about fuel broker implicated in graft probe
description: Brazil's Petrobras found suspicious activity in its oil trading business - and failed to stop it - six years before an alleged bribery scandal erupted in that unit in 2018, according to three people with knowledge of the situation and documents seen by Reuters.

title: Aiding 'organized crime': India alleges 22 audit violations by Deloitte, KPMG arm in fraud case
description: India detected at least 22 violations of auditing standards by Deloitte Haskins & Sells and a KPMG affiliate while investigating a fraud at a financial company, leading it to seek a five-year ban on the auditors, according to government legal filings seen by Reuters.

title: In VW Chattanooga vote, UAW seeks elusive U.S. southern toehold
description: For the second time in five years, workers at Volkswagen AG's Chattanooga, Tennessee, assembly plant have been voting this week on whether to unionize, potentially handing the United Auto Workers its first toehold in the U.S. South.

title: DHL says it will invest $150 million to expand U.S. healthcare business
description: Deutsche Post DHL Group on Thursday said it will spend $150 million this year to expand its U.S. healthcare distribution network capacity by roughly 40 percent.

title: Seeking shelter from trade war, fund managers bet on China's consumers
description: China may be an odd choice for investors seeking shelter from a Sino-U.S. trade war. Yet, money managers in Asia are pouring funds into Chinese stocks as the long-term promise of a growing middle class trumps more immediate fears about tariffs.

title: Safe havens emerge in China, South Asia as recession risks grow
description: Fears of a global recession are on the rise as the U.S.-China trade war re-escalated in May, sending investors to the safety of U.S Treasuries, the Japanese yen and gold.

title: Over 600 U.S. companies urge Trump to resolve trade dispute with China: letter
description: Walmart Inc, Target Corp and more than 600 other companies urged U.S. President Donald Trump in a letter on Thursday to resolve the trade dispute with China, saying tariffs hurt American businesses and consumers.

title: U.S. judge sets pre-trial hearing next week for Sprint/T-Mobile deal
description: The judge hearing a complaint from state attorneys general seeking to stop T-Mobile US Inc from buying Sprint Corp for $26 billion will hold a pre-trial hearing next week.

title: Canada rejects idea of halting extradition of top Huawei executive to United States
description: Canadian Foreign Minister Chrystia Freeland on Thursday dismissed a suggestion that Ottawa block the extradition of a top executive from China's Huawei Technologies Co Ltd to the United States, saying it would set a dangerous precedent.

title: Huawei files to trademark mobile OS around the world after U.S. ban
description: China's Huawei is in the process of potentially launching its "Hongmeng" operating system (OS) to replace the U.S. Android OS, an executive said on Thursday, after Reuters reported that the company has applied to trademark the OS in various countries.

title: Trump talks trade with Apple CEO Cook as China dispute looms
description: U.S. President Donald Trump met with Apple CEO Tim Cook on Thursday to discuss trade and other hot-button issues facing the tech company as Trump deliberates whether to make good on his threat to hike tariffs on imports from China.

title: Target expands same-day shipping as delivery war heats up
description: Target Corp on Thursday expanded its same-day delivery options for online shoppers, intensifying the race among retailers to deliver orders faster.

title: Wall St. climbs as oil jumps after Gulf tanker attacks
description: U.S. stocks rose on Thursday after two days of declines, as energy shares rebounded with oil on concerns of a supply disruption following attacks on two tankers in the Gulf of Oman.

title: Biden criticizes Amazon for not paying federal taxes in 2018
description: Democratic presidential hopeful Joe Biden on Thursday took umbrage with e-commerce giant Amazon.com Inc's $0 federal tax bill in 2018 and said no company making billions in profits should pay a lower tax rate than firefighters and teachers.

title: Google policy head retools team for global lobbying push
description: Alphabet Inc's Google is trying to plug a surge of public scrutiny around the world by overhauling how its policy office operates, with increased emphasis on having policy staffers and top company executives alike building relationships with governments, people familiar with the matter said this week.

title: U.S. denies Tesla, GM, Uber 25% Chinese tariff relief
description: The Trump administration is expanding efforts to block the use of Chinese technology in advanced vehicles, denying additional requests by Tesla Inc for tariff relief on key components of its electric vehicles, and rejecting ride-hailing company Uber's petition to waive tariffs on electric scooters and at least 50 separate requests by General Motors Co.

title: Airbus in talks with Indigo Partners on A321XLR sale: sources
description: Airbus is in talks with U.S.-based private equity firm Indigo Partners about a potential sale of its new A321XLR passenger jet, industry sources said on Thursday.

title: Uber, Bird loses bid for U.S. tariff relief on Chinese-made bikes, scooters
description: The U.S. Trade Representative's Office rejected Uber Technologies Inc's request for relief from 25% tariffs imposed on Chinese-made electric bicycles, according to a May 29 letter.

title: U.S. weekly jobless claims rise; imported inflation subdued
description: The number of Americans filing applications for unemployment benefits unexpectedly rose last week, which could add to concerns that the labor market was losing steam after job growth slowed sharply in May.

title: Southwest extends Boeing 737 MAX cancellations through Sept. 2
description: Southwest Airlines Co said on Thursday it was extending the removal of Boeing Co 737 MAX aircraft from its flying schedule through Sept. 2, after the plane was grounded worldwide following two deadly crashes.

title: Uber enlists "Qute" to take on India's choked, polluted roads
description: Uber Technologies Inc  has launched a new ride-hailing service in India's tech capital Bengaluru that will use miniature gas-powered cars called "Qute" to win over commuters stressed out by the sprawling city's heavily-congested streets.

title: U.S. retailers' halting outlook reveals scale of tariff fear
description: The first half of 2019 was expected to be a boon for U.S. retailers, buoyed by solid consumer sentiment at home and expansion in China - the market many of them have targeted for the future.

title: U.S. healthcare stocks shielded from political pressures prove profitable
description: U.S. healthcare investors have found success this year buying stocks of companies whose products improve eyesight, treat pets and fix crooked teeth, all viewed as unlikely to fall victim to  political and regulatory issues pressuring a wide swath of the sector.

title: Oil surges on tanker attacks; stocks rise on Fed rate cut expectations
description: Oil futures rose on Thursday after attacks on two tankers off the coast of Iran, while the U.S. Treasury yield curve steepened and stocks rose following economic data seen as strengthening the case for the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates this year.

title: Philip Green's Arcadia avoids collapse as creditors back deal
description: Philip Green's Topshop-to-Dorothy Perkins fashion empire staved off a collapse into administration on Wednesday as creditors approved his sweetened restructuring plan.

title: Heated Hong Kong protests dent stocks, spike cash demand
description: Hong Kong's financial markets came under pressure on Wednesday, with stocks falling and demand for cash surging, as protesters clashed with police during a mass demonstration against legislation that would allow citizens to be extradited to China.

title: Salesforce bets on big data with $15.3 billion Tableau buy
description: Salesforce.com Inc agreed on Monday to buy big data firm Tableau Software Inc for $15.3 billion, adding muscle in its fight with Microsoft Corp for a bigger share of the market that helps businesses target customers with tools to analyze and visualize data.

title: Reckitt picks PepsiCo executive as CEO, going outside for first time
description: Consumer goods group Reckitt Benckiser has picked PepsiCo executive Laxman Narasimhan as its next chief executive, becoming the latest industry heavyweight to turn to a company outsider to tackle faltering growth and new media-savvy rivals.

title: Exclusive: Ethiopia plans to issue telco licenses by year-end
description: Ethiopia is aiming to award telco licenses to multinational mobile companies by the end of the year, ending a state monopoly and opening up one of the world's last major closed telecoms markets, three people with direct knowledge of the process said.

title: Ford Motor opens research center in Tel Aviv
description: Ford Motor Co on Wednesday opened a research center in Tel Aviv, joining a growing number of major automakers and suppliers setting up shop in the Israeli tech hub as they race to develop self-driving cars.

title: BAT warns of steeper declines in cigarette sales, shares slip
description: British American Tobacco (BAT), the world's No. 2 tobacco company, on Wednesday warned of steeper declines in cigarette sales globally mainly due to waning demand in its main U.S. market, sending its shares lower.

title: Hong Kong shops, workers in rare strike to 'defend freedom'
description: Hong Kong retailer Alan Li shut up shop on Wednesday, joining about 100 businesses and numerous workers in a rare strike to protest against an extradition bill that many fear will undermine freedom and confidence in the commercial hub.

title: No meat please! Nestle may extend plant-based burger partnerships
description: (This June 11 story has been corrected to delete erroneous reference to talks with McDonald's in fifth paragraph, amend headline.)

title: UK PM May says Hong Kong extradition must be in line with Sino-British declaration
description: British Prime Minister Theresa May said extradition rules in Hong Kong had to respect the rights and freedoms set out in the  1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration.

title: Britain calls on Hong Kong to pause extradition bill, maintain rights
description: Britain urged the Hong Kong government to "pause and reflect" on an extradition bill that has sparked widespread protests, and said the former British colony must take steps to protect its rights, freedoms and high degree of autonomy.

title: KKR offers 40% premium to buy out Axel Springer minorities
description: U.S. private equity investor KKR on Wednesday offered a 40% premium to buy out minority investors in Axel Springer in a deal that entrenches the influence of the main shareholders at the publishers of Germany's Bild newspaper.

title: The media has a big problem, Reuters Institute says: Who will pay for the news?
description: News organizations are being challenged by technology giants and unsettled by a broader lack of trust but they have a much deeper problem: most people don't want to pay for online news, the Reuters Institute found.

title: Adidas shares slide as traders say top investor GBL to cut stake
description: By Thyagaraju Adinarayan, Emma Thomasson and Philip Blenkinsop

title: Proxy advisers lob rare rebuke against Nissan CEO Saikawa
description: Two leading proxy advisory firms have urged Nissan shareholders to vote against reappointing its chief executive as a director, heaping more pressure on Hiroto Saikawa as he struggles to find accord with alliance partner Renault.

title: China reiterates support for Hong Kong government on extradition law
description: China's central government firmly supports the Hong Kong government in passing an extradition law allowing people to be sent to mainland China for trial, the foreign ministry reiterated on Wednesday.

title: China's CATL, Ant Financial and Hellobike set up e-bike battery firm
description: China's Contemporary Amperex Technology Co Ltd (CATL), Ant Financial Services and Hellobike said on Wednesday they will invest 1 billion yuan ($144.60 million) to establish a electric bicycle battery joint venture.

title: ABN AMRO fund invests in financial crime detection firm ThetaRay
description: ABN AMRO's Digital Impact Fund said on Wednesday it has taken a stake in ThetaRay, an Israeli provider of big data analytics to combat financial cybercrime and operational failures.

title: Facebook to create 500 jobs in new London engineering center
description: Facebook will create 500 new tech jobs in London by the end of 2019, including 100 roles in artificial intelligence, with many working on systems to detect and remove malicious content, fake accounts and harmful behavior, it said on Wednesday.

title: Dassault Systemes targets life sciences with $5.8 billion Medidata deal
description: France's Dassault Systemes moved to build up its life sciences presence with a $5.8 billion cash deal to buy Medidata Solutions, a U.S. firm focused on clinical trials.

title: Saudia airline close to placing order for Airbus aircraft: sources
description: Saudi Arabian Airlines is close to placing a multi-billion-dollar order for aircraft at least partly involving Airbus jets, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.

title: Skoda Auto's May deliveries drop 6.6% on weaker Chinese market
description: Global deliveries for Skoda Auto, part of the Volkswagen group, dropped by 6.6% to 104,900 vehicles in May, pulled down by a weaker overall market in China, its biggest sales destination, the company said on Wednesday.

title: KKR says investment pact with Springer valid for five years
description: U.S. private equity investor KKR said on Wednesday its investment agreement with the main shareholders in German publisher Axel Springer, under which it is making an offer to buy out minorities, was valid for five years.

title: Iran scrambles to lift petrochemical sales as sanctions hammer oil
description: Iran has been racing to step up exports of petrochemicals and tap new markets to compensate for sliding oil sales, Iranian and international industry sources said, but now risks losing that crucial revenue as Washington tightens the screw on sanctions.

title: Therapy in the office: banks take mental health fight in-house
description: In 'Billions', a U.S. television show set in the world of hedge funds, traders at the fictional Axe Capital regularly attend sessions with an in-house psychiatrist.

title: ABB names ex-GE exec Maryrose Sylvester to lead U.S. business
description: ABB has appointed industrial and software specialist Maryrose Sylvester as the new head of its U.S. business, the Swiss engineering company said on Wednesday, replacing company veteran Greg Scheu, who is due to retire.

title: Motorbike taxi firms rev up for race into West Africa
description: Motorcycle taxi companies are expanding in West Africa with backing from investors betting that the meteoric rise of two-wheeled taxi firms in Asia can be replicated in some of the fastest growing countries in the world.

title: Ford to spend $180 million to fix suspension issue in Explorer vehicles
description: Ford Motor Co said on Wednesday its North American unit will spend $180 million to correct a suspension issue in Explorer vehicles.

title: GM to invest $150 million to boost heavy-duty pickup truck production
description: General Motors Co president Mark Reuss said on Wednesday that the automaker is investing about $150 million at its Flint Assembly plant, Michigan, to boost production of heavy duty trucks by another 40,000 vehicles a year.

title: Ford recalls 1.2 million Explorer SUVs for potential steering problem
description: Ford Motor Co said on Wednesday it is recalling 1.2 million Explorer sport utility vehicles in the United States for a potential suspension defect that could lead to reduced steering control.

title: Huawei asks Verizon to pay over $1 billion for over 230 patents: source
description: Huawei Technologies Co Ltd has told Verizon Communications Inc that the U.S. carrier should pay licensing fees for more than 230 of the Chinese telecoms equipment maker's patents and in aggregate is seeking more than $1 billion, a person briefed on the matter said on Wednesday.

title: Analysts split on Tesla 2019 delivery promises
description: Tesla Inc shares were down 2% on Wednesday, as analysts remained divided on the electric-carmaker's chances of meeting delivery and production targets in the months ahead, despite Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk's reassurances at an annual shareholder meeting.

title: Republican senator criticizes potential dual U.S. antitrust tech probes
description: The Republican chairman of the Senate's antitrust panel criticized plans by the Justice Department and Federal Trade Commission to potentially investigate four of the biggest U.S. tech firms.

title: Democratic commissioner questions FCC review of Sprint T-Mobile merger
description: The senior Democrat on the Federal Communications Commission on Wednesday criticized the FCC's review of the proposed $26.5 billion tie-up of Sprint Corp and T-Mobile US Inc, saying Republican commissioners moved toward approving the merger without adequate economic and legal analysis.

title: U.S. pet doctors steel themselves for online pharmacy challenge
description: A David and Goliath battle is brewing in the business of selling prescription medicines for pets, pitching veterinarians against online giants moving into this lucrative corner of the growing market for animal supplies.

title: Nissan CEO: Will discuss differences in views with 'important' partner Renault - Jiji
description: Nissan Motor's chief executive said on Thursday he would discuss differences in views over the automaker's plan to reform its governance directly with Renault, calling the French car maker an important shareholder and partner, Jiji news agency reported.

title: FAA says has no timetable for Boeing 737 MAX's return to service
description: The Federal Aviation Administration said on Wednesday it does not have a specific timetable on when Boeing Co's troubled 737 MAX jet would return to service after two fatal crashes led to the airplane's worldwide grounding in March.

title: American Airlines CEO sees Boeing 737 MAX flying by mid-August
description: The grounded Boeing Co 737 MAX is "highly likely" to be flying by mid-August, American Airlines Group Inc Chief Executive Doug Parker told shareholders on Wednesday.

title: Trump confident Hong Kong and China will 'work things out' after protests
description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday he was sure China and Hong Kong would be able to "work things out" after mass protests in the city against an extradition bill that would allow people to be sent to mainland China for trial.

title: Jet.com falls by wayside as Walmart focuses on its website, online grocery
description: Walmart Inc on Wednesday announced a sweeping overhaul at Jet.com, an online start-up it acquired in 2016 for $3.3 billion, after it failed to live up to the world's largest retailer's e-commerce ambitions.

title: Wall St. slips; banks fall with prospect of rate cut, energy drops
description: Wall Street ended down slightly on Wednesday, with bank stocks declining as prospects of a U.S. interest rate cut rose and energy shares tumbling along with oil prices.

title: CFM wins blockbuster jet engine order from IndiGo: sources

description: Shenzhen-listed shares in Chinese video surveillance firm Hikvision Digital Technology Co Ltd opened 10% lower on Wednesday after reports that the U.S. may blacklist the firm.

title: U.S. Treasury's Mnuchin says U.S. to hit debt limit in late summer
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin on Wednesday urged Congress to raise the U.S. debt ceiling as soon as possible,  saying the U.S. government was expected to exhaust its borrowing authority around late summer.

title: U.S. Treasury's Mnuchin: No discussion with White House on Trump's taxes
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin on Wednesday said he had not discussed releasing President Donald Trump's tax returns with the White House, and disagreed with an IRS memo that reportedly concluded he should release them to Congress.

title: British Steel collapses after failing to secure extra funding
description: British Steel, the country's second largest steel producer, has collapsed and put 25,000 jobs at risk after failing to secure emergency government funding, Britain's Official Receiver said on Wednesday.

title: IBM, Cera Care to test self-driving car tech in elder homes
description: IBM and British start-up Cera Care plan a six-month pilot to test whether lidar laser sensors, used to help self-driving cars "see", can enable elderly people to stay in their homes for longer - without compromising privacy.

title: Investors seek safety on threat of wider U.S.-China spat
description: Global equity markets slid on Wednesday as investors sought safety in bonds, the Japanese yen and Swiss franc amid renewed worries over the U.S.-China trade standoff after reports the United States has another Chinese tech firm in its sights.

title: Philip Green's Arcadia to close UK stores, review U.S. in restructuring

title: Uber to open third Latin America support center in Bogota

description: Brazil's Natura SA said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement to buy rival Avon Products Inc via a share swap, creating the world's fourth-largest beauty company with a redoubled focus on direct sales.

description: U.S. Federal Reserve officials at their last meeting agreed that their current patient approach to setting monetary policy could remain in place "for some time," a further sign policymakers see little need to change rates in either direction.

description: General Motors Co faces pushback over its request that U.S. regulators waive some automobile safety standards to make it possible to deploy a ride-sharing fleet of driverless cars without steering wheels or other human controls.

title: Tesla drops for sixth straight session, down 20% since share offer
description: Tesla shares extended their recent sell-off on Wednesday after Citi cut its price target on the struggling electric car maker, leaving buyers of its recent share offer, including Chief Executive Elon Musk, $175 million in the hole.

description: The acting head of the Federal Aviation Administration said on Wednesday he does not have a specific timetable for when the agency may unground the Boeing 737 MAX that has been involved in two fatal crashes since October.
