title: Ahead of holidays, FedEx leans on special bonuses to keep pilots from retiring
description: Santa's sleigh cannot fly without its pilot.

title: Facebook, responding to lawsuit, says sex trafficking banned on site
description: Facebook said on Wednesday in response to a lawsuit accusing it of not doing enough to protect users from human traffickers that it works internally and externally to thwart such predators.

title: Race bias lawsuit against Morgan Stanley sent to private arbitration
description: A black former Morgan Stanley broker who filed a lawsuit accusing the bank of racial bias must pursue his claims in private arbitration, a federal judge ruled on Wednesday.

title: Ebay alleges Amazon poached sellers from its platform
description: Ebay Inc on Wednesday accused Amazon.com Inc of trying to poach sellers for its own platform through Ebay's internal messaging system.

title: Tesla must defend lawsuit alleging abuse of foreign workers
description: A federal judge has ruled that Tesla must defend itself at a trial over allegations it knew foreign workers at its California assembly plant were threatened with deportation if they reported an injury and worked long shifts that violated forced labor laws.

title: Zalando expands beauty offer to men, and two new countries
description: Germany-based Zalando  is expanding its beauty business to Austria and Poland, and adding men's grooming products, the online specialist fashion retailer said on Thursday.

title: Britain's CMA toughens action against Lloyds Bank over PPI
description: Britain's Competition and Markets Authority has demanded Lloyds Banking Group  toughen its procedures around payment protection insurance (PPI) after it accused the bank of breaching its current arrangements.

title: Aston Martin skids on market debut
description: Shares in luxury automaker Aston Martin  fell as much as 6.5 percent on their market debut in London on Wednesday as investors and analysts raised concerns over its ability to deliver an ambitious roll-out of new models.

title: Swedbank says its anti-money laundering procedures not being investigated
description: Sweden's Swedbank  said on Thursday that there were no ongoing investigations into its anti-money laundering procedures, a day after its shares slumped on worries about cross-border transactions by banks in Estonia.

title: Wealth managers count cost of U.S.-Chinese trade war on Asian business
description: The performance of big wealth managers may take hit as a trade war between the United States and China hurts business in major growth market Asia, bankers said.

title: Honda to invest $2.75 billion in GM's self-driving car unit
description: Honda Motor Co Ltd  will invest $2.75 billion and take a 5.7 percent stake in General Motors Co's  Cruise self-driving vehicle unit, to jointly develop autonomous vehicles for deployment in ride services fleets around the world.

title: Comcast secures over 75 percent of Sky shares
description: Comcast  said it had secured over 75 percent of Sky's  shares, bringing it closer to finalizing the $40 billion takeover of the British pay TV group.

title: Casino gambles on Amazon-style checkout free Champs Elysees store
description: Casino  is doing away with cashiers in a new shop near the Champs Elysees in a French version of the Amazon Go  checkout-free convenience stores in the United States.

title: HSBC bolsters infrastructure, power and real estate teams in expansion drive
description: HSBC  has hired seven new bankers to expand its power, infrastructure and real estate businesses as part of a global push to serve clients across these industries, the investment bank said in a release on Thursday.

title: U.S. weekly jobless claims near 49-year low; factory orders surge
description: The number of Americans filing for unemployment benefits fell to a near 49-year low last week, pointing to sustained labor market strength, which should continue to underpin economic growth.

title: Wells Fargo planning its first post-crisis mortgage bond: Bloomberg
description: Wells Fargo & Co  is planning its first post-crisis offering of bonds tied to U.S. home loans without government backing, Bloomberg reported on Thursday citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Wall Street stumbles as bond yield climb continues
description: Wall Street stocks stumbled on Thursday as U.S. Treasury yields continued their ascent to multi-year highs on the latest round of strong economic data, building concerns for an acceleration of inflation.

title: Exclusive: Third Point demands Campbell Soup board records
description: Activist investor Daniel Loeb's hedge fund Third Point LLC has demanded access to a trove of records from Campbell Soup Co, ranging from board meeting minutes to financial documents, as it ratchets up a campaign to replace the company's board of directors, according to a letter seen by Reuters.

title: Gucci boss reassures staff over looming era of slower growth
description: The head of Gucci has reassured shop staff over a looming slowdown in the pace of sales growth after a revenue explosion at the Kering -owned label, according to an internal video message seen by Reuters.

title: Snap to bet on older users, revamped marketing for profitability in 2019: Cheddar
description: Snap Inc's  Chief Executive Evan Spiegel has set a goal to achieve full-year profitability in 2019 and outlined a new set of strategic goals, online news service Cheddar reported on Thursday, citing a memo.

title: Costco barely beats sales estimates, gross margins weigh
description: Costco Wholesale Corp's  quarterly sales barely beat analysts' estimates on Thursday as growth in online business decelerated to its slowest in the year amid intense competition, while gross margins fell on rising costs and higher investments.

title: DoubleLine's Gundlach: 30-year U.S. Treasury signals higher bond yields
description: Jeffrey Gundlach, chief executive of Doubleline Capital, on Thursday said the 30-year U.S. Treasury bond yield has broken above a multiyear base, which should lead to significantly higher yields for financial markets.

title: E-cigarette maker Juul files complaints against 'copycat products'
description: Juul Labs, the e-cigarette maker at the heart of a U.S. crackdown on youth vaping, has filed patent infringement complaints in the United States and Europe against what it said were copycat rivals.

title: Tronc renames itself back to Tribune Publishing
description: Newspaper publisher Tronc Inc  said on Thursday it will rename itself as Tribune Publishing Co, effective Oct. 9.

title: Tesla's Musk appears to mock SEC on Twitter after settlement
description: Tesla Inc Chief Executive Elon Musk appeared to mock the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in a tweet on Thursday by calling it the "Shortseller Enrichment Commission" days after settling fraud charges it brought against him.

title: U.S. Treasuries sell-off has ripple effect across globe, stocks sink
description: A two-day unloading of U.S. Treasuries pushed their yields to multi-year peaks on Thursday as robust economic data and hawkish speeches by Federal Reserve officials stoked concerns about inflation, hitting Wall Street and stock markets globally.

title: Oil falls from four-year highs; Wall Street weighs
description: Oil prices fell on Thursday as the prospect of increased crude production from Saudi Arabia and Russia prompted profit-taking the day after futures hit four-year highs on a boost from imminent U.S. sanctions on OPEC's No. 3 producer Iran.

title: Cadillac edges Tesla in semi-automated driving test
description: General Motors Co’s  Cadillac outscored Tesla Inc  in a new ranking of partially automated driving systems tested by Consumer Reports and released on Thursday.

title: Lilly's diabetes drug data impresses, hurts rival Novo's shares
description: Eli Lilly and Co  said on Thursday its new two-in-one diabetes drug was successful in lowering blood sugar and reducing weight, sending its shares to a record high and weighing on those of arch-rival Novo Nordisk .

title: U.S inquiry deepens Danske money-laundering crisis
description: Danske Bank  faces a U.S. criminal investigation into a 200 billion euro ($230 billion) money laundering scandal at its Estonian branch which has rocked investor faith in Denmark's biggest lender and forced its chief executive to quit.

title: Danske money laundering scandal widens with DOJ inquiry
description: Danske Bank  faces a widening investigation into suspected money laundering at its Estonian branch.

title: Tencent Music files for U.S. IPO, first-half revenue surges
description: Tencent Music Entertainment, which owns China's most popular music apps, has filed for a U.S. IPO seeking funds to develop content and new services, in what is expected to be one of the biggest U.S. listings by a Chinese company this year.

title: With rates on the rise, Fed must plan for next downturn, Evans says
description: With the U.S. economy strong, inflation nearly back to the Federal Reserve's 2-percent goal, and the Fed's gradual rate hikes likely to begin mildly restraining growth by late next year, it is time to consider how best to fight the next downturn, a U.S. central banker said on Wednesday.

title: Fed can hold rates 'relatively indefinitely' when mildly restrictive: Evans
description: U.S. interest rates could plateau for a while once they have risen to a level we they become mildly restrictive for the economy, Federal Reserve policy maker Charles Evans said on Wednesday.

title: Goldman Sachs raises stake in Spain's DIA to more than 15 percent
description: Goldman Sachs has raised its stake in Spanish supermarket chain DIA  to 15.8 percent from 14.5 percent, a regulatory filing showed shortly after the discounter's main shareholder disclosed it had raised its own holding close to the legal threshold for a full takeover bid.

title: VW's Skoda needs to boost annual capacity by 400,000 cars: CEO
description: Volkswagen's  Czech carmaker Skoda Auto needs to increase its capacity in Europe by 400,000 cars annually from the start of the next decade, Chief Executive Bernhard Maier was quoted as saying on Wednesday.

title: Inflation expectations haven't gone up as much as wanted: Fed's Evans
description: Chicago Federal Reserve Bank President Charles Evans said on Wednesday that U.S. inflation expectations in financial markets hadn't gone up as much as he would have liked.

title: Federal Reserve prepares for next crisis, bets it will begin like the last
description: The Federal Reserve painted a picture of the U.S. economy that was almost too good to be true at its last meeting, with inflation seen contained in the near future despite the lowest unemployment rate in 20 years.

title: Fed's Evans says comfortable with a December rate hike
description: Federal Reserve policymaker Charles Evans said on Wednesday he was comfortable with expectations in financial markets that the U.S. central bank will raise interest rates again in December.

title: France to press General Electric on job pledges: minister
description: French Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire said on Wednesday he would press General Electric's new chief executive to stick to French job creation pledges made by the CEO's predecessor.

title: Renault-Nissan, Daimler mull extending alliance to autonomous, battery tech
description: Renault-Nissan and Daimler may expand their cooperation to battery and autonomous cars technology and mobility services, the companies said on Wednesday.

title: Aston Martin shares open flat at 19 pounds per share in London debut
description: Shares in luxury carmaker Aston Martin  opened flat at the offer price of 19 pounds ($24.70) per share in its London debut on Wednesday.

title: Exxon Mobil eyes multi-billion dollar investment at Singapore refinery: executive
description: Exxon Mobil Corp  is considering a multi-billion dollar investment at its Singapore refinery, the company's largest, ahead of new global shipping fuel regulations starting in 2020, a senior executive said on Wednesday.

title: With Hemlibra, Roche seeks to break into tight hemophilia circle
description: Swiss drugmaker Roche  is breaking into hemophilia A treatment, a $10 billion global market dominated by rivals who have cultivated close ties to sufferers of the genetic bleeding disorder.

title: Tech giants allied against proposed Australia law seeking encrypted data
description: Four global tech giants - Facebook, Apple, Alphabet and Amazon - will oppose an Australian law that would require them to provide access to private encrypted data linked to suspected illegal activities, an industry lobby group said on Wednesday.

title: Looming large: Shell's LNG Canada seen as tip of megaproject iceberg
description: The launch of a massive liquefied natural gas (LNG) export project in Canada could fire the starting gun on a wave of other approvals around the world, potentially curbing a supply crunch expected after 2020.

title: After lean years, Big Oil is under pressure to spend
description: Executives at the world's biggest oil and gas companies are under growing pressure to loosen the purse strings to replenish reserves, halt output declines and take advantage of a crude price rally after years of austerity.

title: North American orders for semi-trucks surge in September
description: North American orders for Class 8 semi-trucks jumped 92 percent in September as trucking companies continued to struggle with tight capacity in a booming U.S. freight market, FTR, a company that tracks the industry, said on Wednesday.

title: Financials lift Wall Street, but rate worry caps gains
description: Wall Street advanced on Wednesday and the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at a record for a second day, after U.S. economic data fueled a rise in Treasury yields, lifting financial stocks.

title: Global energy bosses send Trump a message: world needs Russian gas
description: Global energy bosses assembled in Moscow on Wednesday said the world needed Russian gas to keep the lights on, in a clear message to U.S. President Donald Trump who has warned he may impose sanctions on Russian gas export projects.

title: Global stocks firm, U.S. Treasury yields soar, oil at four-year high
description: Stock markets around the world were up slightly on Wednesday amid signs that Italy would cut its budget deficits in coming years, but U.S. Treasuries yields hit multi-year highs after strong U.S. jobs data, while oil prices saw 4-year highs ahead of U.S. sanctions on Iran exports.

title: Merger talks started in spring between Canadian oil companies Husky, MEG
description: Canadian oil companies Husky Energy Inc  and MEG Energy Corp  discussed a possible merger for months, and one major MEG shareholder expressed interest early, before Husky was rebuffed and launched a hostile bid this week, according to a Husky filing.

title: Exclusive: Saudi Arabia, Russia agreed in September to lift oil output, told U.S.
description: Russia and Saudi Arabia struck a private deal in September to raise oil output to cool rising prices and informed the United States before a meeting in Algiers with other producers, four sources familiar with the plan said.

title: Vedanta gets interim relief as Indian court stays state's land allotment cancellation
description: An Indian court on Wednesday ordered an interim stay on the cancellation of land allotted for expansion of Vedanta's south Indian copper smelter, in a relief to the conglomerate whose unit was shut on environmental grounds.

title: U.S. judge says China's ZTE violated probation; extends monitor's term
description: A U.S. judge on Wednesday issued an order finding that China's ZTE Corp violated probation imposed in March 2017 when the company pleaded guilty for conspiring to evade U.S. sanctions by illegally shipping U.S. goods and technology to Iran.

title: CBS executive placed on leave after accusations of sexual language
description: CBS Corp has placed television executive Vincent Favale on leave after earlier allegations of using sexual and homophobic language resurfaced, the company said on Wednesday.

title: Barnes & Noble opts for strategic review after takeover interest
description: Barnes & Noble Inc said on Wednesday it would explore strategic options after several parties, including founder-chairman Leonard Riggio, showed interest to buy the bookseller, sending its shares up as much as 24 percent in extended trading.

title: Dollar hits six-week highs on hawkish Fed
description: The U.S. dollar rose to its highest in six weeks on Wednesday as Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell said the U.S. economy is “remarkably positive” and spoke of the need to continue raising interest rates.

title: U.S. hedge fund King Street urges Toshiba to speed up share buybacks
description: Japan's Toshiba Corp  is "severely undervalued" and should boost share repurchases, U.S. hedge fund King Street Capital Management LP said in a letter on Wednesday.

title: Brent hits new four-year high on Iran supply worries
description: Brent crude rose nearly 2 percent after hitting a four-year high on Wednesday as the market focused on upcoming U.S. sanctions on Iran while shrugging off the year's largest weekly build in U.S. crude stockpiles and reports of higher Saudi Arabian and Russian production.

title: Instagram back up after worldwide outage
description: Facebook Inc's  photo-sharing social network Instagram is back up for some users on Wednesday, after suffering a worldwide outage days after it installed a new head of the app.

title: Facebook's lead EU regulator opens probe into data breach
description: Facebook's  lead regulator in the European Union, the Irish Data Protection Commissioner (DPC), on Wednesday commenced an investigation into a massive cyberattack on the social networking site that the company disclosed last week.

title: Dell exploring IPO option if tracking stock bid fails
description: Dell Technologies Inc  confirmed on Wednesday it had met with some investment banks to explore an initial public offering if its plan to buy the tracking stock of VMware Inc  falls through.

title: Fast and serious: Vietnam's first domestic car manufacturer bets big
description: At a time when auto companies in the developed world are facing a squeeze on their profits from cash-rich tech firms, Vietnam is betting car-making can be a ticket t o a more prosperous economy, just as it was for the likes of Japan and South Korea.

title: U.S. retailer group sees 2018 holiday sales up more than 4 percent
description: U.S. holiday sales in 2018 will increase 4.3 percent to 4.8 percent boosted by a strong economy but will be slower than a year ago when consumer spending surged to a 12-year high, according to a forecast from a leading retail industry group.

title: U.S. services sector activity hits 21-year high; hiring accelerates
description: U.S. services sector activity raced to a 21-year high in September and companies boosted hiring, signs of enduring strength in the economy at the end of the third quarter.

title: Kroger to test grocery pick-up program at Walgreens stores

title: Italy's Enel names Nicola Cotugno chief of Brazil operations

title: Regulator says South Africa's Eskom can recover $2.25 billion over four years
description: South African energy regulator NERSA on Tuesday gave power utility Eskom the go-head to recover 32.69 billion rand ($2.25 billion) of costs incurred over the past three years through higher tariffs over a four-year period from 2019 to 2023.

description: Britain's biggest carmaker Jaguar Land Rover  has yet to make an imminent decision on whether to build electric cars in its home market partly due to uncertainty over the final Brexit terms, its boss told Reuters on Tuesday.

title: PepsiCo margin slip clouds profit beat, North America beverage rebound
description: PepsiCo Inc's  quarterly profit margins disappointed investors on Tuesday as commodity and transportation costs jumped, overshadowing an earnings beat fueled by growth in emerging markets and a rebound in North American beverage sales.

title: Peugeot open to new deals as turnaround draws attention: CEO
description: French carmaker PSA Group  is open to new industry tie-ups and is attracting attention from competitors after its lightning turnaround and swift progress in restructuring recently acquired Opel, Chief Executive Carlos Tavares said.

title: Bill allowing U.S. to sue OPEC drawing renewed interest

description: The technology sector appears to be doing just fine on Wall Street a week after it lost two of its highest-profile components to a newly christened communication services group.

description: Germany welcomes a trade agreement between the United States, Canada and Mexico, a spokeswoman for the German foreign ministry said on Tuesday.

description: German carmaker Volkswagen  has agreed to help with hardware retrofits for diesel cars but some details still need to be discussed while BMW  has refused such retrofits, German Transport Minister Andreas Scheuer said on Tuesday.

title: BMW would up Dutch production in hard Brexit scenario: CEO
description: German carmaker BMW  sees a 50:50 chance of Britain leaving the European Union without a trade agreement, which would force it to shift more production of Mini vehicles to the Netherlands, Chief Executive Harald Krueger said on Tuesday.

title: Making cars separately for UK and EU would impact UK production, PSA warns
description: If Britain's departure from the European Union disrupts trade to the extent PSA Group  has to make cars separately for the two markets, there would "necessarily be an impact" on its UK production, the automaker's European boss said on Tuesday.

description: Britain has begun exclusive talks with planemaker Boeing Co  for a multi-billion pound contract to replace its fleet of ageing surveillance aircraft for the Royal Air Force, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.

title: Walmart acquires plus-sized clothing startup Eloquii
description: Walmart Inc  on Tuesday said it will acquire Eloquii, a fashion startup that sells plus-sized clothing, for an undisclosed amount as it continues to look for ways to appeal to younger shoppers and differentiate from rival Amazon.com Inc .

title: Fed's Powell says U.S. outlook 'remarkably positive'
description: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell on Tuesday hailed a "remarkably positive outlook" for the U.S. economy that he feels is on the verge of a "historically rare" era of ultra-low unemployment and tame prices for the foreseeable future.

description: With his political future at stake, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau will mount a charm offensive to placate dairy farmers who say he sold them out in order to win approval of a continental trade deal.

title: Japan car makers welcome North America trade deal, but U.S. export curbs a risk
description: Toyota, Nissan and Mazda welcomed on Tuesday the revised North America trade deal that left Japanese automakers unscathed but they may face a bumpy ride when Washington and Tokyo hold new talks on over $40 billion of annual U.S. auto imports from Japan.

title: Wells Fargo has not done enough to refund cheated drivers: regulator
description: Wells Fargo & Co has not convinced U.S. regulators it is doing enough to repay 600,000 drivers who were wrongly pushed into buying auto insurance, a leading bank regulator said on Tuesday.

title: Trade pact clause seen deterring China trade deal with Canada, Mexico

title: Hilton to double hotels in Africa in next five years: CEO

title: J. C. Penney names retail veteran, Joann Stores chief as new CEO

description: Exxon Mobil Corp  is exploring the sale of many of its U.S. Gulf of Mexico assets, as higher prices prompt the world's largest publicly traded oil company to review its portfolio, people familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

description: The Dow hit a record closing high on Tuesday, but another drop in Facebook shares weighed on both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, driving both to finish in the red.

description: Tesla Inc  announced record quarterly car production on Tuesday but warned of major problems with selling cars in China due to new tariffs that would force it to accelerate investment in its factory in Shanghai.

title: Fed regulator says midsize bank relief 'highest priority'

title: Sharp makes long-awaited OLED foray, wary of big spending
description: Japan's Sharp Corp  unveiled its long-awaited move into the organic light-emitting diode (OLED) market on Wednesday as the Apple Inc  supplier looks to catch rival Samsung Electronics Co Ltd .

title: Tariffs could lift U.S. prices but no sign yet: Fed's Powell
description: The array of trade tariffs and counter measures from other countries could raise U.S. inflation but there is so far no indication of that happening, Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell said on Tuesday.

title: Euro weakens to six-week low as Italian concerns weigh
description: The euro fell to a six-week low on Tuesday after a senior lawmaker in one of Italy's ruling parties said most of the country's problems would be resolved if it readopted a national currency.

title: S&P downgrades GE's credit rating, Moody's, Fitch put it on review
description: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's cut General Electric Co's  credit rating on Tuesday, a day after the conglomerate announced a $23 billion charge related to its power business and ousted its chief executive officer.

title: Senator Bernie Sanders applauds Amazon for wage hike
description: U.S. Democratic Senator and prominent Amazon critic Bernie Sanders praised the company's move to increase minimum hourly wages to $15 on Tuesday and said other companies should follow its lead.

title: Oil eases below four-year highs; U.S. inventory rise expected
description: Oil prices eased slightly on Tuesday after rallying for three straight sessions, but remained close to four-year highs on worries that global supplies will drop due to Washington's sanctions on Iran.

title: Amazon raises minimum wage to $15, urges rivals to follow
description: Amazon.com Inc said on Tuesday it would raise its minimum wage to $15 per hour for U.S. employees from next month, giving in to critics of poor pay and working conditions at the world's second most valuable company.

description: The top lenders of Toys 'R' Us have decided to cancel the bankruptcy auction of its brand name and other intellectual property assets and instead plan to revive the Toys 'R' Us and Babies 'R' Us brand names, a court filing on Monday showed.

title: Trump hails Canada, Mexico trade pact as win for U.S. workers
description: President Donald Trump on Monday touted a new trade deal with Canada and Mexico as a win for U.S. workers while investors breathed a sigh of relief that the key pillars of NAFTA had survived his hardball strategy to reshape global commerce.

title: New Fiat Chrysler boss picks team to tackle industry in flux
description: Fiat Chrysler's  new boss unveiled his management team on Monday, seeking to revive the automaker in Europe, forge ahead in North America and keep the group in contention in the industry's race to develop self-driving and electric cars.

title: Volvo not considering diesel car retrofits in Germany: spokeswoman
description: Volvo is not considering any hardware retrofits for diesel vehicles in Germany, a company spokeswoman said on Monday, denying a report by Germany's Der Spiegel magazine that said the Swedish carmaker was mulling that option.

title: USMCA pact could take effect in second half of 2019: Mexico minister

description: Tesla Inc  produced 53,000 Model 3 sedans in the third quarter ended Sept. 30, Electrek reported on Monday, citing a source familiar with the matter.

description: Thyssenkrupp  last week unveiled plans to spin off its capital goods business into a separately-listed entity, effectively splitting the conglomerate in two.

description: Tencent Music, which owns China's most popular music streaming apps, is often compared to Sweden's Spotify Technology  but it offers more in the way of socially interactive services that is helping it hit bigger notes in money making.

title: U.S. September auto sales seen down 6 percent: J.D. Power and LMC
description: U.S. auto sales in September likely fell 6 percent from the same month last year as dealerships felt the mixed impact of hurricanes both this year and in 2017, industry consultants J.D. Power and LMC Automotive said on Thursday.

title: Saudi Arabia's legal revamp offers hope for cautious investors
description: Saudi Arabia's first comprehensive bankruptcy law went into effect last month, one of many reforms to the legal system that economists say may be more important in the long run than high-profile privatizations.

title: Minister to Air France-KLM boss: Fix airline before talk of stake sale
description: France has no plans for now to sell its 14 percent stake in Air France-KLM , Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire said on Thursday, pressing the group's new chief executive to focus on increasing competitiveness.

title: Tencent & Alibaba chase remittances in battle for Southeast Asia
description: For Chinese tech giants Alibaba  and Tencent,  Southeast Asian domestic helpers in Hong Kong may prove key to their global ambitions in financial services.

title: French finance minister says no plans to sell stake in Air France-KLM
description: France has no plans for now to sell its stake in Air France-KLM  and the priority is to increase the competitiveness of the group's French unit, Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire said on Thursday.

title: Trump rejects Canada leader's request to meet, unhappy with NAFTA talks
description: U.S. President Donald Trump said he rejected Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau's request for a meeting during the UN General Assembly this week because bilateral North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) talks are going poorly and the United States is unhappy with Canada's negotiators.

title: Comcast to stop buying Sky shares in the market
description: Comcast said it would stop buying Sky's shares in the market after it secured 38 percent of the stock plus the 39 percent holding from Rupert Murdoch in the $40 billion takeover.

title: Canada sticks to plan to stay at NAFTA talks despite Trump attack
description: Canada on Thursday shrugged off U.S. President Donald Trump's criticism that talks to modernize NAFTA were moving too slowly and made clear it had to keep negotiating as long as there was a chance of success.

title: Brazil's Petrobras to pay $853 million U.S. fine in Car Wash probe
description: Petróleo Brasileiro SA  will pay an $853.2 million fine to settle charges that former executives and directors of the state-run Brazilian oil company broke U.S. anti-corruption laws by bribing politicians and then seeking to conceal the payments, the U.S. Justice Department (DOJ) said on Thursday.

title: J.C. Penney CFO Jeffrey Davis to step down
description: Department store operator J.C. Penney Co Inc  said on Thursday its Chief Financial Officer Jeffrey Davis plans to step down effective Oct. 1.

title: Oil rises as investors fret over Iranian supply gaps
description: Oil edged higher on Thursday, driven by the prospect of a shortfall in global supply once U.S. sanctions against major crude exporter Iran come into force in five weeks.

title: Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin to supply engines for Vulcan rocket
description: Blue Origin, the space company founded by Amazon.com Inc  Chief Executive Officer Jeff Bezos, has won a contract to supply engines for United Launch Alliance's massive Vulcan rocket, the companies said on Thursday.

title: WITHDRAWAL: Apple shaves cost from displays in newest iPhones - analyst firm
description: The Reuters story "Apple shaves cost from displays in newest iPhones -analyst firm" published Sept. 25 is withdrawn because analyst firm TechInsights of Canada now says its analysis of Apple's iPhone Xs Max parts was inaccurate and that parts were not removed from the iPhone's display. There will be no replacement story.

title: Rolls-Royce facing fresh issues on Trent 1000 engine
description: Rolls-Royce  said on Thursday that turbine blades of its problematic Trent 1000 engines were wearing out faster than expected, grounding additional Boeing Co  787 widebody jets for early repairs.

title: Goldman, JPMorgan, four others must face stock lending antitrust case
description: A U.S. judge on Thursday ordered Goldman Sachs Group Inc , JPMorgan Chase & Co  and four other large banks to face an antitrust lawsuit by investors who said they conspired to stifle competition in the nearly $2 trillion stock lending market.

title: Amazon turns to toys, home goods in latest brick-and-mortar trial
description: Amazon.com Inc  on Wednesday said it is opening a general store in New York City that will sell toys, household goods and a range of other products highly rated on its website, marking its latest push into brick-and-mortar retail.

title: Ford wants 'certainty' in any U.S. trade deals: chairman
description: As the Trump administration negotiates new trade pacts with Canada, China and other countries, Ford Motor Co  Executive Chairman Bill Ford said on Thursday the automaker wants deals that allow it to plan and invest with "certainty."

title: Google CEO meeting with lawmakers amid Republican criticism
description: Google's chief executive officer, Sundar Pichai, is on Capitol Hill this week to face questions from Republican lawmakers who accuse the company of being biased against conservatives and have raised a litany of other concerns.

title: Communication services stocks elevate Wall Street
description: Wall Street climbed on Thursday, helped by gains in Apple, Alphabet and Facebook, as well as the U.S. Federal Reserve's confidence in the strength of the economy after it raised rates for the third time this year.

title: Fed chief Powell signals central bank is done with signaling
description: Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell has a new message for financial markets: watch the data on jobs, wages and inflation for signals on monetary policy - not the U.S. central bank's words or forecasts.

title: Fed's Powell says short-term U.S. recession risks are not high
description: The U.S. economy does not face a large chance of a recession in the next two years and the Federal Reserve plans to keep gradually raising interest rates, Fed Chairman Jerome Powell said on Thursday.

title: U.S. dollar rises on weaker euro, Fed policy; stocks gain
description: The U.S. dollar held near a one-week high against a basket of major currencies on Thursday following an interest rise by the Federal Reserve on Wednesday, while robust economic growth and a rally in the shares of Apple Inc and Amazon.com Inc boosted the U.S. stock market.

title: U.S. economy not facing high chance of recession in next two years: Fed's Powell
description: The U.S. economy is not facing a large chance of a recession in the next two years, Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell said on Thursday.

title: World trade's top court close to breakdown as U.S. blocks another judge
description: The supreme court of world trade is close to breakdown after the United States turned down a last-ditch petition to reappoint one of the four remaining judges at the World Trade Organization.

title: Deal-making spree keeps investors upbeat about European M&A revival
description: The $40 billion takeover of British broadcaster Sky  and other new deals in Europe have broken a summer lull to bolster investor optimism over an M&A revival in the region.

title: Daimler names R&D head as next CEO, Zetsche to become chairman
description: Daimler  named research chief Ola Kaellenius as its next CEO on Wednesday in a succession plan that promotes a raft of tech-savvy managers at its Mercedes-Benz car brand and also seeks to install long-serving CEO Dieter Zetsche as chairman.

title: UK faces permanent debate over financial rules after Brexit: lawmaker
description: Britain faces a permanent debate over whether to copy or diverge from European Union financial rules after Brexit, a top UK lawmaker said on Wednesday in comments likely to prolong uncertainty for banks.

title: U.S. business asks British PM May: how bad can Brexit get?
description: British Prime Minister Theresa May was reminded of how worried businesses are about Brexit on Wednesday when a rallying speech to executives in New York was met with a single stark question from the floor - just how bad can things get?

title: JPMorgan steps up push for women executives and clients
description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  is expanding the reach and funding of a group established to promote women working inside the bank to also help female clients, including entrepreneurs and individuals.

title: Dearth of equity keeps stock market bull alive
description: Amid all the brickbats thrown at one of the longest bull markets in history, the remarkable buoyancy of world equity prices may simply be down to a shortage of shares.

title: Ford expands partnership talks with VW and Mahindra to cut costs
description: With its stock trading near a 6-year low late last month, Ford Motor Co  CEO Jim Hackett gathered the automaker's top 300 executives near its headquarters in Michigan for a global leadership meeting.

title: Airbus board meets in China amid jet sale hopes
description: The board of Airbus  is holding an unusual meeting in China as the European planemaker implements plans to increase local assembly of jets - a hike that could help unlock talks over a long-delayed deal to sell up to 180 jets, industry sources said.

title: EU negotiator seeks orderly Brexit, new partnership respecting UK sovereignty
description: The European Union's negotiator Michel Barnier said on Wednesday that he was working for a Brexit deal and a future cooperation model with Britain that would respect the UK's sovereignty.

title: Hyatt Hotels to more than double its Africa hotels by 2020
description: Hyatt Hotels Corp  plans to more than double its hotels in Africa by 2020 to capitalize on improved travel links and robust economic growth that is boosting demand for rooms, the company's regional vice president said on Wednesday.

title: Nissan blames latest improper tests on 'low awareness' of rules
description: Nissan Motor Co  said on Wednesday an "extremely low awareness" of the seriousness of inspection standards and rules had led to improper measuring of exhaust emissions and fuel economy in vehicle models made in Japan.

title: Deutsche Bank dismisses merger reports as 'fictions'
description: Deutsche Bank  has dismissed speculation that it might seek a merger as "fictions", after media reports suggested Germany's biggest lender might seek tie ups with Switzerland's UBS or German peer Commerzbank.

title: Brexit and the City: A barometer for London's financial outlook
description: London's skyline is changing fast, pierced by gleaming new skyscrapers which defy predictions of a Brexit-related slowdown in the capital's two financial districts.

title: Germany's deputy finance minister urges insurers to prepare for no-deal Brexit
description: German Deputy Finance Minister Joerg Kukies on Wednesday urged insurers to prepare for a no-deal Brexit and added that the German government was very interested in attracting financial service providers looking to leave Britain due to Brexit.

title: Anbang in talks to sell Japan real estate to Blackstone, other bidders: sources
description: Anbang Insurance Group Co Ltd [ANBANG.UL] aims to sell $200 million worth of Japanese real estate to bidders including Blackstone Group LP , about two years after buying them from the U.S. investment firm, two people with knowledge of the matter said.

title: Brexit at breaking point? Diary dates for Britain's EU departure
description: With just six months to go until the United Kingdom is due to leave the European Union, negotiations are at what Prime Minister Theresa May has called an impasse.

title: Factbox: Reuters surveys UK financial services jobs post-Brexit
description: As few as 630 UK-based finance jobs have been shifted or created overseas so far ahead of Brexit, while the number of jobs that UK-based financial institutions said they expected to move in the event of a "hard" Brexit is 5,766, a Reuters survey shows.

title: Daimler's new CEO adds international flair to Mercedes
description: Daimler's  appointment of company veteran Ola Kaellenius to become chief executive from next year signals a cultural shift by the world's oldest carmaker as it takes on new rivals from the tech sector.

title: Deutsche Bank comfortable with consensus forecasts: CFO
description: Deutsche Bank is comfortable with consensus forecasts for the third quarter, the lender's finance chief said on Wednesday, as he played down speculation of a possible merger.

title: Foreign airlines to face new rivals on popular China routes as restrictions ease
description: Foreign airlines that fly on 20 popular long-haul routes to China will face fresh competitive pressure as Beijing begins to ease decade-old restrictions on Oct. 1, allowing more Chinese carriers to offer service.

title: Versace takeover will bring jobs to Italy, its designer says
description: Fashion house Versace did not receive any offers from Italian investors before selling to Michael Kors  but the deal with the U.S. fashion group will create jobs in Italy, creative director Donatella Versace told newspapers on Wednesday.

title: Talks on Air India bailout package at 'advanced stage':  official
description: Discussions on a bailout package for embattled state-run carrier Air India are at an "advanced stage", the country's junior aviation minister Jayant Sinha said on Wednesday.

title: Nestle CEO expects to hike prices in coming years
description: Nestle  hopes to be able to pass on rising costs resulting from higher inflation in Western countries in coming years.

title: Trump slams Canada over NAFTA, says rejected Trudeau meeting
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday blasted Canada over the slow pace of talks over NAFTA, saying he was so unhappy that he had rejected Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau's request for a one-on-one meeting.

title: Exclusive: JPMorgan in talks to lead Lyft's IPO - sources
description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  is in talks about leading Lyft Inc's upcoming initial public offering as an underwriter, after rivals Goldman Sachs Group Inc  and Morgan Stanley  decided not to pursue such a role out of loyalty to another IPO hopeful, Lyft's larger competitor Uber Technologies Inc, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Wall Street rally fizzles, U.S. dollar rises, after Fed rate hike
description: A rally in U.S. equities fizzled out late on Wednesday, while the U.S. dollar rose, after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates, as expected, and flagged the end of its "accommodative" monetary policy.

title: Facebook unveils new VR headset 'Oculus Quest' for $399
description: Facebook Inc  unveiled its new wireless virtual reality headset at a conference on Wednesday and said it plans to start shipping it in spring next year.

title: Papa John's asks potential acquirers to submit offers: sources
description: Papa John's International Inc , the world's third-largest pizza delivery company, has reached out to potential acquirers to ask them to submit offers, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.

title: U.S. union seeks raises, three-year contract for refinery workers
description: Union officials representing 30,000 workers at U.S. oil refineries and chemical plants on Wednesday said they will pursue sizable wage increases and a 3-year contract in coming negotiations.

title: Nine state attorneys general back AT&T in Time Warner appeal
description: A group of nine state attorneys general on Wednesday backed AT&T Inc  as the Justice Department asks a federal appeals court to reverse approval of the company's $85.4 billion acquisition of Time Warner Inc.

title: Wall Street rally disintegrates shortly before the close
description: A Wall Street rally collapsed and stocks turned negative shortly before the market close on Wednesday after investors reassessed the Federal Reserve's policy statement and reduced their risk as they weighed how long the U.S. central bank would continue to raise interest rates.

title: Merck's Frazier to remain CEO of the U.S. drugmaker beyond 2019
description: Merck & Co Inc  Chief Executive Officer Kenneth Frazier will remain in the role beyond 2019, the drugmaker said on Wednesday, after it scrapped a policy requiring its CEOs to retire at the age of 65.

title: Traders keep bets on U.S. Fed's 2019 interest rate rises
description: Interest rates futures traders on Wednesday stuck with bets the Federal Reserve will raise rates once more this year and two times next year even after the central bank released forecasts flagging a slightly steeper rate rise path.

title: Apple, Salesforce team up to bring Siri to more business apps
description: Apple Inc  and Salesforce.com Inc  are entering a partnership in which the iPhone maker will help Salesforce build the iPhone maker's features such as its Siri voice assistant deeper into Salesforce's own mobile apps, which are widely used in the sales and marketing industries.

title: Rupert Murdoch's Fox to sell Sky stake to Comcast
description: Twenty-First Century Fox Inc  agreed to sell its 39 percent stake in Sky PLC  to Comcast Corp , the companies said on Wednesday, a deal that completes the U.S. cable group's takeover and ends Rupert Murdoch's relationship with the UK-based satellite broadcaster.

title: Trump not happy about Federal Reserve raising interest rates
description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he was not happy about the Federal Reserve's decision earlier in the day to raise its benchmark interest rate, but added the increase was a result of a strong economy.

title: Fed raises U.S. interest rates, sees at least three more years of growth
description: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised interest rates on Wednesday and left intact its plans to steadily tighten monetary policy, as it forecast that the U.S. economy would enjoy at least three more years of growth.

title: Fed lifts U.S. rates by quarter percentage point
description: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised interest rates on Wednesday, as expected, and left its monetary policy outlook for the coming years largely unchanged amid steady economic growth and a strong job market.

title: Trump metals tariffs will cost Ford $1 billion in profits, CEO says
description: Steel and aluminum tariffs imposed by the Trump administration have cost Ford Motor Co  about $1 billion in profits, its chief executive officer said on Wednesday, while Honda Motor Co  said higher steel prices have brought "hundreds of millions of dollars" in new costs.

title: BlackRock's Rieder differs from 'consensus' on future U.S. rates
description: Top BlackRock Inc  bond investor Rick Rieder said on Wednesday the U.S. Federal Reserve will raise rates only twice "or so" in 2019, countering what he called an "excessive" expectation by investors.

title: Chile government approves construction of Walmart distribution center
description: The Chilean government said on Wednesday it had approved the construction of a distribution center for Walmart  in its capital Santiago, an investment of about $180 million.

title: Lyft revenue more than doubled in first half of 2018: The Information
description: U.S. ride hailing firm Lyft Inc's revenue more than doubled in the first half of the year to $909 million, while its net loss expanded at a slower rate than a year earlier, technology news website The Information reported on Wednesday.

title: Oil eases, but Iran sanctions keep Brent above $80 a barrel
description: Oil prices eased on Wednesday after U.S. data showed a surprise build in domestic crude inventories, but an impending drop in Iranian exports kept Brent futures above $80 a barrel and on track for a fifth straight quarterly gain.

title: U.S. new home sales rebound, but trend weakening
description: Sales of new U.S. single-family homes rebounded in August after two straight monthly declines, but the underlying trend still pointed to a weakening housing market against the backdrop of rising mortgage rates and higher home prices.

title: Uber to pay $148 million to settle data breach cover-up with U.S. states
description: Uber Technologies Inc [UBER.UL] will pay $148 million for failing to disclose a massive data breach in 2016, marking a costly resolution to one of the biggest embarrassments and legal tangles the ride-hailing company has suffered.

title: Nike shares dip after forecast disappoints
description: Nike  shares fell as much as 3 percent on Wednesday after the company disappointed Wall Street by not raising its full-year forecast following a sales boost from its Colin Kaepernick ad campaign.

title: Tech companies back U.S. privacy law if it preempts California's
description: Major technology companies and internet service providers told a U.S. Senate panel on Wednesday they support federal legislation to protect data privacy but want Congress to preempt tough new rules adopted by California.

title: GM's Cadillac to leave Big Apple, return to Michigan roots
description: General Motors Co  said on Wednesday that Cadillac will switch its headquarters back to Michigan from New York after just three years to be closer to engineers and design teams as the luxury brand plans to roll out two new vehicles annually through 2020.

title: U.S. trade chief says China policy change 'not going to be easy'
description: U.S. President Donald Trump's top trade official said on Tuesday that changing China's economic policies to become more market-oriented "is not going to be easy" even with tariffs now in place on $250 billion worth of Chinese goods.

description: Verizon Communications Inc  said on Tuesday it is offering voluntary separation buyout packages to thousands of management employees in the United States.

title: Google to allow certain cryptocurrency ads in U.S., Japan
description: Alphabet Inc's  Google said on Tuesday it would allow certain regulated cryptocurrency exchanges to advertise in the United States and Japan, easing an earlier ban on all cryptocurrency ads.

title: Canada's PM sees possibility to build on U.S.-Mexico NAFTA deal
description: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau on Tuesday took a cautious line over talks to update NAFTA, saying he saw a possibility that Canada could build on a bilateral deal that the United States and Mexico have already agreed.

title: Uber's strongest growth comes in depressed Argentina -- minus commissions
description: Uber's fastest-growing market in the world is now Argentina, company executives say, attributing the expansion to the nation's sudden economic unraveling, which has boosted unemployment and sliced the purchasing power of Argentines.

title: Denmark bolsters defenses against wider Danske Bank risks
description: Denmark has bolstered defenses against shocks to its financial system after a risk-assessment body said the sector's stability could be threatened by the Danske Bank  money laundering scandal.

title: Japan-U.S. shared broad understanding over trade: Japan economy minister
description: Japan and the United States have reached a broad understanding over how to promote bilateral trade and may announce specifics on Wednesday, Economy Minister Toshimitsu Motegi was quoted as saying after meeting U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer.

title: Goldman trading executive Bash-Polley to depart at year-end: memo
description: Stacy Bash-Polley, who plays a key role with clients in Goldman Sachs Group Inc's  trading business, plans to retire at year-end, according to an internal memo sent on Tuesday.

title: Comcast crosses 30 percent Sky threshold after buying shares
description: Comcast , the victor in the $40 billion auction for Sky , said on Tuesday it had bought more than 30 percent of the European pay-TV group's shares in the market.

title: Arby's owner to buy drive-in chain Sonic for $1.57 billion
description: Arby's-owner Inspire Brands Inc said on Tuesday it would buy Sonic Corp  for about $1.57 billion in cash, adding more than 3,600 drive-in restaurants to its portfolio that includes brands such as Buffalo Wild Wings and Rusty Taco.

title: Instagram co-founders resign in latest Facebook executive exit
description: Instagram on Monday said co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger have resigned as chief executive officer and chief technical officer of the photo-sharing app owned by Facebook Inc, giving scant explanation for the move.

title: In Nigeria, Shell’s onshore roots still run deep
description: Royal Dutch Shell wants to reweight its footprint in Nigeria to focus on oil and gas fields far offshore, away from the theft, spills, corruption and unrest that have plagued the West African country's onshore industry for decades.

title: How Trump split Mexico and Canada in NAFTA talks
description: A day after winning the Mexican presidential election, Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador took a congratulatory call from U.S. President Donald Trump. But Trump had something more important on his mind: Would Mexico's new president consider a bilateral trade deal?

title: Out of fashion? H&M tests new store to get back in vogue
description: Step into one of the more than 4,300 H&M  budget fashion stores around the world and you often know what to expect: clothes racks crammed with tops, trousers and skirts in a spartan and sometimes cluttered environment.

title: China says trade war to 'certainly' hurt U.S. exporters, create opportunities to others
description: China is being forced to retaliate against the United States in their trade dispute, and U.S. exporters including suppliers of liquefied natural gas would "certainly" be hurt, said Chinese vice commerce minister Wang Shouwen.

title: Tesla is making its own car carriers
description: Tesla Inc  is building its own car carriers, as the electric carmaker faces vehicle distribution problems.

title: Senior China diplomat says confrontation with U.S. lose-lose
description: Confrontation between China and the United States means both sides lose, and talks with Washington cannot take place under threats and pressure, the Chinese government's top diplomat State Councillor Wang Yi told U.S. business leaders.

title: Facebook shares slip after Instagram founders quit
description: Shares of Facebook Inc  fell more than 2 percent in early trading on Tuesday after the two founders of photo-sharing app Instagram left the social networking giant under unexplained circumstances.

title: U.S. consumer confidence hits 18-year high; house prices slowing
description: U.S. consumer confidence surged to an 18-year high in September as households grew more upbeat about the labor market, pointing to sustained strength in the economy despite an increasingly bitter trade dispute between the United States and China.

title: Full-blown trade war would cost jobs, growth and stability: WTO's Azevedo
description: A full-blown trade war would have serious effects on global economic growth and there would be no winners in such a scenario, the director-general of the World Trade Organization (WTO), Roberto Azevedo, said on Tuesday.

title: Fiat Chrysler says regulators get 'wake-up call' over fuel rules
description: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV  said on Tuesday that U.S. regulators have received a "wake-up call" from automakers over the hurdles they face in trying to meet rising Obama-era fuel-efficiency requirements.

title: Raytheon Co wins $1.5 billion U.S. defense contract: Pentagon
description: Raytheon Co  has been awarded a $1.5 billion modification to a contract for the sale of Patriot missile systems to Poland, the Pentagon said in a statement on Tuesday.

title: Delta lifts U.S. groundstop after restoring computer systems
description: Delta Air Lines Inc said it has restored all its systems after a technology issue grounded some flights that had not yet taken off, briefly disrupting travel for its passengers across the country on Tuesday evening.

title: Spotify, Deezer and others call for stronger EU action against U.S. rivals
description: Music streaming services Spotify and Deezer joined European business and industry bodies in calling on EU regulators to take tougher action to curb what they say are the unfair practices of online platforms.

title: U.S. says Canada not making concessions needed for NAFTA deal
description: Canada is not making concessions needed to reach a deal with the United States for a trilateral NAFTA pact and is running out of time before Washington proceeds with a Mexico-only agreement, a top U.S. official said on Tuesday.

title: Dunkin' drops 'Donuts' from name in shift to coffee
description: Dunkin' Donuts said on Tuesday it plans to rebrand itself as "Dunkin'" as part of new CEO Dave Hoffman's plans to bring beverages and breakfast meals to the forefront of the restaurant chain's menu.

title: Dunkin's rebranding leaves hole in heart of doughnut lovers
description: Doughnut lovers took to social media on Tuesday to decry a decision by Dunkin' Donuts to drop its signature product from its name, an effort by the brand now known simply as Dunkin' to highlight a wider array of menu items and appeal to a younger generation.

title: S&P 500 dips as chip stocks and utilities tumble
description: The S&P 500 fell on Tuesday as chipmakers were dented by ratings downgrades and utilities declined ahead of an expected Federal Reserve interest rate hike, offsetting a boost from the energy sector.

title: Independent BMW car dealers loath to agree new terms: Sueddeutsche Zeitung
description: Most of BMW's  550 independent car dealerships are unwilling to accept new terms set by the carmaker and are threatening to ignore an end-September deadline, Sueddeutsche Zeitung reported on Wednesday.

title: Nike profit tops targets but margins disappoint some
description: Nike Inc  topped first-quarter profit on Tuesday, but a small rise in gross margins and no change in its 2019 forecast despite the launch of a successful ad campaign was not enough for some investors, sending shares down 4 percent after hours.

title: Energy shares rise on higher oil; dollar slips as policy tightening eyed
description: Energy stocks climbed on Tuesday as oil prices surged above $81 a barrel, but U.S. shares ended lower as chipmakes fell on ratings downgrades and rate-sensitive shares lost ground ahead of an expected Federal Reserve interest rate hike.

title: Michael Kors makes high-end fashion statement with $2.2 billion Versace buy
description: Michael Kors  agreed to buy luxury designer Versace for 1.83 billion euros ($2.15 billion) including debt on Tuesday, as the U.S. fashion group positions itself to take on larger European rivals.

title: Versace sale turns up heat on fashion's independent outliers
description: Michael Kors'  swoop on Versace leaves a shrinking universe of fashion brands determined to go it alone and fend off luxury empire builders, raising the pressure on those struggling financially to lift sales or sell out.

title: Qualcomm accuses Apple of stealing its secrets to help Intel
description: Qualcomm Inc on Tuesday accused Apple Inc of stealing its chip-making secrets and giving them to rival Intel Corp, paving the way for Apple to switch to Intel's improved semiconductors, which may have cost Qualcomm billions of dollars in lost sales.

title: China says U.S. putting 'knife to its neck', hard to proceed on trade
description: A senior Chinese official said on Tuesday it is difficult to proceed with trade talks with the United States while Washington is putting "a knife to China's neck", a day after both sides heaped fresh tariffs on each other's goods.

title: No class action for unhappy Uber drivers: U.S. appeals court
description: Uber Technologies Inc won a legal victory on Tuesday as a federal appeals court said drivers seeking to be classified as employees rather than independent contractors must arbitrate their claims individually, and not pursue class-action lawsuits.

title: New GM-built 'Beast' presidential limo makes Trump debut
description: The latest version of the heavily armored U.S. presidential limousine known as "The Beast" is making its debut in New York City this week.

title: Oil jumps, then pares gains as Trump pressures OPEC again
description: Oil prices rose Tuesday on global supply concerns following U.S. sanctions on Iran's oil exports, with benchmark Brent surging to a four-year high, then retraced gains to settle just slightly higher after U.S. President Donald Trump called again on OPEC to boost crude output.

title: Volvo halts Iran truck assembly due to U.S. sanctions
description: Swedish truckmaker AB Volvo has stopped assembling trucks in Iran because U.S. sanctions are preventing it from being paid, a spokesman for the company said on Monday.

title: Sky's shares jump after Comcast wins auction with big bet
description: Sky  shares jumped 9 percent on Monday to within touching distance of what Comcast  will pay to buy Europe's biggest pay-TV group after seeing off competition from Twenty-First Century Fox .

title: Singapore fines Grab and Uber, imposes measures to open up market
description: Singapore slapped ride-hailing firms Grab and Uber with fines and finalized restrictions to open up the market to competitors after concluding that their merger in March has driven up prices.

title: Home modems, routers hit by U.S. China tariffs as 'smart' tech goods escape
description: U.S. tariffs that hit some $200 billion worth of Chinese products on Monday spare many high-profile consumer technology items such as "smart" watches and speakers, but the less flashy home modems, routers and internet gateways that make them work weren't so lucky.

description: T-Mobile US Inc  said Monday it is renaming its prepaid brand to Metro by T-Mobile and adding two new unlimited phone plans that will include perks like Google One cloud storage and Amazon  Prime, in an effort to remove the perception that prepaid plans have subpar service.

title: Symantec ends accounting probe without major revision to results
description: Symantec Corp  said on Monday that it would not restate previous financial results except for a specific $13 million transaction, following a four-month long probe into the Norton anti-virus maker's accounting practices, sending its shares up about 4 percent.

title: Iran says oil to rise as Saudi, Russia do 'little and late'
description: Saudi Arabia and Russia won't add significantly more oil to the market because of a lack of capacity, a top Iranian official said on Monday, predicting prices will probably rise further.

title: Tech index refresh could give under-the-radar names their day in the sun
description: A reshuffling of Wall Street benchmark industry sectors that transferred high-flying FANG stocks like Facebook Inc  and Google-parent Alphabet Inc  out of the technology label may be a boon to some under-the-radar companies that used to compete with them for investor attention.

title: Danske Bank board close to appointing new CEO: Finans
description: Danske Bank's  board is close to appointing a new chief executive to replace Thomas Borgen who resigned last week amid a money laundering scandal, Danish online media Finans reported on Monday, citing unnamed sources.

title: Asian firms shuffle production around the region as China tariffs hit

title: Take Five: World markets themes for the week ahead

title: Canada PM says informal NAFTA talks likely in next few days at U.N.
