title: American Medical Association opposes merger of CVS and Aetna
description: The American Medical Association, which represents U.S. physicians, urged the U.S. Justice Department on Wednesday to stop CVS Health Corp's plan to buy insurance provider Aetna Inc, saying the deal could result in higher prices for prescription medicines.

title: European stocks falter as pharma sector falls
description: European shares dipped on Wednesday as poor corporate earnings in the pharmaceutical sector weighed on sentiment already soured by trade tensions, with Washington preparing tariffs on another $16 billion of Chinese goods.

title: IKEA strives to keep prices low as it opens first store in India
description: IKEA will set some prices even lower in India than elsewhere when it opens its first store in the country on Thursday, as it woos cost-conscious shoppers unaccustomed to DIY furniture.

title: Tariffs on Chinese goods could batter the U.S. vaping industry
description: Proposed tariffs on U.S. imports from China of electronic cigarettes, known as vaping products, could not come at a worse time for the industry.

title: Factbox: European companies respond to latest Iran sanctions
description: New U.S. sanctions against Iran took effect on Tuesday and President Donald Trump, who defied Washington's allies to impose them, pledged that companies doing business with Tehran would be barred from doing business with the United States.

title: Beer drinkers lose U.S. appeal over Anheuser-SABMiller merger
description: A federal appeals court on Wednesday rejected an antitrust challenge by 23 beer drinkers to Anheuser-Busch InBev SA's  $107 billion purchase in 2016 of SABMiller Plc, which they claimed would thwart competition and raise prices in the U.S. beer market.

title: Fox posts offer document for Sky deal
description: Twenty-First Century Fox Inc  on Tuesday posted an offer document and form of acceptance for its 14 pounds a share offer to buy UK's Sky  on Tuesday.

title: Factbox: European companies respond to latest Iran sanctions
description: New U.S. sanctions against Iran took effect on Tuesday, and President Donald Trump, who defied Washington's allies to impose them, pledged that companies doing business with Tehran would be barred from doing business with the United States.

title: Consultation prize: U.S.-China trade war fires bonanza for advisory firms
description: As U.S. and Chinese firms rush for outside expertise on how to handle fallout from the escalating trade war between the two nations, consultants on everything from management to logistics say they have seen soaring demand for their services.

title: Saudi sovereign fund PIF has bought a below 5 percent stake in Tesla: source
description: Public Investment Fund, Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, has bought a minority stake in Tesla  at just below 5 percent, a source familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

title: Saudi sovereign fund builds 3 to 5 percent stake in Tesla: FT
description: Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, overseen by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, has built a significant stake in Tesla Inc, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.

title: BMW recalls 324,000 cars in Europe after Korean engine fires: FAZ
description: German luxury carmaker BMW  is recalling about 324,000 diesel vehicles in Europe to fix a technical fault that has caused engine fires in South Korea, German newspaper Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung (FAZ) said.

title: U.S. job openings hover at record highs in June
description: U.S. job openings held near record highs in June amid a modest decline in hiring, pointing to further tightening labor market conditions, which economists hope will soon spur faster wage growth.

title: China's HNA to sell over $2 billion Avolon stake to Orix: sources
description: China's HNA Group Co Ltd is in advanced talks to sell a 30 percent stake in aircraft lessor Avolon Holdings Ltd to Japan's Orix Corp , two sources said, as the company attempts to restructure and trim stakes even in its core assets.

title: UniCredit has stopped using Facebook for advertising: CEO
description: Italy's UniCredit has stopped using Facebook for advertising and marketing campaigns and will not do so again until the U.S. giant improves its ethical standards, the bank's CEO said on Tuesday.

title: Baidu ready to beat Google if U.S. firm returns to China: CEO
description: Baidu Inc  is prepared to win against Alphabet Inc's  Google in China, its chief executive officer said on social media, amid rumblings the U.S. search engine giant was planning to re-enter a market it left eight years ago.

title: Nestle sees no direct implications on business from Iran sanctions
description: Nestle  sees no direct fallout from renewed U.S. sanctions on Iran, the world's biggest food company said on Tuesday.

title: India doubles import tax on textile products, may hit China
description: India doubled the import tax on more than 300 textile products to 20 percent on Tuesday as the world's biggest producer of cotton tries to curb rising imports from China.

title: Overseas costs drag on profits at Domino's Pizza; shares slide
description: Rising overseas costs, particularly in Norway, overshadowed an improvement in sales at Domino's Pizza Group , pushing first-half pre-tax profit down almost 10 percent and sending the company's shares to an 11-month low.

title: Exclusive: Mattress Firm explores U.S. bankruptcy to close stores
description: Mattress Firm Inc, the largest U.S. mattress retailer, is considering a potential bankruptcy filing as it seeks ways to get out of costly store leases and shut some of its 3,000 locations that are losing money, people familiar with the matter said.

title: GlaxoSmithKline appoints HSBC's Iain Mackay as new CFO
description: GlaxoSmithKline  has named Iain Mackay from global bank HSBC  as its new chief financial officer, marking another key appointment by Chief Executive Emma Walmsley as she reshapes the top team at Britain's biggest drugmaker.

title: Daimler abandons Iran expansion plans as sanctions bite
description: German car and truck manufacturer Daimler  on Tuesday said it has dropped plans to expand its Iran business in reaction to renewed U.S. sanctions, which come into effect on Tuesday.

title: Chinese newspaper mocks Trump's claim of winning trade war as 'wishful thinking'
description: Chinese state media kept up their criticism of U.S. President Donald Trump's trade policies, with a newspaper on Tuesday describing as "wishful thinking" Trump's belief that a fall in Chinese stocks was a sign of his winning the trade war.

title: U.S. safety regulator probes fires in some Ford pickup trucks
description: U.S. traffic safety regulator is investigating complaints of fire during crashes in some Ford Motor Co  F-150 Supercrew pickup trucks linked to a seat belt component.

title: Tesla starts hiring for new $2 billion Shanghai plant
description: Tesla Inc has started hiring for a new factory in Shanghai, according to job postings on its website, just a month after the U.S. electric vehicle (EV) maker signed agreements with local authorities for the $2 billion project.

title: Alibaba merging China food delivery units to counter Tencent-backed Meituan
description: Alibaba Group  plans to merge its food delivery units and raise funds for the combined business, intensifying a battle with Tencent-backed Meituan Dianping for dominance of China's booming on-demand services market, sources told Reuters.

title: U.S. think tank's tiny lab helps Facebook battle fake social media
description: A day before Facebook announced that it had discovered and disabled a propaganda campaign designed to sow dissension among U.S. voters, it exclusively shared some of the suspicious pages with an online forensics team so busy it hasn't put a nameplate on the door.

title: Tesla call options soar on Musk tweet, short-sellers hit
description: Some nimble traders in Tesla Inc's options made massive paper profits on Tuesday, while short-sellers were hit with about $1.3 billion in paper losses after Tesla Chief Executive Elon Musk tweeted he was considering taking the company private at $420 a share.

title: Tesla shares halted after Musk tweet about going private
description: Shares of Tesla Inc were halted for news pending on Tuesday after Chief Executive Elon Musk earlier tweeted he was considering taking the company private at $420 a share.

title: Apple tells lawmakers iPhones are not listening in on consumers
description: Apple Inc told U.S. lawmakers on Tuesday that its iPhones do not listen to users without their consent and do not allow third-party apps to do so either, after lawmakers asked the company if its devices were invading users' privacy.

title: Elon Musk says taking Tesla private is 'best path,' shares jump
description: Chief Executive Elon Musk said on Tuesday he is considering taking Tesla Inc private in what would be the largest deal of its type, moving the electric car maker out of the glare of Wall Street as it goes through a period of rapid growth under tight financial constraints.

title: Snap's strategy shifts win over advertisers more than users
description: Snap Inc on Tuesday received a vote of confidence from a billionaire investor and reported record revenue from outside North America, factors that helped soften the blow of its first-ever drop in daily users.

title: Papa John's cuts earnings forecast on public spat with founder
description: Papa John's International Inc  on Tuesday posted a second-quarter comparable sales decline of 6.1 percent in North America and cut its forecast for the coming months, as a heated spat between the pizza chain and its founder dragged on profits.

title: Disney quarterly profit falls short as streaming costs rise
description: Walt Disney Co  missed Wall Street profit targets as new technology costs rose during the quarter ended June 30, but Chief Executive Bob Iger said an exodus of consumers from its television channels was slowing.

title: Musk plan to privatize Tesla pushes $2.3 billion of debt above conversion price
description: Elon Musk's suggestion on Tuesday that he would like to take  Tesla Inc private may provide something the electric car maker needs: a little debt relief.

title: U.S. prosecutors target Goldman Sachs in 1MDB probe: NYT
description: U.S. prosecutors are investigating whether Goldman Sachs Group Inc  has any culpability in a Malaysian fraud involving a government fund that had ties to a former bank employee, the New York Times reported on Tuesday.

title: Superyacht linked to 1MDB probe arrives at Malaysian port
description: A $250 million superyacht, impounded as part of a hunt for assets linked to the multi-billion dollar investigation into 1Malaysia Development Bhd, arrived at a port in Malaysia on Tuesday about six months after it was seized.

title: Toshiba posts record quarterly profit on chip sale, outlook unclear
description: Japan's Toshiba Corp  reported a record quarterly net profit on Wednesday, thanks to the $18 billion sale of its flash memory chip business earlier this year to a consortium led by U.S. private equity firm Bain Capital.

title: Amazon and Microsoft nudge S&P 500 closer to record high
description: The S&P 500 inched nearer to a record high on Tuesday, lifted by Amazon, Alphabet and Microsoft, and by a strong second-quarter earnings season that fueled optimism about the U.S. economy's strength.

title: Icahn urges Cigna shareholders to vote against Express Scripts deal
description: Activist investor Carl Icahn on Tuesday urged Cigna Corp  shareholders to vote against the health insurer's $52 billion purchase of Express Scripts Holding Co , citing regulatory hurdles and the growing threat from Amazon.

title: Global stocks rise on China boost, S&P 500 nears record; oil gains
description: Equity markets around the world neared a six-month high on Tuesday, buoyed by a rebound in Chinese stocks and an earnings-driven surge on Wall Street, while oil prices rose on concerns U.S. sanctions against Iran could cause supply shortages.

title: Wendy's North America same-restaurant sales top estimates
description: U.S. burger chain Wendy's Co  on Tuesday topped Wall Street targets for sales at established outlets in North America, led by the popularity of its value-menu offerings.

title: Tesla statement on potential deal to go private
description: The following blog post was published on Tuesday by Tesla Inc Chief Executive Elon Musk following his earlier comments on Twitter about taking the company private. The link to the full blog is: https://www.tesla.com/blog/taking-tesla-private?redirect=no

title: Musk says no final decision on taking Tesla private
description: Tesla Inc Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk said on Tuesday in a letter to employees that he is considering taking the electric car maker private at a price of $420 per share.

title: Tesla buyout would add to year of pain for short-sellers
description: It would be the ultimate black eye for short sellers.

title: EU asks WTO to certify it has removed Airbus subsidies
description: The European Union has asked the World Trade Organization to certify that it has complied with WTO rulings on its subsidies for planemaker Airbus, attempting to forestall billions of dollars of U.S. sanctions, a document published by the WTO showed on Monday.

title: Wynn Resorts settles with Elaine Wynn, names industry veteran vice-chairman
description: Casino operator Wynn Resorts  on Monday named industry veteran Phil Satre its vice-chairman, in a symbolic victory for largest shareholder Elaine Wynn, who has been pushing for changes at the company's board.

title: Goldman Sachs names Jim Esposito co-head of trading division
description: Goldman Sachs  on Monday named Jim Esposito global co-head of the Wall Street bank's trading division, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters.

title: Exclusive: Russia's Gazprom suspends external borrowing amid spat with Naftogaz - sources
description: Russia's Gazprom  suspended its external borrowing program earlier this year because of a deepening legal dispute with Ukraine's Naftogaz over gas supplies, three banking sources told Reuters.

title: Linde shares drop as Praxair merger hits U.S. antitrust hurdle
description: Shares in Linde  dropped as much as 10 percent on Monday after the German industrial gases group's planned $86 billion merger with U.S. rival Praxair  was thrown into doubt by more demands from U.S. antitrust regulators.

title: Indonesia hands yacht linked to 1MDB over to Malaysia
description: Indonesia handed over to Malaysia on Monday a $250 million luxury yacht, impounded earlier this year as part of an international hunt for assets purchased with billions of dollars allegedly siphoned off from state fund 1Malaysia Development Bhd.

title: Trump's trade 'extortion' won't work, China state media says
description: Chinese state media on Monday lambasted U.S. President Donald Trump's trade policies in an unusually personal attack, and sought to reassure investors anxious about China's economy as growth concerns battered its financial markets.

title: China fines Alipay for violating payment services regulations
description: The Shanghai head office of China's central bank has levied a fine of 4.12 million yuan ($601,846) on Alipay, the online payment platform of Ant Financial, for violating regulations on payment services, the regulator said on Monday.

title: Japan's Universal says former chairman Okada arrested in Hong Kong
description: Japanese gaming group Universal Entertainment Corp  said on Monday its former chairman Kazuo Okada was arrested in Hong Kong by the territory's Independent Commission Against Corruption in relation to multiple corruption-related offences.

title: Honda to recall 96,900 SUVs in China, runs checks on two models
description: Honda Motor Co  on Monday said it will recall 96,900 Avancier sport utility vehicles (SUVs) in China, due to a cold-climate engine problem that has already led to hundreds of thousands of its vehicles being recalled earlier this year.

title: Vietnam jails former bankers in graft crackdown
description: A court in Vietnam handed lengthy prison terms on Monday to several former bankers accused of mismanagement, amid a crackdown on corruption in the communist-ruled country.

title: China's Didi to invest $1 billion in its auto services platform
description: Didi Chuxing Technology, China's largest ride-hailing service, said on Monday it will invest $1 billion in its auto services business, part of a larger unit rebranding as the company ramps up to a widely anticipated initial public offering (IPO).

title: Linde shares drop as Praxair merger hits U.S. antitrust hurdle
description: Shares in Linde  plunged more than 8 percent on Monday after the industrial gases group's planned $87 billion merger with Praxair  was put in doubt by demands from U.S. antitrust regulators.

title: BOJ's architect of 'shock and awe' plots retreat from stimulus
description: More than five years into a radical plan to boost the world's third-biggest economy, the Bank of Japan sent a message of quiet surrender last week, admitting it couldn't stoke inflation and walking back steps intended to do so.

title: U.S. bond market takes looming Treasuries deluge in stride
description: U.S. government debt supply will likely continue to boom, but bond market investors seem to be taking it in stride.

title: Haier sees costs spike at GE arm amid steel tariffs, U.S.-China trade spat
description: China's Haier Group said rising steel prices amid hefty U.S. import tariffs was driving up costs for its business in America, and warned that consumers stood most to lose from a mounting trade spat between the world's top two economies.

title: Arista to pay $400 million to Cisco to resolve court fight
description: Arista Networks Inc  will pay $400 million to Cisco Systems Inc  to resolve a U.S. court fight between the two network equipment makers, Arista said in a regulatory filing on Monday, the day a jury trial in the dispute was scheduled to begin.

title: BMW Korea apologizes as 27 vehicles catch fire over January-July
description: BMW's  South Korean unit apologized over a spate of engine fires, estimated by the country's transport ministry at 27 over January to July, that has prompted a government probe and a major backlash from consumers.

title: Analysts stick with CBS as Moonves allegations probed
description: Wall Street is largely backing CBS Corp , with few analysts changing their ratings or price targets on the media company, even as it looks into allegations of sexual misconduct against Chief Executive Les Moonves.

title: Berkshire shares surge as U.S. economy fuels broad-based strength
description: Shares of Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Inc  surged on Monday to their highest level since March after the conglomerate reported strong second-quarter results in several major business lines.

title: S&P buybacks brisk in second-quarter, may set another record: S&P Dow Jones
description: S&P 500 companies engaged in a brisk pace of share buybacks in the second quarter, putting them on track to near or beat the first quarter's record level, according to a S&P Dow Jones Indices analysis.

title: Icahn to send letter to oppose Cigna-Express Scripts deal: WSJ
description: Investor Carl Icahn will send an open letter to the shareholders of insurer Cigna Corp  asking them to vote against the company's $52 billion Express Scripts Holding Co  buyout, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing a draft of the letter.

title: Rising costs and U.S. settlement crimp HSBC's first-half profit
description: HSBC Holdings Plc  posted a small increase in first-half pretax profit, as rising expenses from investments in a new growth strategy and a $765 million settlement for alleged mis-selling of U.S. mortgage securities ate into higher revenues.

title: Facebook in talks with banks to expand customer service
description: Facebook Inc  said on Monday it is in talks to deepen links with banks and financial institutions, saying it can help the firms improve their customer service.

title: Sempra Energy CEO 'very optimistic' about talks with Elliott Management
description: Sempra Energy's  Chief Executive Jeffrey Martin told investors on Monday the company was in a "constructive dialogue" with activist investor Elliott Management, which has been pushing for sweeping changes at the utility.

title: U.S. banks further eased business loan standards in Q2 2018
description: Loan officers at U.S. banks reported easing lending standards for business loans for firms of all sizes while keeping terms for commercial real estate loans almost unchanged in the second quarter, a Federal Reserve survey showed on Monday.

title: Harley seeks alliance for lightweight bikes to grow India business
description: Harley-Davidson Inc  is scouting for a partner with a manufacturing and distribution footprint to make lightweight motorcycles for use in India and other Asian markets, a top company executive said.

title: Wall Street closes higher as strong earnings cheer investors
description: The three major U.S. stock indexes closed higher on Monday as investors applauded a strong U.S. earnings season with results from Berkshire Hathaway impressing and Facebook lifting Nasdaq after a report it was planning new services.

title: Marriott sees revenue weakness in third quarter, shares fall
description: Marriott International Inc  on Monday signaled weakness in revenue per available room (revPAR) in North America, its largest market, for the third quarter, sending shares of the world's largest hotel chain down about 4 percent.

title: Global stocks lift on strong earnings as trade fight caps gains; sterling slumps
description: Stock markets lifted on Monday after strong corporate earnings helped Wall Street close higher, but a tariff dispute between the United States and China limited gains in equities while boosting the dollar and helping keep Treasury yields lower.

title: U.S. argues judge failed to take its arguments into account in AT&T trial
description: The U.S. government said on Monday the judge in the trial to stop AT&T Inc's  purchase of Time Warner failed to take into account how companies negotiate with each other and seek to maximize profits in considering the Justice Department's arguments about how the deal would decrease competition.

title: Tyson Foods beats profit estimates on strong beef demand
description: Tyson Foods Inc  beat analysts' quarterly profit estimates on Monday as the No. 1 U.S. meat processor reported a record operating income for its beef business due to increased exports and cattle supplies.

title: Oil rises after OPEC sources say Saudi crude output fell
description: Oil futures gained on Monday after OPEC sources said Saudi crude production unexpectedly fell in July, raising concerns about global oil supplies as the United States prepares to reinstate sanctions against major exporter Iran.

title: Sprint, T-Mobile in early stages of regulatory review, no decisions yet:  source
description: U.S. antitrust enforcers are in the early stages of reviewing T-Mobile US Inc's  plan to buy Sprint Corp  for $26 billion, and have reached no conclusions on how many wireless carriers the country needs, a source familiar with the situation said on Monday.

title: Mexico and U.S. studying NAFTA rules of origin proposals - minister
description: Mexico's economy minister Ildefonso Guajardo said on Monday the country has put forward a proposal to update the North American Free Trade Agreement's contentious rules of origin, and in turn was studying the U.S. position.

title: PepsiCo veteran Ramon Laguarta to replace Indra Nooyi as CEO
description: PepsiCo Inc has appointed Ramon Laguarta to take over as chief executive from Indra Nooyi, handing the reins to a veteran who led the company's fast-growing emerging markets business.

title: Friendship no more: how Russian gas is a problem for Germany
description: For decades, the Friendship pipeline has delivered oil from Russia to Europe, heating German homes even in the darkest days of the Cold War.

title: China state media attacks Trump on trade in unusually harsh terms
description: China's state media on Monday lashed out at the policies of U.S. President Donald Trump in an unusually direct attack, accusing him of "starring in his own carefully orchestrated street fighter-style deceitful drama".

title: CBS entertainment chief defends network amid Moonves allegations
description: The president of CBS Entertainment said on Sunday that the broadcast network is committed to a safe workplace following a "tough week" clouded by allegations of sexual misconduct against Chief Executive Leslie Moonves.

title: Munich Re to back away from coal-related business: CEO
description: Munich Re , the world's biggest reinsurer, will stop investing in bonds and shares of companies that generate more than 30 percent of their sales with coal-related business, its chief executive said, caving to pressure from investors.

title: Indonesia lobbies U.S. to maintain special tariff treatment
description: Indonesia lobbied visiting U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo to keep the Southeast Asian nation on a list of countries that receive preferential trade terms, its foreign and trade ministers said on Sunday.

title: Huawei in British spotlight over use of U.S. firm's software
description: Huawei Technologies is facing increased scrutiny in Britain because it is using an aging software component sold by a firm based in the United States, one of the countries where lawmakers allege its equipment could facilitate Chinese spying, sources told Reuters.

title: Indonesia to hand over yacht linked to 1MDB to Malaysia
description: Indonesia has agreed to hand over to Malaysia a $250 million luxury yacht it impounded in Bali earlier this year in connection with a corruption scandal at a Malaysian state fund, Indonesian authorities said on Saturday.

title: Ding! Alibaba office app fuels backlash among some Chinese workers
description: In the cramped former home of Jack Ma, founder of the Chinese e-commerce giant Alibaba, about thirty young engineers sit elbow-to-elbow, working to attract the next million users for DingTalk, Alibaba's workplace communication software.

title: Facebook fakers get better at covering tracks, security experts say
description: Creators of fake accounts and news pages on Facebook  are learning from their past mistakes and making themselves harder to track and identify, posing new challenges in preventing the platform from being used for political misinformation, cyber security experts say.

title: ECB's Lautenschlaeger says worried about banking deregulation: Welt am Sonntag
description: An easing of European banking regulation risks taking power from regulators to ensure that banks have sufficient capital to withstand crises, ECB board member Sabine Lautenschlaeger has told a German newspaper.

title: Canada 'very keen' on wrapping up year-old NAFTA talks
description: Canada is "very keen" on concluding negotiations to renew the North American Free Trade Agreement as soon as possible, Foreign Minister Chrystia Freeland said on Saturday, amid signs of progress after months of delays.

title: China won't accept U.S. trade 'blackmail': state media
description: China's state media said on Saturday the government's retaliatory tariffs on $60 billion of U.S. goods showed rational restraint and they accused the United States of blackmail.

title: Berkshire Hathaway profit surges as economy gives Buffett a boost
description: Berkshire Hathaway Inc, the conglomerate run by billionaire Warren Buffett, on Saturday said quarterly operating profit rose 67 percent, as insurance underwriting rebounded and several business units benefited from a growing economy.

title: Facing U.S. tariff threat, Toyota warns car costs could rise
description: Toyota Motor Corp  on Friday said higher U.S. auto tariffs would ramp up the cost of vehicles produced locally along with those imported to the United States from Japan, which would have a "big impact" on its bottom line.

title: Traders see two more U.S. rate hikes in 2018 after jobs data
description: U.S. interest rates futures held steady on Friday, suggesting traders were sticking with their view the Federal Reserve would raise key overnight borrowing costs twice more in 2018 following a mixed payrolls report for July.

title: China's Unipec suspends U.S. oil imports as trade spat intensifies
description: China's Unipec, the trading arm of state oil major Sinopec, has suspended crude oil imports from the United States due to a growing trade spat between Washington and Beijing, three sources familiar with the situation said on Friday.

title: AIG shares slide 3 percent after executives downplay weak results
description: Insurer American International Group Inc slid more than three percent in morning trading on Friday after executives tried to downplay another weak earnings report and vowed a turnaround was on the horizon.

title: FedEx to not charge extra for most peak-season home deliveries
description: FedEx Corp  said on Friday it would not charge customers extra fees for most packages delivered to homes during the peak holiday shopping season, except packages that are oversized, unauthorized or require additional handling.

title: U.S. July payrolls rise less than expected
description: U.S. job growth slowed more than expected in July, likely due to companies' struggles to find qualified workers, and the unemployment rate declined, pointing to tightening labor market conditions.

title: U.S. June trade deficit posts biggest rise in 1-1/2 years
description: The U.S. trade deficit recorded its biggest increase in more than 1-1/2 years in June as the boost to exports from soybean shipments faded and higher oil prices lifted the import bill.

title: Amazon reports 1.7 million pound UK tax bill due to share deductions
description: The main UK subsidiary of Amazon.com Inc had a tax bill of 1.7 million pounds ($2.21 million) on profits of 72.4 million pounds in 2017 thanks to deductions related to share-based awards to staff, accounts published this week show.

title: China's Didi, Ant Financial weigh joint $2 bln Ofo buyout: source
description: Chinese ride-hailing giant Didi Chuxing and Alibaba's  Ant Financial are in talks with bike-sharing startup Ofo for a joint buyout offer that could value Ofo at up to $2 billion, according to a source with direct knowledge of the discussions.

title: Audi steps up production ahead of new pollution rules
description: Audi has stepped up production ahead of a September deadline when it becomes harder to register vehicles as roadworthy, the German premium carmaker said on Friday.

title: UK regulator confirms Disney must offer at least 14 pounds per share for Sky
description: Britain's takeover regulator said on Friday that a review had confirmed its ruling that Walt Disney might have to offer at least 14 pounds a share to buy UK pay-television group Sky.

title: For investors in Russia, U.S. sanctions will not pack the same punch as before
description: A threat to impose sanctions on Russian sovereign debt transactions is one of the biggest financial weapons that the U.S. can deploy against the Kremlin, but Moscow's slide down the investment league table in recent years means the move will not pack the punch it once would have.

title: Opel to slow production at two German plants: newspaper
description: Carmaker Opel, a unit of France's PSA Group , plans to slow production at two German sites after the summer to help cut costs in response to declining sales, regional newspaper Allgemeine Zeitung reported on Friday.

title: Some FT reporters call on CEO Ridding to give back part of $3.4 million pay
description: A group of Financial Times reporters have complained about the pay of CEO John Ridding, who earned 2.6 million pounds ($3.4 million) in 2017, and called for him to give back some of the money, according to an email seen by Reuters.

title: Cashing in on DNA: race on to unlock value in genetic data
description: How much is your DNA worth? As millions of people pay for home tests to check on ancestry or health risks, genetic data is becoming an increasingly valuable resource for drugmakers, triggering a race to create a DNA marketplace.

title: Japan weighs sovereign wealth fund for U.S infrastructure investment: Nikkei
description: Japan is considering creating a sovereign wealth fund to invest in U.S. infrastructure projects and U.S.-Japan joint projects in third countries and will float the idea at two-way trade talks in Washington next week, the Nikkei daily reported on Friday.

title: Czech leader's planned spending spree has some people worried
description: Leaders tend to rein in generous election promises once they come to power; few tour the country adding more, as Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis has been doing.

title: U.S. TIPS breakeven rate pares gains after July payrolls data
description: The bond market's gauge of investors' inflation expectations trimmed earlier gains on Friday as nominal Treasury yields fell in the wake of government data that showed jobs growth was short of analyst expectations in July.

title: Heineken toasts $3.1 billion China Resources Beer premium tie-up
description: Heineken  is taking a $3.1 billion stake in the parent of China Resources Beer , China's top brewer, to tap a growing thirst for premium brands in the world's biggest beer market.

title: White House says Trump's resolve is firm on China trade
description: A top White House adviser warned China on Friday not to underestimate U.S. President Donald Trump's resolve in a brewing trade battle between the world's two largest economies, showing little concern over Beijing's threat to impose retaliatory tariffs on $60 billion worth of U.S. goods.

title: China plans tariffs on $60 billion of U.S. goods in latest trade salvo
description: China proposed retaliatory tariffs on $60 billion worth of U.S. goods ranging from liquefied natural gas (LNG) to some aircraft on Friday, as a senior Chinese diplomat cast doubt on prospects of talks with Washington to solve their bitter trade conflict.

title: Exclusive: Deutsche Bank reports show chinks in money laundering armor
description: Deutsche Bank has uncovered shortcomings in its ability to fully identify clients and the source of their wealth, internal documents seen by Reuters show, more than a year after it was fined nearly $700 million for allowing money laundering.

title: U.S. court allows release of bench transcripts in AT&T merger fight
description: An appeals court that is hearing the U.S. Justice Department's fight with AT&T  over its merger with Time Warner agreed on Friday to allow the release of transcripts of bench conferences that the public was unable to listen in on during the trial in a lower court.

title: Wells Fargo faces tax credit probes, new problems with mortgage borrowers
description: Wells Fargo & Co  is facing government probes into its use of low-income housing tax credits, and has also set aside $8 million to compensate borrowers who were incorrectly denied mortgage modifications under a federal assistance program, the bank said in a regulatory filing on Friday.

title: Wall Street gains as upbeat earnings trump trade jitters
description: U.S. stocks advanced on Friday as upbeat earnings helped investors shrug off heightened trade anxieties and weaker-than-expected July jobs growth.

title: Race is on for second place after Apple's $1 trillion valuation
description: Amazon , Microsoft  and Alphabet  are locked in a tight race to become the second publicly-listed U.S. company to reach a $1 trillion stock market value after Apple  became the first to touch the 13-digit milestone.

title: China tariffs on LNG, oil aim at U.S. energy dominance agenda
description: China's proposed tariffs on U.S. liquefied natural gas and crude oil exports opens a new front in the trade war between the two countries, at a time when the White House is trumpeting growing U.S. energy export prowess.

title: Dish results beat estimates, shares jump 14.5 percent

title: Apple's pricey iPhone X, subscriptions deliver earnings beat
description: Apple Inc sales led by the pricey iPhone X pushed quarterly results far beyond Wall Street targets on Tuesday, with subscriptions from App Store, Apple Music and iCloud services bolstering business.

title: Carlyle Group signs lease at One Vanderbilt in New York
description: SL Green Realty Corp , a major New York landlord, said on Tuesday that The Carlyle Group LP signed a 15-year lease for three floors at One Vanderbilt, a marquee office tower that is part of a bevy of new buildings redefining the city's skyline.

title: Pfizer CEO believes U.S. will eliminate rebates on prescription drugs
description: Pfizer Inc  Chief Executive Ian Read said on Tuesday that he believes the Trump administration intends to eliminate rebates on prescription drug purchases, but he does not know how quickly such a policy could be implemented.

title: Devon Energy misses profit estimates as costs, oil hedges weigh
description: U.S. oil producer Devon Energy Corp  on Tuesday missed Wall Street estimates for quarterly profit as expenses rose and a misplaced bet on the direction of oil prices offset higher oil output.

title: Apple buybacks eclipse value of most S&P 500 companies
description: Apple Inc said on Tuesday it handed its shareholders $20 billion through share buybacks in the June quarter, bringing its tally this year to a record $43 billion and helping push its stock price to an all-time high.

title: Third Point seeks allies to put pressure on Campbell Soup: sources
description: Activist hedge fund Third Point LLC is meeting with some of Campbell Soup Co's  largest shareholders to seek support for changes at the U.S. consumer company, people familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

title: Wall St. bounces back, led by industrials
description: U.S. stocks rebounded on Tuesday, boosted by gains in industrial shares following reports of renewed trade negotiations between the United States and China.

title: Credit Suisse charged with rigging foreign exchange rates
description: Credit Suisse has been charged by European Union antitrust regulators with rigging foreign exchange rates, the Swiss bank said on Tuesday, a sign that the five-year long EU investigation may reach a conclusion in the coming months.

title: DoubleLine's Gundlach: Short-maturity U.S. Treasuries look attractive
description: Jeffrey Gundlach, chief executive of DoubleLine Capital, said on Tuesday that short-maturity U.S. Treasuries "look as good" relative to stocks and long-maturing bonds than they have in a long time.

title: Dialog Semiconductor ends talks to buy Synaptics
description: Dialog Semiconductor Plc said on Tuesday it has ended discussions with Synaptics Inc about a potential acquisition of the U.S. touch-pad technology company, without citing a reason.

title: Sanofi has been stockpiling drugs for no-deal Brexit: WSJ
description: French drugmaker Sanofi  has been making drug-shortage contingency plans for more than a year to prepare for Britain and the European Union failing to reach a Brexit transition deal, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing a source.

title: MGM Resorts signs sports betting agreement with NBA
description: MGM Resorts International  said on Tuesday it signed an agreement with the NBA to become the basketball league's first sports betting partner.

title: Mexico president-elect Lopez Obrador sees NAFTA deal soon
description: Mexican presidential winner Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador said on Tuesday that he expected there would be an agreement in the renegotiation of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) in the coming days.

title: Pfizer CEO expects Trump to eliminate drug rebates
description: Pfizer Inc  Chief Executive Ian Read said on Tuesday he believes the Trump administration intends to stop the practice of allowing rebates on prescription drug purchases, suggesting that U.S. drug pricing reforms may focus on middlemen rather than drugmakers.

title: China will strive to hit growth target despite trade tensions with U.S.
description: China will keep its economic growth within a reasonable range and achieve this year's target despite challenges, the state-run Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday as a trade war with the United States intensifies.

title: Cummins to recall 500,000 U.S. trucks over faulty emissions part
description: Cummins Inc has agreed to recall about 500,000 medium- and heavy-duty trucks in the United States to correct a faulty emissions control system in the engines it made for the trucks, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said on Tuesday.

title: L.A. prosecutors decline to pursue sex abuse charges against CBS CEO Moonves
description: Los Angeles prosecutors said on Tuesday that they had declined to pursue three accusations of sexual abuse against CBS Corp  Chief Executive Les Moonves dating back to the 1980s because the statute of limitations had expired.

title: Chipotle slumps 9 percent after Ohio outlet linked to food poisoning complaints
description: More than 100 people said they had fallen sick after eating at a Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc  restaurant in Ohio, sending shares of the burrito chain down as much as 9 percent on Tuesday.

title: Equities inch higher on U.S.-China talks report
description: Global stock markets inched up on Tuesday helped partly by a report that the United States and China were seeking to resume talks to defuse the battle over import tariffs, while the U.S. dollar rose against the yen after the Bank of Japan said it intends to keep interest rates low.

title: Mexico says dispute resolution, autos and sunset clause key to NAFTA deal
description: Mexico's economy minister said on Tuesday that among the top issues to resolve in order to reach an agreement on a new NAFTA trade deal are dispute resolution, auto sector rules and the so-called "sunset clause."

title: Global auto powers plotting response to Trump auto tariff threats
description: Canada, the European Union, Japan, Mexico and South Korea will meet in Geneva next week to discuss how to respond to threats by U.S. President Donald Trump to impose tariffs on U.S. imports of autos and car parts, officials familiar with the talks said.

title: Review of Toshiba’s delayed British nuclear plant raises new doubts
description: Delays to the planned sale of Toshiba's  NuGen nuclear project in Britain have prompted a review of the roles of 60 direct employees, who are mainly based in Manchester, raising further doubts over its future.

title: Exxon Mobil, Chevron earnings miss Wall Street expectations
description: Exxon Mobil Corp  and Chevron Corp , two of the world's largest oil producers, reported quarterly profit on Friday that fell far short of Wall Street's expectations.

title: Deutsche Bank shifts euro clearing as post-Brexit landscape emerges
description: Deutsche Bank  has moved the clearing of a "large part" of new euro-denominated derivatives trades from London to Frankfurt, as financial firms ramp up their Brexit preparations.

title: CBS board to discuss CEO Moonves investigation on Monday: sources
description: CBS Corp's board will discuss the investigation into allegations of personal misconduct against the U.S. broadcasting and media company's Chief Executive Leslie Moonves on Monday, according to two people familiar with the matter.

title: US Foods to buy SGA's Food Group for $1.8 billion
description: Food distribution company US Foods Holding Corp  said on Monday it would buy SGA's Food Group of Cos for $1.8 billion in cash and reported disappointing second-quarter sales, sending its shares down 15 percent.

title: Meat processor Tyson Foods cuts profit forecast on mounting tariff pressures
description: Tyson Foods Inc  cut its full-year profit forecast on Monday, citing the uncertainty in trade policies and increased tariffs that have hurt domestic and export prices of meat, sending its shares down 6 percent.

title: Air India seeks additional equity from government to pay vendors: source
description: State-owned carrier Air India has sought 21.21 billion rupees ($309 million) of additional equity from the government for the fiscal year 2018-19 to make pending payments to its vendors, a source at the airline told Reuters on Monday.

title: Exclusive: BMW to raise prices of two U.S.-made SUV models in China
description: German carmaker BMW  said it will raise the prices of two U.S.-made crossover sport-utility vehicles in China to cope with the additional cost of tariffs on U.S. car imports into the world's biggest auto market.

title: U.S. plans $113 million 'down payment on a new era' in Indo-Pacific: Pompeo
description: The United States will invest $113 million in technology, energy and infrastructure initiatives in the Indo-Pacific as part of a new strategy to deepen ties with the region, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo said on Monday ahead of a trip to Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.

title: Tesla explores building Gigafactory in Europe: Wall Street Journal
description: Tesla Inc  is in talks with authorities in Germany and the Netherlands to build its first major European factory, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing officials involved in the matter.

title: China tempts Britain with free trade, says door to U.S. talks open
description: China offered Britain talks on a post-Brexit free trade deal on Monday, reaching out to London as Beijing remains mired in an increasingly bitter trade war with Washington, even as a senior Chinese diplomat reiterated its door remained open for dialogue.

title: Exclusive: Russian steelmaker MMK changes tack after tariffs, Iran sanctions
description: MMK , one of Russia's largest steel producers, has postponed the launch of a lucrative project in Turkey due to uncertainty created by global trade wars, Andrey Eremin, the company's director for economics, told Reuters in an interview.

title: China offers to open discussions on post-Brexit trade deal: UK minister
description: China has offered to open discussions on a post-Brexit free trade deal with Britain, British Foreign Minister Jeremy Hunt said in Beijing on Monday.

title: How BP found shale profits with 'crystal ball' oilfield technology
description: In the pine forests of eastern Texas, oilfield workers equipped with virtual-reality goggles are helping BP's  shale business turn a profit for the first time.

title: Toyota plans to expand production, shrink cost of hydrogen fuel cell vehicles
description: Toyota Motor Corp  is doubling down on its investment in hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, designing lower-cost, mass-market passenger cars and SUVs and pushing the technology into buses and trucks to build economies of scale.

title: German prosecutors investigate VW ex-CEO's financial transfers
description: German prosecutors said on Monday they are investigating whether former Volkswagen  Chief Executive Martin Winterkorn moved some of his assets out of Germany following an inquiry into his role in the manipulation of anti-pollution tests.

title: AmEx raised currency prices for business clients without warning: Wall Street Journal
description: American Express Co  raised currency conversion rates for business clients without notifying customers in an attempt to boost revenue and employee commission, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: U.S. seeks to end criminal fraud case against bond trader Litvak
description: U.S. prosecutors on Monday moved to dismiss their criminal fraud case accusing former trader Jesse Litvak of lying to customers about bond prices, after two convictions of the former Jefferies managing director were overturned on appeal.

title: Ferrari bets on tobacco veteran in post-Marchionne era
description: Ferrari's  new boss Louis Camilleri has big shoes to fill but the tobacco industry veteran may have just what is needed to steer the luxury sportscar maker through its next lap, analysts and industry insiders said.

title: Brazil's Embraer to fight bid by leftist lawmakers to halt Boeing talks
description: Embraer  said on Monday it will defend itself against a lawsuit brought by leftist lawmakers aimed at halting a bid by Boeing Co  to take over most of the Brazilian planemaker's commercial jet unit, the latest legal headache for the proposed tie-up.

title: Chipotle shuts Ohio restaurant after reports of illness
description: Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc  has shut a restaurant in Ohio following reports of customers falling sick after eating there, the burrito chain said on Monday.

title: Uber to stop developing self-driving trucks
description: Uber [UBER.UL] will stop developing self-driving trucks that have been hauling cargo on U.S. highways, the ride-hailing company said on Monday, seeking to focus its autonomous-vehicle technology solely on cars.

title: With nimbler bikes, Harley sharpens Asia focus to revive growth
description: Harley-Davidson Inc  is launching lightweight motorcycles in Asia and electric bikes globally in the hope of reviving demand, as it faces falling sales in the United States and the threat of trade tariffs adding to its costs.

title: Widespread tech sell-off drags Wall St. down
description: A broad sell-off of technology stocks pushed the three major U.S. stock indexes lower on Monday, with the Nasdaq Composite posting its third consecutive loss of more than 1 percent for the first time in three years just days after hitting a record high.

title: Tech stocks pull down equity markets, euro gains
description: A gauge of global equity markets fell on Monday, pulled down by a sell-off in U.S. technology heavyweights, while the dollar slipped against the euro ahead of several central bank monetary policy meetings later this week.

title: Nokia reiterates outlook after announcing $3.5 billion deal with T-Mobile
description: Nokia  reiterated its outlook on Monday after it announced a $3.5 billion 5G network agreement with T-Mobile .

title: Nokia, T-Mobile US agree $3.5 billion deal, world's first big 5G award
description: T-Mobile US  named Nokia  to supply it with $3.5 billion in next-generation 5G network gear, the firms said on Monday, marking the world's largest 5G deal so far and concrete evidence of a new wireless upgrade cycle taking root.

title: Caterpillar paints upbeat picture of global economy
description: Caterpillar Inc  on Monday gave a promising outlook for the global economy despite ongoing trade tensions and mounting cost concerns, and the heavy equipment maker lifted its full-year earnings forecast after quarterly profits nearly doubled.

title: GE hires bankers to mull sale of digital assets: WSJ
description: General Electric Co  has hired an investment bank to organize an auction for its digital assets, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday citing people familiar with the matter.

title: Wary of China's rise, Pompeo announces U.S. initiatives in emerging Asia
description: U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announced $113 million in new technology, energy and infrastructure initiatives in emerging Asia on Monday, at a time when China is pouring billions of dollars in investments into the region.

title: Walmart stumbles with its 'last mile' package delivery plan
description: Standing before an audience of 14,000 people last year, Walmart Inc executives described a radical plan to help it fend off Amazon.com Inc and other online delivery services from stealing its customers.

title: Starbucks and China's Alibaba to partner on delivery: media reports
description: Starbucks Corp and e-commerce company Alibaba Group Holding Ltd are set to join forces on coffee delivery, according to media reports, as the coffee retailer seeks to rebound from a sales slump in the once-booming China market.

title: Bitcoin slips below $8,000 as investors step away from risk
description: Bitcoin briefly fell below $8,000 on Monday as investors scaled back their exposure to cryptocurrenices, after a sell-off in shares of technology and internet companies spilled over into other risky assets.

title: Singapore's offshore industry recovering, but no return to glory days
description: A big drag on Singapore's growth in recent years, the embattled offshore and marine industry, has broken a three-year losing streak. Yet industry executives aren't betting on a return to the glory days anytime soon.

title: U.S. stock index futures dip ahead of big earnings week
description: U.S. stock index futures dipped late on Sunday ahead of a week when more than 140 S&P 500 companies, including Apple Inc , will report earnings.

title: California farmers and Mexican cheese sales, U.S. trade war takes a toll

title: Economy, dollar, trade key to U.S. stocks' global edge
description: The ability of the U.S. stock market to keep an edge this year over equities elsewhere in the world hinges on the United States maintaining its economic and earnings growth advantage, the strength of the dollar and how global trade tensions resolve, investors said.

title: U.S. Treasury's Mnuchin says he sees at least 3 percent growth for next 4-5 years
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said on Sunday that he believes the quickening pace of growth in the nation's economy in the second quarter will persist for the next few years.

title: CBS probes misconduct allegations against CEO Moonves amid legal battle
description: U.S. broadcasting and media company CBS Corp  said it was investigating claims of personal misconduct by its chief executive Leslie Moonves made in a New Yorker magazine article that was published on Friday.

title: Iran woos local investors as U.S. sanctions loom, currency falls
description: Iran plans to offer price and tax incentives to private investors to take over idle state projects and help boost the economy, state media reported on Saturday, as the country faces likely U.S. sanctions and the exit of many foreign companies.

title: G20 agriculture ministers had 'frank discussion' about protectionism: Germany
description: The G20 agriculture ministers gathered in Buenos Aires this weekend had a "frank discussion" about the fact that they do not want unilateral protectionist measures, German Agriculture Minister Julia Klockner told reporters on Saturday.

title: Germany says U.S.-Europe trade tensions ease, questions remain on soy
description: The trade relationship between the United States and Europe is improving, German Agriculture Minister Julia Kloeckner said on Saturday, but there is no guarantee the bloc will buy the quantity of soybeans that Washington expects.

title: G20 agriculture ministers slam protectionism, pledge WTO reforms
description: Agriculture ministers from the G20 countries criticized protectionism in a joint statement on Saturday, and vowed to reform World Trade Organization (WTO) rules, but did not detail what steps they would take to improve the food trade system.

title: UK's Thomas Cook mulling airline sale: Sunday Times
description: British travel company Thomas Cook  is considering splitting off its airline and selling a stake to an outside investor to reduce debt, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.

title: Bank Leumi, Azrieli agree to sell credit card unit to Warburg Pincus
description: Israel's Bank Leumi  and Azrieli Group  have agreed to sell their credit card business Leumi Card to the U.S. private equity firm Warburg Pincus for 2.5 billion shekels ($685 million).

title: Trump to speak about economy after strong report
description: U.S. President Donald Trump was set to deliver remarks on the economy at the White House at 9:30 a.m. ET (1330 GMT) on Friday after the Commerce Department said the economy grew at its fastest pace in nearly four years during the second quarter.

title: Exxon quarterly profit misses due to refinery maintenance
description: Exxon Mobil Corp , the world's largest publicly traded oil producer, posted a lower-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday as its production dropped and it spent heavily to upgrade several key refineries.

title: U.S. touts EU trade truce, attention now turns to China
description: The United States signaled on Thursday it is set to push ahead on trade talks with Canada and Mexico after agreeing to suspend hostilities over tariffs with Europe in a fragile deal that may clear the way for renewed pressure on China.

title: Factbox: Impact of trade tariffs on European companies
description: Some European companies are rethinking their strategies to cushion the impact of trade tensions between the world's two biggest economies, the United States and China.

title: Thyssenkrupp to invest up to $250 million in U.S. elevator site: executive
description: German industrial conglomerate Thyssenkrupp  is planning to invest $150 to $250 million in a new U.S. headquarters for its elevators business, an executive told Reuters.

title: Qualcomm CEO in the ring alone after U.S.-China spat kills deals
description: Qualcomm Inc  Chief Executive Officer Steven Mollenkopf sought government help to block an acquisition of the U.S. chip maker on fears of China's technological ascendance, only to see his biggest deal thwarted by China.

title: BP pays $10.5 billion for BHP shale assets to beef up U.S. business
description: BP Plc  has agreed to buy U.S. shale oil and gas assets from global miner BHP Billiton   for $10.5 billion, expanding the British oil major's footprint in some of the nation's most productive oil basins in its biggest deal in nearly 20 years.

title: Amazon shares hit record high as profit tops $2 billion for first time
description: Shares of Amazon.com Inc  rose 4 percent to hit an all-time high after the online retailing giant's quarterly profit topped $2 billion for the first time, powered by its best operating margin in 13 years.

title: Dollar index trims gain after robust U.S. GDP data
description: The dollar pared its earlier gains against a basket of currencies on Friday as data showed the U.S. economy expanded at its fastest clip in nearly four years but they did not quell worries the pace of growth would slow due to tariffs.

title: U.S. says has addressed residual seasonality in GDP data
description: U.S. government statisticians say they have addressed a methodology problem, which analysts had argued tended to understate economic growth in the first quarter.

title: U.S. regulator stands by decision to block Winklevoss bitcoin ETF
description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday stood by a decision blocking an exchange-traded fund that would have tracked bitcoin, citing concerns about market manipulation.

title: China's ZTE revises down first-quarter profit after factoring in U.S. supplier ban
description: ZTE Corp   revised its first-quarter results to a net loss on Friday, after China's second-biggest telecommunications equipment maker took into account the impact of a crippling U.S. supplier ban that has now been lifted.

title: Instagram not an instant fix for ailing Facebook
description: Revenue forecasts from Facebook Inc that alarmed investors, fueling the worst day ever for its shares on Thursday, add to the pressure on its Instagram unit to win over more of the ad buyers that have long found success on the company's flagship app.

title: Mastercard reiterates FY expenses outlook
description: (This version of the July 26th story corrects to say company reiterated its full-year expense forecast, not raised the full-year expense forecast in headline and paragraphs 1, 2)

title: Sell long-in-the-tooth FAANGs, build up BRICs, say analysts
description: Investors poured $600 million in to U.S. technology stocks in the week leading up to poor results from Facebook , according to Bank of America Merrill Lynch (BAML) analysts, urging clients to sell the sector on signs inflows have reached bubble territory.

title: Thomson Reuters unit to be renamed Refinitiv after Blackstone deal
description: Thomson Reuters Corp's  Financial and Risk unit, in which U.S. private equity firm Blackstone Group  is buying a majority stake, will be renamed Refinitiv once the deal closes, the company said in a statement on Friday.

title: China says it is still open to talks on scrapped Qualcomm-NXP takeover
description: China's market regulator said it still hoped to find a solution to antitrust concerns that doomed Qualcomm Inc's $44 billion takeover of NXP Semiconductors, after finding that proposals to address the issue had fallen short.

title: As Hyundai struggles, its labor union shows signs of softening
description: When workers at South Korea's Hyundai Motor  went on strike last year, the stoppage lasted 24 days, triggered months of negotiations and netted them their smallest raise in nearly a decade.

title: Merck profit beats, but Keytruda sales fail to impress
description: Merck & Co  beat quarterly profit estimates on Friday as sales of its blockbuster drug Keytruda overtook rival Bristol-Myers Squibb's Opdivo, but that was not enough for investors who expected bigger gains in market share for the cancer therapy.

title: WeWork's China unit gets $500 million funding from Temasek, Softbank, others
description: The Chinese unit of U.S. co-working space provider WeWork Cos said it has raised $500 million from investors including Temasek Holdings [TEM.UL] and SoftBank Group Corp  as it looks to expand in the market for shared office space in the country.

title: Luxury group Kering's shares fall, Gucci seen bit weaker than forecast
description: Shares in luxury goods group Kering , which hit record highs last month, fell back sharply on Friday as traders said sales growth at Kering's Gucci brand had come in a bit weaker than forecast.

title: U.S. Senate quietly votes to cut tariffs on hundreds of Chinese goods
description: As trade tensions escalate between Washington and Beijing, the U.S. Senate quietly passed legislation on Thursday that would lower trade barriers on hundreds of items made in China.

title: Twitter warns fake account purge to keep erasing users, shares drop 19 percent
description: Twitter Inc  on Friday said it lost 1 million monthly active users from the previous quarter and warned the closely watched figure could keep falling as it deletes more phony accounts, causing the biggest one-day decline in its shares since 2016.

title: Wells Fargo apologizes to customers for recent account problems
description: Wells Fargo & Co  apologized on Friday to customers who were having issues with their bank accounts after getting a stream of complaints on social media about checks not clearing or mobile deposits not working.

title: Bayer hits back at new Netflix medical device documentary
description: Bayer AG disputed accusations in a new Netflix documentary that claims medical device makers and the U.S. Food and Drug Administration placed profits before patient safety.

title: City Council aims to make New York first U.S. city to cap Uber, others
description: New York City is moving toward becoming the first major U.S. municipality to cap ride-sharing services, sparking a tsunami of protest on Friday from Uber [UBER.UL] and others, which warned that those living in far-flung neighborhoods will suffer most.

title: Advisory firm ISS recommends against Rite Aid sale to Albertsons
description: Institutional Shareholder Services Inc (ISS), a shareholder advisory firm whose recommendations are followed by major mutual funds, said on Friday that Rite Aid Corp  investors should vote down its $24 billion merger with Albertsons Cos.

title: Higher U.S. soy imports won't harm EU farmers: German minister
description: An agreement by the European Union to increase soy imports from the United States will not harm EU farmers, German Agriculture Minister Julia Kloeckner said in an interview published on Saturday.

title: Tech stocks weigh on Wall Street
description: Wall Street's major indexes fell on Friday as weak earnings reports from major technology companies led to a big drop for the sector.

title: Facebook is sued after stock plunge 'shocked' market
description: Facebook Inc  and its chief executive Mark Zuckerberg were sued on Friday in what could be the first of many lawsuits over a disappointing earnings announcement by the social media company that wiped out about $120 billion of shareholder wealth.

title: BlackRock's Rieder halved fund's emerging market exposure
description: Top BlackRock Inc  bond investor Rick Rieder halved exposure in recent months to a once-major bet in his portfolios on emerging markets on concerns including that the dollar could move higher, he told Reuters on Friday.

title: Trump hails growth as one-offs and consumers boost economy

title: Global stocks end fourth week of gains on sour note as investors jeer earnings
description: World shares fell on Friday as corporate results and economic data failed to wow investors, leaving them to stew over trade tariffs and central bank policies.

title: Fox and Disney shareholders approve deal for entertainment assets
description: Twenty-First Century Fox Inc  and Walt Disney Co  said on Friday their shareholders voted to approve Disney's $71 billion purchase of Fox's film and television assets.

title: Exclusive: China eyes infrastructure boost to cushion growth as trade war escalates - sources
description: China plans to put more money into infrastructure projects and ease borrowing curbs on local governments to help soften the blow to the economy from the Sino-U.S. trade war, policy sources told Reuters.

title: U.S. appeals court to reconsider Hyundai-Kia gas mileage settlement
description: A U.S. appeals court will reconsider its decision to throw out a $210 million nationwide class-action settlement for owners of Hyundai Motor Co  and Kia Motors Corp  vehicles whose fuel economy was inflated.

title: Sanctions blamed as Silicon Valley firms won't ship some kit to Russia

title: IBM wins $83 million from Groupon in internet patent fight
description: A U.S. jury on Friday awarded International Business Machines Corp  $83 million in a patent dispute with e-commerce company Groupon Inc .

title: Factbox: Trump touts strong economy; facts are more nuanced
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday hailed a report on economic growth as a sign that the economy was mounting a remarkable turnaround under his stewardship. The facts are more nuanced.

description: Interactive Brokers Group said on Friday it will increase margin requirements for clients making Tesla Inc bets due to recent volatility in shares of Elon Musk's electric car company.

title: Caterpillar results likely to shed light on tariffs fallout
description: When Caterpillar Inc  reports earnings on Monday, investors will focus on the heavy equipment maker's ability to adjust its prices in the face of rising materials costs that are expected to pressure profit margins.

title: New York state revokes approval of Charter-Time Warner Cable deal
description: The New York State Public Service Commission said on Friday it revoked its approval of the 2016 merger agreement between Charter Communications Inc  and Time Warner Cable, saying Charter failed to build out its network for enough homes and that the company must end its operations in the state.

title: Intel shares slip on fears of AMD data center chip challenge
description: Intel Corp  shares fell 9 percent on Friday, after the chipmaker's upbeat results were overshadowed by concerns that Advanced Micro Devices Inc  may be chiseling off market share from its high-margin data center business.

title: U.S. Treasury chief: 'Disappointed' Qualcomm deal not ok'd: CNBC
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin on Thursday said he was very disappointed over Qualcomm Inc's  failed bid to buy NXP Semiconductors NV  after China did not approve the deal, calling it "unfortunate."

title: Nokia's IP routing business hit by component shortage: CEO
description: Nokia's  second-quarter sales of IP routers were held back by component supply shortages, the network equipment maker's chief executive said on Thursday.

title: Nestle CEO says is in full agreement with chairman on strategy
description: Nestle  Chief Executive Mark Schneider on Thursday defended the food giant's efforts to improve margins without sacrificing growth, also countering speculation he could be in disagreement with Chairman Paul Bulcke on the strategy.

title: Sky expands against backdrop of takeover battle finale
description: Sky  posted double-digit earnings growth after it added another 500,000 customers in its latest financial year, showing why Comcast and Rupert Murdoch's Fox are slugging it out to buy the European pay-TV leader.

title: Mercedes-Benz mulls production shift away from U.S. but no decision taken
description: German carmaker Daimler  on Thursday said it was  looking at ways to mitigate the impact of a trade war between China and the United States, a step which includes a review of whether to shift some U.S. production to Asia.

title: 3M to pay $9.1 million over defective military ear plugs
description: The 3M Co. has agreed to pay $9.1 million to settle allegations it knowingly sold defective combat ear plugs to the U.S. military without disclosing defects that limited the effectiveness of the hearing protection devices, the U.S. Justice Department said on Thursday.

title: Raytheon earnings beat, but cash flow concerns hit shares
description: Tomahawk missile maker Raytheon Co  on Thursday raised its earnings forecast for 2018 and reported stronger than expected results, but its shares fell on investor concerns about lower cash flow for the year.

description: The former assistant chairman of China's banking regulatory commission has been sentenced to 16 years in prison for accepting bribes, state media said on Thursday, as the Chinese government clamps down on corruption.

title: U.S. jobless claims rebound from more than 48-and-a-half-year low
description: The number of Americans filing for unemployment benefits rose from a more than 48-1/2-year low last week, but continued to point to a tightening labor market.

title: Daimler CEO says weaker Mercedes prices tied to WLTP bottlenecks
description: Daimler  Chief Executive Dieter Zetsche said the introduction of the new WLTP emissions testing procedure was causing delays getting Mercedes-Benz vehicles certified for road worthiness, distorting supply and demand.

title: NXP launches $5 billion buyback after Qualcomm deal fails
description: NXP Semiconductors followed Qualcomm Inc in announcing share buybacks worth billions of dollars on Thursday as the companies sought to compensate investors for the collapse of their $44 billion merger due to Chinese opposition.

title: Daimler braced for emissions-test impact as profit weakens
description: Mercedes maker Daimler  blamed U.S.-China tariffs for a 30 percent drop in second-quarter profit and predicted a further decline as new emissions test standards hit sales.

title: Facebook's grim forecast: privacy push will erode profits for years
description: Facebook Inc's shares lost as much as a quarter of their value on Wednesday after executives said that profit margins would plummet for several years due to the costs of improving privacy safeguards and slowing usage in the biggest advertising markets.

title: Daimler to split business into cars, trucks, mobility units
description: Daimler  unveiled a new corporate structure on Thursday designed to give its trucks, mobility services and Mercedes-Benz car division greater scope to chase growth in an era when carmakers prepare to launch fleets of autonomous cars.

title: Retailers set sights on Facebook, Google ad revenue

title: Chesapeake Energy plans to sell Utica shale stake for $2 billion
description: Chesapeake Energy Corp  plans to sell all of its Ohio natural gas acreage to privately owned Encino Acquisition Partners for about $2 billion, the company said on Thursday.
