description: Business confidence among Japan's big manufacturers worsened for a second straight quarter in the three months to June, a Bank of Japan survey showed, with the outlook clouded by U.S. trade protectionism and rising input costs.

title: Walmart creates new executive role aimed at serving customers
description: Walmart Inc  has appointed a former American Express executive to the newly created role of chief customer officer, focused on attracting shoppers and offering better customer service, at a time when competition in the retail industry has made it tough to retain shoppers.

title: Wall Street ends higher, helped by tech rally
description: Wall Street ended higher on Monday after a choppy session, with gains in Apple and other technology stocks offsetting worries about an escalating trade war between Washington and its trading partners.

title: Trump threatens action on WTO after reports he wants to withdraw
description: U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to take action against the World Trade Organization on Monday after media reports said he wanted to withdraw from the global trade regulator.

title: ADM to buy French animal nutrition business Neovia for $1.8 billion
description: Archer Daniels Midland Company (ADM)  is in exclusive talks to take over French animal feed business Neovia for 1.5 billion euros ($1.8 billion) as part of the U.S. farm giant's strategy to expand in the fast-growing animal nutrition sector.

title: Tesla's all-nighter to hit production goal fails to convince Wall Street
description: Tesla Inc's  burning the midnight oil to hit a long-elusive target of making 5,000 Model 3 vehicles per week failed to convince Wall Street that the electric carmaker could sustain that production pace, sending shares down 2.3 percent on Monday.

title: Australia's Fairfax Media spinoff Domain names new CEO
description: Property classifieds website Domain Holdings Australia Ltd  named Jason Pellegrino as managing director and chief executive on Tuesday.

title: U.S. fund managers zero in on software as tariffs upend tech sector
description: Worries that a broadening trade war between the United States and China will upend the global supply chain are prompting some U.S. fund managers to buy shares of companies they believe will shield them from such disruptions.

title: Report of Trump bill rejecting WTO seen by trade experts as hot air
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has ordered the drafting of legislation that would mean abandoning key disciplines agreed at the World Trade Organization, Axios news website reported late on Sunday, to a skeptical response from trade experts.

title: Probe into Facebook's data breach broadens: Washington Post
description: A federal investigation into Facebook Inc's data breach with political consultancy Cambridge Analytica has broadened  focus on the actions and statements of the tech giant, the Washington Post reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the inquiries.

title: Trump makes veiled WTO threat after EU warning on car tariffs
description: U.S. President Donald Trump warned the World Trade Organization on Monday that "we'll be doing something" if the United States is not treated properly, just hours after the European Union said that U.S. automotive tariffs would hurt its own vehicle industry and prompt retaliation.

title: Loeb's Third Point takes new approach in battle with Nestle
description: For a year, billionaire hedge fund manager Daniel Loeb has watched quietly from afar as Nestle SA tries to energize its business. But his patience has worn thin and he has been telling associates and his own investors that time is now up for the world's No. 1 food company.

title: Top U.S. business group assails Trump's handling of trade dispute
description: The U.S. Chamber of Commerce on Monday denounced President Donald Trump's handling of global trade disputes, issuing a report that argued tariffs imposed by Washington and retaliation by its partners would boomerang badly on the American economy.

title: Boeing and Embraer close to final agreement: report
description: Planemakers Boeing Co  and Embraer SA  have prepared contracts of their proposed tie-up and are expected to submit them to the Brazilian government within two weeks, Brazilian newspaper Valor Economico reported on its website Monday.

title: Dollar rises as trade tensions attract safe-haven bids
description: The dollar started the third quarter on a positive note on Monday, benefiting from mounting global trade tensions and political developments in Europe, as investors scooped up the greenback as a safe-haven bet.

title: Study backs pay rise for New York City's Uber, Lyft drivers
description: New York City's cash-strapped Uber and Lyft drivers have been campaigning for bigger paychecks, and their effort got a boost on Monday from a study two economists conducted for the city's Taxi and Limousine Commission.

title: Tesla engineering head Doug Field steps down
description: Tesla Inc  said on Monday Doug Field, senior vice president of engineering, is stepping down after five years with the electric carmaker.

title: Dell moves to go public, spurns IPO
description: Dell Technologies Inc said on Monday it would pay $21.7 billion in cash and stock to buy back shares tied to its interest in software company VMware Inc , returning the computer maker to the stock market without an initial public offering.

title: Trade worries extend equities' slide into new quarter
description: The worst start to a year for world shares since 2010 continued into the third quarter on Monday, with another slump in Chinese shares and weakening global factory surveys leading global equity markets lower.

title: Nissan calls off potential $1 billion sale of battery unit to China's GSR
description: Nissan Motor  cancelled a potential $1 billion sale of its electric car battery unit to China's GSR Capital, and while the automaker said it still aimed to find a buyer, analysts feel it could be a hard sell as the technology was not cutting edge.

title: Saudi king said will boost oil output if needed: White House
description: The leader of Saudi Arabia promised President Donald Trump that he can raise oil production if needed and the country has 2 million barrels per day of spare capacity, the White House said on Saturday, rowing back on an earlier Trump tweet that appeared to suggest the Saudis had agreed to boost output by that amount.

title: China's ChemChina, Sinochem set to merge: Caixin
description: Chinese state-owned Sinochem Group [SASADA.UL] and ChemChina will merge to create a new company, and Sinochem Chairman Ning Gaoning will become the chairman of ChemChina, financial publication Caixin reported late on Saturday.

title: Iran eyes private oil exports to help beat U.S. sanctions
description: Iran will allow private companies to export crude oil, part of a strategy to counter U.S. sanctions, and is urging fellow OPEC members, including regional rival Saudi Arabia, not to break output agreements, state media and officials said on Sunday.

title: Trump sends high-level team to push exports at Farnborough Airshow: sources
description: The White House is sending a high-level delegation to this month's Farnborough Airshow to push the Trump administration's "Buy American" drive aimed at boosting exports of weapons and aircraft, industry sources familiar with the matter said.

title: Germany not ruling out further car recalls: transport minister in paper
description: Germany is not ruling out further recalls of cars as it continues to check the car industry for illegal software, transport minister Andreas Scheuer told a German daily.

title: Trump blasts OPEC, warns European companies against Iran ties
description: President Donald Trump lashed out at OPEC with a warning to stop manipulating oil markets and piled pressure on close U.S. allies in an interview that aired on Sunday with a threat to sanction European companies that do business with Iran.

title: Can Saudi Arabia pump much more oil?
description: The leader of Saudi Arabia has assured U.S. President Donald Trump that the Kingdom can raise oil production if needed and the country has 2 million barrels per day of spare capacity that could be deployed to help cool down oil prices to compensate for falling output in Venezuela and Iran.

title: Dell nears deal buy out VMWare tracking stock with cash and equity: source
description: Dell Inc. is nearing a deal to buy out the holders of shares that track the performance of VMWare Inc  using a mix of cash and equity in Dell, people familiar with the matter said on Sunday.

title: Dell near deal to swap out DVMT tracking shares: WSJ
description: Dell Inc is close to a deal to combine shares that track its VMware Inc virtualization-software unit in an effort that would result in a public listing for the personal computer and data storage company, the Wall Street Journal said on Sunday.

title: Japan June manufacturing PMI shows growth but export orders contract
description: - Japanese manufacturing activity grew at a slightly faster pace in June, but export orders fell more than initially reported in a worrying sign of the potential impact of a heated trade dispute between the United States and major economies.

title: Loeb pressures Nestle for more sales, restructuring
description: Billionaire investor Daniel Loeb on Sunday stepped up pressure on food group Nestle SA , in a letter that urged its board to be "sharper," "bolder" and "faster" in spinning off businesses and untangling its complex management structure.

title: China commerce minister says will significantly widen market access
description: China will significantly widen market access and oppose any kind of protectionism, Chinese Commerce Minister Zhong Shan said in an article published in the state-run People's Daily on Monday.

title: KKR seeks to woo investors with corporate rejig
description: KKR & Co  transforms into a corporation on Sunday, a change that should help the U.S. private equity firm tap a new pool of investors for its stock.

title: South Korea's Hyundai says U.S. car tariffs would harm security ties over North Korea
description: Hyundai Motor  cautioned the U.S. administration that imposing up to 25 percent tariffs on imported vehicles from South Korea would hurt a security alliance between the two countries over North Korea's nuclear ambitions.

title: Three quarters of big UK firms downbeat on Brexit: Deloitte survey
description: A record 75 percent of major British companies are now pessimistic about Brexit, a survey showed on Monday, adding to signs of anxiety around the economy as Britain's divorce with the European Union draws near.

title: Trump, Saudi king discuss oil markets, no mention of production plans
description: Saudi King Salman and U.S. President Donald Trump emphasized the need to preserve oil market stability and the efforts of oil-producing countries to compensate for any potential shortage, in a phone call reported by Saudi state media on Saturday.

title: Novartis chairman says Alcon worth $20 billion-$30 billion: Finanz und Wirtschaft
description: The chairman of Swiss drugmaker Novartis  expects Alcon to be valued at between $20 billion and $30 billion when the opthalmic devices unit is spun off to shareholders next year, he said in an interview with Finanz und Wirtschaft.

title: China further eases foreign investment curbs in free trade zones
description: China on Saturday further relaxed restrictions imposed on foreign investment in its free trade zones, in the latest step to fulfill its promise to open up the economy.

title: China factory growth slows in June as trade tensions rise
description: Growth in China's manufacturing sector slowed in June after a better-than-expected performance in May, official data showed, as escalating trade tensions with the United States fuel concerns about a slowdown in the world's second-biggest economy.

title: BMW says U.S. tariffs on EU cars may hit investment there
description: U.S. tariffs on imported cars could lead BMW  to reduce investment and cut jobs in the United States due to the large number of cars it exports from its South Carolina plant, the German carmaker has warned.

title: Trump, Trudeau discuss trade, economic issues over phone call
description: U.S. President Donald Trump spoke with Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau late on Friday to discuss trade and other economic issues, White House Press Secretary Sarah Sanders said on Saturday.

title: VW CEO says arrest of Audi's Stadler hard to comprehend: Bild am Sonntag
description: The CEO of Volkswagen , Herbert Diess, told a German newspaper the arrest of Audi head Rupert Stadler was a shock and hard to comprehend.

title: Saudi Arabia pledged to expand oil capacity if needed: White House
description: Saudi Arabia's leader has promised U.S. President Donald Trump that the country will produce more oil if needed and that it has 2 million barrels per day of spare capacity, the White House said on Saturday.

title: Nike returns to growth in North America, tops estimates
description: Nike Inc  beat fourth-quarter profit and revenue estimates as new launches and focus on direct-to-customer sales helped reverse declining sales in North America for the first time in a year.

title: JPMorgan Chase takes smartphone account 'Finn' nationwide
description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  said on Thursday that it is now offering a digital bank account for smartphones nationally after testing and refining the app in St. Louis since October.

title: Sprint names Andrew Davies CFO
description: Sprint Corp  said on Friday it named Andrew Davies chief financial officer ahead of its pending merger with rival T-Mobile US Inc .

title: German data, not politics key for trade war watchers
description: While German politics may dominate the headlines again in the coming week, the less attention grabbing release of industrial data could offer a better indication of the headwinds facing the European Union and its largest economy.

title: Novartis hands investors Alcon spin-off, $5 billion share buyback
description: Novartis  plans to spin off its Alcon eye care business to shareholders and buy back up to $5 billion in stock as Chief Executive Vas Narasimhan refocuses the Swiss group on prescription drugs.

title: Qualcomm extends NXP tender offer yet again
description: U.S. chipmaker Qualcomm Inc  on Friday extended the tender offer for its proposed $44 billion deal to buy NXP Semiconductors NV  for the 29th time as it awaits clearance from the Chinese government.

title: Oasis raises heat on Britain's Premier Foods over 'weak' brands
description: Activist investor Oasis Management stepped up its campaign against Premier Foods'  management on Friday, questioning the board's culture after its chairman Keith Hamill called some of its British brands "weak cards".

title: Deutsche Bank investors unshaken by U.S. stress test failure
description: Deutsche Bank investors took a largely long view on its failure in this year's U.S. stress tests, with its shares recovering on Friday from a record low hit earlier this week.

title: Blackstone selling two jumbo loans for F&R buyout
description: LONDON (LPC) - Selldown of the jumbo $13.5 billion financing backing Blackstone Group’s  $20 billion acquisition of a 55 percent stake in Thomson Reuters’ Financial and Risk unit is under way, banking sources said on Friday.

title: Spooked by Trump, Europe's Iranian oil purchases set to plummet
description: European refiners are cutting purchases of Iranian oil faster than expected as the U.S. prepares to reimpose sanctions on Iran, threatening a more severe impact than the last round of punitive measures in 2012 even though the EU has not joined in.

title: Bitcoin skids below $6,000, hits lowest level since November
description: Bitcoin's value slid to its lowest level since November on Friday, as waning investor interest and recent negative headlines from global regulators weakened demand for the cryptocurrency and most of its rivals.

title: Lloyd's of London's first female CEO to leave in 2019
description: Lloyd's of London [SOLYD.UL] Chief Executive Inga Beale, the commercial insurance market's first female CEO, will leave next year, Lloyd's said on Friday.

title: U.S. funds remain cautious faced with trade war threat: Reuters poll
description: U.S. fund managers in June replicated defensive recommendations from the previous month with slightly more cash, a Reuters poll showed, underscoring worries that a U.S. trade conflict with China and some of its own allies will hurt global growth.

title: CATL to build electric car battery cell factory in Thuringia: sources
description: China's Contemporary Amperex Technology Ltd (CATL) will build a battery cell factory in the German state of Thuringia to supply European carmakers including BMW , three sources said on Friday.

title: China's CATL battery factory plan for Germany is commercial decision: Germany
description: Chinese battery maker CATL's plans for a factory in Germany reflected a commercial investment decision and were unrelated to Berlin's plans to strengthen Germany's position in the field, a government spokeswoman said.

title: China says U.S. should tell airlines to change websites in Taiwan row
description: China said on Friday that the United States should tell its airlines to change their websites to refer to self-ruled Taiwan as Chinese territory, after the United States said China had rejected requests for talks on the matter.

title: Global funds cut stocks to 11-month lows, eye trade war risk: Reuters poll
description: Global investors cut equities to 11-month lows in June and raised cash levels as the U.S. ratcheted up trade tensions, but a majority of Reuters poll participants still expect world stocks to end 2018 higher after a volatile first half.

title: Japan's SoftBank hires Ford's chief lobbyist as it ramps up Washington profile
description: Ford Motor Co's  long-time top lobbyist is leaving the No. 2 U.S. automaker to join Japan's Softbank Group , which is muscling up its Washington efforts, the companies said on Friday.

title: China's Xiaomi raises $4.72 billion after pricing HK IPO at bottom of range: sources
description: HONG KONG (Reuters/IFR) - China's Xiaomi Corp  priced its Hong Kong initial public offering (IPO) at the bottom of an indicative range, raising $4.72 billion in the world's biggest tech float in four years, people close to the transaction said on Friday.

title: China Tower wins approval for Hong Kong IPO of up to $10 billion: sources
description: HONG KONG (Reuters/IFR) - China Tower, the world's largest mobile mast operator, has won approval in Hong Kong for an IPO that could raise up to $10 billion, according to people familiar with the situation.

title: BMW signs battery order with China's CATL
description: BMW  has awarded a contract worth just over a billion euros ($1.16 billion) to China's lithium battery maker  Contemporary Amperex Technology Ltd (CATL) , the German carmaker said on Thursday.

title: Japan's Sharp ditches $2 billion share issue plan after investor backlash
description: Japan's Sharp Corp scrapped a plan to issue up to $2 billion in new shares, changing its mind in a matter of weeks after the initial announcement prompted investors to dump its shares on fears of earnings per share dilution.

title: U.S. core PCE price index hits 2 percent; spending slows
description: U.S. consumer prices accelerated in the year to May, with a measure of underlying inflation hitting the Federal Reserve's 2 percent target for the first time in six years.

title: China's ZTE shakes up board in bid for U.S. ban lift
description: Chinese telecoms giant ZTE Corp announced a new board on Friday in a radical management shakeup as part of a $1.4 billion deal with the United States, moving it closer towards getting a devastating American supplier ban lifted.

title: U.S. bank shares rise on capital return plans after stress test
description: Shares in the biggest U.S. banks rose on Friday after the Federal Reserve completed its annual stress test giving financial institutions the go-ahead for plans to return capital to investors through dividends and buybacks.

title: Wall Street ekes out gain as Nike surges
description: Wall Street's major stock indexes edged higher on Friday, as a surge in Nike Inc shares helped the quarter close out on an upswing while concerns over U.S. international trade relations ebbed.

title: Oil gains on anticipation of sanctions on Iran
description: Oil prices rose on Friday on concern that U.S. sanctions against Iran would remove a substantial volume of crude oil from world markets at a time of rising global demand.

title: Missouri appeals court tosses $55 million J&J talc-powder verdict
description: A Missouri appeals court on Friday threw out a $55 million  verdict against Johnson & Johnson in a lawsuit by a woman who claimed she developed ovarian cancer after using  talc-based products, including J&J's baby powder, citing a U.S. Supreme court ruling on where such cases can be brought.

title: AbbVie, AndroGel partner owe $448 million in antitrust case: U.S. judge
description: A U.S. judge on Friday found that pharmaceutical company AbbVie Inc used sham litigation to illegally prevent generic versions of testosterone replacement drug AndroGel from getting to market and ordered the drugmaker and its partner to pay $448 million.

title: Stress test results signal more flexible new-look Fed
description: This year's Federal Reserve stress test results suggested a more flexible approach, a further sign the regulator's new leadership is responding positively to a Wall Street push for pragmatic bank supervision, analysts and lawyers said.

title: In farewell to U.S. shoppers, Toys 'R' Us urges 'Play on!'
description: As Toys "R" Us Inc stores across the United States marked their final day in business on Friday, the bankrupt toy retailer posted a farewell message to customers on its website next to an image of its iconic Geoffrey the Giraffe mascot thanking them and urging them to "Play on!"

title: Comcast says services being restored after outage
description: Comcast Corp  said on Friday services interrupted by two separate incidents of fiber cuts at its network providers    were being restored.

title: General Electric wins $437 million U.S. defense contract: Pentagon
description: General Electric Co  has won a $437 million modification to a contract for designing, fabricating, integrating, and testing complete, flight-weight adaptive engines, the Pentagon said in a statement on Friday.

title: Trump says auto tariff probe will be completed in three-four weeks
description: President Donald Trump said on Friday his administration's investigation into whether to increase tariffs on cars from the European Union and other trading partners would be completed in three to four weeks.

title: Treasury chief Mnuchin slams report that Trump wants to exit WTO
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin said on Friday a report by the Axios news website, that cited sources as saying President Donald Trump wanted the United States to withdraw from the World Trade Organization, was wrong.

title: Apple rebuilds mapping app, but will still tap TomTom
description: Apple Inc is rebuilding the widely used mapping application on its iPhones from the ground up with its own dataset, but Amsterdam-based TomTom NV will continue to be a data provider for Apple's maps app, Cupertino, California-based Apple told Reuters on Friday.

title: GM says U.S. import tariffs could mean 'smaller' company, fewer jobs
description: General Motors Co warned on Friday that higher tariffs on imported vehicles under consideration by the Trump administration could cost jobs and lead to a "a smaller GM" while isolating U.S. businesses from the global market.

title: Canada hits back on U.S. tariffs; Mnuchin denies Trump wants to quit WTO
description: Canada struck back at the Trump administration on Friday over U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs, vowing to impose punitive measures on C$16.6 billion ($12.63 billion) worth of American goods until Washington relents.

title: Canada hits back at U.S. on tariffs, says it will not back down
description: Canada struck back at the Trump administration over U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs on Friday, vowing to impose punitive measures on C$16.6 billion ($12.63 billion) worth of American goods until Washington relents.

title: Morgan Stanley pays $3.6 million fine for weak investor protection rules
description: Morgan Stanley  agreed to pay a $3.6 million fine on Friday after regulators found it failed to have systems in place to help it detect and prevent the misappropriation of client funds, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said.

title: After stellar run, smallcaps may see some turbulence
description: After a strong rally that saw the Russell 2000 notch a record in three straight sessions in June, smallcap stocks may be showing signs of slowing down, leading some market participants to question whether their recent bulletproof performance is starting to crack.

title: Nike shares hit record as investors cheer North America rebound
description: Nike Inc's  shares jumped 12 percent to their all-time high on Friday after the world's largest shoe maker saw a major sales rebound in its North America business and forecast strong growth for 2019.

title: Lawsuit targets 'hidden fees' in Wells Fargo finance programs
description: Wells Fargo & Co has been hit with a lawsuit by a Texas jewelry company accusing it of encouraging thousands of retailers nationwide to charge hidden fees to customers using financing programs created by the bank.

title: Citi avoids fine for overcharging interest to credit card customers
description: The U.S. regulator for consumer finance said on Friday it would not penalize Citigroup  for overcharging credit card customers provided the bank returns $335 million to the 1.75 million borrower accounts that are due refunds.

title: Tesla lagging on Model 3 production, workers say
description: Tesla Inc is not producing enough Model 3s per shift to reach the 5,000 per week target that Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk said it would reach by Saturday, three line workers at the company's Fremont, California, assembly plant told Reuters this week.

title: World stocks up slightly Friday, but down for June as U.S. trade policy unnerves investors
description: World stocks edged up slightly on Friday with Wall Street and European indexes rallying through the day, but overall major markets ended lower for the third straight week as U.S. trade policy took its toll on investor and business confidence.

title: German court orders Volkswagen to pay MAN minorities 300 million euros
description: A German court has ordered auto maker Volkswagen AG's  truck unit to pay 300 million euros ($350 million) to shareholders in MAN SE , ending a long-running court battle over its buyout offer.

title: Walgreens plays down Amazon pharmacy entry, but investors spooked
description: Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc's  chief executive officer said on Thursday he was not worried about Amazon.Com Inc's  push into the U.S. healthcare sector, but investors were rattled by the threat the online giant could pose to the sector.

title: Ex-Fed's Yellen sees meager pick-up from Trump tax cuts
description: U.S. President Donald Trump's tax cuts are likely to give only a meager boost to productivity growth in the United States, former Federal Reserve chief Janet Yellen said on Thursday.

title: Panasonic flags battery cell shortages as Tesla Model 3 output picks up
description: A pickup in production of Tesla Inc's  Model 3 cars, after earlier delays, has resulted in occasional battery cell shortages, a Panasonic Corp  official said on Thursday in a sign Tesla is in overdrive to meet its end-June forecast.

title: Visa, Mastercard close to settling issues over card-swipe fees: WSJ
description: Visa Inc  and Mastercard Inc  are close to settling a long-running antitrust lawsuit with merchants over the fees they pay when they accept card payments, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.

title: U.S. first-quarter GDP growth trimmed; labor market strong
description: The U.S. economy slowed more than previously estimated in the first quarter amid the weakest consumer spending in nearly five years, but growth appears to have since regained momentum on the back of a robust labor market and tax cuts.

title: LVMH cuts ties with Bono's ethical fashion brand Edun
description: French luxury group LVMH  is parting ways with the eco-friendly Edun label started by singer Bono and his wife Ali Hewson, transferring its minority stake back to the founders as the firm winds down its U.S. operations.

title: Rusal elects new board of directors in bid to escape U.S. sanctions
description: Shareholders at sanctions-hit Russian aluminum producer Rusal elected a new board of directors on Thursday in an effort to appease the U.S. and get the restrictions lifted.

title: Saudi-Russian axis rules oil markets as Trump fights Iran
description: Iran may be Russia's ally in the Syrian conflict but when it comes to oil, Tehran's arch-enemy Saudi Arabia takes precedence - if last week's OPEC meeting in Vienna is anything to go by.

title: Trump threatens Harley-Davidson over European production move
description: U.S. President Donald Trump threatened Harley-Davidson Inc with higher taxes on Tuesday and said the motorcycle maker, which he previously hailed as a model of American manufacturing, would suffer from a public backlash if it went ahead with a plan to move production for European customers overseas.

title: Britain's Tesco tests checkout-free shopping
description: Britain's biggest retailer Tesco  is trialing a checkout-free method of payment for its convenience stores, allowing customers to scan products on their mobile devices and then walk out with them, it said on Thursday.

title: UK takeover panel to review impact of Disney bid for Fox on Sky
description: Britain's takeover regulator is considering whether Walt Disney  might have to make a higher offer for Sky  in the wake of the U.S. company's move to hike its bid for Twenty-First Century Fox assets to $71.3 billion.

title: Workers can shield German conglomerates from GE-style breakups
description: The breakup of General Electric  announced this week has put pressure on German conglomerates to consider similar moves, but executives must take account of the labor unions on their boards who have the power to veto radical plans.

title: Madison Square Garden shares rise after company mulls spinoff
description: Shares of Madison Square Garden Co  rose 12 percent on Thursday after the New York Knicks owner said it is exploring a spinoff to separate its sports businesses from live entertainment.

title: Takeda shareholders bin proposal from anti-Shire group; only 10 percent in favor
description: A group of Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd  shareholders, who are trying to build support to block the $62 billion acquisition of London-listed Shire Plc , failed to get a proposal passed at the drugmaker's annual general meeting (AGM) on Thursday.

title: Twitter, Facebook launch tools to track advertising
description: Twitter Inc  on Thursday made it easier for users to identify political campaign ads and know who paid for them, as social media platforms faced the threat of U.S. regulation over the lack of disclosure on such spending.

title: Icahn cuts stake in Cheniere Energy, says confident on management
description: Activist investor Carl Icahn said on Thursday he had reduced his stake in liquefied natural gas exporter Cheniere Energy Inc  to 9.5 percent, but added that he was confident in the company's management and Chief Executive Officer Jack Fusco.

title: Amazon wants to foster small independent delivery fleets
description: Amazon.com Inc  on Wednesday said it would offer incentives to entice entrepreneurs to set up their own small package-delivery  businesses as part of Amazon's latest effort to solve the challenge of getting goods the last mile to customer doorsteps.

title: Exclusive: Generali to start exclusive talks to sell German life book to Viridium - source
description: Italy's Generali  is expected to start exclusive talks shortly over the potential sale of its 40 billion euro ($48 billion) German life insurance portfolio to private equity-backed Viridium, a person close to the matter said.

title: China says carefully monitoring U.S. policies on inbound investments
description: China's commerce ministry said on Thursday it would carefully monitor U.S. policies on inbound investments, stressing that the country opposes using national security as grounds to restrict foreign investments.

title: Factbox: Crossfire of tariffs as Trump rattles world trade order
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has rattled the world trade order this year by seeking to renegotiate the terms of some of the United States' trading relationships, in particular with China. He has imposed tariffs on some imports, in turn sparking retaliatory action by other countries, raising fears of a global trade war.

title: Exclusive: China shuns U.S. request for talks on airline website dispute over Taiwan
description: China has rejected U.S. requests for talks over how U.S. airlines and their websites refer to Chinese-claimed Taiwan, according to sources, including a U.S. official, adding to tensions in a relationship already frayed by a major trade dispute.

title: GM to transfer Vietnam operation to Vingroup's car arm, eyes sales boost
description: General Motors  has agreed to transfer its Vietnamese operation to VinFast Trading and Production LLC and distribute Chevrolet cars through the local carmaker, in a move that could help drive up its modest sales in the country.

title: Mulvaney-led U.S. CFPB slashes payday lender penalty: sources
description: Mick Mulvaney, head of the U.S. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, cut in half a fine that his Obama-era predecessor sought against a payday lender and dropped some of the agency's earlier claims in the case, three people familiar the matter told Reuters.

title: Trade war or not, China Inc already reining in American brands
description: As Beijing and Washington veer towards a full-blown trade war, American brands in China face what may be an even bigger threat: local rivals armed with innovative products and the Chinese government's blessing.

title: UK accounts watchdog probes Deloitte's audit of SIG's 2015, 2016 statements
description: UK's accounting watchdog said on Thursday it began an investigation into Deloitte LLP's audit of two annual financial statements of SIG Plc  and is focusing on the audit of cash and supplier rebates.

title: Walmart rolls out 3D virtual online shopping
description: Walmart Inc said late Wednesday it is introducing a 3D virtual shopping tour on its website that would help customers browse and choose items for their homes.

title: Ray Dalio's Bridgewater plans to become partnership: NYT
description: Bridgewater Associates, the hedge fund controlled by billionaire investor Ray Dalio, plans to become a partnership in the coming months, giving its top executives more say in running the fund, the New York Times reported on Thursday.

title: California lawmakers approve data-privacy bill opposed by Silicon Valley
description: California Governor Jerry Brown on Thursday signed data privacy legislation aimed at giving consumers more control over how companies collect and manage their personal information, a proposal that Google and other big companies had opposed as too burdensome.

title: U.S. fines CVS for failing to report opioid theft in New York
description: CVS Health Corp agreed to pay a $1.5 million civil fine to resolve U.S. charges that some of its pharmacies in Nassau and Suffolk counties in New York failed to report in a timely manner the loss or theft of prescription drugs, including the opioid hydrocodone.

title: Ex-Morgan Stanley adviser sentenced to U.S. prison for fraud
description: A former Morgan Stanley  adviser was sentenced to 20 months in prison on Thursday after he admitted that he misused client funds to invest in and support a wind farm project that a friend had decided to start.

title: China's penetration of Silicon Valley creates risks for startups
description: Danhua Capital has invested in some of Silicon Valley's most promising startups in areas like drones, artificial intelligence and cyber security. The venture capital firm is based just outside Stanford University, the epicenter of U.S. technology entrepreneurship.

title: Amazon, H&M and other multinationals pressing to soften Indian state's plastic ban

title: Deutsche Bank sells $1 billion non-performing ship loan portfolio: sources
description: Deutsche Bank  has found a buyer for the bulk of its bad ship loans as it seeks to draw a line under sour investments in the sector and to start a fresh push in transport lending, people close to the matter said.

title: Facebook's public relations chief to step down
description: Facebook Inc  said on Thursday that Elliot Schrage, who as head of communications and public policy has led the social network's response to scandals about privacy and election meddling, would step down from the company after a decade.

title: Cryptocurrency tether used to boost bitcoin prices, study finds
description: There is evidence that tether, a digital currency pegged to the U.S. dollar, may have been used to manipulate the price of bitcoin <BTC=BTSP> and other cryptocurrencies, according to a research paper released by the University of Texas on Wednesday.

title: Canada says agreed with U.S. to keep NAFTA alive, no talks set
description: Canada agreed with the United States on Thursday that slow-moving talks to update NAFTA should continue although they did not set a date for the next round, a senior official said in remarks casting further doubt on the chances of a deal this year.

title: Atlanta Fed raises U.S. second quarter GDP view to 4.8 percent
description: The U.S. economy is growing at a 4.8 percent annualized rate in the second quarter, the Atlanta Federal Reserve's GDPNow forecast model showed on Thursday, following data that showed domestic retail sales grew at its strongest pace in six months in May.

title: Euro falls most since Brexit as ECB delays rate hikes into 2019
description: The euro on Thursday suffered its worst day against the dollar since the UK's Brexit vote nearly two years ago after the European Central Bank unexpectedly indicated that it planned to keep interest rates at record lows into the summer of 2019.

title: AT&T closes $85 billion deal for Time Warner
description: AT&T Inc, the No. 2 wireless carrier, on Thursday closed its $85 billion deal to acquire media company Time Warner Inc after U.S. antitrust regulators indicated they would not seek a delay.

title: Instant View: Federal judge OKs AT&T takeover of Time Warner
description: AT&T Inc won approval from a U.S. court on Tuesday to buy Time Warner Inc for $85 billion, allowing AT&T to compete with internet companies that dominate digital advertising and providing new sources of revenue.

title: Renault boss Ghosn faces tight shareholder vote on pay
description: Renault  boss Carlos Ghosn faces another nail-biting salary vote when the French government, the carmaker's largest shareholder, is expected to oppose his 7.4 million euro ($8.7 million) 2017 payout at Friday's annual shareholder meeting.

title: Sorrell haunts WPP as shareholders rebel over farewell package
description: Angry WPP  shareholders rebelled on Wednesday at an annual meeting dominated by differences over the departure of the advertising firm's former chief executive Martin Sorrell.

title: Exclusive: Etihad Airways in talks to cancel, defer Boeing 777X orders - sources
description: Etihad Airways is exploring options with Boeing to cancel or defer orders for 777X jets worth billions of dollars in a fresh sign of the carrier's financial strains and potentially squeezing Boeing's newest model, four sources familiar with the matter said.

title: Volkswagen CEO says still trying to overcome diesel cheating scandal
description: Volkswagen's  new Chief Executive Herbert Diess said the carmaker was still trying to overcome its emissions cheating scandal after German authorities ordered the Wolfsburg-based company to pay a 1 billion euro ($1.18 billion)fine.

title: Linde-Praxair deal gets Brazil antitrust nod
description: Brazil's antitrust regulator on Wednesday approved the $80 billion merger of gas group Linde AG and Praxair Inc, as long as the companies go ahead with an undisclosed asset sale plan.

title: U.S. automaker GM names Suryadevara CFO to succeed Stevens
description: General Motors Co  said on Wednesday Dhivya Suryadevara, currently vice president of corporate finance, will succeed Chuck Stevens on Sept. 1 as chief financial officer of the No. 1 U.S. automaker.

title: U.S. accuses Fiat Chrysler, union of conspiring to break labor laws
description: Top officials of Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV and the United Auto Workers (UAW) union conspired to violate U.S. labor laws, federal prosecutors alleged in a court document, saying a former executive at the automaker knew bribes paid to union leaders were designed to "grease the skids" in labor negotiations.

title: Citigroup CFO sees flat second-quarter markets revenue versus year earlier
description: Citigroup Inc  sees second-quarter markets revenue coming in "flattish" compared to a year earlier, Chief Financial Officer John Gerspach said on Wednesday.

title: Investors wipe $3 billion off China's ZTE as U.S. settlement sinks in
description: Investors wiped about $3 billion off embattled Chinese telecommunications giant ZTE Corp's market value as it resumed trade on Wednesday after agreeing to pay up to $1.4 billion in penalties to the U.S. government.

title: Iran rebukes Trump for latest attack on OPEC
description: Iran responded to U.S. President Donald Trump's latest attack on OPEC on Wednesday, saying U.S. sanctions on Iran and fellow OPEC member Venezuela had contributed to volatile prices.

title: Toyota pumps $1 billion in Grab in auto industry's biggest ride-hailing bet
description: Toyota Motor Corp has agreed to buy a $1 billion stake in Southeast Asia's Grab in the biggest investment by a carmaker into a ride-hailing firm, at a time when traditional automakers are racing to team up with disruptive tech companies.

title: AT&T wins court approval to buy Time Warner over Trump opposition
description: AT&T Inc won court approval on Tuesday to buy Time Warner Inc for $85 billion, rebuffing an attempt by U.S. President Donald Trump's administration to block the deal and likely setting off a wave of corporate mergers.

title: AT&T legal win could spur another jumbo bond; more M&As
description: NEW YORK (IFR) - AT&T's court victory on Tuesday will likely mean the company will have to return to the bond market to fund its US$85bn acquisition of Time Warner, investors told IFR.

title: Breakingviews - New ZTE regime could climb out of big hole
description: ZTE is back to life, but faces a tough rehab. The Chinese telecommunications company lost nearly $3 billion in market value after its reprieve from a death sentence imposed by the Trump administration. That suggests concerns about a clean management sweep. If, however, ZTE can find decent leadership and stay out of trouble – big ifs, for sure – a 5G rollout holds real promise.

title: WPP says 30 percent of shareholder votes fail to back Sorrell remuneration package
description: Nearly 30 percent of WPP  shareholders failed to back its executive pay proposal on Wednesday as shareholders expressed their anger over the handling of founder Martin Sorrell's departure.

title: Hunt for new WPP CEO after Sorrell is 'well advanced': chairman
description: The hunt for a new chief executive of WPP  after the sudden departure of Martin Sorrell in April is well advanced and moving ahead rapidly, Chairman Roberto Quarta told the advertising company's annual general meeting on Wednesday.

title: WPP says four month net sales show improvement
description: The world's biggest advertising agency WPP  reported four-month net sales which were marginally up on Wednesday, and said it was focused on improving revenue and managing costs for the rest of 2018.

title: Nissan doubles down on emerging markets as U.S. sales slow
description: Nissan Motor Co Ltd  said on Wednesday it expects vehicle sales in some markets to beat industry growth, driven by countries including Saudi Arabia - crucial for the Japanese firm that is struggling with slowing sales in the United States.

title: Aerion signs up supersonic business jet customers ahead of greenlighting project: executive
description: Aerion Supersonic, the developer of a $120 million supersonic business jet, has signed provisional purchase contracts with wealthy customers as it looks to greenlight the project over the next 18-24 months, a senior executive said.

title: Exclusive: Saudi Aramco eyes partnerships as it expands refining, petrochems
description: Saudi Aramco plans to boost investments in refining and petrochemicals to secure new markets for its crude, and sees growth in chemicals as central to its downstream strategy to lessen the risk of a slowdown in oil demand.

title: Property agents abandon China's resort island as sales plunge on cooling measures
description: Tough measures to cool the property market in China's resort island of Hainan have put the brakes on a real estate boom and underscore the policy risks developers and investors face as the government tries to rein in prices.

title: Blackstone raises $9.4 billion for Asia real estate, private equity funds
description: Blackstone Group LP  said it has raised about $9.4 billion for two new funds - the largest-ever fund dedicated to real estate investments in Asia as well as its first private equity fund for the region.

title: Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi alliance says on track for cost savings goal
description: Annual synergies in the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi alliance reached 5.7 billion euros ($6.69 billion) in 2017, up 14 percent from a year earlier, the companies said on Wednesday, adding they were on track to meet 2022 cost savings targets.

title: Trump, Iran spar over oil prices ahead of OPEC meeting
description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Iran exchanged sharp words over oil prices on Wednesday, with Trump blaming OPEC for high oil prices and Tehran accusing him of stoking volatility after he withdrew last month from a global nuclear arms deal with Iran.

title: Facebook releases new privacy safeguards after ceding to pressure from advertisers
description: Facebook is installing new controls it says will better inform its members about the way companies are targeting them with advertising, the latest step to quell a public outcry over the company's mishandling of user data.

title: British lawmakers press regulator over PwC's BHS audit
description: British lawmakers are pressing the accounting regulator to divulge details of the misconduct that prompted it to slap unprecedented fines on accountants PwC and a former senior partner over a 2014 audit of now-collapsed retail chain BHS.

title: Treasury yields jump, Wall Street falls after Fed decision
description: U.S. Treasury yields jumped and Wall Street reversed earlier gains to close lower on Wednesday, after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signaled that two more hikes could be coming this year.

title: Madoff customers' recovery tops 75 percent with Merkin settlement
description: The court-appointed trustee liquidating Bernard Madoff's firm on Wednesday announced a $280 million settlement with one of the swindler's earliest investors, enabling customers to recoup more than 75 percent of the principal they lost.

title: Fed lifts rates amid stronger inflation, drops crisis-era guidance
description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates on Wednesday, a move that was widely expected but still marked a milestone in the U.S. central bank's shift from policies used to battle the 2007-2009 financial crisis and recession.

title: After nine years of U.S. recovery, Fed sheds anxieties
description: The Federal Reserve is guiding a U.S. economy that is as close to ideal as it could have dreamed a decade ago, when the darkest days of the recession forced it to take big risks to protect workers, banks and economies around the world from further devastation.

title: Facebook used less for news as youngsters turn to WhatsApp: Reuters Institute
description: The use of social media networks such as Facebook  to consume news has started to fall in the United States as many young people turn toward messaging apps such as Facebook-owned WhatsApp to discuss events, the Reuters Institute found.

title: Comcast offers $65 billion to lure Fox from Disney bid
description: Comcast Corp  offered $65 billion on Wednesday to lure Twenty-First Century Fox Inc  away from a merger with Walt Disney Co , setting up a bidding war between two of the largest U.S. media companies with its 20 percent higher offer.

title: Mexico judge cancels arrest warrant for JPMorgan executive, bank says
description: A judge in Mexico canceled an arrest warrant for the country head of U.S. investment bank JPMorgan Chase & Co  and another employee, the bank said on Wednesday, just days after it was issued.

title: Comcast prepares financing for 21st Century Fox buy
description: NEW YORK (IFR) - Comcast says it has "Highly Confident Letters" from Bank of America Merrill Lynch and Wells Fargo for its US$65bn 21st Century Fox bid.

title: Senate, White House gear up for battle over China's ZTE
description: Legislation to block the Trump administration's agreement allowing China's ZTE Corp to resume business with American suppliers could be killed in the U.S. Congress in the coming weeks, lawmakers and aides said on Wednesday.

title: Exclusive: Venezuela eyes first-ever refining of foreign oil - documents
description: Venezuela is considering producing fuels from foreign crude oil for the first time, according to planning documents seen by Reuters, as the country struggles to meet its obligations despite having the world's largest crude reserves.

title: Wall Street sees two more Fed hikes in 2018, three in 2019: Reuters poll
description: Wall Street's top banks expect the U.S. Federal Reserve to raise interest rates twice more this year and three times in 2019, in line with forecasts issued Wednesday by central bank policy makers who signaled a modest acceleration to their pace of rate hikes along with increased confidence in the economy.

title: Wall Street falls as Fed signals two more hikes this year
description: U.S. stocks ended a choppy session lower on Wednesday after the U.S. Federal Reserve raised interest rates as expected and projected a slightly faster pace of rate hikes this year.

title: Apple to undercut popular law-enforcement tool for cracking iPhones
description: Apple Inc  said on Wednesday it will change its iPhone settings to undercut the most popular means for law enforcement to break into the devices.

title: Ford says fuel cell venture with Daimler will close
description: Ford Motor Co and Daimler AG are winding down a joint venture formed to develop automotive fuel cell technology, Ford said on Wednesday, as both companies plan to take their respective fuel cell technology development in-house.

title: Volkswagen fined one billlion euros by German prosecutors over emissions cheating
description: Volkswagen  was fined one billion euros ($1.18 billion) over diesel emissions cheating in what amounts to one of the highest ever fines imposed by German authorities against a company, public prosecutors said on Wednesday.

title: Elon Musk buys 72,500 of Tesla shares
description: Tesla Inc  Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk bought 72,500 shares of the company's common stock, a regulatory filing http://bit.ly/2t4K2sY showed on Wednesday.

title: Traders see fourth Fed interest rate hike this year
description: Traders of U.S. short-term interest-rate futures increased bets the Federal Reserve will raise rates again this year and next after the central bank on Wednesday increased its benchmark lending rate and dropped its longstanding pledge to stimulate the economy "for some time."

title: Oil rises as U.S. inventories fall on strong demand
description: Oil prices turned positive on Wednesday after a bigger-than-expected decline in U.S. crude inventories along with surprise drawdowns in gasoline and distillates indicated strong demand in the world's top oil consumer.

title: Gasoline leads broad increase in U.S. producer inflation
description: U.S. producer prices increased more than expected in May, leading to the biggest annual gain in nearly 6-1/2 years, the latest sign of a gradual building up of inflation pressures.

title: Instant View: Fed raises rates again, sees two more hikes in 2018
description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates on Wednesday, a move that was widely expected but still marked a milestone in the U.S. central bank's shift from policies used to battle the 2007-2009 financial crisis and recession.

title: Fox shares pop ahead of expected Comcast bid
description: Twenty-First Century Fox Inc's shares hit a record high on Wednesday as approval for AT&T Inc's $85 billion buyout of Time Warner Inc spurred speculation that Comcast Corp would make an offer for most of Fox's assets.

title: M&A gates open with judge's blessing on AT&T-Time Warner merger
description: A federal judge on Tuesday gave a ringing endorsement to AT&T Inc's planned acquisition of Time Warner Inc without any conditions, opening the door for companies such as Comcast Corp and Verizon Communications Inc to pursue deals to buy creators of media content.

title: Uber hires Facebook's product director as its driver product head
description: Uber Technologies Inc [UBER.UL] has hired Facebook Inc product director Daniel Danker as its head of driver product, Chief Executive Officer Dara Khosrowshahi said in a tweet on Wednesday.

title: Brazil watchdog fines Morgan Stanley, Royal Bank of Canada for forex manipulation
description: Brazil's antitrust watchdog on Wednesday fined Morgan Stanley  and Royal Bank of Canada  a total of 42.9 million reais ($11.6 million) for meddling with foreign exchange rates charged to clients.

title: UAW elects new leader to face contract talks, federal probe
description: The union that represents factory workers at the Detroit Three automakers elected regional director Gary Jones as its new president on Wednesday, ahead of tough 2019 contract talks likely to coincide with declining U.S. sales of new vehicles.

title: IMF's Lagarde says global economic outlook darkening by the day
description: International Monetary Fund chief Christine Lagarde led an attack by global economic organizations on U.S. President Donald Trump's "America First" trade policy on Monday, warning that clouds over the global economy "are getting darker by the day".

title: Bank of America executive sees consumer unit's efficiency ratio flat to down
description: Bank of America Corp's  co-head of consumer and business banking said on Tuesday he expects the consumer banking unit's efficiency ratio to remain flat or improve further as it cuts more costs tied to moving physical checks and cash.

title: BMW says May sales of BMW, Mini vehicles dip due to China tariffs
description: BMW  said vehicle sales fell 2.1 percent in May, weighed down by China tariffs, the launch of a new model, and a 13.6 percent drop in German deliveries as cities like Hamburg started banning older diesel vehicles from key streets.

title: U.S. SEC charges Bank of America subsidiary $15 million for RMBS trader lapses
description: The Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday said Bank of America subsidiary Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc. will pay $15 million to settle charges that staff misled clients into overpaying for Residential Mortgage Backed Securities (RMBS).

title: VW board to discuss prosecutors' probe into Audi CEO on Monday
description: Volkswagen's  supervisory board will on Monday discuss German prosecutors' investigation into the head of its Audi brand, as the carmaker weighs up how to tackle the latest fallout from its 2015 emissions scandal, sources said.

title: Louboutin wins EU court battle over distinctive red soles
description: Christian Louboutin's battle to protect the distinctive red soles on the shoes he designs got a boost on Tuesday when the European Union's top court said their red color was separate from the shape of the soles, which is usually not protected under EU trademark law.

title: AT&T, Justice Department await decision that could determine future of media
description: AT&T Inc , which owns DirecTV, awaits a court ruling on Tuesday that will determine if it can buy Time Warner Inc , a decision that could prompt a cascade of pay TV companies buying television and movie makers and the first big test of the Trump administration's antitrust teams.

title: GM has no projects underway with Lyft, CEO Barra says
description: General Motors Co  Chief Executive Officer Mary Barra said on Tuesday the No. 1 U.S. automaker currently has no projects underway with ride-sharing company Lyft, in which it has a 9 percent stake.

title: With assembly team and samosas, IKEA lays ground for India debut
description: IKEA is set to open its first store in India next month, and the world's biggest furniture retailer is localizing its offering - from the food menu to its "do-it-yourself" (DIY) assembly model - to ensure success in the country.

title: McDonald's to post $80-$90 million charges for restructuring, layoffs
description: McDonald's Corp  plans to take $80 million to $90 million in charges during the second quarter from a restructuring at its U.S. operations that includes layoffs.

title: Trump, in trade feud with allies, say won't let them take advantage of U.S.
description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday kept up his feud with  America's closest allies over trade, saying he could not allow them to continue taking advantage of the United States.

title: Malaysia's attorney general says received 1MDB investigation papers from anti-graft agency
description: Malaysia's attorney general on Tuesday said he has received investigation papers relating to state fund 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB) from the country's anti-graft agency.

title: OPEC will squeeze oil buffer to historic lows with an output hike
description: The oil industry will face the biggest squeeze on its spare production capacity in more than three decades if OPEC and its allies agree next week to hike crude output, leaving the world more at risk of a price spike from any supply disruption.

title: Huawei patent case shows Chinese courts' rising clout
description: A smartphone patent fight between Huawei Technologies Co Ltd and Samsung Electronics Co  could reach a global resolution through a ruling by a Chinese court, a development that reflects the growing attractiveness of China as a quick and effective forum for intellectual property disputes.

title: VW's Skoda Auto May deliveries rise 13 percent
description: Global deliveries by Volkswagen's  Czech carmaker Skoda Auto rose 13.4 percent year-on-year in May, posting the best-ever result for the month thanks to double-digit growth in China and Russia.

title: Top WPP shareholder says to back re-election of board at AGM
description: Top WPP  shareholder Harris Associates said on Tuesday it would back the re-election of the board of the advertising company, which has faced criticism over its handling of the departure of founder Martin Sorrell.

title: China's ZTE to resume trading after $1.4 billion U.S. settlement
description: ZTE Corp   said trading in its shares would  resume on Wednesday, ending a two-month suspension, after the Chinese telecommunications giant agreed to pay up to $1.4 billion in penalties to the U.S. government and radically overhaul its management.

title: Financial crime task force eyeing binding crypto exchange rules: Japan official
description: International financial crime-fighting group Financial Action Task Force (FATF) will start discussions later this month on introducing binding rules governing cryptocurrency exchanges, a Japanese government official familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

title: Rio Tinto hires CFO from Danish shipper Maersk
description: Major miner Rio Tinto   named Jacob Stausholm, formerly CFO of Danish shipping company A.P. Moller-Maersk, to replace outgoing financial boss Chris Lynch when he retires in September, the Anglo-Australian mining company said on Tuesday.

title: Ericsson doubles its 2023 forecast for IoT connections
description: Ericsson has almost doubled its forecast for connected cellular Internet of Things (IoT) in 2023 to 3.5 billion, the mobile telecom gear maker said on Tuesday.

title: Malaysia says U.S. to monetize and return assets seized from 1MDB probe
description: The U.S. ambassador to Malaysia has told Kuala Lumpur that assets seized by the United States as part of its probe into the 1MDB fund will be monetized and returned to Malaysia, the Southeast Asian nation's finance minister said.

title: Telecom Italia agrees measures with unions equivalent to 4,500 layoffs: source
description: An accord Telecom Italia signed with trade unions Monday night will achieve savings equivalent to 4,500 layoffs through so-called 'solidarity' measures, a source familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

title: Domino's Pizza says CFO leaves, outlook on track
description: Domino's Pizza Group  said its chief financial officer Rachel Osborne had left with immediate effect, in a statement which reiterated that the biggest pizza delivery firm in Britain was on track to meet guidance.

title: L'Oreal to appeal after UK setback in haircare patent row
description: L'Oreal , maker of brands like Lancome and Maybelline, said on Tuesday it would seek to appeal a British court ruling favoring a U.S. start-up that accuses the French cosmetics giant of infringing its patent on a haircare product.

title: Trial begins in $20 million insider trading case over hacked press releases
description: Nearly three years after federal prosecutors unveiled a landmark case charging nine people with trading on inside information stolen through computer hacking, a trial of two of the defendants began on Tuesday.

title: Hurt in past by false dawns, Chinese businessman is wary of bets on North Korea opening up
description: Property speculators in China may be betting that Tuesday's U.S.-North Korea summit will unlock riches across the border but Chinese construction machinery dealer Wang Chenglin is far from convinced.

title: Dissident doyen set to rejoin Fed's rate-setting panel
description: The U.S. central bank's staunchest advocate for faster interest-rate hikes is set to regain the power to vote at the Federal Reserve's rate-setting meetings starting next month, but the shift is unlikely to mean faster rate hikes under Chair Jerome Powell.

title: Exclusive: Exxon Mobil breaks with past, bulks up energy trading to boost profit
description: Exxon Mobil Corp  is pushing deeper into energy trading, building a global cadre of experienced traders and beefing up risk-management systems to lift profit, according to executive recruiters and people familiar with the business.

title: Blackstone in agreement to acquire Australia's Investa Office Fund for $2.3 billion
description: Australia's Investa Office Fund (IOF)  and Blackstone Group  on Wednesday entered into a scheme implementation agreement through which the U.S. private equity giant would acquire real estate investment trust for A$3.08 billion ($2.3 billion).

title: Tesla cuts 9 percent of workforce in search for profit
description: Electric car maker Tesla Inc  is cutting several thousand jobs across the company as it seeks to reduce costs and become profitable without endangering the critical production ramp-up for its Model 3 sedan.

title: Global stocks steady after Trump-Kim summit, investors eye Fed
description: Wall Street made modest gains on Tuesday while the U.S. dollar rose slightly against a basket of major currencies, with only muted impact from the long-awaited U.S.-North Korea summit aimed at denuclearizing the Korean peninsula.

title: S&P 500 ends up; Time Warner shares jump after hours
description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq ended higher on Tuesday, boosted by gains in the technology and utilities sectors, and shares of media and telecom companies jumped in extended trade after AT&T won court approval to buy Time Warner.

title: Guess Chairman Paul Marciano resigns after probe into improper conduct
description: Guess Inc  said on Tuesday its co-founder, Paul Marciano, had resigned as the company's executive chairman after a special committee completed an investigation into allegations of improper conduct.

title: Gundlach says 'excellent time' to shift into emerging markets
description: The recent selloff in emerging markets has provided investment opportunities not seen in years, Jeffrey Gundlach, executive of DoubleLine Capital, said on Tuesday, and he urged moving at least some money into emerging market bonds.

title: With rate hike in the bag, focus turns to Fed's policy language
description: With the Federal Reserve virtually guaranteed to raise interest rates at its two-day meeting this week, investors are focused on how the U.S. central bank characterizes its monetary policy as borrowing costs return to more normal levels amid an ongoing economic expansion.

title: Morgan Stanley's fixed-income business has great potential: CEO
description: Morgan Stanley  Chief Executive Officer James Gorman said on Tuesday that in recent years the bank's fixed-income group has had the greatest opportunity for delivering growth.

title: AT&T to close Time Warner purchase by June 20: attorney
description: AT&T plans to close its purchase of Time Warner Inc no later than June 20 after a U.S. court decided it could move ahead with the deal, the company's lead attorney said on Tuesday.

title: Qualcomm will not exit data center business, chip chief says
description: Qualcomm Inc has no plans to abandon its efforts to create processors for data centers, the company's president, who oversees the chip division, said.

title: As millennials age, more U.S. companies look ahead to Generation Z
description: After a decade of focusing on the so-called millennial generation, some U.S. companies are starting to look ahead to what’s next.

title: U.S. government posts $147 billion deficit in May
description: The U.S. government had a $147 billion budget deficit in May, an increase of 66 percent from the same month last year as the ledger took a hit from declining revenue and higher spending, according to Treasury Department data released on Tuesday.

title: Bitcoin sinks to two-month low as downtrend persists
description: Bitcoin fell to a two-month low on Tuesday, sliding in three of the last four sessions on nagging regulatory and security concerns after the weekend hacking of South Korean cryptocurrency exchange Coinrail.

title: Wells Fargo workers push for more board access, so far in vain
description: A labor-backed group is stepping up pressure on Wells Fargo & Co  to add an employee to a council that has the ear of the bank's board and management, arguing workers deserve a voice as Wells Fargo works to get past a damaging scandal over sales practices.

title: Union leaders to meet General Electric in bid to save Virginia jobs
description: Union leaders plan to meet with General Electric Co on Wednesday in a bid to avert closure of a Virginia factory that makes controls for GE's power plants, the company and the union said on Tuesday.

title: Farewell package for WPP's Sorrell faces investor backlash
description: WPP's  decision to allow founder Martin Sorrell to quit with share awards worth millions of pounds faced fresh opposition on Tuesday as Hermes EOS advised shareholders to vote against the advertising giant's remuneration report.

title: New York top court narrows Martin Act in $11 billion Credit Suisse case
description: New York's highest court on Tuesday curbed the state attorney general's ability to fight fraud on Wall Street, awarding a victory to Credit Suisse Group AG  as it tries to end an $11 billion lawsuit over risky mortgage securities.

title: Tesla short sellers $2 billion in the red for June as shares soar
description: The surging share price for automaker Tesla Inc  this month has slammed short-sellers of the stock with more than $2 billion in losses on paper so far in June, according to financial analytics firm S3 Partners.

title: JPMorgan is sued over Mexican property transfer
description: A Mexican real estate developer has filed a $1.2 billion lawsuit accusing JPMorgan Chase & Co  of fraudulently inducing it to transfer properties based on a false promise it would sell them.

title: Oil mixed as OPEC cites uncertain market outlook for 2018
description: Oil prices were mixed on Tuesday, with U.S. crude settling higher before falling in post-settlement trading, and Brent slipping as investors prepared for a key meeting of the OPEC producer group next week.

title: Two ex-Penn West executives must face U.S. SEC fraud charges
description: A U.S. judge has ordered two former finance executives at Penn West Petroleum Ltd, now known as Obsidian Energy Ltd , to face regulatory charges that they helped engineer a multi-year accounting fraud to reduce the Canadian company's operating expenses.

title: Biotech's Soon-Shiong hiring bankers for Nant cancer drug IPO
description: Billionaire Patrick Soon-Shiong plans to take an experimental cancer treatment company public this year and has begun hiring bankers, the biotechnology entrepreneur told Reuters.

title: Rolls-Royce, preparing to cut thousands of jobs, says engine problem has spread
description: Britain's Rolls-Royce  said a costly compressor problem that had grounded Boeing planes had now been found in a different type of engine, compounding pressures on a group that is due to cut more than 4,000 jobs this week.

title: Norwegian Air says Rolls-Royce engine problem a concern
description: Europe's third biggest budget airliner Norwegian Air said on Monday that summer traffic is running well but expressed concern about Rolls-Royce engine problems.

title: Daimler shares drop on report up to one million cars contain defeat device
description: Daimler  shares fell following a report that up to a million Daimler cars contained illegal defeat devices as Chief Executive Dieter Zetsche prepared to meet the transport minister on Monday.

title: Germany to determine number of Daimler cars fitted with defeat devices: ministry
description: German Transport Minister Andreas Scheuer will try to establish during a meeting on Monday with Daimler  Chief Executive Dieter Zetsche how many Mercedes diesel models were possibly fitted with devices to cheat emissions tests, a spokesman said.

title: Trump, Trudeau swap jokes but hold firm in trade dispute
description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau were all jokes and smiles for the media as they met at the Group of Seven leaders summit in Quebec on Friday, but neither budged on the serious trade dispute between them.

title: Takeda shareholder group aims to block $62 billion Shire deal
description: A group of Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd  shareholders is trying to build support to block the $62 billion acquisition of London-listed Shire Plc  at an extraordinary general meeting, a leading member of the group told Reuters on Monday.

title: HSBC to invest $15-17 billion by 2020 in push for growth
description: HSBC will invest $15-17 billion in the next three years in areas including technology and China as it swings from a strategy of cost-cutting to growth, new CEO John Flint said on Monday, while keeping profitability and dividend targets little changed.

title: KPMG fined $4.3 million in Britain over audit of Quindell
description: Britain's accounting watchdog fined KPMG 3.2 million pounds ($4.3 million) on Monday for failings in its audit of Quindell Plc, after the legal services firm twice restated its accounts leading to heavy losses.

title: Bitcoin tumbles as hackers hit South Korean exchange Coinrail
description: South Korean cryptocurrency exchange Coinrail said it was hacked over the weekend, sparking a steep fall in bitcoin amid renewed concerns about security at virtual currency exchanges as global policy makers struggled to regulate trading in the digital asset.

title: Bombardier JV wins $4.9 billion Los Angeles Airport contract
description: Bombardier Inc  and its partners have been awarded a $4.9 billion contract to build and operate a passenger transit system at the Los Angeles International Airport, the company said on Monday.

title: Pompeo says confident G7 ties will move forward despite clash

title: UK's House of Fraser to shut 31 stores, 6,000 jobs at risk
